31419.s: The bill modernises the Dutch public-law trade organisation system (product- and bedrijfschappen) by removing residence requirements, requiring members to be employed under civil employment contracts, introducing a four-yearly representative survey of business support, a Good Governance requirement with ministerial power to designate principles by AMvB, and strengthening SER supervision. It also abolishes annual approval of levy ordinances and adjusts ministerial approval and consultation rules.
31419.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as a way to set good-governance standards and ensure democratic legitimacy, with the code's principles designated by AMvB only if the voluntary code proves inadequate.
q: By general administrative order on the proposal of the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment it is determined that good governance of a schap as referred to in the first paragraph is in any case guaranteed if the principles of good governance designated in that order are met.

Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur op voordracht van Onze Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid wordt bepaald dat een goed bestuur van een bedrijfslichaam als bedoeld in het eerste lid in ieder geval is gewaarborgd als wordt voldaan aan bij die algemene maatregel van bestuur aan te wijzen principes van een goed bestuur.
d: repeat survey timing and procedures for business support research
further rules and designated good-governance principles for schappen
mandatory additional good-governance rules and manner of SER advice on support
SER may set rules on the manner of supervision by ordinance
p: Ministerial power by AMvB to specify and designate governance principles that bind the schappen's self-regulation.
Abolishes the annual re-adoption of levy ordinances, a temporary deduction is allowed for three years.

parties: Asks for a timetable and rationale for the draagvlak pilot and AMvB, and whether the AMvB will be pre-submitted to the House, while broadly welcoming the bill.
The conditions will, based on a pilot study with two trade bodies, be laid down in an AMvB.
De voorwaarden zullen, op basis van een proefonderzoek bij twee bedrijfslichamen, worden vastgelegd in een AMvB.
Asks for a voorhangprocedure so that AMvBs on the Code and draagvlak conditions are pre-submitted to the House, and questions the basis of the 60% threshold and disclosure of results.
The PvdA members consider it important that the AMvB is first submitted to the House for prior review.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie achten het van belang dat de AMvB eerst bij de Kamer voorgehangen wordt.
Argues the bill does too little to democratise the boards and demands that delegation provisions be submitted to parliament before entry into force.
They believe the delegation provisions in this amendment must be submitted to the House before introduction; is the government willing to do so?
Zij zijn van mening dat de delegatiebepalingen die deze wetswijziging bevat aan de Kamer moeten worden voorgelegd voorafgaand aan de invoering ervan, is de regering hiertoe bereid?
Argues the self-run draagvlak test and self-supervision are not independent, and that individual entrepreneurs lack direct control and voting rights.
If an organisation is to be assessed, it should be carried out independently and not by the organisation being assessed itself!?
Als er van een organisatie een beoordeling wordt verlangd, dient deze toch onafhankelijk te worden uitgevoerd en niet door de te beoordelen organisatie zelf!?
Asks how unorganised entrepreneurs are involved in the draagvlak survey, how the public interest is weighed, and why checks and balances are not legislated.
The SGP members ask why the necessary checks and balances are not legislated and regulated.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen waarom de noodzakelijke «checks and balances» niet wettelijk worden vastgelegd en geregeld.

31446.s: The bill makes technical changes to the Dutch housing allowance act: it fixes service-cost amounts, moves annual indexation of rent and income thresholds from 1 July to 1 January, and shifts the indexation of several amounts from an algemene maatregel van bestuur to a ministeriële regeling. It also makes a one-off correction to rent-indexation amounts and sets entry into force retroactively to 1 January 2008.
31446.j: The memorandum justifies the change by saying the earlier voorhang procedure made the indexation method known late, burdening implementation, and that a ministerial regulation saves procedural effort.
q: Indexation will no longer be laid down in an algemene maatregel van bestuur but in a ministerial regulation, which also yields a procedural saving.

De indexering zal in het vervolg niet meer in een algemene maatregel van bestuur worden vastgelegd maar in een ministeriële regeling, waarmee het voorstel ook een besparing in procedurele zin oplevert.
d: annual indexation of service costs, maximum rent limit and norm income
adjustment of norm income to prevent unintended effects of measures above the minimum income threshold
annual indexation of maximum rent limit, norm rents, quality discount and cap limits by expected rent development
publication in Staatscourant of revised thresholds, rents and service-cost amounts by 1 November
p: Annual amounts that previously required an algemene maatregel van bestuur, subject to a pre-publication procedure in both chambers, are moved to a ministerial regulation without parliamentary pre-review.

parties: Asks the government to keep pursuing the date shift with the landlords' and tenants' consultation body and questions the changed indexation rule, which it says will often disadvantage tenants.
They urge the government to keep striving in the Landelijk Overleg Huurders Verhuurders (LOHV) for shifting the date from 1 July to 1 January.
Zij dringen er bij de regering op aan in het Landelijk Overleg Huurders Verhuurders (LOHV) te blijven streven naar verschuiving van de datum van 1 juli naar 1 januari.
Supports simplification but worries that a sizeable group of tenants will face higher housing costs from the service cost change and asks how vulnerable groups are protected.
Does the government share the PvdA members' concerns about the rise in housing costs for a considerable group of tenants?
Deelt de regering de zorgen van de leden van de PvdA-fractie over de stijging in de woonlasten van een aanzienlijke groep huurders?
Insists that the interests of rent allowance recipients come first, asks for compensation of adverse income effects and for indexation of flat-rate service costs.
How does the government intend to offer compensation for this, in light of its principle that adverse income effects of the proposals on citizens should be compensated as far as possible?

Op welke wijze denkt de regering hiervoor compensatie te bieden, in het licht van haar uitgangspunt dat nadelige inkomensgevolgen van de voorstellen voor de burger zoveel mogelijk moeten worden gecompenseerd?
Asks why a flat-rate instead of other options is chosen, raises risks of abolishing the suitability test and moving norm, and questions the indexation assumptions and staffing effects.
The VVD members consider the abolition of the suitability test and the moving norm risky where people may move into homes that are too expensive yet keep receiving rent allowance.
De leden van de VVD-fractie achten de afschaffing van de passendheidstoets en de verhuisnorm risicovol wanneer het gaat om mensen die te duur kunnen gaan wonen en toch huurtoeslag blijven ontvangen.
Asks questions about the distribution of the service cost flat-rate by income and the number of households losing out, and about how service costs develop relative to inflation.
The said members wonder whether this is bearable for the lowest income groups.
Genoemde leden vragen zich af of dit te dragen is voor de laagste inkomensgroepen.

31518.s: The bill inserts a new title into the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure creating a 'deelgeschil' (partial dispute) procedure, allowing either the injured party or the liable party to ask a court for a binding ruling on part of a personal injury or fatal damage claim during out-of-court negotiations. It also extends the limitation period for insurer negotiations and requires a review of the procedure's effectiveness within five years.
31518.j: The memorandum justifies the new procedure as a means to speed up out-of-court settlement and reduce pressure on the courts, without delegating new powers to the executive.
q: This proposal provides for a new form of procedure for this purpose.
Dit voorstel voorziet daartoe in een nieuwe procesvorm

parties: Asks why the partial-dispute procedure cannot be heard by the preliminary relief judge and how costly disputes will be bounded, and questions the expected reduction in court workload.
The CDA members ask why the partial-dispute procedure cannot take place before the preliminary relief judge.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen waarom de deelgeschilprocedure niet plaats kan vinden voor de voorzieningenrechter.

Stresses the fundamental inequality between victim and insurer and asks for a dispute procedure available only on joint request or as an extra access route for the victim, plus mandatory legal representation and no-appeal concerns.
For these members, the fundamental inequality between the victim and his or her opponent is paramount.
Voorop staat voor deze leden de fundamentele ongelijkheid tussen het slachtoffer en zijn of haar tegenpartij.
Supports the goal of faster settlement but questions whether repeated partial-dispute requests serve speed and whether a limit on their number should be introduced.
They ask why no limit was chosen on the number of times this is possible.
Zij vragen waarom niet gekozen is voor een beperking van het aantal keren dat dit mogelijk is.

Supports the procedure but asks how binding force is to be understood, when a judge may set the decision aside, and whether overlap with main proceedings and stacking should be excluded; also asks for a baseline measurement and earlier evaluation.
These members ask the government to clarify how the 'certain binding force' of the partial-dispute decision should be interpreted.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering nader inzichtelijk te maken hoe de «zekere bindende kracht» van de deelgeschilbeslissing geïnterpreteerd dient te worden.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill introducing a partial-dispute procedure for personal injury and fatal damage claims but warns that distinguishing binding material-rights decisions from other decisions in art. 1019cc Rv may create demarcation disputes and advises dropping that distinction. The government's reply removes the second paragraph of art. 1019cc, limits binding effect to material-rights decisions and convictions, and adjusts the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The distinction between binding material-rights decisions and other decisions in art. 1019cc may cause demarcation disputes over binding effect and should be dropped.

31527.s: The bill amends the Dutch bathing-facilities hygiene law and the Water Management Act to implement EU Directive 2006/7/EC on bathing water quality, introducing rules for designating and classifying bathing waters, monitoring, profiles, management measures, public information and closure or bathing bans. It largely delegates technical detail to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulations and assigns operational powers mainly to provincial executives (gedeputeerde staten).
31527.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to implement the EU directive's technical and administrative requirements and states the bill contains no rules beyond what implementation requires.
q: In line with the Dutch legislative guidelines on implementing EU regulation, the bill contains no rules beyond those necessary to implement the directive.

Conform de Aanwijzingen voor de regelgeving (Ar) betreffende de implementatie van Europese regelgeving bevat het wetsvoorstel geen andere regels dan die welke voor de implementatie van de richtlijn noodzakelijk zijn
d: start and end of bathing season and other time periods
classification of bathing water into poor, sufficient, good, excellent
cases in which designation of a location may be withheld
rules on public information about bathing water via media and technologies
information and data to be supplied to ministers
monitoring of bathing water and parameters
bathing water profile, assessment, management measures, and conditions for poor classification up to five years
closure or bathing ban for designated locations not meeting quality requirements
designation of bathing water function in water management plans
p: Provincial executives may order closure, bathing bans or negative advice where measures are infeasible or disproportionately costly, and the Commissioner of the King may act in cases of immediate danger.
Provincial executives gain discretion to withhold designation of locations and to order closure or bans for locations that fail quality standards.
The minister and provincial states may stop fixing the bathing water function in plans where measures are deemed unfeasible or costly, with tentative revisions allowed by provincial executives.

parties: Asks whether the bill imposes rules beyond what the EU directive requires and about administrative burden and the reporting obligations to Brussel.
They attach importance to the fact that this amendment prescribes no rules other than those necessarily following from implementing the European Directive.
Zij hechten er aan dat met deze wetswijziging geen andere regels worden voorgeschreven dan noodzakelijkerwijs voortvloeien uit de implementatie van de Europese Richtlijn

Worries about legal uncertainty from differing measurement methods, overlapping responsibilities and bureaucracy, unclear public participation and inspection roles, and whether citizens can still object.
This is an open door to bureaucracy, which the memorandum further on euphemistically describes as 'organic relationships'.
Dit is een open deur richting bureaucratie die iets verderop in de memorie eufemistisch wordt getypeerd als «organieke verhoudingen».
Asks for a cost-benefit analysis, expected costs and benefits, why the matter must be regulated at EU level, and how the various administrative bodies coordinate and which is leading.
Which administrative body is leading in this?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill implementing EU Directive 2006/7/EC on bathing water quality, raising points on the level of regulation, the complex allocation of designation powers, the scope of the Whvbz, and delegation limits. The government's nader rapport largely accepted the advice, amending several provisions and expanding the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: Important implementing rules were to be left to general administrative orders; the Council advised including the core of the Directive's provisions in the bill itself, which the government did.

The complex interplay of designation and function-assignment provisions under the Whvbz and Wwh was unclear, and the Council asked for simplification or clarification; the government clarified the rationale and the link between the two regimes but kept the structure.
The purpose and scope of the Whvbz relative to the Directive, and the reasons for locations not designated, needed clarification in the explanatory memorandum; the government supplemented it.

The choice between a permanent bathing ban and a permanent negative bathing advice was left to provincial executives without clear criteria; the government added explanation and a preference for the advice except in exceptional cases.
The restriction of delegation powers to implementation of EC directives was questioned; the government kept the restriction while adding a substantive limitation and explanation.

Joint submission by the two ministers for general administrative orders was questioned against drafting guideline 111; the government explained the shared responsibility and amended the explanatory memorandum.

31563.s: The bill amends the Wet gemeentelijke basisadministratie persoonsgegevens to allow a general administrative order (AMvB) to set up systematic disclosure of basic citizen data (name, date of birth, address) to credit and debt registration institutions. Disclosure is limited to identity verification and must be grounded in a generally binding rule or lawful processing under the data protection act.
31563.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation as enabling efficient verification of identity by credit registration bodies, with safeguards including purpose limitation, data limits, and a voorhang procedure.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order, rules may be made on the systematic provision of general and reference data to institutions tasked with maintaining a registry of credit or debts of natural persons.

Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kan een regeling worden getroffen omtrent de systematische verstrekking van algemene en verwijsgegevens aan instellingen die tot taak hebben om een registratie in stand te houden betreffende kredieten of schulden van natuurlijke personen
d: systematic disclosure of basic municipal data to debt and credit registration institutions
p: Allows the executive by AMvB to open systematic access to citizens' basic registry data for private credit registration bodies, with purpose limits and the bill fixing which data may be shared, subject to pre-submission (voorhang) to both chambers.

parties: Welcomes the bill as a fair balance between consumer protection and privacy, raising no check-related concern.
These members recognise in the bill a proper balance between consumer protection and important privacy aspects.
Deze leden herkennen in het wetsvoorstel een juist evenwicht tussen bescherming van de consument en belangrijke privacyaspecten.
Questions the two parallel registries, complaints about BKR errors and difficulty of removal, and prefers government rather than independent supervision of the LIS.
The SP members would prefer that such registrations be under government supervision.
De leden van de SP-fractie zouden liever zien dat dergelijke registraties onder overheidstoezicht staan.
Asks what happens with inaccurate GBA data, when repeated queries are justified, and how use is limited to identity verification, weighing privacy against debt prevention.
They wish to put a number of further questions to the government.
Graag leggen zij de regering nog een aantal vragen voor.

31590.s: The bill seeks parliamentary approval under Article 91(1) of the Constitution for the Protocols of 9 July 2008 admitting Albania and Croatia to the North Atlantic Treaty. It has two articles: approval of the protocols for the Netherlands, and entry into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Whereas the Protocols of 9 July 2008 on the accession of Albania and Croatia to the North Atlantic Treaty require approval of the States General under Article 91(1) of the Constitution before the Kingdom can be bound.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de op 9 juli 2008 te Brussel totstandgekomen Protocollen bij het Noord-Atlantisch Verdrag inzake de toetreding van de Republiek Albanië en de Republiek Kroatië ingevolge artikel 91, eerste lid, van de Grondwet de goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal behoeven

parties: Asks whether the government will press for continued development of the two states after accession and whether the invitation process had adequate safeguards.

The CDA members invite the government to state in a reasoned way whether it believes the process surrounding the invitation to Albania and Croatia was accompanied by the safeguards it considers necessary.

De leden van de fractie van het CDA nodigen de regering uit om gemotiveerd aan te geven of zij van mening is dat het proces rondom de uitnodiging aan Albanië en Kroatië omgeven is geweest met de in haar ogen noodzakelijke waarborgen.
Supports accession but asks for continued oversight of democratic reforms in Albania, which failed OSCE standards in the 2007 local elections.
Is the government willing to argue within NATO for sufficient oversight and guidance regarding democratisation reforms in Albania in particular?
Is de regering bereid om binnen de NAVO te pleiten voor voldoende toezicht en sturing ten aanzien van de democratiseringshervormingen in, met name, Albanië?

Opposes accession, citing broken 1991 assurances to Russia, Balkan instability, and the Article 5 risk of being drawn into conflict; also asks for clarity on military infrastructure and common funding before accession.
These members think it is in any case necessary that clarity on this first exists before both countries can become members.
Het lijkt deze leden in ieder geval noodzakelijk dat hierover eerst duidelijkheid bestaat voordat beide landen lid kunnen worden.
Asks for information on the military units Albania and Croatia can provide to NATO operations such as ISAF and on the reforms of their armed forces.

Can a description be given of the military units that Albania and Croatia can currently provide in this context, and of the units they have already actually delivered to international operations such as the NATO-led ISAF operation in Afghanistan?

Kan een beschrijving worden gegeven van de militaire eenheden die Albanië en Kroatië in dat verband thans kunnen leveren en van de eenheden die zij in dat verband reeds daadwerkelijk hebben geleverd aan internationale operaties zoals de door de NAVO geleide ISAF-operatie in Afghanistan?

31707.s: The bill replaces the premium exemption for older workers with a premium discount for employers who hire unemployment-benefit recipients aged 50 and over and keep employees aged 62 and over, and amends related social security laws accordingly. It also adjusts several employment-subsidy laws so that the age limit for wage-cost subsidies applies from age 50, subject to a related bill.
31707.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial delegations as needed for practical implementation, such as clarifying working-hour calculations and interrupted employment, and notes the earlier amendment power was never used and is removed.
q: By ministerial regulation, in agreement with the Minister of Finance, further rules may be set for the good implementation of this section, including for determining working hours.

Bij regeling van Onze Minister, in overeenstemming met Onze Minister van Financiën, kunnen regels worden gesteld ten behoeve van een goede uitvoering van paragraaf 1 van deze afdeling, waaronder voor het vaststellen van de arbeidsduur.
d: rules on applying premium discounts during interruptions and successive employment contracts
rules for good implementation of premium discounts, including working hours
further rules on applications for premium discounts

parties: Asks government to justify age thresholds, cost-effectiveness, dead-weight loss and how misuse such as repeated dismissals and rehiring will be prevented.
Can the government calculate the dead-weight loss of this discount, since it is also granted to employees who already work and whether they already planned to?
Kan de regering becijferen wat de «dead weight loss» van deze korting is, aangezien deze ook wordt verstrekt aan werknemers die al werken en of dat reeds van plan waren?
Asks for justification of the three-year limit, cost estimates, scenarios and evaluation, and requests UWV advice on administrative feasibility of anti-cumulation rules.
Can the government substantiate with factual information why it chose to limit the premium discount to a maximum of three years?
Kan de regering met feitelijke informatie onderbouwen waarom hij ervoor gekozen heeft om de premiekorting maximaal drie jaar toepassing te laten zijn?
Argues the bill gives employers tax relief without sufficient obligations and asks whether employers could be required to retain workers after three years.
The present proposal results in a reduction of burdens for employers with, in the view of the SP members, insufficient obligations.
Het voorliggend voorstel resulteert in een lastenverlichting voor werkgevers met, naar de mening van de leden van de SP-fractie, onvoldoende verplichtingen.
Asks whether collective labour agreement provisions raising costs of older workers should be addressed and how the scheme will be communicated and prevent dismissals.
How will these possibilities be communicated? Will awareness of these rules not largely determine the success of the proposal?
Hoe worden deze mogelijkheden gecommuniceerd? Gaat de bekendheid met deze regels niet voor een groot deel het succes van het voorstel bepalen?
Asks about foregone revenue for businesses, possible demotivating effects, and the budgetary cost and returns of the measure.
What is the effect of this bill and the return on this investment if only 0.1% return to work?
Wat is het effect van dit wetsvoorstel en het rendement van deze investering als slechts 0,1% weer aan het werk is?
Says the target group is too narrow, excludes re-entrants and job changers, and that the budget could be used more effectively, for example for training.
Asks about age thresholds and their relation to age discrimination rules, the risk of temporary contracts and dismissal-rehiring cycles, and the administrative burden.
Is there a danger that current, working 50-plussers will be dismissed and then rehired with a premium discount?
Bestaat er een gevaar dat huidige, werkzame, 50-plussers ontslagen gaan worden, waarna ze met een premiekorting weer aangenomen gaan worden?

31734.s: The bill inserts a new article 23a into the Dutch Personal Data Protection Act allowing the processing and transfer of sensitive personal data to authorities outside the EU for a serious public interest, such as combating terrorism, when required by foreign law and based on a binding EU decision or treaty. It implements the 2007 EU-US PNR agreement on passenger data transfers by airlines.
31734.j: The memorandum justifies the exception by the need to implement the PNR agreement and the fight against terrorism and serious cross-border crime as a serious public interest, and argues it is compatible with Article 8 ECHR and Article 10 of the Constitution.
q: In the view of the undersigned, combating terrorism and other forms of serious cross-border crime is such a reason of serious public interest.
Naar het oordeel van ondergetekenden is de bestrijding van terrorisme en andere vormen van ernstige grensoverschrijdende criminaliteit een dergelijke reden van zwaarwegend algemeen belang.
p: Lifts the general prohibition on processing sensitive personal data for transfer to foreign authorities for serious public-interest purposes, with the purposes fixed by a binding EU decision or treaty and appropriate privacy safeguards required.

parties: Doubts whether anticipating future EU rules undermines the legal basis for lifting the ban on processing sensitive passenger data, and asks whether the European Data Protection Supervisor commented.

Given the government's response, these members doubt whether anticipating forthcoming European rules may cast doubt on the legal sustainability of the basis for lifting the ban on processing sensitive passenger data.

Gezien de reactie van de regering daarop, bestaat bij deze leden de twijfel en de vraag of het vooruitlopen op komende Europese regelgeving geen aanleiding kan geven tot twijfel over de juridische houdbaarheid

Skeptical of expanding personal information exchange without demonstrated added value; asks about the legal basis for binding EU decisions in the third pillar, the Cbp's room to review licence applications, and citizens' access and objection rights.
They want to know what duty airlines have to inform customers about the transfer of sensitive data and how customers can deal with it.
Zij willen graag weten wat voor plicht de luchtvaartmaatschappij heeft om klanten te informeren over de overdracht van bijzondere gegevens

Argues the EU-US agreement conflicts with the Wbp and ECHR Article 8 during provisional application, questions the airline legitimate-interest rationale, and asks for limits on the data volume and whether the public-interest justification is assessed case by case.

Has the interference with the right to respect for private life since that date not been in conflict with Article 8 ECHR, given the absence of the requirement that the interference be provided for by law?
Is de inmenging in het recht op respect voor het privé-leven sinds die datum niet in strijd geweest met artikel 8 EVRM

31815.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Horst aan de Maas, Sevenum and part of Meerlo-Wanssum into a new municipality named Horst aan de Maas, and transfers the remaining part of Meerlo-Wanssum to Venray, abolishing Meerlo-Wanssum and Sevenum. It also sets transitional rules for taxes, joint arrangements, staff, archives, municipal registries, court and police district boundaries, and early council elections.
q: With effect from the date of reorganisation, the municipalities of Horst aan de Maas, Meerlo-Wanssum and Sevenum are abolished.
Met ingang van de datum van herindeling worden de gemeenten Horst aan de Maas, Meerlo-Wanssum en Sevenum opgeheven.

parties: Welcomes the bill and the unanimous municipal decision-making, asking only general questions about the policy line on municipality size.
The CDA members have noted the present proposal with approval.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van het onderhavige voorstel.
Asks whether the splitting of Meerlo-Wanssum villages matches residents' wishes and how local identity will be safeguarded after the merger.
Does the government share our view that, in any case, the integration of the three villages of Meerlo-Wanssum into Venray deserves the greatest attention?
Deelt de regering onze opvatting dat, hoe dan ook de integratie van de drie kernen van Meerlo-Wanssum in Venray de grootst mogelijke aandacht verdient?
Questions whether the merger was truly bottom-up, citing village polls against joining Venray and a campaign focused on independence, and asks for guidelines on independent referenda.
Give an assignment for voluntary merger from the bottom up! Can the government explain this sentence?
Een opdracht geven tot vrijwillige herindeling van onderop! Kan de regering deze zin toelichten?
Welcomes the bill but asks the government to justify splitting Meerlo-Wanssum and why benefits outweigh drawbacks.
The VVD members consider this part of the proposal very far-reaching and unusual.
Dit onderdeel van het voorstel achten de leden van de VVD-fractie zeer ingrijpend en ongebruikelijk.
Asks whether referenda or polls were held in the municipalities, their results, and how councils and provincial states voted.
The PVV members ask whether there have been referenda, polls or popular consultations in the municipalities concerned and, if so, what the outcomes were.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of er referenda of peilingen of volksraadsplegingen zijn geweest in de betreffende gemeenten en zo ja, wat daarvan de uitkomsten waren?

31824.s: The bill approves the 2008 tax treaty between the Netherlands and Bahrain on avoiding double taxation and preventing fiscal evasion regarding income taxes, together with its protocol. It provides that the law enters into force the day after the Staatsblad publication date.

parties: The CDA welcomes the treaty for legal certainty and asks only a few technical questions about the residency tiebreaker and arbitration, without challenging executive discretion.
Given the ever-expanding business relationship between the Netherlands and Bahrain, it is good that a tax treaty between the two countries has now been signed.
Gezien de zich steeds verder uitbreidende bedrijfsrelatie tussen Nederland en Bahrein is het goed dat nu een belastingverdrag tussen beide landen getekend is.

The SP questions the budgetary effects, the lack of automatic information exchange, possible use of the treaty for tax avoidance and the absence of an impact assessment, asking the state secretary for justification.
The SP members are somewhat worried that the state secretary cannot make any estimate of the budgetary consequences of the tax treaty with Bahrain.
Het baart de leden van de SP enige zorgen dat staatssecretaris geen enkele inschatting kan maken van de budgettaire gevolgen van het belastingverdrag met Bahrein.

31833.s: The bill adds Article 692 to the Civil Code making both the employer and the third-party hirer jointly liable for paying the statutory minimum wage and minimum holiday allowance of temporary workers performed in the Netherlands, regardless of the applicable law. The third party is exempt if the employer is certified against standards set by ministerial regulation and accredited certification bodies.
31833.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by stating that the list of standards in the ministerial regulation will be specific and limited to norms concerning compliance with the minimum wage articles.
q: A ministerial regulation will contain a list of specifically named standards on the basis of which a certificate may be issued.
Een ministeriële regeling zal een lijst van met name genoemde normen bevatten op grond waarvan een certificaat kan worden verstrekt.
p: The minister may designate by regulation the certification standards that determine whether third-party hirers escape joint liability, with the regulation limited to standards concerning minimum wage compliance.

parties: Asks how the certification system and the Arbeidsinspectie and Belastingdienst enforcement will ensure the feared effect, and whether self-regulation by the sector provides adequate oversight.
According to these members, the proposed measures will only have an effect if the chance of being caught for malafide agencies actually increases.
De voorgestelde maatregelen zullen naar het oordeel van deze leden echter alleen effect sorteren, als de pakkans voor malafide bureaus ook daadwerkelijk toeneemt.

Not yet convinced the bill will achieve its aim; asks whether registration of all agencies, including foreign and one-man companies, can be made mandatory and how enforcement can be made more efficient.
However, the PvdA members are for now not convinced of the elaboration of the bill and whether it will achieve the intended effect.
Echter, de leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn vooralsnog niet overtuigd aangaande de uitwerking van het wetsvoorstel en het halen van het beoogde effect.

Favours a licensing system with power to revoke licences, questions whether the sector should set the certification norm itself rather than Parliament, and asks for faster inspections by Belastingdienst and Arbeidsinspectie.
The SP members ask the government not to let the sector itself determine the norm temp agencies must meet, but to set it in consultation with the House.

De leden van de SP fractie vragen de regering om de inhoud van de norm waaraan uitzendondernemingen moeten voldoen niet door de sector zelf te laten vaststellen maar in samenspraak met de Kamer vast te stellen.

Probes legal protection of agencies against certification decisions, whether certifying bodies are administrative organs under the AWB, the unclear norm, and the rights of workers and hirers in subcontracting chains.
Is it correct that no legal protection under the General Administrative Law Act is available if the government does not regard the certifying bodies as administrative organs?
Is het juist dat geen rechtsbescherming volgens de Algemene Wet Bestuursrecht openstaat als de regering de certificerende instellingen niet als bestuursorgaan aanmerkt?
Asks the government to clarify the disagreement with Actal on whether certifying bodies are administrative organs and whether the bill increases administrative burdens on firms.
The PVV members request the government clarify this fundamental difference of opinion between the government and Actal.
De leden van de PVV-fractie verzoeken de regering duidelijkheid te verschaffen over dit fundamentele verschil van mening tussen de regering en Actal

Supports better protection of agency workers but questions whether the hirer's liability is an effective incentive compared with existing criminal penalties, and how often workers actually invoke liability.
However, these members still have some questions about the effectiveness of the amendment.
Wel hebben deze leden nog enkele vragen over de effectiviteit van de wetswijziging.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on a bill making the user company (inlener) jointly liable with the temporary employment agency for payment of the statutory minimum wage and holiday allowance, with exemption for certified agencies. It raises concerns about cross-border agencies, illegal temporary workers, and the minister's vague power to designate norms; the government's reply responds on each point, largely by rejecting the concerns about scope and illegal workers and partly accepting the drafting changes.
concerns: The Raad doubts the private-law liability will bite for foreign agencies because the Detacheringsrichtlijn and private international law may leave the rule inapplicable.
The Raad considers illegal temporary workers unlikely to invoke the joint liability, so the incentive to use certified agencies may not work.
The Raad finds the statutory basis for the minister to designate norms insufficiently limited, with the essential elements left to a ministerial regulation.
The Raad notes the designated norms in the ministerial regulation serve purposes beyond wage protection, such as tax and identity checks, and asks for clarification.

31905.s: The bill makes several technical amendments to the Wet op de zorgtoeslag and the Zorgverzekeringswet: it sets the standard premium for a partner of a person under Article 69 of the Zorgverzekeringswet, adds a delegation to an AMvB on how the CVZ determines administrative costs, and repeals a provision in a 2007 amending act. It also sets entry into force and gives Article II retroactive effect to 1 January 2009.
31905.j: The memorandum explains that the delegation provides the basis for regulating in the Besluit zorgverzekering how the CVZ annually sets the CAK's administrative costs, since this basis was previously missing.
q: It is proposed to regulate this basis after all in the Besluit zorgverzekering.
Voorgesteld wordt deze basis alsnog te regelen in het Besluit zorgverzekering.
d: manner in which CVZ sets administrative costs

31923.s: The bill gives statutory force to the Order of 30 June 2010 amending the transitional period for the ban on keeping laying hens in enriched cages, so that it takes effect on the date this law enters into force. It is a nahang-procedure case in which parliament chose to regulate the order by law.
31923.j: The memorandum explains that parliament, within thirty days of the order being laid before it, asked that its entry into force be regulated by law under the nahang procedure of the animal welfare act.
q: Within thirty days of submission, at least one fifth of the constitutional number of members of either chamber may express the wish that the entry into force of the order be regulated by law.

Binnen dertig dagen na overlegging kan, ingevolge dit artikel, door ten minste een vijfde van het grondwettelijk aantal leden van één der Kamers de wens te kennen worden gegeven dat de inwerkingtreding van het besluit bij wet zal worden geregeld.

parties: Opposes the extension to 2021 and the Kleingruppenhaltung alternative, arguing economic interests weigh too heavily against animal welfare.
The PvdA members are not in favour of the proposed change to the transition period until 1 January 2021.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn geen voorstander van de voorgestelde wijziging van de overgangstermijn tot 1 januari 2021.

Questions how the ban will be enforced in the Netherlands and other member states, and how the bedding requirement will be monitored, seeking government answers on enforcement and inspection capacity.
The SP members are concerned about the implementation and enforcement of the battery hen ban in Europe.
De leden van de SP-fractie maken zich zorgen over de uitvoering en handhaving van het verbod op legbatterijen in Europa.

Argues the 2017 deadline should be kept, that the government should not fully cover entrepreneurial risk, and asks whether the government will consider alternatives such as sanering or incentives to switch earlier.
The Party for the Animals members believe the 2017 transition deadline should be maintained.
De leden van de fractie van de Partij voor de Dieren menen dat vastgehouden moet worden aan de overgangstermijn van 2017.

31950.s: The bill amends several health-sector laws (Geneesmiddelenwet, Wmg, WMO, WBIG, Wet orgaandonatie, Zorgverzekeringswet and others) to bring a number of independent administrative bodies (zbo's) under the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen. It largely replaces their bespoke governance, reporting and budget rules with the framework law, while excepting the minister's power to annul their decisions under article 22 for specified bodies and specified decisions.
31950.j: The memorandum justifies the exceptions by arguing that the minister's annulment power is incompatible with the nature of these bodies' tasks, as the advisory board BTZ concluded, and that the Kaderwet's general oversight tools suffice for democratic control.
q: The Council of State's advice is not made public.
Het advies van de Raad van State wordt niet openbaar gemaakt
d: Artikel II, B (Wmg art. 4) and H (Wmg art. 14, third paragraph)
content and structure of work programme, budget, annual accounts and reserves of the Zorgautoriteit
Artikel VII, H (Zvw art. 75, third paragraph)
content of work programme, budgets, annual accounts and audit of the College zorgverzekeringen
Artikel VI, F/G (Wet ZON art. 14 and 16)
publication of annual report and accounts by ZorgOnderzoek Nederland board
p: Artikel I, A (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 2, third paragraph) and Artikel II, A (Wmg art. 3, sixth paragraph)
Applies the Kaderwet to the Cbg and Zorgautoriteit, excluding the minister's power to annul certain decisions (art. 22) and, for the Zorgautoriteit, the power to fix tariffs (art. 17).
Lets the minister give the Zorgautoriteit general directions on the subjects on which it may issue rules and policy rules, replacing the earlier narrower instruction power.
Replaces the minister's approval of the College's budget and accounts with reporting duties and removes approval requirements in several places.
Artikel I, I/Artikel II, I (Wmg art. 15) and Artikel III, D (WMO art. 27)
Removes the minister's separate duty to report to both chambers on the functioning of the body, folding it into the general annual report under the Kaderwet.
Artikel III, A (WMO art. 14) and Artikel IV (WBIG art. 14, eleventh paragraph)

Excludes the minister's annulment power for the central committee and registration committees, and excludes the Kaderwet's ministerial intervention power for taakverwaarlozing in the registration context, relying instead on existing specialty-title withdrawal powers.

parties: The CDA supports the goal but worries that narrowing the minister's annulment power and dropping the annual report to the Staten-Generaal weakens ministerial responsibility and parliamentary oversight.
They have serious doubts about dropping the minister's obligation to report annually to the Staten-Generaal on the functioning of the Dutch Healthcare Authority.

De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben ernstige twijfels bij het schrappen van de verplichting van de minister om jaarlijks zijn oordeel over het functioneren van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit ter kennis te brengen van de Staten-Generaal.
The SP is critical of creating zbo's because they reduce state control, especially in healthcare, and asks which decisions the minister should still be able to annul.
Since the SP considers it important that the government retains control in healthcare, they have further questions about the exception in Article 22.
Aangezien de leden van de SP-fractie het van belang vinden dat de overheid zeggenschap blijft houden in de zorg hebben zij nog enkele vragen over de uitzondering van artikel 22.

32058.s: The bill temporarily extends the chain-contract rule in Article 7:668a of the Civil Code, allowing employers to offer up to four fixed-term contracts totalling 48 months to workers under 27 to promote youth employment during the economic crisis. The change lapses on 1 January 2012 unless extended by royal decree, and existing workers keep the protection of the prior rules.
32058.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary change by the economic crisis and youth employment, and explains that a CAO alternative was considered but legislation was chosen.
q: Article 668a paragraph 6 (and thus also the reference to this paragraph in paragraph 5) lapses with effect from 1 January 2012. It does, however, become possible to extend that lapse date by royal decree.

Artikel III Artikel 668a lid 6 (en daarmee ook de verwijzing naar dit lid in lid 5) vervalt met ingang van 1 januari 2012. Het wordt wel mogelijk gemaakt om die vervaldatum bij koninklijk besluit te verlengen.
d: extension of sunset date of the temporary chain-contract rule

parties: Supports the bill as a benefit for employers and young workers and dismisses the Council of State's displacement concern, but asks how the effectiveness study will be reported and which indicators will be used.
They do not share the Council of State's criticism that displacement of school leavers may occur.
Zij delen niet de kritiek van de Raad van State die aangeeft dat er mogelijk verdringing van schoolverlaters kan ontstaan.

Asks for an evaluation clause and a sunset clause so that any extension needs critical parliamentary scrutiny, plus quantitative displacement and budget analysis and a check on EU age-discrimination rules.
First, they want the law to include an evaluation provision so that the House can see what the effects of this temporary measure are.
Ten eerste willen zij dat de wet wordt voorzien van een evaluatiebepaling, zodat het voor de Kamer inzichtelijk is wat de effecten zijn van deze tijdelijke maatregel.
Criticises the bill as worsening job security for young people and asks for justification, evidence of the claimed unemployment effect, and reasons for the age limit and retention of the chain rule.
The position of young people on the labour market is not improved by this.
De positie van jongeren op de arbeidsmarkt wordt daardoor niet beter.

Welcomes the bill as implementing a motion and asks the government to broaden the effectiveness study to all youth unemployment measures and to justify not following the Council of State on age scope.
Can the government motivate more soundly why the advice of the Council of State was not followed.
Kan de regering nog eens deugdelijker motiveren waarom het advies van de Raad van State niet is overgenomen.
Asks about the age limit's basis, the displacement assumption, the criteria and indicators for extension by royal decree, and safeguards to move young workers to permanent contracts afterwards.
Which criteria will the government use to decide on extending the measure, the ChristenUnie members ask.
Welke criteria gaat de regering hanteren om te besluiten tot verlenging van de maatregel, zo vragen de leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill temporarily allowing fixed-term employment contracts for young people up to age 27 (a fourth contract or fourth year before permanent employment), supporting the aim but raising concerns about the age limit, displacement of school leavers, and the lack of a sunset clause. The government reply accepted the sunset clause (expiry 1 January 2012 unless extended by royal decree), explained why the age limit and the displacement risk were acceptable, but did not adopt the suggestion to extend the scheme past age 27.
concerns: The Raad questioned why the measure should be limited to under-27s given the economic crisis, and the government kept the age limit while explaining that youth unemployment is higher than total unemployment.
The explanatory memorandum insufficiently addressed the possible displacement of school leavers by young workers; the government added reasoning that the effect is limited.
The bill lacked a sunset clause; the government added an expiry date of 1 January 2012 unless extended by royal decree.

32139.s: The bill approves for the Netherlands the Supplementary Agreement signed in Ankara on 16 April 2009 with Turkey, revising the 1966 bilateral social security treaty under the European Code of Social Security. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The Supplementary Agreement concluded at Ankara on 16 April 2009 ... is approved for the Netherlands.
Het op 16 april 2009 te Ankara totstandgekomen Aanvullend Akkoord ... wordt goedgekeurd voor Nederland.

parties: Asks in which situations a spouse remaining in Turkey receives AOW pension, how many people are affected, and whether there are financial or organisational consequences.
In which situations does a spouse left behind in Turkey of an insured person working in the Netherlands receive old-age pension under the General Old Age Act (AOW)?
In welke situaties ontvangt een in Turkije achtergebleven echtgeno(o)t(e) van een in Nederland werkende verzekerde ouderdomspensioen ingevolge de Algemene Ouderdomswet (AOW)?
Asks for the number of cases per year, whether the changes can apply to other countries, which changes were requested by Turkey or the Netherlands, and whether child benefit export was pursued.
Can the government explain which changes in the text were made at Turkey's request and which at the Netherlands' request?
Kan de regering toelichten welke wijzigingen in de tekst op verzoek van Turkije zijn aangebracht en welke wijzigingen op verzoek van Nederland?

32157.s: The bill creates ministerial power to issue binding directions to public entities that fail to comply with EU obligations or misuse EU subsidies, enforceable by the minister acting on their behalf and at their cost. It also allows the state to recover EU fines, penalty payments and subsidy repayments from the responsible public entity, and repeals the Wet toezicht Europese subsidies.
32157.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the state's Community-loyalty responsibility for EU law compliance and the need for instruments beyond existing supervision, following the Commission's rising financial sanctions and the Oosting commission's advice to rely on generic supervision.
p: The minister may direct any public entity, including provinces, municipalities and their joint arrangements, to comply with an EU obligation within a set period, with subnational generic supervision taking priority and judicial appeal available to the Administrative Jurisdiction Division.

If a directive is not followed, the minister may act in the name of and at the cost of the public entity, including by taking private-law legal acts, with appeal available directly to the Administrative Jurisdiction Division.
The minister may decide to recover EU fines, penalty payments and subsidy repayments from a public entity after consultation, enforceable by writ of execution.
The annulment provision of the General Administrative Law Act does not apply where annulment is for breach of EU obligations, limiting the legal effect of such annulment in private-law matters.

parties: Asks why the bill took over five years after the 2004 cabinet position, how central government powers to compel municipalities and provinces are justified, and whether instruments are needed against overshooting as well as undershooting EU implementation.
The CDA members ask the government to further justify the powers the central government receives to compel municipalities and provinces to comply with European law.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering de bevoegdheden die het Rijk krijgt om gemeenten en provincies te dwingen het Europese recht na te leven, nader te motiveren.
Asks when the generic supervisory instruments are insufficient to justify the new powers, how often they would be used, and why the pending revitalisation of generic supervision is not awaited first.
Why is this review not awaited before proposing new instruments?
Waarom wordt deze herijking dan niet eerst afgewacht alvorens nieuwe instrumenten voor te stellen?

Accepts the need to prevent central government being liable for unfulfilled treaty obligations, but insists on restraint toward decentralised governments given their democratic legitimacy and asks whether central government would be substituting its view for the courts.

At the same time these members share the government's view that central government should intervene with great restraint toward decentralised governments because of their own autonomy and democratic legitimacy.

Tegelijkertijd delen deze leden de opvatting van de regering dat er zeer terughoudend moet worden omgesprongen met het ingrijpen als Rijksoverheid bij decentrale overheden vanwege hun eigen autonomie en democratische legitimatie.

Asks how a minister learns of non-compliance, whether the instruction power will be used against provinces and municipalities when generic supervision suffices, and what the experience with the Wet toezicht Europese subsidies has been.
Does this mean the instruction instrument will never be used against provinces, municipalities and Wgr regions when the generic supervisory instruments are sufficient?
Betekent dit dat het instrument van de aanwijzing nooit jegens provincies en gemeenten en Wgr-regio’s zal worden gebruikt als de generieke toezichtsinstrumenten voldoende zijn?

Argues the bill cuts across normal relations and the autonomy of decentralised governments, questions the lack of a principled analysis and an explicit state-interest norm, and worries about a very broad possibility of intervention.
Does this not offer a very broad possibility for infringing on the autonomy of decentralised governments?
Wordt hiermee niet een zeer ruime mogelijkheid geboden voor inbreuk op de autonomie van decentrale overheden?
Opposes supranational EU aspects and the expansion of central government instruments over municipalities and provinces, and will not support the bill.
will therefore not support this bill, which gives central government more instruments to promote compliance with European legislation by public entities such as Dutch municipalities and provinces.

zullen daarom geen steun verlenen aan dit wetsvoorstel waarmee het Rijk meer instrumenten in handen krijgt om de naleving van Europese wetgeving door publieke entiteiten zoals Nederlandse gemeenten en provincies te bevorderen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill on enforcing EU law against public entities needs revision, especially its powers to enforce compliance in cases of threatened breach before the European Commission formally acts, and the overlap with the generic intergovernmental supervision instruments for provinces and municipalities. The government's reply accepted some remarks (clarifying terms, reframing intervention triggers, adding a recourse right for EIB claims) but rejected the view that intervention must await a formal Commission action and that specific powers over provinces and municipalities are premature.
concerns: The terms 'verzuim' and 'dreigend verzuim' are unclear and the trigger for preventive intervention lacks a clear point of reference; the government reworded the trigger to a decision or conduct in breach of EU obligations.
Preventive intervention before a formal Commission action is premature and uncertain; the Raad would only find sufficient grounds once the Commission formally addresses the Netherlands.

Specific intervention powers over provinces, municipalities and joint arrangements are premature and unnecessary given the generic intergovernmental supervision instruments and the recourse right; the government retained them for autonomous tasks while accepting primacy of the generic instruments.

Concern that the proposal does not fit the government's own position on the Oosting commission report regarding the role of the national interest in intra-governmental supervision; the government disputed this.
Zelfstandige bestuursorganen and other entities are not discussed in the explanatory memorandum; the government added a paragraph on them and on the interplay with the Kaderwet zbo's.

Recourse and intervention provisions should also cover liability claims by the EIB or other member states, and the scope of the Minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat's powers over water boards should align with the Binnenlandse Zaken model.

32193.s: The bill amends the Dutch Education Inspection Act to introduce risk-based, proportionate and integrated supervision of schools, including supervision of financial lawfulness and teacher quality. It allows the minister, by general administrative order, to delegate enforcement powers such as sanctions and funding corrections to the Inspectorate of Education.
32193.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need for quicker, more effective enforcement and an evolving intervention policy that is better regulated in a general administrative order than in the statute.
q: By giving the inspectorate, through a general administrative order based on this act, the mandate to impose sanctions independently in less serious cases, faster improvement is expected.

Door de inspectie bij algemene maatregel van bestuur, op basis van deze wet, het mandaat te geven om bij de minder zware gevallen zelfstandig sancties op te kunnen leggen, ontstaat die snellere verbetering naar verwachting wel.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 3, derde lid WOT)
delegation of enforcement and sanction powers from minister to inspectorate
p: Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 3, derde lid WOT)
The minister may, by general administrative order, transfer sanction and other decision-making powers over schools to the Inspectorate, which operates at arm's length from the minister.
Introduces a statutory basis for supervising knowledge centres for vocational education and business, with the inspectorate acting on ministerial or own-initiative assignments.
Allows the inspectorate to conduct specific investigations on its own initiative or on the minister's instruction.

parties: Questions whether the Inspectorate should both enforce and impose sanctions, arguing this concentration of roles weakens impartiality and that sanctions should stay with the minister.
If that same institution also imposes the sanctions, the members wonder whether this benefits its impartiality.
Als dan diezelfde instelling ook de sancties oplegt, vragen de leden zich af of dit de zuiverheid ten goede komt.
Supports strict risk-based oversight but wants fair, transparent criteria, visits to all schools, and avoidance of the Inspectorate imposing its own views on education content.
the Inspectorate should work only on the quality features set by government in the assessment framework through objective criteria.
de Inspectie van het onderwijs uitsluitend zou moeten werken op basis van de kwaliteitskenmerken die door de overheid in het toetsingskader door middel van objectieve criteria echt zijn vastgelegd
Questions whether the reform truly reduces supervision burden and whether the Inspectorate can absorb new tasks under budget cuts.
Does this amount to a heavier task load for the Inspectorate, or are there as many staff in total to carry out these new tasks?
Komt dit neer op een taakverzwaring voor de Inspectie van het onderwijs of zijn er per saldo evenveel medewerkers om deze nieuwe taken uit te voeren?

Supports trust-based supervision but asks how the Inspectorate's independence is guaranteed given its political accountability to the minister, and how legal certainty is ensured against arbitrariness.
how is arbitrariness by the Inspectorate toward schools prevented?
hoe wordt willekeur door de Inspectie van het onderwijs richting scholen voorkomen?
Questions expansions of the Inspectorate's mandate, particularly sanctions and financial oversight, and where the line on delegating powers should be drawn.
Where does the government draw the line in granting mandate to the Inspectorate of Education?
Waar legt de regering de grens in het verlenen van mandaat aan de Inspectie van het onderwijs?

Argues the reform should have analysed the meaning of quality more fundamentally, warns the risk-based approach may miss parts of school reality, and questions sanction powers delegated to an inspectorate.
These members ask whether a mandate arrangement is a suitable instrument for such sensitive decisions.
Deze leden vragen of een mandaatconstructie voor zulke gevoelige beslissingen een geschikt instrument is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on a bill amending the Education Inspection Act to introduce integrated, risk-based supervision and mandate sanctioning powers to the Inspectorate, warning that this shifts the inspectorate toward enforcement and may erode its stimulating role and the quality oversight of average and good schools. The government's reply (nader rapport) adds clarifications to the explanatory memorandum on the stimulating role, the advisory issue and the narrowed mandate, and largely adopts the advice on mandate design, excluding the most severe sanctions.
concerns: The Raad doubts the bill really changes supervision practice and asks why statutory change is needed; the government clarified the intended changes in the explanatory memorandum but kept risk-based supervision.

The Raad warns risk-based selective supervision weakens the stimulating and informing role for average and good schools and conflicts with budget cuts and expanded tasks; the government argued stimulation continues through benchmarking and publication.

The mandate provision is internally inconsistent and cannot be irrevocable under the Awb; the Raad advises that the general administrative order set which powers may be mandated under which conditions, which the government adopted.

The Raad advises against mandating severe sanctions such as full withholding of funding or deprivation of rights; the government excluded these from mandating and clarified the explanatory memorandum.
The Raad makes redactional comments, such as punctuation and renumbering of a chapter and deleting an article, which the government incorporated.

32238.s: The bill amends the Meststoffenwet to add a delegation basis allowing an algemene maatregel van bestuur to set maximum administrative fine levels for violations of administrative rules, and extends the fine maximum to the sixth category for legal persons. It also updates cross-references in the Wet op de economische delicten and the Meststoffenwet's partnership provision.
32238.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need for effective enforcement and by the desire to avoid disproportionate burdens of the heavy procedure for fines below 340 euro, while keeping fine amounts linked to the Criminal Code categories.
q: Whereas for effective enforcement it is desirable to include in the Meststoffenwet a delegation basis for determining the level of administrative fines for administrative rules;

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het voor een doelmatige handhaving wenselijk is in de Meststoffenwet een delegatiegrondslag op te nemen voor de bepaling van de hoogte van bestuurlijke boetes voor administratieve voorschriften;
d: maximum administrative fine levels per violation or category
p: Fine maxima for administrative violations can be set by general administrative order rather than by statute, with the per-violation cap tied to the fifth category of the Criminal Code.

parties: Asks whether affected businesses keep the right to present their side (zienswijze) and whether the fine cap of EUR 340 combined with discretion and subsidy cuts risks disproportionate or double punishment.
The CDA members ask whether this does not greatly restrict the possibility for interested parties to present the real situation in which the violation took place.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen zich verder af of hiermee de mogelijkheid voor belanghebbenden voor het naar voren brengen van de werkelijke situatie, waaronder de overtreding heeft plaatsgevonden, niet erg wordt beperkt.
Asks why the EUR 340 threshold was chosen and whether it remains under the Fourth tranche, and worries about a shortfall in inspection capacity delaying environmental goals.
The SP members are concerned about a possible shortfall in inspection capacity.
De leden van de SP-fractie maken zich zorgen om het mogelijk tekort in de controle capaciteit.

32247.s: The bill raises the AOW (state pension) eligibility age from 65 to 67 with transitional rules for older cohorts, and adjusts related pension tax limits in the Wage Tax Act and Income Tax Act 2001. It also amends pension accrual and tax-facilitated early-retirement (40/42 years) rules and sets out a possible earlier start for the tax changes via a general administrative order (AMvB).
32247.j: The memorandum justifies the age increase by demographic change, the sustainability of public finances and the need to secure social provision for future generations; the AMvB power is justified by the aim of strengthening the pension system via social partners' agreements.
q: Article V: If social partners conclude an agreement in which funds released by adjusting pension schemes are used to strengthen the pension system, an earlier start date for the tax changes in articles II and III(B, C, D) may be set by general administrative order.

MOGELIJK VROEGER INGANGSTIJDSTIP WIJZIGINGEN WET INKOMSTENBELASTING 2001 EN WET OP DE LOONBELASTING 1964 Indien sociale partners een convenant sluiten waarin middelen, die vrijvallen in verband met aanpassing van pensioenregelingen vooruitlopend op het tijdstip van ingang van de in artikel III, onderdelen B, C en D, van deze wet opgenomen wijzigingen, worden ingezet voor versterking van het pensioenstelsel, kan ter ondersteuning daarvan bij algemene maatregel van bestuur een vroeger ingangstijdstip van de artikelen II en III, onderdelen B, C en D, worden vastgesteld.
d: earlier start date for tax changes to pension rules

parties: Supports the age increase but asks the government to answer open questions and wants the Witteveen adjustment's convenant route submitted to parliament via a prior-consultation procedure.
The CDA members still have a number of questions for the government, including after hearing the participants at the Chamber hearing on 20 January 2010.</evidence_en>
Bij de leden van de CDA-fractie leven wel nog een aantal vragen voor de regering, onder andere na het horen van de aanwezigen in de hoorzitting in de Kamer op 20 januari 2010.
Accepts the age increase in principle but insists it cannot take effect without the flanking measures and asks the government for a commitment to link the two bills.
The present bill can only take effect for the PvdA members if the draft laws on flanking policy lead to enacted laws.</evidence_en>
Het voorliggende wetsvoorstel kan voor de leden van de PvdA-fractie alleen van kracht worden wanneer de voorontwerpen van wet inzake het flankerend beleid zullen leiden tot aangenomen wetten.

Rejects the age increase as unnecessary and unfair, criticizes the splitting of the bill from flanking measures, and presses the government with extensive questions on evidence and distributional effects.
Raising the AOW age is unnecessary, unreasonable and therefore undesirable.</evidence_en>
Het verhogen van de AOW-leeftijd is onnodig, onredelijk en daarom ongewenst.

Supports the principle of raising the age but finds the timing, fairness and burden allocation objectionable, and presses the government for quantified intergenerational evidence that the Council of State requested.
Can the government still provide the quantified insight into the balance of benefits and burdens between generations requested by the Council of State?</evidence_en>
Kan de regering het door de Raad van State verzochte cijfermatige inzicht in de balans tussen lusten en lasten tussen de generaties alsnog verstrekken?
Opposes the measure as unnecessary, demands that the bill not be voted on until flanking policy and financial effects are fully known and studied, and questions the government's rationale.
Before this bill comes to a vote, the PVV members would like a study into the financial, cultural and social consequences for both the private and public sector.</evidence_en>

Voordat dit wetsvoorstel tot een stemming komt hebben de leden van de PVV-fractie graag dat er een onderzoek zoek komt naar wat de financiële, culturele en sociale gevolgen voor zowel de private als publieke sector zijn.
Accepts the agreed age increase but insists the related bills be handled together for careful, integrated scrutiny and asks how the government ensures this.
To reach a balanced judgement, it is therefore of crucial importance to them that the relevant bills be treated together.</evidence_en>
Om tot een afgewogen oordeel te komen, is het volgens hen dan ook van cruciaal belang de betreffende wetsvoorstellen in samenhang te behandelen.

Supports raising the age in principle but objects to the separation from flanking measures, the late start in 2020, and the hard generational break, and asks for quantified information and justification.
The D66 members believe the increase in the AOW age cannot be viewed separately from the flanking measures.</evidence_en>
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn van mening dat de verhoging van de AOW-leeftijd niet los gezien kan worden van de flankerende maatregelen.

Supports the principle of the increase but questions the two-step, late implementation and its administrative and intergenerational fairness, asking for alternative phasing and concrete solidarity measures.
Why does the government set aside the Council of State's advice to introduce the AOW age more gradually and sooner, instead of in two large steps over ten and fifteen years?</evidence_en>
Waarom legt de regering het advies van de Raad van State naast zich neer om de AOW-leeftijd geleidelijker en sneller in te voeren, in plaats van in twee grote stappen over tien en vijftien jaar?

v.summary: The Raad van State supports raising the AOW pension age to 67 in two steps (2020 and 2025) but advises substantial reconsideration: the bill lacks quantified justification, the timing is too slow given the deficit and labour shortages, the intergenerational burden distribution is unexplained, and the planned flexibilisation linked to work history is discouraged. The government's nader rapport largely accepts the points on justification and the Witteveen framework, rejects speeding up the timeline, and defers the flankerende maatregelen to a separate bill.
concerns: The Raad asks for quantified justification of the sustainability deficit and labour-market shortages; the government adds some context but gives limited new figures.

The Raad finds the phased timeline (2020/2025) too slow to address urgency and labour shortages and advises earlier implementation; the government keeps the timeline citing administrative costs and transition needs.
The Raad calls for quantified insight into how the burden is distributed between generations; the government acknowledges the importance but offers no new calculation.

The Raad advises against the planned flexibilisation of the AOW below the pension age linked to work history, as it undermines the AOW as a volksverzekering and simplicity of implementation; the government defers this to a separate bill.
The Raad advises adjusting the Witteveen framework to the higher AOW age but notes that social partners remain responsible for pension rules; the government agrees and clarifies the text.
The Raad notes that early application of the Witteveen change could reduce pension accrual for those reaching 65 before 2020; the government clarifies the memorandum that the effect is small.

32292.s: The bill amends the Wft to implement EU Directive 2007/44/EC on prudential assessment of acquisitions and increases of qualifying holdings in the financial sector, shifting the approval decision for qualifying holdings to De Nederlandsche Bank and removing the Minister of Finance's own substantive review. It also sets fixed procedural deadlines, requires DNB to inform the Minister proactively about systemically relevant applications, and aligns notification thresholds.
32292.j: The memorandum justifies removing the Minister's review by the directive's exclusion of political or policy considerations and the need for independent prudential supervision, while keeping the Minister informed.
q: The directive explicitly excludes considerations of a political or policy nature from the assessment of a proposed holding or takeover.
De richtlijn sluit expliciet uit dat bij een toets van een voorgenomen deelneming of overname afwegingen van politieke of beleidsmatige aard worden betrokken.
d: qualifying holding approval by DNB instead of Minister
data to be specified for holding application
p: Artikel I, onderdelen M, O, Q (art. 3:95, 3:97, 3:100 Wft)
Removes the Minister of Finance's substantive review and approval role over qualifying holdings, shifting the decision to DNB; the Minister receives only proactive information under art. 1:93c.
DNB must inform the Minister of relevant applications affecting the financial system, preserving ministerial accountability.

parties: Doubts the practice will match the directive's aims and questions whether the limited assessment criteria and removal of the minister's financial-stability tool leave adequate checks against systemic risk.
The VVD members have considerable concerns about the consequences for supervision of limiting systemic risks that may arise from consolidation.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben tamelijk grote zorgen over de gevolgen voor het toezicht ten aanzien van het beperken van systeem risico’s die kunnen optreden bij consolidatie.
Asks whether the removal of political review by the finance minister is a directive obligation or a Dutch choice, and whether the criteria allow protectionist conduct by supervisors.
Is it correct that the five criteria the supervisor must apply under the directive are so open to multiple interpretations that the supervisor could still display protectionist behaviour?

Is het juist dat de vijf criteria waaraan de toezichthouder volgens de richtlijn moet voldoen, dusdanig multi-interpretabel zijn, dat de toezichthouder nog steeds in staat zal zijn om protectionistisch gedrag te vertonen?
Argues the finance minister loses political responsibility for financial stability and asks how he can still answer for it, and whether ministerial information rights are adequate.
The most important change this bill makes is that the finance minister's current responsibility for acquisitions or increases in holdings is reduced, according to the CDA members.

De belangrijkste wijziging die door dit wetsvoorstel tot stand komt, is dat de huidige verantwoordelijkheid van de minister van Financiën bij de verwerving van een deelneming of een vergroting daarvan vermindert, aldus de leden van de fractie van het CDA.
Asks whether the directive allows a broader-than-prudential assessment, whether supervisors act independently, and whether parliament can still see full advice and decisions.
Asks whether the minister formally can instruct DNB to test macroprudential criteria and whether the minister keeps a role in deciding, to preserve accountability.
Does it fall within the minister's formal competence to ask DNB to actually test against this criterion?
Behoort het tot de formele bevoegdheid van de minister om DNB te verzoeken daadwerkelijk op dit criterium te toetsen?
Asks whether the competition authority should be informed of consolidation and why several safeguards in the directive were not transposed into the law.
It seems advisable to the PVV members that DNB also inform the NMa of an imminent consolidation.
Het lijkt de leden van de fractie van de PVV raadzaam om ook de NMa door de DNB van een op handen zijnde consolidatie op de hoogte te stellen.
Critical of the full removal of the finance minister's formal role, warning of more informal influence and asking how the minister and parliament keep control.
They consider it unwise that the formal role of the finance minister in a no-objection declaration, though already limited, is entirely abolished.
Zij vinden het onverstandig dat de – weliswaar reeds beperkte maar wel aanwezige – formele rol van de minister van Financien, bij een verklaring van geen bezwaar (vvgb) volledig komt te vervallen.
Questions the claim that the stability test is unchanged, the minister's apparent restraint, and whether supervisors' coordination provides adequate discipline.
The SP members do not see why the minister's current legal power in the acquisition process calls for restraint.
De leden van de SP-fractie zien niet in waarom de huidige juridische bevoegdheid van de minister in het overnameproces tot terughoudendheid noopt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a government bill implementing EU Directive 2007/44/EC on prudential assessment of acquisitions in financial firms, moving approval power from the Finance Minister to DNB and warning that the Minister's wider policy role and information flows needed clarification, plus the late implementation deadline. The government's nader rapport largely rejects the core concern on ministerial responsibility while accepting adjustments to information provision and the transitional clause and explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether the minister can still fulfil his shared responsibility for financial stability once approval power moves to DNB; the government rejected a continuing ministerial decision role but clarified the responsibility in the memorandum.

The Afdeling asked for an explanation of how the transitional period and implementation deadline are handled, and warned against treating Dutch law as applicable without directive-conform interpretation; the government adjusted the explanatory memorandum accordingly.

The Afdeling asked that the information-disclosure provision in Article 1:93c be reconciled with the closed confidentiality system; the government clarified the scope and limits of the information duty.
Redactional comments on cross-references and the citation title were accepted in the revised bill.

32319.s: The bill amends the Dutch Criminal Code on conditional sentencing and conditional early release: it widens the list of special conditions judges may impose, allows immediate enforceability of conditions and supervision pending appeal, lets prosecutors order pre-trial detention for suspected breach of conditions, and extends probation periods. It also abolishes the community service learning-project option and makes related technical changes.
32319.j: The memorandum justifies the expanded powers as necessary for a person-focused approach to conditional sentences, stronger probation supervision and quicker response to breaches, while stressing specificity of conditions and judicial decision-making.
q: The new article 14fa of the Criminal Code provides for arrest and detention of the convicted person pending the court's decision on enforcement of the custodial sentence.
