Het nieuwe artikel 14fa Sr voorziet in een mogelijkheid van aanhouding en insluiting van de veroordeelde in afwachting van de beslissing van de rechter over de tenuitvoerlegging van de vrijheidsstraf.
d: further special conditions concerning offender behaviour
further rules on the supervision exercised by probation services
p: Prosecutors may order arrest of a conditionally sentenced person on serious grounds of suspected breach, with a rechter-commissaris deciding within 72 hours and a right to compensation for unlawful detention.

Conditions and supervision may be made immediately enforceable pending appeal, but only by a court order where serious risk to physical integrity is expected and the order may be lifted by the appeal court.
Expanded catalogue of special conditions, including location bans and electronic monitoring, gives courts and probation wider intrusive options, subject to proportionality.

parties: Welcomes tightening of conditional sanctions and clearer conditions, but asks whether the offender gets too much say and whether conditions protecting victims are explained.
These members read in the explanatory memorandum that short unconditional prison sentences for adults are considered the least effective in reducing recidivism.
Deze leden lezen in de memorie van toelichting dat de korte onvoorwaardelijke vrijheidsstraffen voor volwassenen gelden als de minst effectieve straffen in termen van recidivevermindering.

Supports a person-focused approach but questions whether judges have enough insight and whether the prosecution and probation service have sufficient capacity; asks about the status of the 'non-fault' exception and the ECHR presumption of innocence.
These members note that this bill only has a chance of success if judges are able to impose conditions in such a way that they actually result in a sentence suited to the convicted person.

Deze leden willen daarbij opmerken dat dit wetsvoorstel alleen kans van slagen heeft als de rechters de voorwaarden zodanig weten op te leggen dat daarmee daadwerkelijk wordt voldaan aan een strafoplegging die past bij de persoon van de veroordeelde.
Asks questions about enforcement capacity of the police and about deportation conditions for foreign offenders without raising a check-specific objection.
They ask to what extent supervision of compliance with the conditions can be enforced within the police's available capacity.
Zij vragen in hoeverre het toezicht op de naleving van de voorwaarden kan worden gehandhaafd binnen de beschikbare capaciteit van de politie.

Supports the person-focused approach but stresses that prompt, consistent enforcement is essential, asks why 25% of non-compliance cases led to no enforcement procedure, and questions whether the less detailed conditions create legal uncertainty.
They find it worrying that research showed that in 25% of the examined cases of non-compliance, the Public Prosecution Service did not start an enforcement procedure.
Zij vinden het zorgelijk dat uit onderzoek is gebleken dat in 25% van de onderzochte gevallen van niet-naleving geen procedure tot tenuitvoerlegging werd gestart door het OM.

Supports conditional sentencing and mandatory probation supervision before finality, but questions whether the maximum probation period and the rapid-arrest rule respect judicial discretion and the presumption of innocence; asks about the Telegraaf report on immediate arrest.
These members believe that the same argument could be used to contend that a maximum probation period is not needed at all.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat met dat argument ook kan worden betoogd dat een maximering van de proeftijd in het geheel niet nodig is.

Asks why the provision protecting freedom of religion and political freedom in conditions is being dropped and how enforcement of the duty to leave the country can work given the lack of travel documents.
These members ask the government to explain further why it chooses to delete this provision.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten waarom de regering er voor kiest om deze bepaling te schrappen.

Asks whether detailed conditions in judgments would give probation more guidance, questions the maximum probation period and the removal of the freedom-of-religion safeguard, and asks about overlap with the bill on contact and area bans.
These members ask whether, given the nature of a judicial ruling imposing a sentence, it would not make sense to specify as far as possible which conditions must in any case be met.

Deze leden vragen of het gezien de aard van de rechterlijke uitspraak – het opleggen van een straf – niet voor de hand ligt om wel zo gedetailleerd mogelijk weer te geven aan welke voorwaarden in ieder geval voldaan moet worden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on a bill amending the Penal Code to make conditional sentences and conditional early release more precise, including a possibility for provisional enforcement of a conditional prison sentence. The government's reply accepts some remarks, such as adding clarity on mandatory treatment and supervision, but rejects the advice that provisional enforcement be limited to breach of special conditions, arguing it does not conflict with the presumption of innocence.
concerns: Provisional enforcement of a conditional prison sentence after breach of the general condition is said to conflict with the presumption of innocence in Article 6(2) ECHR; the government disagrees, citing the ernstige redenen test.

Special conditions for conditional sentences and early release are insufficiently specified and may infringe liberty rights; the Council asks for clearer statutory regulation and for justification of not specifying conditions for suspended pre-trial detention.

The duty to leave the Netherlands as a special condition raises questions about the public-order test under EU law and practical enforceability given identity and travel-document problems, and the Council asks for clarification.

Mandatory outpatient treatment including medication may create coercion; the Council asks the explanatory memorandum to address consent and bodily integrity under Article 10 Constitution and Article 8 ECHR.
The Council advises keeping the clause that special conditions may not restrict freedom of religion or belief and political freedom, which the government proposes to delete.
The Council asks for clarification of the expected recidivism effects, the reclassering resourcing and the inspectorate findings in the explanatory memorandum.
Redactional remarks on extending conditions to the probation period and clarifying independence of two claims in article 14fa were incorporated.

32337.s: The bill amends the Beginselenwet verpleging ter beschikking gestelden, the Penitentiaire beginselenwet and the Beginselenwet justitiële jeugdinrichtingen to broaden the grounds for involuntary medical treatment of detainees, juveniles and forensic psychiatric patients with a mental disorder causing danger. It sets procedural conditions: a treatment plan, a written decision by the facility head with two psychiatric opinions and time limits, complaints and appeal, and detailed rules to be set by general administrative order.
32337.j: The memorandum justifies the broader powers by the need to treat chronic psychiatric disorders causing danger, by equivalence of care with the Wet bopz, and by the Minister's duty of care toward detainees, and notes safeguards such as complaints and appeal to the RSJ.
q: Applying a medical (medicinal) treatment under compulsion constitutes a restriction of the right to private life and bodily integrity.
Het toepassen van een geneeskundige (medicamenteuze) handeling onder dwang vormt een beperking van het recht op het privé-leven en de onaantastbaarheid van het lichaam
d: rules on involuntary treatment decisions, registration and prohibited treatment methods
facilities and availability of psychiatrists and nurses for mental health treatment
requirements for treatment plans and amendment procedure
rules on time limits, registration, prohibited treatment and decision methods for involuntary treatment
facilities and staffing for treatment in juvenile institutions
rules on involuntary treatment of juveniles: time limits, registration, prohibited methods
p: Allows involuntary treatment of forensic psychiatric patients as a last resort without their consent when it is absolutely necessary to avert danger, decided by the facility head on medical advice.
Allows involuntary psychiatric treatment of detainees as a last resort, decided by the prison director, without a judicial order for treatment.
Allows involuntary treatment of juveniles in institutions as a last resort, decided by the director, where the juvenile or parents do not consent.

parties: Asks why the bill took so long and how it relates to the forensic care and mental health bills, and supports ex-post judicial review with possible suspension rather than prior review.
The VVD members support the government's decision not to include prior judicial review.
De leden van de VVD-fractie ondersteunen het besluit van de regering om de voorafgaande rechterlijke toetsing niet mee te nemen.
Argues that the decision on involuntary treatment should be reserved for an independent judge rather than the prison director, who may be influenced by operational interests.
These members do not consider the director the appropriate person to judge whether a detainee's personal integrity is respected.
Deze leden achten de directeur niet de aangewezen persoon om te oordelen of de persoonlijk integriteit van een gedetineerde gerespecteerd wordt.
Asks why no commission advising the director is set up as in the Wvggz bill, and how notification in emergencies would work, to keep decisions controllable.
These members ask why no commission is established in this bill, as is the case in the Wvggz bill.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen waarom in het betreffende wetsvoorstel geen commissie wordt ingesteld, net als het geval is bij het wetsvoorstel Wvggz.

Supports extending coercive treatment to juveniles and finds safeguards carefully balanced, while asking about the difference in guarantees between criminal and civil circuits and the proportionality of the safeguards under the ECHR.

In the view of these members, the bill and explanatory memorandum have carefully and evenly addressed the advisory comments and critical remarks on legal protection, safeguards and conditions for coercive treatment.

Naar de mening van de aan het woord zijnde leden is in het wetsvoorstel en de memorie van toelichting op zorgvuldige en evenwichtige wijze gevolg gegeven aan de in de ingewonnen adviezen gemaakte opmerkingen en kritische kanttekeningen inzake rechtsbescherming.

Stresses that coercive treatment is a serious infringement of bodily integrity that must be strictly tested, and questions whether the lack of a prior court finding of a mental disorder, unlike in Wet bopz cases, meets ECHR standards.
Does the government consider the safeguards included heavy enough to justify an infringement of bodily integrity, and can they also pass the ECHR test?
Vindt de regering de opgenomen waarborgen zwaar genoeg om een inbreuk op de lichamelijke integriteit te rechtvaardigen en kunnen deze ook de toets aan het EVRM doorstaan?

Asks the government to explain why ex-post judicial review is justified from the patient's perspective when the Wvggz uses prior review, and whether the new necessity criterion is harder to objectify and review.
These members ask the government to explain, in its response, why this distinction between prior and ex-post review is justified from the patient's perspective.

Deze leden verzoeken de regering bij de gevraagde toelichting in te gaan op de vraag waarom vanuit het perspectief van de patiënt dit onderscheid in toetsing vooraf en toetsing achteraf gerechtvaardigd is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill extending involuntary medical treatment for TBS patients, prisoners and youth detainees, asking alignment with the Wvggz and Wfz bills, dropping the probability criterion, adding prior judicial review, and limiting the scope to medication. The government's reply accepted alignment via amendment provisions, adopted several changes, but rejected prior judicial review in favour of ex post review with suspensive effect.
concerns: The Raad advised dropping the 'aannemelijkheid' criterion for detainees as it is applied outside the ultimum remedium context; the government clarified the justification in the explanatory memorandum rather than dropping it.
The Raad advised prior judicial review of involuntary treatment of detainees in line with the Wvggz; the government rejected this and chose ex post review with possible suspensive effect.
The Raad asked that the ultimum remedium character of coercive treatment be made clear; the government adjusted articles and explanatory notes to express this more clearly.
The Raad asked the explanatory memorandum to address shortcomings in prison psychiatric facilities and treatment of short-sentence prisoners; this was added.
The Raad advised limiting the bill to medication since the memorandum speaks only of medication; the government instead broadened the memorandum to cover all necessary treatment.
The Raad advised aligning the bill with the pending Wvggz and Wfz bills; the government addressed this through indien-provisions in those bills.

32364.s: This is a technical repair bill (Reparatiewet VWS 2010) that corrects wording errors and makes minor amendments across several health, welfare and sport laws, including the Drank- en Horecawet, Kwaliteitswet zorginstellingen, Warenwet, Wet bijzondere opnemingen in psychiatrische ziekenhuizen, Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning and Tabakswet. It also repeals obsolete provisions and an old 1995 law on civilian war victims' benefits. It creates no new executive discretion.
32364.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as repairs of defective wording and removal of superfluous provisions, not as new powers.
q: This amendment serves to repair a defective wording.
Deze wijziging dient als herstel van een gebrekkige formulering.
p: The treating physician's written decision for involuntary treatment replaces the earlier procedure, and the decision must state its duration, a technical change that shifts the procedural step to the treating physician.

32373.s: This bill amends the pending Wet implementatie EG-richtlijnen energie-efficiëntie by deleting several articles, including those on energy audits and the related sanctions, and redrafting the market surveillance and penalty provisions. It also adds definitions of final electricity and gas consumers, with the effective date set by royal decree.
q: The third paragraph lapses, with the fourth renumbered as the third.
Het derde lid vervalt, onder vernummering van het vierde lid tot derde lid.
d: effective date of definitions via royal decree
p: The management board of the competition authority may establish that an infringement has occurred and order a report, with the general administrative law procedure applying by analogy.

Earlier sanction provisions are removed and administrative fines and penalty payments are retained as the sanction tools, with objection suspending enforcement only of collection orders for administrative fines.

parties: The CDA reserves its final position until the government answers its earlier questions on dropping the cooperation obligation and the attached sanction.
The answer to those questions will be decisive for these members in determining their final position on the present amendment.
Het antwoord op die vragen zal voor deze leden leidend zijn voor de bepaling van hun definitieve standpunt over de onderhavige novelle.

The SP worries that data security and integrity safeguards against misuse by energy companies and third parties are insufficient, and asks who supervises this and whether checks are more than paper controls.
Can the government indicate which guarantees against misuse by energy companies and third parties are anchored in the bill?
Kan de regering aangeven welke zekerheden tegen misbruik door energiebedrijven en derden in het wetsvoorstel verankerd zijn?
The D66 reserves its position pending government answers on the introduction of smart energy meters, asked in relation to the market model bill.
The answers to these questions will guide these members in determining their position on both bills.
De antwoorden op deze vragen zullen voor deze leden leidend zijn bij het bepalen van de positie ten opzichte van beide wetsvoorstellen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on a bill amending the Wet implementatie EG-richtlijnen energie-efficiëntie, objecting that the proposed voluntary acceptance of individual smart meters by small consumers may conflict with the 80% smart meter target of the third electricity directive. The minister's reply keeps the voluntary approach to gain experience and public support, promising later supplementary proposals if the target looks unlikely to be met.
concerns: The voluntary approach to smart meter acceptance may be at odds with the 80% coverage objective of the third electricity directive, which the Raad sees as best served by mandatory rollout.

32382.s: The bill amends the Advocatenwet, Wet op de rechtsbijstand and Wet tarieven in burgerlijke zaken to tighten admission and registration of lawyers, codify core professional values, shift registration requests from the district court to the raad van toezicht, add a raad van advies, and give the Orde power to make regulations subject to ministerial approval. It also removes provisions on fee disputes and lets the Orde adopt rules that are subject to prior ministerial approval or annulment.
32382.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to guarantee quality of legal services and a good administration of justice, and by the diversity of the profession that requires flexible rules.
q: The interest of a proper administration of justice and the demands it places on the lawyer underlie and form the rationale and legitimacy of the special position of the legal profession.
Het belang van een goede rechtsbedeling en de eisen die dat aan de advocaat stelt, liggen ten grondslag aan en vormen de ratio en de legitimatie van de bijzondere positie van de advocatuur.
d: further professional requirements for admission as lawyer
designating degrees equivalent to Bachelor in law
Orde regulations on professional values, competence and organisation
ministerial approval of Orde regulations, with annulment for conflict with law or public interest
rules on composition and organisation of raad van advies
p: Allows the raad van toezicht to ask the disciplinary council to strike lawyers who do not practise the profession durably and systematically, with appeal to the hof van discipline.
Gives the raad van toezicht discretion to refuse to admit an applicant where there is reasonable fear of future breaches, based on broad grounds such as conduct a proper lawyer would not show.
Reorganises election procedures within the Orde, changing who elects the deken and board members and how representatives are chosen.
Codifies core professional values of lawyers as a benchmark for disciplinary and regulatory review.
Creates a raad van advies with a majority of non-lawyers to advise on Orde regulations before adoption.

parties: Asks the government to justify retaining preventive ministerial oversight of NOvA regulations given the bar's independence, as the Raad van State advised such oversight is unnecessary.

They therefore ask the government to further justify why it insists on preventive oversight, now that the explanatory memorandum notes that all regulations concerning internal organisation will in any case not be reviewed.

Zij vragen de regering dan ook nader te onderbouwen waarom wordt vastgehouden aan het preventieve toezicht, nu in de memorie van toelichting opgemerkt wordt dat alle verordeningen die de interne organisatie betreffen hoe dan ook niet zullen worden getoetst.

Accepts ministerial pre-approval of NOvA regulations as proportionate and necessary because self-regulation alone is insufficient, but asks how core values such as independence and partiality interact in practice.
Moreover, they share the government's view that, with careful weighing of all interests, self-regulation by the profession alone is no longer sufficient.
Bovendien delen zij de mening van de regering dat bij een zorgvuldige weging van alle belangen alleen zelfregulering door de branche zelf niet meer voldoende is.
Questions how deskundigheid is verified and sanctioned, why preventive oversight is preferred over trust in professionals, and how criminal-proceeds payments are policed.
Why does the government attach such importance to preventive oversight?
Waarom hecht de regering zo aan het preventieve toezicht?

Opposes resultaatgerelateerde beloning as undermining independence and prefers effective, transparent ex post supervision and disciplinary law over preventive oversight; questions the consistency of tightening bar rules while other legal advisers remain unregulated.
In the view of the SP faction, the 'no-win, no-fee' system is in essence no better than 'no-cure, no-pay'.
Naar de mening van de SP-fractie is het systeem van «no-win, no-fee» in essentie niet beter dan «no-cure, no-pay».
Asks whether preventive ministerial approval of a public body is appropriate when ex post suspension and annulment exist, and how the advocate's independence fits with the NOvA oversight regime.
Are the regular methods of suspension and annulment after the fact not sufficient?
Zijn de reguliere methoden als schorsing en vernietiging achteraf niet voldoende?
Asks whether the government will address the bar's concerns, the role of deans in filtering complaints, and the independence of appointments and of the supervisory college.
They point out first of all that the present proposal cannot count on much support within the professional group concerned.
Zij wijzen er allereerst op dat het voorliggende voorstel niet op veel draagvlak kan rekenen binnen de beroepsgroep die het betreft.
Supports external oversight of the bar for public interest but asks how to ensure independence, uniformity and the role of local deans.
On the other hand, the members speaking attach great value to the independence of the legal profession.
Anderzijds hechten de aan het woord zijnde leden veel waarde aan de onafhankelijkheid van de advocatuur.
Asks whether the existing self-regulation failed and whether investigative powers would extend to lawyers' files.
These members ask whether the current (self-regulating) supervision failed in these cases and how the proposed supervision would do better or prevent this.
Deze leden vragen of het huidige (zelfregulerende) toezicht in deze gevallen faalde en hoe het voorgestelde toezicht dit beter zou doen of zou voorkomen.
Doubts that an extra supervisory layer with government-appointed members improves uniformity and clarity and risks government interference in an independent bar.
Even though such an appointment corresponds to how judicial officials are appointed, the principle that the bar must be able to operate fully independently of the government is thereby abandoned.

Ook al komt een dergelijke benoeming overeen met de wijze waarop rechterlijke ambtenaren worden benoemd, het uitgangspunt dat de advocatuur volledig onafhankelijk moet kunnen opereren van de overheid is hiermee losgelaten.
Sees the proposal as necessary to professionalise and independently supervise the bar, asking about staffing and the role of deans.
They see the proposals laid down here as a necessary improvement and professionalisation of supervision of the legal profession.
Zij zien de hierin neergelegde voorstellen als noodzakelijke verbetering en professionalisering van het toezicht op de advocatuur.
Warns that government participation in controlling the bar touches its independence and questions the necessity of prior approval of bar regulations.
These members explicitly ask the government to reflect on the distance the government in its view should keep from the legal profession.
Deze leden vragen de regering nadrukkelijk te reflecteren op de afstand die de overheid naar haar mening dient in te nemen ten opzichte van de advocatuur.
Supports stronger preventive supervision but questions the direct route of complaints to the disciplinary board and the cost and clarity of the procedure.
They therefore ask for further justification on a number of points.
Zij vragen daarom op een aantal punten om een nadere onderbouwing.
Views the bar as essential to the democratic rule of law and asks questions about strengthening its independent position.
These members assume that public trust in the legal profession gives sufficient credit to strengthen the independent position of the bar in the Dutch democratic rule of law.

Deze leden veronderstellen dat het publieke vertrouwen in de advocatuur voldoende credits geeft om de onafhankelijke positie van de advocatuur in de Nederlandse democratische rechtstaat te versterken.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division opposed the creation of an independent college of supervision positioned within the NOvA for lawyers, and advised against allowing clients to file complaints directly with the disciplinary judge and against introducing a court fee. The government's nader rapport rejected most objections, keeping the college and the direct complaint route, while adopting the advice on damages in disciplinary proceedings and on timeliness of complaints.
concerns: The Afdeling was not convinced that a separate college of supervision is necessary; the government maintained the college, arguing the existing system is reactive and insufficiently uniform.

The Afdeling questioned the positioning of the college as an organ of the NOvA given its independence from the minister and the bar; the government kept the NOvA positioning but explained the appointment procedure and budget approval as safeguards.

The Afdeling advised against allowing clients to file complaints directly with the disciplinary judge; the government retained the direct access system, citing a stronger independent position for clients.
The Afdeling objected that a court fee for filing disciplinary complaints could deter complainants; the government kept the fee at a low level, refunding it in successful cases.

The Afdeling asked for clarification of the wording on disputes over declarations and the relation to arbitration and binding advice; the government removed the word 'kunnen' and clarified the commentary.
The Afdeling advised that the college's power to appoint its own staff as supervisors be limited; the government rejected this on the basis that such staff offer better guarantees of independence.

The Afdeling advised allowing disciplinary complaints filed late to be excused where the client could not reasonably have acted earlier; the government pointed to existing rules, and no change was made to the wording.
The Afdeling advised introducing a damages mechanism for the disciplinary judge now rather than waiting for the Kaderwet; the government added an article 48b allowing damages up to 5,000 euro.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against ministerial prior approval (preventief toezicht) of Orde van Advocaten regulations and against an unclear regulation of result-related fees, and asked for codification of core values to be reconsidered. The government's reply largely rejects the preventive supervision objection, drops a statutory ban on result-related fees in favour of an experiment, and partly accepts the drafting remarks.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that preventive ministerial approval of Bar regulations is not justified given the Orde's public-body status, and advised relying on an advisory council instead; the government maintained that prior approval is desirable for legitimacy and public trust.

The Afdeling found the codified ban on pars quota litis and the regulation of result-related fees insufficiently justified in necessity and proportionality, and unclear in scope; the government dropped the statutory ban in favour of a supervised experiment.
The Afdeling said the pars quota litis ban must be shown necessary and proportionate under EU free-movement and competition law, which the explanatory memorandum did not do.
The Afdeling asked for clarity on civil-law consequences of breaching the proposed fee rule and on the scope of the proposed core values, including whether other professions will follow.
The Afdeling made several redactional remarks on the bill text, which the government said it had taken into account.

32418.s: The bill amends the Civil Code and the Code of Civil Procedure to allow an general administrative order (AMvB) to set and cap the reimbursable extrajudicial debt-collection costs for claims up to EUR 25,000, mainly to protect consumers and small businesses. It also excludes such capped costs from the rule that turns out-of-court costs into procedural costs, and removes the judge's power to moderate them for these claims.
32418.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the lack of clear guidance in the extrajudicial phase on the amount of collection costs, which gives both debtors and creditors legal certainty.
q: I therefore propose to include in the law a basis for setting rules by general administrative order on the reimbursement of extrajudicial collection costs.
Ik stel daarom voor om in de wet een grondslag op te nemen om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur regels te stellen voor de vergoeding van buitengerechtelijke incassokosten.
p: For claims up to EUR 25,000 the judge loses the power to moderate agreed extrajudicial collection costs, because the fixed AMvB norm applies instead.

parties: Questions whether regulation is justified and asks that the central delegation to a general administrative order be placed in the statute itself, with possible pre-consultation of the amvb.
Deviations from this starting point should preferably be regulated in the law itself, in the view of these members.
Afwijkingen op dit uitgangspunt dienen naar het oordeel van de deze leden bij voorkeur in de wet zelf te zijn geregeld.
Welcomes the bill but asks for the amvb to be sent to parliament for review and questions the tiered structure that may increase debts.
The PvdA members further ask whether the government is willing to send the announced amvb to the House so its content can be assessed.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen voorts of de regering bereid is de aangekondigde amvb naar de Kamer sturen zodat de inhoud daarvan beoordeeld kan worden.
Asks technical questions about thresholds, the relation to Voor-werk II and deposit payments, and whether protecting small businesses is justified.
These members note that the scheme in this bill aims to protect consumers and small businesses.
De leden van de PVV-fractie merken op dat de regeling in het onderhavige wetsvoorstel consumenten en kleine bedrijven beoogt te beschermen.

Supports capping costs but worries a €40 minimum could push creditors quickly into costlier court procedures and burden the judiciary, and asks whether regulation should instead be via licensing or quality mark.
The risk that may then loom is that cases are passed too quickly to court procedures (via the bailiff) that are many times more costly for the debtor.
Het risico dat dan wellicht opdoemt is dat er te snel wordt doorgeschakeld naar gerechtelijke trajecten (via de deurwaarder) die voor de schuldenaar vele malen kostbaarder zijn.
Supports the statutory tariff cap for protecting debtors but proposes damages liability for creditors charging above the maximum and asks that the amvb be made binding and sent with the statute.
These members therefore propose that creditors demanding excessive collection costs be required to pay damages to the debtor.
Deze leden stellen daarom voor de schuldeisers die te hoge incassokosten eisen, een schadevergoeding te laten betalen aan de schuldenaar.
Questions whether the bill will achieve its protective aim, whether shorter collection trajectories and an unfair cost structure were adequately studied.
They nevertheless wonder whether the current bill will actually achieve its intended aim, namely protecting debtors against excessive collection costs.
Zij vragen zich desalniettemin af of het huidige wetsvoorstel wel het beoogde doel zal bereiken, namelijk de bescherming van debiteuren tegen te hoge incassokosten.
Asks how the bill relates to improving quality and supervision of collection firms, the EU late-payment directive, and VAT treatment for non-VAT-liable creditors.
These members ask how EU-level policy development, such as the directive on combating late payment in commercial transactions, is taken into account in Dutch legislation.

Deze leden vragen op welke wijze de beleidsontwikkeling op Europees niveau, zoals de richtlijn betreffende de bestrijding van betalingsachterstand bij handelstransacties, wordt betrokken bij Nederlandse wetgeving.
Asks why the tariffs are lower than Voor-werk II, whether the bill covers government fines, and how the costs are distinguished in law.
These members note that some stakeholders point out that the schedule and minimum fee norms in the explanatory memorandum are lower than the norms under Voor-werk II.

Deze leden constateren dat enkele belanghebbenden erop wijzen dat de normen inzake de staffel en de minimumvergoeding die in de toelichting van het wetsvoorstel zijn gegeven lager zijn dan de normen die gelden op basis van Voor-werk II.

32427.s: The bill amends the Wet milieubeheer so that water management plans must include measures preventing deterioration of water bodies, with an express statutory basis allowing a general administrative order (amvb) to set the detailed content of the 'no deterioration' requirement and monitoring rules. It also adds the new provision to the list of articles where a draft amvb must be submitted to parliament and published for public comment.
32427.j: The memorandum justifies the amvb delegation by the experience gained in drafting the Bkmw 2009 and by the wish to make maximum use of the latitude the KRW allows for practical consequences.
q: When drafting the Bkmw 2009 it appeared desirable to further specify the no-deterioration requirement by or pursuant to an amvb.
Bij de opstelling van het Bkmw 2009 is gebleken dat het wenselijk is het vereiste van geen achteruitgang verder in te vullen bij of krachtens amvb.
d: Artikel I A, 1 (art. 5.2b, vierde lid Wm)
exceptions to no-deterioration requirement under KRW
Artikel I A, 2 (art. 5.2b, vijfde lid Wm)
further rules on applying the no-deterioration requirement
p: Artikel I A, 2 (art. 5.2b, vijfde lid Wm)
Lets a general administrative order set further rules on the no-deterioration requirement, with draft submitted to parliament and public comment.

parties: Asks how detailed the new quality-norm assessment will be and how the two-decimal norms relate to the status classes and bandwidths in the explanatory memorandum.
How does this relate to the status classes and the associated bandwidth as explained in the explanatory memorandum?
Hoe verhoudt dit zich nu tot de toestandsklassen en de bijbehorende bandbreedte zoals die worden uitgelegd in de memorie van toelichting?
Asks why the earlier national additions were included and whether the Algemene Maatregel van Bestuur route for key choices gives the States General adequate involvement.
Finally, the CDA members ask why a number of important choices will be made by General Administrative Order (AMvB) rather than in this act.
Tot slot vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie waarom een aantal belangrijke keuzes zal worden gemaakt bij Algemene Maatregel van Bestuur en niet in deze wet.

Fears that removing restrictions on deterioration of chemical quality and dropping the permit link allow water quality to worsen without consequences, and questions consistency with the KRW and Drinking Water Directive.
The members fear that no restriction will be imposed on the deterioration of chemical water quality where it is already poor.
De leden vrezen daarbij dat geen enkele restrictie meer wordt gesteld aan de verslechtering van de chemische waterkwaliteit als deze al slecht is.

Suggests dropping the general coupling to permits but keeping it selectively for groundwater protection areas and drinking-water intake points, and asks what sanctions water managers have to compel businesses and citizens.
What sanctioning instruments do water managers have and/or will they receive to oblige businesses and private individuals to take relevant and technically and economically realistic measures?
Welke sanctiemiddelen hebben en/of krijgen de waterbeheerders om bedrijven en particulieren te verplichten om relevante en technisch en economische reële maatregelen te treffen?
Expresses interest in the bill without raising substantive questions in this excerpt.
The ChristenUnie members have taken note of the bill with interest.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.

32445.s: The bill amends the Wet milieubeheer so that, for unusual incidents in an establishment whose adverse environmental effects are not significant, the competent authority may in the environmental permit or a tailored regulation set a different reporting deadline and require registration instead of immediate notification. Such incidents are then exempt from the standard notification, supplementary data, and inspector-reporting obligations of articles 17.3 to 17.5.
32445.j: The memorandum justifies the differentiation by the case law requiring all disturbances to be reported, which imposes large administrative burdens, while registration keeps records available to supervisors.
q: As a consequence, companies must report almost every disruption in their business process.
Het gevolg hiervan is dat bedrijven vrijwel elke verstoring in hun bedrijfsproces moeten melden.
d: competent authority sets registration and reporting deadline for minor unusual incidents in permit or tailored regulation
p: I.A (Art. 17.2, second and third paragraphs, new)

Competent authorities may waive immediate notification and the usual supplementary reporting for incidents whose environmental effects are not significant, reducing routine transparency to the inspectorate, with the scope limited to incidents specified in the permit or regulation.

parties: Asks how permits for tailored reporting arrangements will be granted, how they will be shaped in practice, and how conflicts over permit decisions will be resolved.
How will this permit-granting work in practice?
Hoe zal deze vergunningverlening in zijn werk gaan?

Asks the government to justify, by category, every national addition beyond EU requirements and to remove national add-ons in the Wet milieubeheer, since going beyond EU obligations needs convincing justification.
They therefore request the government to remove the national add-ons in chapter 17 of the Wet milieubeheer through this proposal.
Zij verzoeken de regering derhalve de nationale koppen in hoofdstuk 17 van de Wet milieubeheer door middel van dit voorstel te verwijderen
Warns that leaving reporting duties to competent authorities lets them compete on low burdens at the expense of environmental protection, and asks how second-line control will prevent this.
How and how often does second-line control take place on this?
Hoe en hoe vaak vindt er tweedelijns controle hierop plaats?
Only states having taken note of the bill, with no substantive concern raised.
The members of the ChristenUnie faction have taken note of the bill with interest.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.

32454.s: The bill adds a provision to numerous Dutch statutes (Mining Act, Price Act, tax acts, Civil Code, Gambling Act, Leegstandwet, Medical Emergency Act and others) applying the procedural rules of Awb paragraph 4.1.3.3 (lex silencio positivo) to permits, exemptions and approvals, so that they are deemed granted if the authority does not decide in time. It also amends the Leegstandwet to regulate permits granted by operation of law, including expiry, revocation and fixing rent by the mayor.
32454.j: The memorandum justifies applying lex silencio positivo as a way to ensure timely decisions and legal certainty for applicants, while noting that deemed permits remain open to appeal in the administrative courts.
q: This means that an objection can still be lodged against a decision granted by operation of law.
Dit betekent dat tegen een van rechtswege verleend besluit gewoon bezwaar kan worden gemaakt.
d: deemed approval of permits and exemptions by ministers, tax inspector, SVB and municipal authorities
p: Permits deemed granted by operation of law may be revoked by mayor and aligned with a fixed rent set after granting, limiting third-party challenges to a later stage.
Minister may grant exemptions from security personnel obligations, subject to a standard eight-week decision period.

parties: Welcomes the bill and asks the government to extend deemed permission to more permit regimes that the government excluded.
The VVD members have taken note of the bill with appreciation.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met waardering kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.
Asks whether third parties who miss the appeal window are adequately protected when deemed permission is granted without publication.

These members ask whether third-party protection is sufficiently guaranteed where that third party has missed the chance to object or appeal because the administrative body did not or late published the decision.

Deze leden vragen of die derdenbescherming wel voldoende wordt gewaarborgd in het geval die derde vanwege het niet of te laat publiceren door het bestuursorgaan van de beschikking, de kans op bezwaar of beroep heeft gemist?
Sees faster decisions as sensible but asks how third-party interests and information for citizens are safeguarded.
The aforementioned members ask how the interests of third-party stakeholders are handled with a permit granted by operation of law.
Voornoemde leden vragen hoe de belangen van de derdebelanghebbenden worden behandeld bij een van rechtswege verleende vergunning.
Accepts that the deemed decision is not fully reasoned but raises concerns about legal consequences, revocation, review and third-party rights when permits conflict with zoning or refusal grounds.
More difficult is the possibility that a decision by operation of law cuts across a system of mandatory refusal grounds.
Lastiger is de kans dat een beschikking van rechtswege een stelsel van dwingend geformuleerde weigeringgronden doorkruist.

Considers the premise fundamentally wrong: deemed permission invites arbitrariness, shifts state failure onto society, removes third-party objection before grant, and the existing Wet dwangsom suffices.

This law, which allows permits to be granted by operation of law after the decision period is exceeded, according to these members fosters arbitrariness and shifts the consequences of government failure onto society.

Deze wet, die het mogelijk maakt dat vergunningen van rechtswege worden verleend na de overschrijding van de beslistermijn, werkt volgens deze leden willekeur in de hand en wentelt de gevolgen van overheidsfalen af op de samenleving.
Asks for monitoring, annual reporting and per-regime justification of added value, and asks why the Wet dwangsom is not sufficient.
They believe careful monitoring and an annual report can provide clarity on the timeliness of decision-making and the effects of introducing this measure.
Zij menen dat zorgvuldig monitoren en een jaarlijkse rapportage helderheid kunnen verschaffen over de tijdigheid van de besluitvorming en de effecten van de invoering van deze maatregel hierop.
Doubts that automatic permits improve legal certainty for third parties and asks about evaluation, negative effects and appeal rates.
They do ask, however, to what extent the instrument of automatic permit granting after the deadline actually improves legal certainty for third parties.

Zij vragen zich echter wel af in hoeverre het middel van de automatische vergunningverlening na het verstrijken van de termijn ook daadwerkelijk een verbetering betekent voor de rechtszekerheid voor derden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill introducing the tacit permit (lex silencio positivo) for a range of permit regimes, questioning its necessity and advising removal of the Wet op de kansspelen provision on gaming machines. The government's reply accepted the general approach but rejected removing the gaming-machine provision, arguing the risk of addiction is minimal, and adopted editorial remarks.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the added value of the tacit permit for many regimes given low application numbers and the existing Wet dwangsom incentive, and asks for per-regime justification.

The Afdeling advises deleting the tacit permit for gaming-machine presence permits under the Wet op de kansspelen because of addiction risks; the government kept the provision, arguing such permits would rarely be granted by lapse of time.
Editorial remarks on the link between the Wet op de omzetbelasting 1968 and article 6 of the Communautair douanewetboek and on the formulation of article XI, part B.

32481.s: The bill amends the Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming to give the Consumentenautoriteit supervisory power over the fare-transparency obligation in Article 23 of EU Regulation 1008/2008 on air services. It also updates the reference in the Luchtvaartwet to the EU regulation and lets the Minister suspend or revoke operating licences in accordance with that regulation.
32481.j: The memorandum justifies the supervisory assignment by the thematic overlap with the Consumentenautoriteit's existing enforcement task under the Wet oneerlijke handelspraktijken, and notes that the regulation is directly applicable.
q: Given the substantive overlap between supervision of Article 23 of the Regulation and the Consumentenautoriteit's existing task, it was decided to assign supervision of compliance with the obligations under Article 23 of the Regulation to the Consumentenautoriteit.

Gelet op het inhoudelijke raakvlak van het toezicht op artikel 23 van de Verordening met deze reeds bestaande taak van de Consumentenautoriteit is besloten het toezicht op de naleving van de verplichtingen die voortvloeien uit artikel 23 van de Verordening bij de Consumentenautoriteit te beleggen.
p: Assigns supervision of airfare transparency to the Consumentenautoriteit, an existing consumer enforcement body, with civil-court enforcement remaining available.

parties: Questions the government's explanation for the long delay in implementing the EU regulation and supports system supervision to limit administrative burdens on firms.
The VVD members regret the delay in implementing the Regulation, since it has been in force since 1 November 2008.
De leden van de VVD-fractie betreuren de vertraging in de implementatie van de Verordening aangezien deze reeds op 1 november 2008 in werking is getreden.
Asks whether the Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat should have been chosen as supervisor instead of the Consumentenautoriteit and asks about past violations and enforcement.
The PvdA members ask the government whether it also considered designating the Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat instead of the Consumentenautoriteit as supervisor under this bill.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering of ook is overwogen om niet de Consumentenautoriteit, maar de Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat aan te wijzen als toezichthouder in het kader van dit voorstel van wet.
Strongly supports the bill as providing full price transparency for consumers and a level playing field, and wants rapid entry into force.
The PVV members are very pleased with the bill before us.
De leden van de PVV-fractie zijn zeer content met het voorliggende voorstel van wet.
Asks why supervision was assigned to the Consumentenautoriteit rather than the Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat, how this relates to existing tasks, and how the fine compares with other countries.

The CDA members also ask, given that the Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat already supervises parts of the aviation sector, whether the supervisory task arising from this bill could better be assigned to the Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen voorts, gelet op het feit dat de Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat reeds toezicht houdt op onderdelen van de luchtvaartbranche, of het onderbrengen van de toezichthoudende taak voortvloeiend uit dit voorstel van wet niet beter bij de Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat belegd zou kunnen worden.

32500-III.s: This bill formally establishes the 2011 budget appropriations for the Ministry of General Affairs (including the Dienst Publiek en Communicatie agency), the Cabinet of the Queen, and the Commission for oversight of the intelligence and security services. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 January of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs for the year 2011 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken voor het jaar 2011 wordt vastgesteld.

32562.s: The bill amends the Evaluatiewet modernisering rechterlijke organisatie and the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie with technical changes: it preserves the existing use of secondary court locations for immigration cases, adjusts municipal boundaries in the court districts, adds transitional rules for pending cases and the Dutch bailiffs' council, and updates ministry names. It is a technical amendment bill with no meaningful shift of power to the executive.
32562.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need for flexible and effective handling of immigration cases across the country, given the existing workloads of different court locations.
q: For effective immigration case law it is therefore important that the current situation can be continued.
Voor een effectieve vreemdelingenrechtspraak is het derhalve van belang dat de huidige situatie kan worden gecontinueerd.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel A (artikel 41, tweede lid, Wet RO)
designation of secondary court locations for immigration cases outside the district

parties: Asks whether enough specialised judges will remain available despite the wider spread of immigration cases, and whether satellite locations should be restricted to main towns to protect quality and legal unity.
These members would like to know how it is guaranteed that, despite the spreading, enough expert judges remain available to handle these cases.
Deze leden willen graag weten hoe gegarandeerd wordt dat ondanks de spreiding nog steeds voldoende deskundige rechters voorhanden zijn om deze zaken te behandelen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the bill adjusting judicial districts to municipal mergers and extending transitional law, but advises that the arrangement keeping the existing sub-location system for immigration case law be placed in a separate exception provision rather than transitional law. The government reply reports that this advice was followed and that an additional transitional provision for the bailiffs' professional body and minor technical corrections were added.
concerns: The Afdeling advised that the retention of the sub-location system for immigration law be placed in a separate exception provision rather than in transitional law, because it is structural rather than temporary.

32616.s: The bill approves seven ministerial regulations already in force for the Caribbean public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, which amend and adapt inherited Netherlands Antillean laws under the Invoeringswet BES. It also sets its entry into force on the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
32616.j: The memorandum explains that the Invoeringswet BES allows Netherlands Antillean laws to be amended by ministerial regulation and that this bill is required so that Parliament approves those regulations.
q: Article 21(1) of the IBES provides that as soon as possible after the entry into force of the above ministerial regulations, a bill approving these regulations must be submitted to the States General.

Artikel 21, eerste lid, van de IBES bepaalt dat zo spoedig mogelijk na de inwerkingtreding van de hierboven genoemde ministeriële regelingen een voorstel van wet tot goedkeuring van deze regelingen bij de Staten-Generaal wordt ingediend.
d: amendment of Netherlands Antillean laws for BES islands

32625.s: The bill (Invoeringswet geluidproductieplafonds) replaces the noise-hindrance chapter of the Wet milieubeheer with a new chapter 11, moving road and rail noise rules and sanitation obligations into that framework and adjusting the Wet geluidhinder, Spoedwet wegverbreding, Tracéwet and related laws. It shifts noise-plafond and sanitation decisions to the minister and sets transitional rules for ongoing projects.
32625.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as a simplification and harmonisation of noise rules and as a way to bring all decisions under one ministry and one procedure.
q: This approach is consistent with that of the new chapter 11 of the Wet milieubeheer.
Deze benadering stemt overeen met die van het nieuwe hoofdstuk 11 van de Wet milieubeheer.
d: which buildings count as other noise-sensitive buildings
categories of buildings excluded from definition of dwelling
sanitation and projection rules for road zones
measures, circumstances and programme timing for sanitation programmes
requirements on rail infrastructure to prevent noise and vibration
rules for applying the financial-efficiency criterion for measures
ARTIKEL II, A (art. 11.1 - geprojecteerde weg definitions)
designation of noise-sensitive objects and related definitions
noise production ceilings included in route decisions
how noise production is calculated for annual reporting
details of data to accompany sanitation plan request
road and rail sections subject to sanitation for strong noise growth
minister adopts sanitation plans with set deadlines
minister may change sanitation plan or deadline in special cases
minister may set a different deadline for noise measures
minister prepares plan of measures for road projects
rules for recalculating noise ceilings under transitional provisions
p: Enforcement of noise obligations is assigned to the minister, with the Inspectie reporting to the minister.
The minister alone adopts sanitation plans and may later alter them in special cases, with only general public consultation on the plan.</description_en
Pending decisions are kept under the old Wet geluidhinder regime, limiting the reach of new protections for those affected.</description_en
ARTIKEL I, E and ARTIKEL I, N
Responsibility for road and rail noise rules shifts from municipalities and provinces to the national minister.</description_en

parties: Asks whether flexibility is possible and questions the 1.5 dB workable margin, seeking information on transitional rules and the basis for distinguishing road and rail noise.
According to the VVD members, flexibility is however important and a balancing must be possible between the interests of mobility, surrounding noise-sensitive objects and residents.

Volgens de leden van de VVD-fractie is flexibiliteit echter van belang en moet er een afweging gemaakt kunnen worden tussen de belangen van mobiliteit, de omliggende geluidsgevoelige objecten en de omwonenden.
Asks whether calculation models are regularly tested against practice by sample measurements and how enforcement and the manager's dual role will work.
These models are only applicable if they are regularly tested against practice through sample-based measurements.
Deze modellen zijn alleen toepasbaar als zij regelmatig aan de praktijk worden getoetst door middel van steekproefsgewijze metingen.
Doubts the accuracy of the ceiling calculations, asks for periodic verification, and argues for more decentralised responsibility and clearer enforcement and sanctions.
They argue for more decentralised responsibility.
Zij pleiten voor meer decentrale verantwoordelijkheid.

Questions the criteria for noise-sensitive objects being set in a lower-level decree rather than the law, the lack of a link between facade and indoor noise values, and whether administrative fines or criminal liability apply to manipulation of calculations.
Why are those criteria not anchored at the level of the law?
Waarom worden die criteria niet op het niveau van de wet verankerd?

Worries that the ministerial split between setting the framework and implementation weakens checks and balances, and asks about resident participation, appeal rights and compliance with the Aarhus Convention.
How will the government, in this new situation, ensure adequate checks and balances?
Hoe zal de regering in deze nieuwe situatie zorgdragen voor afdoende «checks and balances»?

Doubts the 1.5 dB workable margin and the 65 dB norm, questions whether residents should go through the Inspectie rather than ordinary administrative court appeal, and worries about the effect on municipal building plans.
Introducing the proposed 1.5 dB workable margin without laying down further principles on measures and techniques to counter traffic noise is not considered responsible by them.

Het invoeren van de voorgestelde werkruimte van 1,5 dB, zonder daarbij nadere uitgangspunten vast te leggen over maatregelen en technieken om verkeerslawaai tegen te gaan, achten zij niet verantwoord.
Asks whether the single minister who sets the ceilings and enforces them creates conflicts of interest and suggests an independent body, such as regional enforcement services, handle enforcement.
To prevent conflicts of interest and 'two-hats problems', these members consider entrusting enforcement to an independent body.
Om nu belangenverstrengeling en «tweepettenproblemen» te voorkomen geven deze leden in overweging om een onafhankelijke instantie te belasten met de handhaving.

Asks whether verification and monitoring of calculated noise production should be done by an independent body with a statutory basis, and whether procedures for raising ceilings are unduly easier than for lowering them.
Would it not be wise to better secure verification and monitoring of calculated noise production and noise production ceilings through measurements by an independent body given a statutory basis?

Is het niet verstandig om verificatie en monitoring van berekende geluidproductie en geluidproductieplafonds beter te borgen door metingen door een onafhankelijke instantie en deze een wettelijke basis te geven?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supported the draft Invoeringswet geluidproductieplafonds but raised concerns about the unexplained budget of EUR 941 million for noise remediation, the lack of VNG advice in the explanatory memorandum, and several drafting points. The government's nader rapport explains the budget basis, clarifies the VNG consultation, and adopts most drafting remarks, declining only one.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for an explanation of how the EUR 941 million budget was determined given unknown remediation objects and incomplete cost insight; the government explained the budget basis and amended the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum report the VNG's position on relevant draft rules and the government's reaction; the government stated the VNG and IPO were consulted and the memorandum was adjusted.

The Afdeling made several redactional remarks; the government adopted most, including deleting references to non-residential sensitive buildings, but did not adopt the remark on article 73 of the Wet geluidhinder.

32710-X.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget statements of the Ministry of Defence and the three Defence operating-cost agencies (DTO, DVD, Paresto), adjusting appropriations and expenditure figures. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, applying retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32742.s: The bill allows teachers holding a Pabo (primary teacher training) diploma to be appointed in practical secondary education for subjects designated by general administrative order, and lets a ministerial regulation list which diplomas qualify teachers for common subjects not named on diplomas. It also amends the BES version of the secondary education law and sets its entry into force by royal decree, with some provisions retroactive to 1 August 2006.
32742.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as technical clarification of appointment possibilities, since the old Regeling bewijzen van bekwaamheid lapsed and a new conversion table is needed for subjects without a specific teacher training.
q: To create clarity on appointability in these situations, a new list is needed, a conversion table, laid down by ministerial regulation.
Om in deze situaties duidelijkheid te creëren ten aanzien van de benoembaarheid, is een nieuwe lijst nodig, een conversietabel, vastgelegd bij ministeriële regeling.
d: subjects in practical secondary education for Pabo-diploma holders
I-A-2 (art. 33, lid 1c, onder a and b)
list of qualifying diplomas for common subjects and programme parts
subjects in BES practical secondary education for Pabo-diploma holders
II-A-2 (art. 80, lid 4, onder a and b)
BES list of qualifying diplomas for common subjects

parties: Asks whether the government's pabo-to-tweedegraads staffing ratio has changed since the Wet BIO and whether the conversion table should be set by ministerial regulation rather than by the teacher-training institutions.
They ask, however, whether the conversion table proposed by the government should be drawn up by ministerial regulation.
Zij vragen echter of de door de regering voorgestelde conversietabel zou moeten worden opgesteld bij ministeriële regeling.
Argues the bill loosens appointability of unqualified teachers and asks the government to add amendments limiting repeated exemptions for long-term appointment of unqualified teachers.
The members have a greater need for a bill that makes it harder to appoint unqualified teachers.
De leden hebben meer behoefte aan een wetsvoorstel dat het benoemen van onbevoegde leraren bemoeilijkt.
Welcomes the clarification of teacher competence for renamed subjects but worries the list could become an unwieldy 'telephone book' of qualifications.
The members ask whether the list to be drawn up does not risk becoming, over time, an unwieldy list and a new 'telephone book of certificates of competence'.

De leden van de genoemde fractie vragen wel of de op te stellen lijst niet het risico met zich meebrengt dat op den duur een onoverzichtelijke lijst gaat ontstaan en er een nieuw «telefoonboek van de bewijzen van bekwaamheid» ontstaat.

Asks how often the minister will grant individual competence declarations for unique subjects, what criteria apply, and on what grounds a request would be refused, noting the Raad van State's remarks on pabo-trained teachers in practical education.
When will the minister refuse an application for such a declaration of competence?
Wanneer zal de minister een aanvraag voor een dergelijke verklaring van bekwaamheid afwijzen?

Supports restoring the teaching qualification for pabo-trained teachers in practical education and clarifying the requirements for teaching a subject, and calls for more investment in teacher quality.
The D66 members agree with the intention to again grant teachers with a pabo certificate a qualification for practical education.
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn het eens met het voornemen om docenten met een getuigschrift van de pabo weer een bevoegdheid te geven voor het praktijkonderwijs.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill allowing teachers with a Pabo certificate to teach vocational practical education (praktijkonderwijs), but asks the government to explain in the explanatory memorandum that such teachers are equally qualified there, and to simplify the enforcement section. The government's reply (nader rapport) adds the requested clarification, revises the enforcement paragraph as advised, and accepts the editorial remarks.
concerns: The Afdeling advised clarifying in the explanatory memorandum that Pabo-certificate teachers and tweedegraads teachers are equivalent in practical education, which the government added.
The Afdeling advised rewording the enforcement and feasibility section, distinguishing handhaafbaarheid from uitvoerbaarheid, and the government revised the paragraph accordingly.
Editorial remarks on the bill's wording, numbering and structure in the annex were incorporated by the government.

32760.s: The bill amends the Primary Education Act to let the minister recognise a branch or detached part of a school as an independent school for funding, provided it meets the founding norm and the remaining school can stay funded for 15 years. It also adjusts funding rules so that pupils moving to a new school within the same governing body are no longer counted at the original school.
32760.j: The memorandum justifies the discretionary power by noting that branches already function largely as independent schools and that distance from the main site can be a reason to refuse.
q: The choice to recognise a detached site for independence rests with the minister: it is a discretionary power.
De keuze om een dislocatie voor verzelfstandiging in aanmerking te brengen is aan de minister: het is een discretionaire bevoegdheid.
d: conditions for recognising a branch as an independent school
size of pupil numbers not counted for funding of other schools
size of pupil numbers not counted for funding of other schools
p: The minister gains discretion to decide whether a branch becomes an independent funded school, subject to statutory criteria.

parties: Asks how the minister's discretionary power to keep a school open under the closure norm relates to applications, and how arbitrariness in the 'too small distance' criterion will be prevented, including criteria to be set in delegation provisions.
How will the appearance of arbitrariness be prevented, ask these members.
Hoe zal de schijn van willekeur worden voorkomen, zo vragen deze leden.
Welcomes removing barriers to separating dislocations but asks who should hold the initiative and whether the wider problem also exists in other education sectors.
They ask who should have the initiative to separate a dislocation or branch location.
Zij vragen bij wie het initiatief moet liggen om een dislocatie of nevenvestiging te verzelfstandigen.
Supports the bill but asks why placing dislocations under the minister's free discretion was chosen and how 'too small distance' and the forecasting models will be explained.
These members would also welcome further explanation of how the concept of 'too small a distance' will be interpreted.
Tevens zien deze leden graag een nadere toelichting tegemoet op de wijze waarop het begrip «te kleine afstand» wordt uitgelegd.
Worries that existing school boards gain a privileged position threatening diversity, that municipalities bypass the school plan procedure and lose steering power, and that staff lack consent rights.
They ask to what extent the municipality and municipal council can still steer this course of events.
Zij vragen in hoeverre de gemeente en de gemeenteraad nog wel kan sturen op deze gang van zaken.
Asks why the existing school may be kept open despite too few pupils, on what basis the 15-year period rests, how quality is served, and who decides and how parents and teachers are involved.
How does the government prevent a dislocation from keeping an existing school that is too small open?
Hoe voorkomt de regering dat dankzij een dislocatie, een te kleine reeds bestaande school in stand wordt gehouden?
Asks why the decision on separation lies with the minister rather than the municipality and how the ministry's forecasting models relate to municipal forecasts.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division supports the bill to allow dislocations of primary schools to become independent schools and to prevent double funding, but advises the explanatory memorandum to address how the VNG (association of municipalities) was consulted, since municipalities bear the consequences. The minister replies that the VNG was consulted, supports the bill with some remarks already incorporated, and adopts the editorial remarks.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should clarify how consultation with the VNG took place and whether the VNG issued formal advice, as required by the Code Interbestuurlijke Verhoudingen.
Editorial remarks: renumber subsections rather than using 5a and 5b, and change the figures 50 and 150 to 100 in the stichtingsnorm example.

32814.s: The bill amends the Electricity Act 1998 and the Gas Act to implement the EU third energy package, aligning rules on grid access, transmission system operator ownership unbundling, and the powers of the national regulator (NMa). It transfers regulatory and oversight tasks to the NMa, adds a notification duty and ministerial veto for changes in control over large power plants, and sets out detailed EU-driven rules for interconnectors and closed distribution systems.
32814.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by the need to harmonise EU energy regulation, secure non-discriminatory market access, and ensure supply security and investment climate.
q: This ensures non-discriminatory access to the electricity and gas markets and prevents commercial risks from production and supply being passed on to the networks.
Daarmee wordt non-discriminatoire toegang tot de elektriciteits- en gasmarkt verzekerd en wordt afwenteling van commerciële risico’s uit productie en levering op de netwerken voorkomen
d: rules on reporting and notification of market and ownership procedures
rules for determining counter-performance for transferred grid economic value
making accounting information available to market parties
procedure and content of notification of changes in control over large power plants
further rules for interconnector operators implementing EU directive
further independence requirements for national grid operator
rules for switching electricity supplier, possibly differing per operator
publication of recommendations by NMa on supply price conformity
defining technical or economic necessity of access to gas storage
further unbundling rules for gas transmission network operator
p: The minister may block or attach conditions to changes in control over large power plants on grounds of public safety and supply security, with transactions made in breach being voidable by a court.
Gas storage access rules are reshaped and the ministry may define technical or economic necessity of access by ministerial regulation.
The NMa board may issue binding instructions to regulated parties with publication in the State Gazette, strengthening an independent regulator rather than the executive.

parties: Asks about interconnector initiatives, the regulator's independence in practice, smart meter specification, boundary penalties and administrative burden.
The VVD members endorse the importance of an improved European internal market with freedom of choice for consumers and businesses.
De leden van de VVD-fractie onderschrijven het belang van een verbeterde Europese interne markt met keuzevrijheid voor de consument en ondernemer.
Raises that the closed distribution system rules impose disproportionate costs on recreation park operators and asks whether a hardship clause or exemption should be included.
Why does the government not include a hardship clause in the law for exceptional cases like this, on which it could formulate policy?
Waarom neemt de regering voor dit soort exceptionele gevallen geen hardheidsclausule op in de wet, waarop de regering beleid kan formuleren?
Asks for clarity on unbundling options, the independence of system operators, the role of parliament in level playing field decisions and the scope of new regulator tasks.
How does the government involve the Chamber(s) in assessing and establishing measures within the level playing field clause?
Hoe betrekt de regering de Kamer(s) bij de toetsing en vaststelling van maatregelen binnen de level playing field clausule?
Generally supports the bill but is critical of new institutions and overlapping competences of the ministry, the NMa and the new European agency, and asks why NMa recommendations were not adopted.
The CDA members are critical of institution-building and fully critical of overlap when it comes to supervision and regulation.
De leden van de CDA-fractie staan kritisch ten opzichte van instituutvorming maar staan helemaal kritisch ten opzichte van overlapping wanneer het gaat om toezicht en regulering.

Criticises the absence of a pre-consultation procedure for the Chamber in delegation provisions, opposes fundamentalist liberalisation and asks for more public ownership and oversight of strategic networks and interconnectors.
The SP members note that in amended delegation provisions no pre-consultation procedure for the Chamber has been included in any case.
De leden van de SP-fractie constateren dat bij gewijzigde delegatiebepalingen in geen enkel geval een voorhangprocedure voor de Kamer is opgenomen.
Asks for clarification on the status of private recreation networks, the AMvB on transfer of networks, and the feasibility of compliance for park owners.
The ChristenUnie members ask for further information on the status of private networks.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen nadere informatie over de status van particuliere netten.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the bill implementing the Third Energy Package (electricity and gas), raising concerns on level playing field measures, the scope of the notification and approval power over energy acquisitions, the NMa's independence, cross-border lease contracts and gas storage access regime. The government's nader rapport accepted many remarks, partly rejected others (notably on level playing field and the state of EU case law), and adjusted the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to address the relationship between the acquisition-screening power and Article 21(4) of the EU Concentration Regulation and the TFEU free movement exceptions, which the government addressed only partly and disputed in part.

The Afdeling advised narrowing the notification and screening power for all changes of control in plants above 250 MW to situations with an actual unlevel playing field, which the government rejected by arguing the scope is in line with the directive.

The Afdeling asked the explanation of how the directive's independence rules relate to the minister's general policy rule power under the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen, and the government added clarification.
The Afdeling argued the Commission must approve measures on gas production and storage under Article 47(2) of the Gas Directive, which the government rejected.
The Afdeling asked the government to justify the negotiated access regime for gas storage given high market concentration, and the memorandum was revised to provide that justification.
The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to explain how the transitional regime for cross-border lease networks and recreational networks relates to the directives, and the commentary was added.
The Afdeling offered numerous redactional remarks, which were incorporated in the revised bill.

32841.s: The bill amends the Wet veiligheidsregio's and the Veiligheidswet BES to create a single Instituut Fysieke Veiligheid, merging the Nifv and Nbbe, governed by a general board of regional chairs with a dagelijks bestuur, and moves the minister's role to a limited supervisory position. It transfers brandweer examination and training tasks to the Institute, shifts inspection reporting directly to the minister, and provides ministerial intervention powers over the Institute's board with parliamentary notification.
32841.j: The memorandum justifies the structure by clear allocation of responsibility, control and planning, and by the need for ministerial intervention powers in exceptional cases where tasks are not performed properly.
q: The Institute's board is only accountable to the minister for the performance of its statutory tasks.
Het bestuur van het Instituut is slechts verantwoording verschuldigd aan de minister ten aanzien van de taakuitvoering van de wettelijke taken.
d: board of Instituut Fysieke Veiligheid delegates tasks to dagelijks bestuur
rules on examination execution by general board reglement
rules on contribution payments to the Institute
fire training subjects and examinations via Institute board
p: Minister may take necessary measures when the Institute board seriously neglects a task, with notice to parliament afterwards and only as a last resort.
Minister may demand inspection of all business records and documents from the Institute board where reasonably necessary.
Inspectorate's oversight extends to the Institute board and it reports directly to the minister.
The Institute is placed at a distance from ministerial control, with the Institute board accountable to the minister only for statutory tasks.

parties: Asks the government to specify the minister's precise accountability for the Institute, given that primacy lies with the local government.
These members ask the government to explain the precise responsibility of the Minister of Security and Justice in this matter. On what is he accountable?
Deze leden vragen de regering in te gaan op de precieze verantwoordelijkheid van de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie in dezen. Waarop is hij aanspreekbaar?
Asks how the minister can assess whether statutory tasks are carried out adequately, since the Institute has no information duty towards the minister.

The Institute, however, has no information obligation towards the minister. Therefore these members want to know how the Minister of Security and Justice can assess whether the statutory tasks are carried out at an adequate level?

Het instituut heeft echter geen informatieplicht aan de minister. Daarom willen deze leden weten hoe de van Veiligheid en Justitie kan beoordelen of de wettelijke taken op adequaat niveau worden uitgevoerd?
Questions the juridical basis of the autonomous body outside the Kaderwet ZBO's and asks who appoints, supervises, can sanction and intervene.
Who appoints this administrative body? Who can dissolve it? Who supervises it? Who has the power to intervene? Who can impose sanctions?
Wie stelt dit bestuursorgaan in? Wie kan het opheffen? Wie controleert het? Wie heeft de bevoegdheid in te grijpen? Wie kan sancties opleggen?
Warns that the Institute's governance lacks democratic embedding and that workers and volunteers have insufficient representation and voice in decisions.
