Financial and smaller-state arguments cannot justify reducing a body that is independent of government and represents the people, a position the government does not accept as decisive.

The transitional arrangement creates an unequal composition of the United National Assembly during the transition; the government deems early dissolution unacceptable and keeps phased entry into force.

33363.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the European Union and its member states and the Republic of Iraq, signed in Brussels on 11 May 2012. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.

parties: Asks what mechanisms apply if political clauses are seriously breached, and what legal framework holds Iraq to human rights commitments beyond political dialogue.
Which mechanisms can come into effect in case of (serious) breach of these clauses?
Welke mechanismes kunnen in werking treden bij (ernstige) schending van deze clausules?
Asks how implementation of the PSO is monitored and how parliament is informed of progress, and what human rights priorities the EU sets in the annual dialogue.
ask how implementation of the PSO is monitored and how the House is informed about its progress and developments?
vragen op welke wijze wordt toegezien op de uitvoering van de PSO en hoe de Kamer geïnformeerd wordt over voortgang en ontwikkelingen hiervan?

Doubts Iraq meets the democratic and rule-of-law conditions for suspension, questions the scope of suspension clauses, and raises reports of confiscation of Assyrian Christian land by Kurdish authorities.
The SP members ask the government for its assessment of the extent to which Iraq currently meets both possible conditions for suspension.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering naar haar inschatting in welke mate Irak op dit moment voldoet aan beide genoemde mogelijke voorwaarden voor opschorting.
Supports cooperation but asks how the agreement strengthens religious minorities and civil society, and how it contributes to counter-terrorism.
In what way does this agreement contribute to strengthening the position of religious minorities?
Op welke wijze draagt dit verdrag bij aan de versterking van de positie van religieuze minderheden?

33400-III.s: The bill formally establishes the 2013 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs (including the Dienst Publiek en Communicatie), the Cabinet of the Queen, and the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 January 2013 or retroactively from that date.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs for the year 2013 belonging to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Algemene Zaken voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

33426.s: The bill replaces the rules on carriage of public broadcasting channels in the Mediawet 2008, setting a minimum standard package of at least 30 television channels and dropping the local programme councils that advised on package composition. It lets the Commissariaat voor de Media grant exemptions from carriage obligations where full compliance would cause disproportionate costs or other unreasonable outcomes.
33426.j: The memorandum justifies the exemption power by pointing to the problems with the programme council system and the need for a general exemption basis for cases where full carriage would be unworkable, such as digital terrestrial distribution.
q: The Commissariaat voor de Media may grant full or partial exemption from the obligations in articles 6.13, 6.14, 6.14b and 6.14c if strict compliance would lead to disproportionate costs, an obstacle to innovation or otherwise unreasonable outcomes.

Artikel 6.14d Het Commissariaat kan geheel of gedeeltelijk ontheffing verlenen van de verplichtingen, bedoeld in de artikelen 6.13, 6.14, 6.14b en 6.14c, als het onverkort nakomen daarvan leidt tot disproportionele kosten, tot een belemmering van innovatie of tot anderszins onredelijke uitkomsten.
d: determining qualifying channels and broadcast quality
p: The Commissariaat may exempt distributors in whole or part from the carriage obligations where compliance would be disproportionate, with no statutory criteria beyond general reasonableness and the power to attach conditions.
Artikel I, B (artikel 2:146 onderdeel n vervalt) en Artikel I, I (paragraaf 6.3.1.3 vervalt)
Local programme councils, which advised on package composition, are abolished, removing a consultative check on distributors and the associated funding for Kabelraden.nl.

parties: Supports abolishing programme councils but asks why mandatory carriage is imposed and why a 30-channel minimum and the 250,000-subscriber threshold are justified.
They support abolishing the programme councils. They see reason to ask a number of questions.
Het afschaffen van de programmaraden ondersteunen zij. Zij zien aanleiding tot het stellen van een aantal vragen.
Notes the government makes no attempt to secure consumer influence over the standard package and asks about mandatory consumer research and protection of customers of smaller cable operators.
At the same time they note that the government makes no attempt to secure consumer influence over the composition of the standard package.
Tegelijkertijd constateren zij dat de regering geen poging doet om consumenteninvloed te borgen in de samenstelling van het standaardpakket.
Argues viewers have a right to participation and calls for independent customer councils, a complaints desk and countervailing power against cable operators.
They are of the view that viewers have a right to participate in the channel offering on television and radio.
Zij zijn van mening dat kijkers recht hebben op inspraak over het zenderaanbod op televisie en radio.
Shares the bill's starting points of universal access to public broadcasters and diversity, and asks technical and cost questions about local carriage and internet providers.
The members share the starting points of this proposal.
De leden delen de uitgangspunten van dit voorstel.
Asks what the advisory bodies said, whether the Commissariaat voor de Media should supervise diversity, and questions exemptions for satellite and terrestrial distributors.
These members see a supervisory task for the Commissariaat voor de Media here.
Deze leden zien hier een toezichthoudende taak weggelegd voor het Commissariaat voor de Media.
Has serious doubts about abolishing programme councils without a suitable alternative and worries about pluralism and smaller broadcasters.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill abolishing programme councils and securing a minimum standard package of TV and radio channels, but raised objections on extending mandatory carriage of Flemish public channels (insufficiently motivated), on the transitional provision, and on consultation reporting. The minister's reply adds motivation for the Flemish channels, clarifies the transitional provision, declines to report consultation positions in detail, and adopts most drafting remarks.
concerns: The extension of mandatory carriage to all Flemish public TV and radio channels was insufficiently motivated and was required to be justified in the explanatory memorandum, which the government did.
Under the EU universal services directive, national carriage obligations must serve a clearly defined general interest and be proportionate; the minister added this justification.
The transitional provision (Article III) was not explained in relation to the existing article 6.14, and the explanatory memorandum was clarified accordingly, with the article adjusted.

The advisory division asked for the views of consulted parties and the involvement of municipalities to be described; the minister declined to report these positions in detail, citing their commercial confidentiality, though noted VNG involvement.

Redactional remarks on cross-references, the wording of articles 6.14b and 6.14a, and a conflicting-amendment clause were largely adopted, except the second remark on article 6.14a which was not followed to limit deviation from the amendment text.

33453.s: The bill removes the '3 out of 6' requirement for EU migrant workers to qualify for Dutch student finance, aligning the law with EU law. It also lets the minister set by ministerial regulation a maximum number of applications for study abroad, along with further implementing rules.
33453.j: The memorandum justifies the cap as a way to limit the financial risk of the EU-compliant change, estimated at a maximum of EUR 40 million per year, and to keep the scheme administrable.
q: By ministerial regulation a maximum may be set on the number of student applications for study-finance for education outside the Netherlands.
Bij ministeriële regeling kan een maximum worden gesteld aan het aantal aanvragen van studenten voor studiefinanciering voor het volgen van onderwijs buiten Nederland.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel 3 (lid 5 van artikel 2.14 WSF 2000)
maximum number of applications for study-abroad student finance
Artikel I, onderdeel 3 (lid 7 van artikel 2.14 WSF 2000)
p: Artikel I, onderdeel 3 (lid 5 van artikel 2.14 WSF 2000)
The minister may cap the number of student applications for study abroad by ministerial regulation, a discretionary limit on access to student finance set outside the statute.

parties: Asks whether the working-hours norm rises to 56 hours and whether this affects the risk analysis, and questions whether first-come-first-served serves talented Dutch students.
The members would like confirmation that the hours norm is indeed being raised to 56 hours per month and ask whether this has consequences for the risk analysis made.
De leden zouden graag bevestigd zien dat de urennorm ook inderdaad opgehoogd wordt naar 56 uur per maand en vragen of dit consequenties heeft voor de gemaakte risicoanalyse.
Supports portable student finance but finds the budget-driven caps disappointing and asks for the expected savings and projected application numbers.

The members do note, however, that it is disappointing that restrictions on application possibilities must be built in through a ministerial regulation because of the necessary budgetary considerations.
De leden stellen echter wel vast dat het teleurstellend is dat door de noodzakelijke budgettaire afwegingen per ministeriële regeling beperkingen in de aanvraagmogelijkheden moeten worden ingebouwd.
Objects to EU rules overriding Dutch national interests and asks for monthly-type monitoring of usage and displacement of Dutch students by non-Dutch ones.
The members believe that despite the amendment, the chance of misuse of scarce facilities and of displacement of our own students is very real.
De leden zijn van mening dat ondanks de wetswijziging de kans op misbruik van schaarse voorzieningen en op verdringing van onze eigen studenten levensgroot is.
Questions the financial impact on the education budget and the treatment of border-region students, and asks how misuse by non-Dutch students will be prevented.
How will it be prevented that the possibility of portable student finance is misused by non-Dutch students, these members want to know.
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat er misbruik wordt gemaakt van de mogelijkheid tot meeneembare studiefinanciering door niet-Nederlandse studenten, willen deze leden weten.
Supports a cap to avoid unreasonable financial burden, asks how the original aim of mobility is still met, and questions whether a cap conflicts with promoting outgoing mobility.

The members of this faction ask whether setting a cap at the level of current users of portable student finance does not conflict with the government's intention to promote outgoing mobility of Dutch students.

De leden van deze fractie vragen of het instellen van een plafond op de hoogte van het aantal huidige gebruikers van meeneembare studiefinanciering niet strijdig is met het voornemen van de regering om uitgaande mobiliteit van Nederlandse studenten te bevorderen.
Asks for budget history, assurance the budget and cap will not be lowered, and an explanation of the first-come-first-served procedure and alternatives considered.

Furthermore, the members want to know how the proposed first-come-first-served procedure for granting portable student finance can help ensure that the people for whom this scheme was originally intended can keep benefiting from it.

Verder willen de leden weten hoe de voorgestelde procedure van «wie het eerst komt, die het eerst maalt» bij het toekennen van meeneembare studiefinanciering eraan kan bijdragen dat de personen voor wie deze regeling ooit juist bedoeld was, hiervan kunnen blijven profiteren.
Argues the CJEU ruling undermines support policy and asks whether the Court wrongly extended EU rules to education in other member states, questioning the court's reasoning.
Is the government of the opinion that the Court gives too broad a scope to the said provisions, now that the Court also treats the interests of children as indirect interests of the worker.
Is de regering van mening dat het Hof een te ruime werkingssfeer toekent aan de genoemde bepalingen, nu het Hof bovendien de belangen van kinderen als indirecte belangen van de werknemer aanmerkt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the bill replacing the three-of-six-years residence requirement for portable student finance with a ministerial cap, but asks the explanatory memorandum to justify whether the 56-hour monthly threshold for migrant workers is consistent with Article 45 TFEU as interpreted by the CJEU. The government's reply states that the footnote referring to the future policy change has been removed, that the regulation and the bill stand apart, and that the Afdeling's point will be addressed when the policy rule is amended.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to justify that the tightened 56-hour threshold for migrant workers complies with Article 45 TFEU as interpreted by the CJEU; the government removed the footnote but did not add the justification, saying the issue will be addressed when the policy rule is changed.
The explanatory memorandum is clarified so that the ministerial power to set a ceiling is described as discretionary rather than imperative, and technical changes improve readability.

33462.s: The bill amends the Wet waardering onroerende zaken to widen public access to WOZ property values, creating a national WOZ facility operated by the Kadaster and allowing eigenaren and third parties to obtain values for homes and business premises. It removes the Fierens tolerance margin, extends the right to request values to parties with an interest beyond tax, and lets an AMvB set conditions and tariffs for bulk disclosure of home values.
33462.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB power by saying the government itself wants to determine in which situations bulk disclosure of WOZ values may take place, and that the details are technical and belong in lower regulation.
q: This was included so that the government itself can specify the situations in which bulk provision of value data (in digital form) may take place.
Dit is opgenomen om zelf aan te kunnen geven in welke situaties verstrekking van waardegegevens in bulk (in digitale vorm) kan plaats vinden.
d: Artikel I, E (artikel 37aa, vierde lid, Wet WOZ)
management, form and organisation of national WOZ facility
Artikel I, I (artikel 40a, tweede lid, Wet WOZ)
cases, conditions and tariff for bulk disclosure of home WOZ values
p: Artikel I, I (artikel 40a, tweede lid, Wet WOZ)
The executive may determine by AMvB in which cases and at what tariff bulk WOZ data on homes may be released, a privacy-relevant decision left largely to delegated rules.
Removal of the statutory tolerance margin lets objections and appeals reach small valuation disputes again, increasing citizens' access to review of state valuations.}],

parties: Asks whether the national registry is adequately controlled and whether informal objection handling could lead to unequal treatment and more objections.
Is it desirable for banks to obtain this data?
Is het wenselijk dat de banken deze gegevens in handen krijgen?
Raises privacy risks of free public access to WOZ values and questions the government's expectation that objections will fall.
These members see a privacy risk in making WOZ values public.although
Deze leden zien een risico voor de privacy in de openbaarmaking van de WOZ- waarden.
Asks for better justification for protecting privacy for homes but not non-residential property and questions the no-fee access model.
The PVV members would like the government to further justify why privacy has prevailed over openness for non-residential properties.
De leden van de fractie van de PVV zouden van de regering graag nader onderbouwd willen zien waarom bij de niet-woningen de privacy het wel van de openbaarheid heeft gewonnen.
Asks about safeguards against misuse of the national registry, verification of requesters' personal interest, and tenant protection under the rent ceiling.
Can the government indicate whether regulation against unjustified use or misuse of the national WOZ facility exists or is coming, asks the SP members.
Kan de regering aangeven of er regelgeving tegen ongerechtvaardigd gebruik dan wel misbruik van de landelijke voorziening WOZ is dan wel komt, zo vragen de leden van de SP-fractie.
Questions why privacy was weighed less than openness and asks about the effects of informal objection handling and fees for bulk requests.
Why has the government decided to consider the importance of privacy less important than openness?
Waarom is door de regering besloten om het belang van de privacy minder belangrijk te achten dan de openbaarheid?
Asks whether an opt-out for citizens who do not want their WOZ value made public has been considered and whether the claimed shift in views is supported by evidence.
The members are curious whether the government has considered an opt-out for this group, so that people can choose not to have the WOZ value of their home made public.
De leden zijn benieuwd of de regering een opt-out heeft overwogen voor deze groep, zodat mensen kunnen kiezen om de WOZ-waarde van hun huis niet openbaar te maken?
Questions the government's weighing of privacy against public interest, citing recent Raad van State and court rulings on privacy sensitivity of WOZ values.

The ChristenUnie members ask why the government gives more weight to changed societal views on the privacy sensitivity of the WOZ Act over the past twenty years than to recent rulings on this by the Council of State and the 's-Hertogenbosch Court of Appeal.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen waarom de regering de wijziging van maatschappelijke opvattingen over de privacy-gevoeligheid van de Wet WOZ in de afgelopen twintig jaar zwaarder laat wegen dan recente uitspraken hierover van de Raad van State en het Gerechtshof 's-Hertogenbosch.
Asks for evidence on how many citizens object to publication and raises the security risk that public values aid burglars, asking whether requesters' identity should be registered.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised in October 2012 on a bill to make WOZ property values of homes publicly accessible without purpose limitation, questioning the government's changed view that WOZ values are no longer privacy-sensitive and asking for a better justification. The government's reply states that the advice was followed and the explanatory memorandum was supplemented with a further justification of the changed view.
concerns: The Afdeling objects that the shift from treating WOZ values as personal data to objective property characteristics needs a convincing justification, which the memorandum initially lacked.
The Afdeling finds the Waarderingskamer advice and the VEH member panel insufficient evidence for the changed view on privacy, given unclear question design and representativeness.

33480-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (House of Representatives and Senate), adjusting appropriations for the first and second supplementary budgets. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date of 1 December 2012.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for 2012 (amendment linked to the Autumn Memorandum)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2012 (wijziging samenhangende met de Najaarsnota)

33507.s: The bill amends the General Act on Exceptional Medical Expenses, the Health Insurance Act, the Health Insurance Introduction Act and numerous other health, youth care and justice statutes, mainly with technical corrections and reporting obligations for the CVZ and the CAK. It also re-sets certain financing and reconciliation calculations for 2002-2005 and rewrites some delegation and notification rules.
33507.j: The memorandum justifies the catastrophe delegation as needed because the regulation cannot foresee all types of catastrophe, so the ministry must be able to designate other extraordinary events.
q: For these reasons, paragraph 1(a) makes it possible to designate, by ministerial regulation, another extraordinary event beyond the disasters listed as a catastrophe.

Om die redenen wordt het in het eerste lid, onderdeel a, mogelijk gemaakt om bij ministeriële regeling ook een andere buitengewone gebeurtenis dan de daar opgesomde rampen als catastrofe te betitelen.
d: content and format of financial reports and audit of CVZ
catastrophe designation and calculation of extra contributions
content and audit of CVZ financial documents
fee for registration in BIG register
designation of medical aids a midwife may prescribe
p: ARTIKEL XXIV, A (artikel 12a Wet op de medische hulpmiddelen)
Inspectors may order suspension of trade or withdrawal of a medical device to prevent harm to public health, aligning the power with the Medicines Act.
ARTIKEL XXII, C/D (artikel 6 en 6a Wet op de jeugdzorg)
Entitlement to youth care lapses on specified grounds, with the foundation's consent required in some child-protection cases.
Renames ministerial responsibilities following a reshuffle of portfolios.

parties: Asks how the 4% catastrophe threshold was derived, whether the DNB study can be shared, and its effect on solvency requirements and premiums.
The 4% was determined on the basis of research by DNB.
De 4% is vastgesteld op basis van onderzoek van DNB.
Questions the retroactive change to accountability deadlines and asks for the DNB report and justification of the threshold.
The bill now retroactively from 1 January 2008 provides that accountability need only be given by 31 December of year t+1.
Het wetsvoorstel regelt nu met terugwerkende kracht vanaf 1 januari 2008 dat de verantwoording pas voor 31 december van het jaar t+1 moet worden gegeven.

Demands explanations on risk equalisation gaps, the 4% threshold, errors in past declarations, supervisory orders, and removal of the foster-care allowance increase, and asks for reports to be sent to parliament.
Can the government send this DNB research to the House?
Kan de regering dit onderzoek van DNB naar de Kamer sturen?
Asks for a definition of catastrophe, the budgetary consequences of the 2005 final settlement change, and why the threshold is in statute rather than a decree.
Why is the 4% threshold included in a statute and not in a decree?
Waarom is de drempel van 4% opgenomen in een wet en niet in een besluit?
Asks about the practical effects of two legal regimes applying to a fetal-tissue case and whether the broadened fetal-tissue definition widens abortion admissibility.
To what extent is the admissibility of abortion also broadened by widening the term 'fetal tissue'?
In hoeverre wordt met het verruimen van de term «foetaal weefsel» ook de toelaatbaarheid van zwangerschapsafbreking verruimd?
Asks why insurers need six months to deliver figures and how the CVZ relies on uncertified estimates for the budget, and asks for the basis of the claim that these estimates are reliable.
Can it be indicated on what the claim that these uncertified figures give a good estimate is based?
Kan aangegeven worden waarop de stelling dat deze niet gecertificeerde cijfers een goede inschatting geven is gebaseerd?

Objects that important rules on youth care in the Caribbean public bodies would be set by general administrative order without prior debate in the House, and asks for enhanced pre-consultation procedures; also questions the privatised insurance model and the treatment of the Wtcg allowance.

These members do not consider it justified that important regulations on access, provision, funding and cost contributions would not first be discussed in the House of Representatives, and therefore ask the minister to apply enhanced pre-consultation procedures to these general administrative orders.

Deze leden vinden het niet gerechtvaardigd dat belangrijke regelgeving over o.a. toegang, aanbod, bekostiging en een bijdrage in de kosten niet eerst in de Tweede Kamer besproken zouden worden, en vragen de minister daarom verzwaarde voorhangprocedures toe te passen bij deze algemene maatregelen van bestuur.

Asks in which cases the NZa could issue enforcement directions to AWBZ insurers and whether it previously lacked that power; also asks about the accuracy of the 4% threshold and the timing of settlement.
In which cases did the NZa want to do this, and did it lack the authority to do so?
In welke gevallen heeft de NZa dit willen doen, en had zij hier de bevoegdheid niet voor?

33525.s: The bill suspends the statutory indexation of the basic child benefit amount in the General Child Benefit Act (AKW) that would otherwise take effect on 1 July 2013, in order to contain child benefit spending. It amends article 13a AKW accordingly and sets entry into force by royal decree.
33525.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as necessary to control child benefit expenditure by not applying the statutory indexation for 1 July 2013.
q: in connection with controlling child benefit spending, to omit the indexation of the basic child benefit amount in the General Child Benefit Act with effect from 1 July 2013
in verband met beheersing van de uitgaven aan kinderbijslag de indexering van het basiskinderbijslagbedrag in de Algemene Kinderbijslagwet per 1 juli 2013 achterwege te laten

parties: Supports the non-indexation as contributing to sound public finances, but asks why the 2014 and 2015 indexation cuts agreed in the coalition agreement are not included in this bill.
They are of the view that this contributes to getting government finances in order.
Zij zijn van mening dat dit bijdraagt aan het op orde brengen van de overheidsfinanciën.
Worried about the cumulative effects of government measures on children growing up in poverty and asks for overviews of total cuts and income effects by income group.
The members are particularly concerned about the cumulative effects of various measures of this government on children who have to grow up in poverty in the Netherlands.
De leden maken zich met name grote zorgen over de cumulatieve effecten van diverse maatregelen van deze regering voor de kinderen die in Nederland moeten opgroeien in armoede.

Views the planned cuts on child benefits as excessively high and fears a stacking of cuts on families with children, especially middle incomes; asks for detailed justification per measure and international comparison.
However, it seems to these members that the cuts the government intends to make on child arrangements and in particular on child benefit are excessively high.
Het komt deze leden echter voor dat de bezuinigingen die de regering voornemens is te nemen op de kindregelingen en in het bijzonder op de kinderbijslag, buitensporig hoog zijn.
Supports the measure in principle but asks when the remaining child-arrangement proposals will come to the House and whether extra cuts could fund childcare.
They endorse the thrust of the measure, but have some additional questions they would like to put to the government.
Zij onderschrijven de strekking van de maatregel, maar hebben enkele aanvullende vragen die zij graag aan de regering zouden voorleggen.
Asks for the distributional and cumulative income effects of non-indexation across income groups and why these are acceptable given existing strain on families with children.

Why does the government consider these income effects acceptable, given that parents with children are already relatively hard hit according to purchasing power calculations such as those of Nibud, these members ask.

Waarom acht de regering deze inkomenseffecten acceptabel gezien het feit dat ouders met kinderen volgens koopkrachtberekeningen zoals van het Nibud al relatief zwaar getroffen worden, zo vragen deze leden.

33543.s: The bill approves, for the European part of the Netherlands, the Protocol of 15 October 2012 amending the 1965 Treaty establishing the Benelux Court of Justice. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.

parties: Asks for examples of divergent Benelux trademark interpretations, whether all existing court instruments were exhausted, and the procedure and role of Dutch government and parliament for extending the court's jurisdiction.
The VVD members would like the government to say when this would arise, what procedure would be needed, and what role the Dutch government and parliament would have in it.

De leden van de VVD-fractie horen graag van de regering wanneer dit aan de orde zou zijn, welke procedure daarvoor nodig is en welke rol de Nederlandse regering en het Nederlandse parlement hierin hebben.
Supports the government's approach and has no additional questions.
The government's position can count on the agreement of these members.
De inzet van het kabinet kan op instemming van deze leden rekenen.

Asks why jurisdiction is extended case by case, which fields could receive it, how the three national chambers coordinate, and how the parliamentary advice on simplifying the preliminary procedure will be implemented.
The D66 members would like to know why it was chosen to assess case by case whether the adjudicative power can be strengthened.
De leden van de fractie van D66 vernemen graag waarom er gekozen is om van geval tot geval te kijken of de rechtsprekende bevoegdheid kan worden versterkt.

33570.s: The bill amends the Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren to formalise 2007-2010 collective pay agreement points on salary placement and reintegration, and to align dismissal rules for incapacity with the WIA benefit scheme. It lets the courts' management, the Minister or the Hoge Raad deviate from salary placement rules, and sets out who advises and decides on dismissal of judicial officials on medical grounds.
33570.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as formalising the 2007-2010 collective pay agreement and aligning rules with the introduction of the WIA, with no adverse effects for those concerned.
q: This amendment primarily formalises two parts of the Labour Conditions Agreement for the judiciary concluded on 28 November 2007.
Deze wetswijziging strekt ten eerste tot formalisering van twee onderdelen van de op 28 november 2007 ... gesloten Arbeidsvoorwaardenovereenkomst
d: deviation from statutory salary placement on subsequent appointment
competence to deviate from salary placement shifted to court management and Raad voor de rechtspraak
reinstatement of judicial official below 35% incapacity by Hoge Raad on proposal of functional authority
p: Competence to deviate from salary placement moves from the Minister to court management, subject to advice from the Raad voor de rechtspraak.
The separate medical advice request for incapacity dismissal is removed and replaced by reliance on the UWV WIA assessment, which the functional authority may request an expert opinion on.
The UWV advice on cooperation with reintegration is replaced by an optional expert opinion requested by the functional authority, changing the evidentiary basis for dismissal.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division supports the bill implementing parts of the 2007 judicial-officials collective labour agreement and aligning the Wrra with the WIA, but objects to the nearly five-to-seven-year delay, which requires retroactive effect (notably for art. 14 Wrra) and creates legal-certainty problems. The Raad advises justifying the delay in the explanatory memorandum and keeping such delays as short as possible in future; the minister's reply is not included in the text beyond the note that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented.
concerns: Retroactive effect over a long period, including a retroactively deemed legal basis for art. 14 Wrra between 2008 and mid-2010, is problematic for legal certainty and should have been avoided.
The explanatory memorandum should justify the delay substantively and future delays between agreement and formalisation should be kept as limited as possible.

33605-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statutes for the Council of State, the Court of Audit, the National Ombudsman, the Chancery of the Netherlands Orders, and the governors' offices of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, as set out in the attached budget tables. It sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the current budget year.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2012 to the departmental budget statements of the Council of State, the Court of Audit, the National Ombudsman
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2012 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de departementale begrotingsstaat van de Raad van State, de Algemene Rekenkamer, de Nationale ombudsman

33615.s: The bill approves the 2012 Berlin tax treaty between the Netherlands and Germany on avoiding double taxation of income taxes, applying to the European part of the Netherlands. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
33615.j: The memorandum justifies the treaty by reference to avoiding abuse of treaty benefits and providing a basis for consultation and arbitration in disputes, and notes the treaty may be expected to benefit Dutch business.
q: Countries are generally only willing to do so if it is guaranteed that the tax treaty is not used improperly.
Landen zijn over het algemeen alleen hiertoe bereid als gewaarborgd is dat niet op oneigenlijke wijze van het belastingverdrag gebruik wordt gemaakt
d: treaty approval by parliament only, no delegation

parties: Asks whether the existing treaty already achieves the aims and whether a transitional rule is considered for pensioners facing higher tax.
Has a transitional arrangement been considered for this group?
Is er voor deze groep een overgangsregeling overwogen?
Asks how the treaty's pension taxation threshold, delegated bilateral arrangements, and anti-abuse provisions will be applied in practice.
Asks for the financial consequences for cross-border workers and pensioners and why Germany refuses equal treatment on the work floor.
Raises possible conflict with EU law (free movement, non-discrimination on nationality), abrupt tax switch versus legal certainty, and asks for independent advice from the Commission or ECER.
Asks about the consequences of the aviation and inland shipping staff provision that deviates from the OECD standard and may cut net income sharply.
Is it correct that air traffic pilots and inland shipping skippers working in Germany and living in the Netherlands are particularly hard hit in disposable income by this provision?
Klopt het dat het verkeersvliegers en binnenvaartschippers die werkzaam zijn in Duitsland en woonachtig in Nederland er door deze bepaling qua besteedbaar inkomen bijzonder hard op achteruit gaan?
Welcomes alignment with OECD norms and a transitional regime, but wants renewed review of the offshore provision because of concerns about shipping competitiveness.
The VVD members are satisfied that a transitional regime is coming for pensioners and people disadvantaged by the new Treaty.
De leden van de fractie van de VVD zijn tevreden dat er een overgangsregeling komt voor gepensioneerden en mensen die door het nieuwe Verdrag nadelig worden getroffen.

Asks about the scope of the treaty for the non-European parts of the Kingdom, the status of ongoing negotiations with Germany on aviation and shipping, and possible divergent interpretations of the treaty texts.
These members are concerned about the differing interpretations Netherlands and Germany give to certain passages of the tax treaty.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie maken zich zorgen over de verschillende uitleg die Nederland en Duitsland geven aan enkele passages uit het voorliggende belastingverdrag.
Requests detailed overviews of income effects for pensioner groups and asks for justification of the six-year transitional period and of the exclusion of social security benefits.
Is the government willing, ask the SP members, to present in a schematic overview which changes this treaty brings for different income groups of Dutch pensioners living in Germany?

Is de regering bereid, zo vragen de leden van de SP-fractie, in een schematisch overzicht weer te geven welke veranderingen het onderhavige verdrag meebrengt voor verschillende (inkomens)groepen van Nederlandse gepensioneerden die in Duitsland wonen?

Argues the transitional reduction scheme is complicated and disproportionate, questions legal certainty and the government's trustworthiness toward affected pensioners, and asks whether the scheme can be extended.
The PVV members find the proposed reduction scheme complicated and disproportionate.
De leden van de fractie van de PVV vinden de voorgestelde verminderingsregeling gecompliceerd en disproportioneel.

Welcomes the transitional regime but questions its design, the regressive income effects, possible indirect discrimination on grounds of nationality, and the lack of communication to taxpayers that the treaty might change.
It is of great importance to make the effects of the compensation scheme visible through calculations of six different standard cases over a six-year period.
Het is van groot belang om de effecten van de compensatieregeling zichtbaar te maken aan de hand van berekeningen van zes verschillende (standaard)gevallen over een periode van zes jaar.
Asks the government to respond to the Dutch Association of Tax Advisers' letter and to justify the six-year transition period with worked examples.
These members ask the government to respond to the various points in this letter.
Deze leden vragen de regering om te reageren op de verschillende punten uit deze brief.

Strongly opposes applying the new treaty to pensioners already living in Germany, arguing it undermines legal certainty and good governance, and calls for applying the treaty only to new cases or raising the 15,000 threshold.

33660.s: The bill amends the Dutch Nuclear Liability Act to allow the Minister of Finance, in agreement with the Ministers of Justice and Security and of Economic Affairs, to exclude domestic nuclear installations from the 1960 Paris Convention when the low risk justifies it. The exploiter stays liable for damage no longer covered by the Convention, and conditions on liability amount, form and financial security may be attached to such a decision.
33660.j: The memorandum of explanation is absent, so no justification is given for the delegated power.
q: The Minister of Finance may, observing decisions taken by the Administrative Commission under Article 1(b) of the Paris Convention, exclude domestic nuclear installations from the Convention if the small scale of the risks relative to the costs of treaty obligations justifies it in his judgment.

Onze Minister van Financiën kan, met inachtneming van de krachtens artikel 1, onderdeel b, van het Verdrag van Parijs door de Bestuurscommissie genomen besluiten, in Nederland gelegen kerninstallaties van de toepassing van dat verdrag uitsluiten, indien de geringe omvang van de betrokken risico's in relatie tot de kosten van de verdragsverplichtingen dat naar zijn oordeel rechtvaardigen.
d: excluding domestic nuclear installations from the Paris Convention
conditions on liability amount, form and financial security
p: The Minister of Finance may decide, on his own judgment, to remove nuclear installations from the Paris Convention's liability regime, with only inter-ministerial agreement required.

parties: Asks why the amendment comes only in 2013 and how Parliament will be involved and informed about decisions under the broad delegated power, given the Raad van State's caution about safety and financial risks.
That calls for caution, according to the VVD members.
Dat vraagt om voorzichtigheid, volgens de leden van de VVD-fractie.

Asks how the delegated power will be procedurally shaped and how Parliament will be kept informed, and whether the Minister may exclude installations without a Committee decision, warning of a race to the bottom in state guarantees.
Is it correct that there is a form of delegation?
Klopt het dat er sprake is van een vorm van delegatie?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill giving the Minister of Finance power to exclude Dutch nuclear installations from the Paris Convention should be narrowed to the 1990 Board decision, or the explanatory memorandum should justify the broader ground. The government's reply states the explanatory memorandum was supplemented to explain the choice for a more general basis, acknowledging the Board may adopt further decisions.
concerns: The Afdeling found the broader discretionary power to exclude installations insufficiently justified and suggested limiting it to the 1990 decision unless future Board decisions are foreseeable.
The explanatory memorandum should address whether new Board decisions are expected in the foreseeable future.

33714.s: The bill simplifies formal tax procedures by making electronic communication with the Belastingdienst mandatory (with ministerial exceptions), replacing the assessment-based system with a request-for-revision procedure, and shortening assessment and reassessment deadlines. It also expands the tax authority's power to re-assess (navordering) in various cases, including a new power for mass computer errors, and extends taxpayer objection rights to refusals of ex officio reduction.
33714.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and wider powers as needed for an efficient, automated tax system and to tackle deliberate non-compliance, while stating that taxpayer and tax-authority powers should be in balance and that the cabinet had dropped the ex officio revision power for legal certainty reasons.
q: The cabinet became convinced that this is less desirable from a legal certainty perspective.
Het kabinet is ervan overtuigd geraakt dat dit vanuit een oogpunt van rechtszekerheid minder gewenst is.
d: ARTIKEL IV, B (Art. 3a AWR, lid 2 en 3)
manner of electronic correspondence; exceptions from mandatory electronic communication
rules on how a request for revision is made
ARTIKEL IV, P (Art. 65 AWR, eerste lid)
cases in which the inspector reduces an assessment ex officio
ARTIKEL V, C (Art. 7b IW 1990, lid 2 en 3)
electronic communication and exceptions in collection procedures
ARTIKEL VI, A (Art. 13a AWIR, lid 2 en 3)
electronic communication and exceptions for benefit recipients
p: Expands the tax authority's power to recover underpaid tax to cases where the taxpayer knew or should have known of the error, and extends the recovery period from five to twelve years for bad faith.
Creates a six-month power to recover tax wrongly assessed due to mass system errors, including errors in third-party information.

Replaces the taxpayer's direct appeal against assessments with a revision request procedure, leaving objection and appeal only against the inspector's later decisions, which the explanatory memorandum says the cabinet dropped ex officio revision for legal certainty reasons.
Removes the earlier requirement of an electronic return confirmation and the statutory basis for electronic return rules, leaving the matter to ministerial regulation.
ARTIKEL IV, A en B (Art. 2 en 3a AWR)
Makes electronic communication with the tax authority mandatory by default, with exceptions set by ministerial regulation, shifting the burden of communication onto taxpayers.
Removes direct appeal against income, gift and inheritance tax assessments, which now become revisable and reachable only through a binding decision.

parties: Welcomes the bill as a step forward but asks about the position of taxpayers who are not digitally literate and whether the shortened navordering period puts undue pressure on the tax authority.
The VVD members have noted the bill with satisfaction and believe it marks a real step forward.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met tevredenheid kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en menen, dat hiermee echt een stap voorwaarts wordt gezet.
Critically positive; warns that a service-oriented approach must not undermine fraud control and asks how shortened periods and flexibility affect taxpayers and fraud risks.
They are therefore critically positive about the bill and have a few further questions about it.
Daarom zijn zij kritisch positief over voorliggend wetsvoorstel, en hebben hierover nog enkele vragen.
Has examined the bill but declines to submit an inbreng, reserving views for later treatment.
The PVV members, however, for their own reasons, refrain from making a contribution.
De leden fractie van de PVV zien echter, om hun moverende redenen, af van het doen van inbreng.

Asks whether the bill gives the inspector discretion over revision requests and deadline suspension without safeguards against arbitrariness, and whether the taxpayer is left with adequate legal protection and remedy.
Can the government explain on what grounds the tax inspector may grant or refuse such a request? Are these grounds limited? What steps will the government take to prevent arbitrariness?

Kan de regering toelichten op welke gronden de belastinginspecteur een dergelijk verzoek mag af- en toewijzen? Zijn deze gronden beperkt? Welke stappen gaat de regering nemen om willekeur te voorkomen?

Argues the bill tilts the balance between taxpayer and Belastingdienst, expands the tax authority's powers without proportionality and without matching taxpayer protection, and objects to navordering for massive system failures shifting risk onto taxpayers.
In that proportionality, according to the CDA members, this bill falls seriously short.
In die proportionaliteit schiet dit wetsvoorstel volgens de leden van de CDA-fractie ernstig tekort.
Asks for clarity on the criteria for 'ernstige twijfel' justifying suspension of deadlines, on the sanctions regime, and on risks of the expanded inkeerregeling and the Berichtenbox for hackers.
Can the government elaborate on this? When is there for example 'serious doubt'? What are the criteria?
Kan de regering hier nader op ingaan? Wanneer bestaat er bijvoorbeeld «ernstige twijfel? Wat zijn daarbij de criteria?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises on the draft Wet vereenvoudiging formeel verkeer Belastingdienst, which introduces a new tax assessment system with earlier definitive assessments, extended review of definitive assessments, narrower ex officio reduction, and broader post-assessment powers, raising numerous concerns about legal certainty and the need for better problem analysis. The Secretary of Finance's nader rapport replies point by point, largely rejecting the objections while accepting some adjustments such as the nova criterion's justification, the dwangsom exclusion, clarifications on interne compensatie and the five-year limit, the massale verstoringen wording, and redactional fixes.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the problem analysis lacking and doubts the necessity of the system change, since the 15-month assessment term hardly shortens the actual period and nihil-assessments could be reduced within the current system.

Review of definitive assessments and the nova criterion reduce legal certainty for taxpayers, and the 'wist of behoorde te weten' navorderingscriterium is unclear; the government adjusted the explanatory memorandum on interne compensatie and the five-year limit but rejected the core objection.
The 12-year navorderingstermijn for bad faith and the extreme difference with the 3-year term for good faith taxpayers require stronger justification, which the government considered adequate.

Exceptions for corporate tax, transitional law for those already past the limitation period and the immediate effect of the new navorderingsregime were raised; the government added a corporate tax note but rejected transitional rules.
Redactional and technical points in the bill text and memorandum were accepted and incorporated.

33750-IIA.s: This bill formally adopts the 2014 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Staten-Generaal, setting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros for the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and joint interparliamentary activities. It also takes effect retroactively from 1 January if published later, and orders ministries to carry it out.
q: Article 1 The budget statement for the year 2014 attached to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2014 wordt vastgesteld.

33840.s: The bill makes a set of technical and editorial amendments to the Higher Education and Research Act (WHW) and the Income Tax Act 2001, including new rules on profiling funds, financial support for students, and tuition payment. It also corrects cross-references, extends some procedures and reporting duties, and clarifies the board's duty to inform the supervisory board.
33840.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly as technical and legislative-economy measures, such as moving detail to ministerial regulations.
q: Ministerial regulations may designate art programmes and art teacher training programmes that may set specific requirements for prospective students and external candidates.

Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen opleidingen op het gebied van de kunst en lerarenopleidingen op het gebied van de kunst worden aangewezen die in verband met de organisatie en inrichting van het onderwijs dan wel de kennis of vaardigheden van de aanstaande studenten en extraneï specifieke eisen kunnen stellen
d: application requests and documents for degree-awarding powers
specific admission requirements for art programmes and procedural rules
payment arrangements and administrative fees for tuition
conditions for ministerial financial support to student board members
institutional rules on procedure, timing and amount of support
p: Ministerial power to grant financial support to student board members is set by ministerial regulation with limited statutory criteria.

parties: Asks whether technical changes have only technical consequences and questions the rationale for examination committees organising exams and the role of NVAO during programme phase-out.
Not all technical changes have only technical consequences.
Niet alle technische wijzigingen hebben alleen technische consequenties.
Supports the amendments in principle but asks about the removal of lex silencio positivo, student access to other programmes, payment terms differences, and student access to the profileringsfonds.
When may these students be entitled to a financial contribution, the members want to know.
Wanneer mogen deze studenten wel aanspraak maken op een financiële tegemoetkoming, zo willen de leden weten.

33912.s: The bill lets the Minister for Housing and Central Government Organisation decide, in agreement with the relevant ministers, that autonomous administrative bodies (ZBOs) use shared central-government back-office infrastructure, either on request or by compulsion for ZBOs that carry out regulation-bound tasks. It also sets cost-sharing via general administrative orders and excludes appeal against those decisions from the General Administrative Law Act.
33912.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated powers by the government's wish for the central government to operate as a unit, making public tasks more effective and efficient.
q: This means that, for example, market supervisors such as DNB, the AFM and the NZa cannot be obliged to participate in the government-wide back-office infrastructure without further legislation.
Dat betekent dat bijvoorbeeld markttoezichthouders, zoals DNB, de AFM en de NZa, niet zonder nadere wetgeving kunnen worden verplicht tot deelname aan de rijksbrede bedrijfsvoeringsinfrastructuur.
d: decision that ZBOs use shared infrastructure
rules on how ZBOs use the shared infrastructure
basis and payment rules for contributions to infrastructure costs
p: The minister may compel ZBOs performing regulation-bound tasks to join shared infrastructure without their request, subject only to a test of efficiency and effectiveness.
Decisions under article 21a are excluded from objection and appeal under the General Administrative Law Act, leaving disputes to internal consultation.

parties: Asks how participation in shared infrastructure could limit future outsourcing or divestment, whether privacy-sensitive citizen data could be linked unlawfully, and how disagreements between the minister and an agency about participation would be resolved.

They also ask how it is prevented that privacy-sensitive citizen information held by different parts of the central government, including independent administrative bodies, is unlawfully linked when sharing infrastructure makes this easier or more attractive.

Daarnaast vragen deze leden op welke manier wordt voorkomen dat privacygevoelige informatie van burgers die berust bij verschillende onderdelen van de Rijksoverheid, waaronder zelfstandige bestuursorganen, onrechtmatig wordt gekoppeld als dat door het delen van infrastructurele voorzieningen gemakkelijker of aantrekkelijker wordt.

Asks which infrastructure facilities are neutral enough that independent bodies may join without their task performance being substantively influenced, and asks for concrete examples of regulatory-bound bodies subject to mandatory participation.

These members ask the government how the bill relates to the budget cuts on the civil service announced in the Coalition Agreement and the recently announced reduction in the number of independent administrative bodies.

Deze leden vragen de regering hoe het voorliggende wetsvoorstel zich verhoudt tot de in het Regeerakkoord genoemde bezuinigingen op de Rijksdienst en de onlangs aangekondigde sanering van het aantal zelfstandige bestuursorganen.

Not yet convinced of the necessity of the bill; asks for per-agency business cases with costs and effects, a justification of compulsory participation, and safeguards against forced joining of well-functioning agencies and inflated charges.

These members therefore ask for which type of independent administrative bodies, or which specific bodies, the minister has compulsory participation in shared infrastructure in mind, and how the efficiency benefits have been mapped.

Deze leden vragen daarom voor welk type zelfstandige bestuursorganen, of voor welke specifieke zelfstandige bestuursorganen, de minister verplichte deelname aan gedeelde infrastructuur in gedachte heeft en hoe de efficiencyvoordelen in beeld zijn gebracht.

Asks for concrete figures on the effects on effectiveness, efficiency and service to citizens, and for justification of the statutory obligation rather than alternatives, including risks and expected savings.
The D66 members would welcome further explanation of the need for a statutory obligation. Why was no other option chosen?
De leden van de D66-fractie ontvangen graag nadere toelichting over de noodzaak van een wettelijke verplichting. Waarom wordt niet gekozen voor een andere mogelijkheid?
Argues that the bill lacks a procedure for cases where a regulatory-bound agency believes participation harms its interests, and that independent safeguards are needed given the agency's status.
Given the status of independent administrative bodies and the interests at stake in such processes, are no more independent safeguards needed, these members ask.
Zijn, gelet op de status van zelfstandige bestuursorganen en de belangen die bij zulke processen aan de orde zijn, niet meer onafhankelijke waarborgen nodig, zo vragen deze leden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill amending the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies (zbo's) to allow ministers to require zbo's to use central government infrastructure, and found the necessity, the zbo's independent position, the diversity of zbo practice, the scope of the term 'voorziening', and EU-law compatibility insufficiently justified, advising reconsideration. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts several points: it adds voluntary participation, limits compulsory participation to zbo's with rule-bound execution, defines 'voorziening', and expands the EU-law discussion.
concerns: The necessity of a generic statutory power was insufficiently justified; the government added a necessity paragraph and clarified the efficiency rationale.
Compulsory joining of zbo's could undermine their statutory independence; the government limited compulsion to rule-bound zbo's, though the power remains ministerial rather than legislative.
Diversity of zbo practice, including EU-regulated bodies, was not accounted for; the bill was restricted to rule-bound zbo's but EU-law exclusions were handled case by case.
The term 'voorziening' lacked a clear definition; a definition was added to article 21a and explained in the explanatory memorandum.
The EU procurement and competition analysis needed further substantiation; the explanatory memorandum was expanded on free movement of services but without full analysis.

33930-IIA.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for 2013, setting the final (slotwet) budget figures for the parliamentary chambers and their members. It also fixes the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, applying retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: the need has emerged to amend the departmental budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for the year 2013
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2013

34047.s: The bill amends the Gerechtsdeurwaarderswet to create a register of bailiffs, tighten qualification and independence requirements, and restructure trainee and assistant bailiff roles. It gives the Bureau financieel toezicht integral supervision over bailiffs, adds disciplinary and administrative fines, and introduces a complaints and dispute committee and a stille bewindvoerder mechanism.
34047.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by pointing to the need for detailed, technical and professional rules and to the need to safeguard quality and independence of the profession, without discussing parliamentary involvement.
q: To continue performing all its tasks well, the Bureau now carries out more risk-based supervision than before.
Het Bureau voert om al zijn taken goed te kunnen blijven vervullen, meer dan voorheen risicogericht toezicht uit.
d: rules on register administration, access and data provision
rules on training, assessment and rights of candidate bailiffs by regulation
rules on training recognition, application and appeal commission
duty to report events affecting financial position of bailiffs
reporting format and data supply to the Bureau
rules on collection of disciplinary fines
general complaints and dispute scheme by KBvG regulation
rules on quality audits by KBvG regulation
p: Gives the Bureau, an independent body, integral supervision and power to impose administrative fines and penalty orders on bailiffs, with a fine cap and no fine where a disciplinary complaint is already pending.
Allows the chair of the disciplinary chamber to appoint a silent administrator with binding instructions over a bailiff's business, subject to hearing and removal powers.
Ministerial approval is required for assigning assistant bailiffs, with a numerical cap of three per bailiff.

parties: Asks whether the classification of finding vacant homes as an official act and the complaint routes, including the Nationale ombudsman, are clear and workable for citizens.
This however makes the complaint options for citizens opaque and unclear.
Dit maakt de klachtmogelijkheden voor de burger echter wel ondoorzichtig en onoverzichtelijk.

Questions whether the BFT is adequately equipped for expanded supervision of bailiffs, and asks about the independence risks of no-cure-no-pay fee arrangements and the role of the Nationale ombudsman.
These members are aware of recent public criticism of the BFT's functioning and ask whether the BFT is sufficiently equipped to extend its remit to bailiffs.

Deze leden zijn op de hoogte van de recente kritiek in de publiciteit op het functioneren van het BFT en vragen naar aanleiding daarvan of het BFT wel voldoende is toegerust voor een uitbreiding van hun werkterrein naar de gerechtsdeurwaarders.

Questions overlap among supervisors (BFT, KBvG, Nationale ombudsman), the unexplained rejection of the report's fee recommendations, and the need to prohibit no-cure-no-pay arrangements to protect debtors.
These members believe no cure-no pay and no cure-less fee should be prohibited, as has largely happened for the legal profession.
Voornoemde leden zijn van mening dat no cure-no pay en no cure-less fee verboden moet worden, net zoals dat grotendeels voor de advocatuur is gebeurd.

Questions the government's basis for calling freelance bailiffs an undesirable development given a court finding of no concrete abuses, and asks for clarification of the independence rules and the ban on combining bailiff and bewindvoerder roles.
These members want to know how the government's conclusion that freelancers are an undesirable development relates to the finding that no concrete abuses were apparent for seven freelancers.

Voornoemde leden willen graag weten hoe de regering haar conclusie dat sprake is van een ongewenste ontwikkeling van de zogenaamde freelancers zich verhoudt tot bovenstaande constatering dat bij zeven freelancers klaarblijkelijk geen sprake is van concrete aantoonbare misstanden.
Welcomes the bill's direction but asks for clarity on the multiple overlapping supervisory and complaint routes and on the limit of two bailiffs per freelancer, which may hinder flexibility.
Supervision is carried out by the BFT and the KBvG, through complaint handling at the Nationale ombudsman, and there is disciplinary case law.
Toezicht vindt plaats door het BFT en de KBvG, via klachtbehandeling bij de Nationale ombudsman en er bestaat tuchtrechtspraak.
Asks why the evaluation provision has not yielded a timely re-evaluation, and questions the cap on freelance bailiffs and the combination of enforcement and debt-collection work.
They note that after decades of preparation the Bailiffs Act has been in force since 2001 and that the Van der Winkel committee evaluation follows from article 85 of the Act.

Zij merken op dat na tientallen jaren van voorbereiding de Gerechtsdeurwaarderwet sinds 2001 in werking is getreden en dat de evaluatie van de commissie-Van der Winkel uit artikel 85 van de Gerechtsdeurwaarderswet voortvloeit.
Asks whether the cap of two bailiffs per freelancer is proportionate to the problems identified and whether less far-reaching measures were considered, and questions the multiple complaint routes.
These members ask the government to explain which problems actually arose that would necessitate this measure.
Deze leden vragen de regering nader te duiden welke problemen er precies opgetreden zijn die tot deze maatregel zouden noodzaken?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill amending the Bailiffs Act (evaluation of the KBvG) but raises objections on overlapping supervision, the position of trainee bailiffs, indefinite retention of register data, and sanctions. The government's reply largely accepts the points on training-period tuchtrecht and the disciplinary-panel composition, while justifying retention, the fine increase and the ten-year waiting period.
concerns: Unclear division of supervisory tasks between the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, the KBvG and disciplinary law; government clarified in the explanatory memorandum and agreed to a covenant but did not change the bill.

Trainee bailiffs who have not yet finished their education can act independently and sit as deputy disciplinary members; the government removed the deputy membership but kept disciplinary liability during the training period.

Indefinite retention of personal data in the bailiff register raises privacy concerns; the government rejected the request to set a retention period, citing possible nullity claims and parallel notarial rules.
Justification for raising the maximum disciplinary fine to the fourth category and for the ten-year bar on acting as substitute was insufficient; the government added explanation in the memorandum.
Redactional remarks on the bill's text and the explanatory memorandum, including co-signature by the Minister for Housing and Central Government Reform, were adopted.

34074.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Edam-Volendam and Zeevang into a new municipality named Edam-Volendam, citing limited administrative capacity of Zeevang. It also makes consequential amendments to the Wet op de rechterlijke indeling, the Wet veiligheidsregio's, and transitional rules under the Wet algemene regels herindeling.
34074.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by the limited administrative capacity of Zeevang and reports that provincial financial supervision finds the new municipality financially healthy.
q: that it is desirable to merge the municipalities of Edam-Volendam and Zeevang because of the limited administrative capacity of the municipality of Zeevang
dat het wenselijk is de gemeenten Edam-Volendam en Zeevang samen te voegen vanwege de beperkte bestuurskracht van de gemeente Zeevang
d: entry into force by royal decree

parties: The VVD sees a voluntary merger with broad local and regional support and has no comments or questions.
The bill gives the members of the VVD faction no reason to make comments or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
The SP asks whether the larger Edam-Volendam will respect the distinct interests and village-level policy of the smaller Zeevang kernels, and asks for data on travel distances to the town hall.
This could lead to the kernels in the current municipality of Zeevang losing out to the places Edam and Volendam.
Dat zou ertoe kunnen leiden dat de kernen in de huidige gemeente Zeevang het onderspit delven ten opzichte van de plaatsen Edam en Volendam.
The CDA welcomes the merger's bottom-up origin and asks about the financial consequences via the municipal fund merger criterion and about future mergers in the region.
These members note that the proposed merger was initiated by the municipalities themselves and enjoys broad support from the municipal councils and social support in the municipalities concerned.
Deze leden constateren, dat de beoogde samenvoeging door de gemeenten zelf is geïnitieerd en kan rekenen op brede steun van de gemeenteraden en op maatschappelijk draagvlak in de betrokken gemeenten.

34083.s: The bill accelerates the increase of the AOW (state pension) age to 66 in 2018 and 67 in 2021, and moves the automatic life-expectancy linkage forward from 2019 to 2017 with a 2022 date. It also amends the Wet op de loonbelasting 1964 to adjust the tax-facilitated early-retirement (deelnemingsjarenpensioen) age and contribution-year thresholds in step with the AOW change.
34083.j: The memorandum justifies the faster age increase by the affordability of the AOW, rising social security costs and the demographic ageing of the population, and the life-expectancy formula is presented as a continuation of existing law.
q: The coalition agreement 'Bruggen slaan' provides that the AOW age is gradually raised from 2016 to 66 in 2018 and 67 in 2021.
In het Regeerakkoord «Bruggen slaan» is opgenomen dat de AOW-leeftijd vanaf 2016 geleidelijk wordt verhoogd naar 66 jaar in 2018 en 67 jaar in 2021
d: Artikel I (Algemene Ouderdomswet art. 7a, tweede en derde lid)
annual decision on further raising the AOW age based on life expectancy

parties: Asks whether legal advice was obtained on the enforceability of AOW rights for emigrants under the European Convention on Human Rights.
The VVD members wonder whether legal advice has been obtained on the enforceability of AOW rights for emigrants under the European Convention on Human Rights.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen zich af of juridisch advies is ingewonnen over de opeisbaarheid van AOW-rechten bij emigranten in het kader van het Europees Verdrag tot bescherming van de rechten van de mens en de fundamentele vrijheden (EVRM).
Objects that the measure removes the guarantee of a minimum income for older people and asks whether alternative savings were considered.
The SP members have taken note of the bill with indignation.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben met verontwaardiging kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.
Finds the transitional arrangement too thin and asks how people can prepare and avoid serious financial hardship.
How will the government prevent people from getting into insurmountable financial problems as a result?
Hoe gaat de regering voorkomen dat mensen hierdoor in onoverkomelijke financiële problemen komen?
Asks how the government assesses the consistency of policy and the adequacy of the overbridging scheme for those affected.

Why does the government not choose to widen the current overbridging scheme, since the faster rise of the AOW age increases the income effect on people with an AOW gap and the measure takes effect in the very short term?

Waarom kiest de regering er niet voor om de huidige overbruggingsregeling te verruimen, aangezien door de snellere stijging van de AOW-leeftijd het inkomenseffect op mensen met een AOW-gat groter is en de maatregel op al korte termijn ingaat?
Asks why the bill reached parliament so late and what the deadline for parliamentary treatment is, given the need for public communication.
The D66 members therefore ask the government for further explanation of why sending the bill to the House was delayed for so long.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering dan ook om een nadere toelichting waarom verzending aan de Kamer zo lang op zich heeft laten wachten.
Asks about the status of a motion requesting study of a flexible AOW and about the effects on people with early-retirement schemes and functional age dismissal.
According to the PvdA members, the ministry wrongly assumed that after April 2015 all pension schemes would have been adjusted to the new statutory pension age of 67.

Het ministerie is er volgens de leden van de PvdA-fractie ten onrechte van uitgegaan na april 2015 alle pensioenregelingen zouden zijn aangepast aan de nieuwe wettelijke pensioenrichtleeftijd van 67 jaar.
Doubts the fiscal necessity of the measure, cites expert criticism, and argues it worsens unemployment among older workers and fails the affected low-income groups.
The bill unilaterally affects older employees.
Het wetsvoorstel treft eenzijdig oudere werknemers.

34092.s: The bill amends the Mining Act so that holders of pre-1965 hydrocarbon extraction licences can split off part of their licence area and transfer it to another party, with the split-off part receiving a new licence carrying the same conditions as far as compatible with the law. It authorises general administrative orders (AMvB) to set further rules on such splits and provides that some regular regime provisions, such as the state participation obligation, do not apply to the split-off licence.
34092.j: The memorandum justifies the splitting rules and exceptions as necessary to safeguard the technical character of splitting and to allow efficient exploration and exploitation of gas and oil reserves.
q: Because the technical character of splitting must be sufficiently safeguarded, under the bill the regular statutory framework of the Mining Act does not apply in all respects in full to these split-off licences.

Omdat het technisch karakter van afsplitsing voldoende gewaarborgd dient te zijn, is op grond van het wetsvoorstel het reguliere wettelijk kader uit de Mijnbouwwet niet in alle opzichten integraal en volledig op die afgesplitste vergunningen van toepassing
d: rules on splitting pre-1965 extraction licences
p: The state participation requirement (paragraph 5.2.3) is disapplied to split-off licences, removing a statutory condition from the regular framework without parliamentary review of the specific case.

parties: Welcomes clarity on splitting pre-1965 licences and accepts the government's view that no state aid arises because the new holder pays economic value; drops further comments after Raad van State points were addressed.
These members note that the comments of the Council of State have been taken into account and therefore refrain from further comments.
Deze leden constateren dat met de opmerkingen van de Raad van State rekening is gehouden en zien daarom af van verdere opmerkingen.
Has no questions on the bill.
The PvdA members have taken note of the bill and have no need to ask questions about the amendment of the Mining Act.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en zij hebben geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen omtrent de Wijziging van de Mijnbouwwet.

Questions the justification for a special law instead of having the legal uncertainty tested by the Landsadvocaat or a court, asks why the Groningen gas-building restructuring did not address this, and whether the state should be strengthened in the gas-building governance.
These members do not understand why, instead of submitting that uncertainty to the Landsadvocaat or a court, a kind of 'exception law' is chosen.
Deze leden begrijpen niet dat in plaats van die onduidelijkheid voor te leggen aan de landsadvocaat of aan een rechtbank, er in plaats daarvan gekozen wordt voor een soort van «uitzonderingswet».
Asks what problem the bill solves, what risks splitting poses for liability for future mining damage, and whether the state can refuse a split or enforce state participation.
These members fear that responsibility for possible damage from extraction could become blurred through the splitting of licences.
Deze leden vrezen dat de verantwoordelijkheid bij mogelijke schade door winning vertroebeld zou kunnen worden door splitsing van vergunningen.

Notes Raad van State criticism of the favourable treatment of old licences and state aid, rejects the state-aid view and questions routinely consulting Brussels; asks about consequences if special positions lapse.
These members therefore share the government's reasoning that there is no state aid and ask the government to distance itself more firmly from the Council of State's insinuations on this point.
Deze leden delen dan ook de redenering van de regering dat van staatssteun geen sprake is en verzoeken de regering om stelliger afstand te nemen van de insinuaties van de Raad van State op dit punt.

Asks whether shale gas extraction could fall under the old licences and whether the government can exclude exploration drilling for shale gas before parliament decides; asks about discretion to refuse a split.
The D66 members would like to know whether, besides conventional oil and/or gas extraction, shale gas extraction is also possible under these original licences.
Graag horen deze leden of behalve conventionele olie- en/of gaswinning ook schalie gaswinning mogelijk is onder deze oorspronkelijke vergunningen.
Asks whether liability for mining damage, including from wells over sixty years, and expertise on earthquakes transfer to new licence holders, and what guarantees the government has.
What guarantees does the government have about expertise on earthquakes and about the willingness and capability of new licence holders to compensate mining damage?
Welke waarborgen heeft de regering over de expertise op het gebied van aardbevingen en over de bereidheid en capabiliteit om schade door mijnbouw te vergoeden van nieuwe vergunninghouders?

v.summary: The Council of State advised on a bill allowing a part of a pre-1965 mining concession to be split off and transferred, and objected that new holders of such split-off areas get more favourable ownership and no state-participation obligation than other licence holders, plus raised a state aid concern. The government's reply accepted the state aid point by adding a justification in the explanatory memorandum and defended the differential treatment as necessary to preserve the technical character of the split-off, while revising the state participation provision.
concerns: The Council considers the privileged treatment of holders of split-off licences on old 1810 concession areas insufficiently justified and advises justifying or deleting the ownership and state participation exemptions.
The Council says the explanatory memorandum should address EU state aid rules, since the exemptions may constitute selective aid; the government added the analysis but argued no aid arises.
The Council advises clarifying in article 143(13) that paragraph 5.2.3 does not apply where an existing licence condition imposes state participation.

34128.s: The bill amends the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 and the Algemene wet bestuursrecht to change legal protection against refusal of entry, including making direct appeal to the court available when border detention is ongoing, and formalises exceptions to the EU Return Directive for certain categories of foreigners. It also makes technical corrections and clarifies that officials may enter business premises to establish identity.
34128.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by citing Raad van State case law requiring simultaneous handling of appeals and a binding normative basis for the Return Directive exceptions.
q: To put beyond doubt that the power to enter exists, it is proposed to state this expressly in article 53a, second paragraph.
Om buiten twijfel te stellen dat de bevoegdheid tot betreden bestaat, wordt voorgesteld dit in artikel 53a, tweede lid, uitdrukkelijk te vermelden.
p: Artikel I, I and Artikel II
Administrative appeal against refusal of entry lapses when court appeal against border detention is pending, shifting the route of challenge directly to the courts for foreigners.

Officials are expressly empowered to enter business premises to seize documents for identity checks of detained foreigners, when reasonably necessary and where the foreigner is suspected of using the space as housing.
Obligations under the Return Directive are declared inapplicable to three categories of foreigners, including those refused entry and those subject to extradition procedures.

parties: Asks how long Dublin transfers take and what happens to a W-document when lawful residence ends, which bears on the residence rights of persons awaiting transfer.
