An alien who can be transferred under the Dublin Regulation has a right to stay in the Netherlands until the effective transfer.
Een vreemdeling die kan worden overgedragen op grond van de Dublinverordening heeft recht tot verblijf in Nederland tot aan de effectieve overdracht.
Worries that excluding illegal aliens from the Return Directive safeguards may lower the level of legal protection for these categories.
does this not in certain cases lead to a deterioration in the level of legal protection of these categories
leidt dit dan niet in bepaalde gevallen tot een verslechtering van het niveau van rechtsbescherming van deze categorieën
Asks about Court of Justice exceptions to reception obligations and about Raad van State rulings that the Secretary of State failed to recognise Dublin claim options.
What are the reasons that the State Secretary for Security and Justice in some cases failed or was late to recognise the possibility of sending a claim request to Italy

Wat zijn de redenen van het gegeven dat de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie in sommige gevallen de mogelijkheid tot het versturen van een claimverzoek aan Italië niet of te laat heeft onderkend
Argues that granting lawful residence pending transfer encourages asylum shopping, and wants conditional release abolished for illegal aliens.
Does the government realise that granting lawful residence encourages asylum shopping
Realiseert de regering zich dat het toekennen van rechtmatig verblijf asielshoppen in de hand werkt

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division endorsed the bill amending the Aliens Act, Administrative Law Act and Criminal Code but advised revisions on the definition of 'gemeenschapsonderdanen', conditional release eligibility, appeal in custody cases and the Return Directive exception provision. The government's reply rejected most advice on conditional release and the Return Directive wording, accepted the appeal point by deleting the amendment, and announced a separate bill on EU-derived residence rights.
concerns: The definition of EU-derived residence rights should be broadened to cover Zambrano situations and returning nationals, and the term 'gemeenschapsonderdanen' should be replaced; the government will address the wider EU-law point in a separate bill.
Conditional release should be withheld only where it is evident the residence application cannot lead to lasting lawful residence, rather than for all categories of foreign nationals listed.
The appeal provision for custody cases should not delete the reference to Article 6a, as the existing law already provides appeal against such measures.
The exception from the Return Directive in Article 109a should refer explicitly to the concrete statutory articles containing the affected obligations rather than use general wording.
The explanatory memorandum should be made self-contained and several drafting corrections to the bill's articles should be made.

34146.s: The bill makes a set of technical and policy amendments across Dutch education laws: it creates statutory grounds for ministerial regulations on public bodies investing or borrowing money and entering financial product commitments, restores a five-day appeal deadline for exam-participation decisions, drops a mandatory cultural arts course for atheneum pupils taking Latin or Greek, exempts practical-education schools from merger approval, and renames 'controleprotocol' to 'accountantsprotocol'. It also aligns the Education Inspectorate Act with the revitalised general supervision regime.
34146.j: The memorandum justifies the financial delegations by the high risk of unlawful or inefficient use of public funds and the need to respond quickly to changing financial conditions.
q: Precisely where it concerns investing money, taking out loans and entering financial product commitments, the risks of unlawful and inefficient spending of public funds are high.

Juist waar het gaat om het uitzetten van gelden, het aangaan van geldleningen en het aangaan van verbintenissen voor financiële producten, zijn de risico's van onrechtmatige en ondoelmatige besteding van publieke middelen groot.
d: investing, borrowing and financial product commitments by school boards
investing, borrowing and financial product commitments by expertise centre boards
investing, borrowing and financial product commitments by secondary school boards
investing, borrowing and financial product commitments under vocational education act
investing, borrowing and financial product commitments by institutional boards
designation of appeal body for exam-participation decisions via general administrative order
p: Ministerial regulations on school and institution financial investments and borrowing are authorised without parliamentary approval, shifting detailed rule-setting to the minister and making enforcement easier.

parties: Asks whether the government will set clear limits on investing and borrowing by education institutions and restrict them to risk-free cash-treasury banking, given the financial collapse risk.

Does the government share this view? Treasury banking is, as stated in the policy review of treasury banking, low-risk and efficient, and institutions hold their funds in the central government treasury through simple and transparent products.

Deelt de regering deze opvatting? Schatkistbankieren is, zoals wordt gesteld in de beleidsdoorlichting schatkistbankieren, risicoarm en doelmatig en instellingen houden hun middelen aan in de schatkist van het Rijk via eenvoudige en transparante producten.
Supports the goal of avoiding unnecessary risk with public money and asks what changes the bill makes and which sanctions it newly enables.
Which sanctions can now be imposed through this bill that cannot be imposed at present, they ask.</evidence_en>
Welke sancties kunnen straks door dit wetsvoorstel wel worden getroffen en nu nog niet, zo vragen zij.

34155.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the 2014 Brussels intergovernmental agreement on transferring and mutualising contributions to the Single Resolution Fund for the European banking union. It also sets out the transitional mechanics of the fund, including national compartments, a five-tier drawing order, and the Single Resolution Board's powers over contributions and non-compliance.
34155.j: The memorandum justifies the agreement as necessary because some member states doubted the Union's competence to regulate these provisions by regulation, so an intergovernmental treaty was chosen.
q: For this reason too, there was insufficient support within the Union to regulate those provisions.
Mede daarom bestond onvoldoende draagvlak voornoemde bepalingen binnen de Unie te regelen.
d: approval of international agreement text for the fund's operation

parties: Asks about ratification status across eurozone countries, the phasing and mutualisation design, and conditions on the use of loans and other support by the resolution board.
Welcomes the European regulation of supervision and resolution and asks for an overview of the build-up of national and common compartments during the transition period.
The PvdA members are pleased that supervision, resolution of problem banks and the financing of resolution and restructuring of problem banks are now arranged at European level.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn tevreden dat het toezicht, de afwikkeling van probleembanken en de financiering van de afwikkeling en herstructurering van probleembanken nu op Europees niveau worden geregeld.
Finds the role of national parliaments too limited and asks whether their powers can be extended to the level of the European Parliament for democratic oversight.
These members would like to know whether these powers could not be extended to the same level as the European Parliament, so that optimal democratic oversight becomes possible.
Graag willen deze leden weten of deze bevoegdheden niet kunnen worden uitgebreid tot hetzelfde niveau als het Europese parlement, zodat een optimale democratische controle mogelijk wordt gemaakt.
Supports a common resolution fund but asks about legal grounds for using an agreement instead of a regulation, the risk of taxpayer backstop, systemic crisis scenarios and too-big-to-fail banks.
Does the government rule out that taxpayers would then still have to step in?
Sluit de regering uit dat de belastingbetaler dan alsnog bijspringen?
Supports a European resolution mechanism with losses borne by shareholders and creditors, and asks whether member states can meet their obligations and about the fund's investment policy and costs.
The D66 members are supporters of the European resolution mechanism with the starting point that losses are borne by shareholders and creditors of a failing bank.
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn een voorstander van het Europees afwikkelingsmechanisme met het uitgangspunt dat verliezen worden gedragen door aandeelhouders en crediteuren van een falende bank.
Asks which member states' legal doubts about EU competence were raised, how the agreement differs legally from a regulation, and for detailed schedules of contributions and tiers of fund use.
First, the PVV members note that the Dutch position in the negotiations was that participating banks must have an equal starting position and that the resolution frameworks must be harmonised.

Allereerst stellen de leden van de PVV-fractie vast dat het Nederlandse standpunt in de onderhandelingen is geweest dat deelnemende banken een gelijke startpositie moeten hebben en dat de raamwerken voor afwikkeling geharmoniseerd dienen te worden.

34182.s: The bill amends the Dutch driving instruction act (WRM 1993) to tighten and streamline the periodic retraining of driving instructors, shortens the loss-of-license window and creates a re-entry route for instructors who lost their authority. It also gives the ILT inspectorate supervisory and enforcement powers, exempts professional driver trainers from certification, and empowers the Minister to impose administrative fines and orders under administrative coercion.
34182.j: The memorandum justifies the new ILT supervisory powers by the need to improve instruction quality and reduce certificate fraud, given limited police capacity.
q: In view of the intended improvement of driving instruction quality and the wish to reduce the risk of fraud with WRM certificates, it is desirable to intensify supervision of compliance with the WRM.

Met het oog op de voorgestane kwaliteitsverbetering van de rijinstructie en de wens om het risico van fraude met WRM-certificaten te verkleinen is het wenselijk dat het toezicht op de naleving van de WRM wordt geïntensiveerd.
d: Art. I, onderdeel L (Art. 13 WRM) / Art. I, onderdeel W (Art. 24a WRM)
designation of supervisory officials and related rules
imposing orders under administrative coercion (bestuursdwang) by the Minister
p: Art. I, onderdeel W (Art. 24a and 24b WRM)
The Minister may designate ILT officials as supervisors and impose orders under administrative coercion, expanding executive enforcement powers over instructors and trainees.
The Minister may impose administrative fines up to statutory maxima for violations of the act, shifting sanctioning power from the criminal courts to the executive.

Certificate invalidation following an insufficient retraining assessment is made possible without the previous seven-day period, and the deadline is set at eight weeks, giving the institute discretion over loss of instructor authority.

parties: Asks how the revised refresher training improves teaching quality and whether the 99% pass rate signals an exam that only checks attendance; also asks about ILT capacity for the added enforcement task and the Raad van State's objection to the dual sanction system.
They therefore ask how the proposed changes contribute to better quality of driving instruction and thus safer driving behaviour among newly trained drivers.
Daarom vragen zij op welke wijze de voorgestelde wijzigingen bijdragen aan een betere kwaliteit van het rijonderricht en daarmee dat opgeleide beginnende bestuurders een veiliger rijgedrag vertonen.

Asks for more statistics on the licence-loss sanction, whether the refresher training is effective, and better protection of learner drivers against unlicensed instructors, including a public register of licensed instructors.
How can learners make sure that their instructor is authorised to give driving lessons? Is there a public and up-to-date register of licensed driving instructors?
Op welke wijze kunnen cursisten zich ervan verzekeren dat hun instructeur bevoegd is rijlessen te geven? Bestaat er een openbaar en actueel register van bevoegde rijinstructeurs?

Questions whether the evaluator (who worked on the 2009 amendment) is marking its own work, the composition of the Centraal Examen Commissie with possible conflicts of interest, and objects to making licence loss a sanction within refresher training.
These members ask whether this is not a case of the butcher inspecting his own meat.
Deze leden vragen of hier geen sprake is van een slager die zijn eigen vlees keurt.

Asks why dual administrative and criminal enforcement is needed, notes differences in legal protection between administrative and criminal sanctions, and wants the intended effectiveness made explicit.
These members believe administrative and criminal sanctions are not equal and differ in particular in effectiveness.
Deze leden menen dat bestuurlijke en strafrechtelijke sancties niet gelijk zijn en met name verschillen op het niveau van effectiviteit.

Notes the Raad van State found no convincing justification for the dual sanction system, questions whether the choice rests on enforcement convenience rather than legal principles, and asks about possible double sanctions.
These members read in the Raad van State's advice that no convincing justification is given for applying a dual sanction system.
De leden van de D66-fractie lezen in het advies van de Afdeling dat er geen overtuigende motivatie wordt gegeven om een duaal sanctiestelsel toe te passen.

Questions whether licence withdrawal is proportionate when most candidates pass, asks why pass rates of instructors are not weighed, and questions whether the eight-week period is realistic for the six-week re-entry track.
According to these members, withdrawal of the instruction licence should be a last resort.
Volgens genoemde leden dient het intrekken van de instructiebevoegdheid een ultimum remedium te zijn.
Asks how instructors who fail retraining can keep teaching for eight weeks, whether mystery-guest controls can be introduced, and how unlawful conduct by instructors is controlled and enforced.
Can the government respond to this? What is the expected number of instructors who at some point give driving lessons without being qualified?
Kan de regering hierop reageren? Wat is de verwachting van het aantal instructeurs dat op enig moment onbevoegd rijles geeft?

Questions why theory retraining has no sanction while practical retraining does, asks why instructors choose their own examination pupils, and whether unannounced quality sampling by IBKI needs statutory anchoring.
Considers the retraining sanction unproven and stressful, and asks whether steering on pass rates would more effectively remove poorly performing instructors.
The SP members ask whether it would not be better to create a different and more effective sanction, such as steering on pass rates.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of het niet beter is om een ander sanctiemiddel in het leven te roepen dat effectiever is, zoals het sturen op slagingspercentage.
Has no further questions after the government's amendment note.
They have no further questions on this.
Zij hebben hierover geen vragen meer.
Has read the second amendment note with interest and has no further questions or remarks.
The VVD members have read the second amendment note with great interest and have no further questions or remarks.

De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben de tweede nota van wijziging op de Wijziging van de Wet rijonderricht motorrijtuigen 1993 (hierna: het wetsvoorstel) met veel interesse gelezen en hebben daarover verder geen vragen, dan wel opmerkingen.
Has read the second amendment note with interest and has no further questions.
The CDA members have taken note of the second amendment note with interest. They have no further questions.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van de tweede nota van wijziging. Zij hebben geen vragen meer.

Asks why success rates are not used to assess instructors, questions the timing and basis for continuous screening, and calls the IBKI practical test arbitrary and asks for more objective, meetable testing and a more binding retraining programme.
According to these members, the amendment note nowhere provides that the IBKI assessment will become more objective and measurable.
Volgens deze leden wordt in de nota van wijziging nergens geregeld dat de toetsing van het IBKI objectiever en meetbaarder wordt.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division opined that the bill to amend the Driving Instruction Motor Vehicles Act 1993 should not introduce a dual sanctions regime (administrative fines alongside criminal enforcement) without a convincing justification, effectiveness evidence and attention to differing legal protection. The government's reply splits enforcement: unlicensed instruction stays criminal, while failing to return invalid certificates and related duties move to administrative enforcement with lower maximum fines, and it notes that effectiveness and legal protection were addressed.
concerns: The Council found no convincing justification or evidence that the dual sanctions regime would be more effective than criminal enforcement alone; the government responded by dropping dual enforcement for most offences and retaining criminal enforcement where the offence is open-context and dangerous.

The Council held that the explanation did not justify a dual regime given the differentiated nature of the offences; the government split enforcement and lowered maximum administrative fines for the remaining administrative offences.

The Council warned that administrative fines differ from criminal sanctions in legal protection (no suspensive effect, immediate collection, court fees, no criminal record entry), which the explanation did not address; the government stated equivalence of legal protection and did not change the regime on that ground.

34191.s: This omnibus bill (Veegwet VWS 2015) corrects errors, removes omissions and makes technical amendments across many health, welfare and sport laws, including extending the prescribing-related advertising rules, enabling broker deductions for protected living contributions, and dissolving the College bouw zorginstellingen. It also introduces a new Zorgverzekeringswet quality standard framework replacing 'professionele standaard' with 'kwaliteitsstandaard'.
34191.j: The memorandum justifies the new delegation and bypass powers as technical corrections needed to continue existing contribution collection for protected living as under the former AWBZ.
q: in order to be able to continue the source deduction of own contributions for protected living under the Wmo 2015, as was also possible when protected living still fell under the AWBZ
teneinde de broninhouding van eigen bijdragen voor beschermd wonen ingevolge de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015 te kunnen voortzetten
d: rules on processing personal data by youth care providers and certified institutions
Zorginstituut policy rule on assessing quality standards
XIV (Wet op de medische hulpmiddelen art. 8 lid 1)
p: XX, XXI, XXIV, XXV, XXVII-XXXI (Algemene nabestaandenwet, AOW, WW and others)
The Sociale verzekeringsbank or UWV may pay benefits directly to the CAK to recover protected-living contributions without the beneficiary's authorisation.

parties: Asks the government about the technical nature of the bill and general points of concern.
Although the bill in question is technical in nature, they still have some important questions (see article-by-article).
Hoewel het desbetreffende wetsvoorstel technisch van aard is hebben zij nog enkele belangwekkende vragen (zie artikelsgewijs).
Worries about municipalities' ability to link personal data in the social domain and about privacy safeguards for clients at neighbourhood teams.
Can the government indicate whether and to what extent the proposed changes give municipalities the possibility to link personal data in the social domain?
Kan de regering aangeven of en in welke mate door de voorgestelde wijzigingen gemeenten de mogelijkheid hebben persoonsgegevens in het sociale domein te koppelen?
Disappointed that the bill makes substantive policy changes labelled as technical, and asks about the co-payment barrier and the lack of legal basis for co-payments on protected living.
According to the government the proposed changes are not technical in nature, while these members note that considerable policy changes are being made to current health legislation.

Volgens de regering dragen de voorgestelde wijzigingen geen technisch karakter, terwijl deze leden constateren dat er aanzienlijke beleidsmatige wijzigingen worden aangebracht in de huidige wet- en regelgeving in de zorg.
Questions why diagnostic data of youths should be available to municipalities and how privacy is safeguarded, proposing alternatives such as a central control office.
Does the government consider it necessary at all that municipalities must be able to access diagnostic data of young people in mental health care?
Is de regering van mening dat het überhaupt noodzakelijk is dat gemeenten moeten kunnen beschikken over diagnostische gegevens van jeugdigen in de GGZ?
Asks for the government's response to the CBP findings that the bill does not meet requirements for explicit legal basis for breaching confidentiality.
These members ask what the government's response is to the CBP's findings that the amendments to articles 7.4.1, 7.4.3 and 7.4.4 do not meet the requirements for explicitness and specification.

Deze leden vragen wat de reactie van de regering is op de bevindingen van het CBP dat met de aanpassing van artikel 7.4.1, artikel 7.4.3 en artikel 7.4.4 niet wordt voldaan aan de vereisten inzake explicitering en specificering
Argues that the statutory rule on conscientious objectors' savings accounts is unreasonable for children and asks for a correction by amendment.
In the past, minor children of conscientious-objector parents were not yet registered as conscientious objectors against insurance.
Vroeger werden minderjarige kinderen van gemoedsbezwaarde ouders nog niet als gemoedsbezwaarde tegen verzekeringen geregistreerd.
The SP is dissatisfied with the government's brief answers and asks for fuller research into effects of abolishing the CBZ and for a fuller answer on the quality standard debate.
The members of the SP faction are very disappointed in the government's answers regarding the abolition of the CBZ.
De leden van de SP -fractie zijn erg teleurgesteld in de beantwoording van de regering als het gaat om de vragen met betrekking tot het opheffen van het CBZ.
The CDA asks whether the chosen way of listing data on invoices to municipalities is consistent with the professional secrecy of care providers.

The SP objects that substantive changes are included in a technical omnibus bill rather than a separate amending bill, and doubts the abolition of the building regime, demanding overviews of care real estate and public capital.
Said members are of the opinion that the substantive points should be introduced through a separate amending act.
Genoemde leden zijn van mening dat de inhoudelijke punten via een Wijzigingswet aangebracht zouden moeten worden.

The CDA asks why a ministerial regulation should be able to assign new tasks to the NZa without explicit parliamentary involvement, and why this is included before a broader bill on the NZa's functioning.
Why are these tasks to be assigned to the NZa by ministerial regulation, and therefore without explicit involvement of the House?
Waarom zijn dit taken die bij ministeriële regeling, en dus zonder expliciete betrokkenheid van de Kamer, aan de NZa opgedragen moeten worden?

34210-III.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget statements (first supplementary budget) of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, and the Oversight Committee for the Intelligence and Security Services, adjusting amounts in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 1 June 2015 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2015 to the budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King and the Oversight Committee for the Intelligence and Security Services.

Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2015 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken, het Kabinet van de Koning en de Commissie van Toezicht betreffende de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten.

34218.s: The bill amends the Dutch Bankruptcy Act to let the court, on a debtor's request, appoint in secret a prospective curator and prospective judge-commissioner before any bankruptcy, formalizing the 'pre-pack' practice for preparing a sale or restart. It adds a new Title IV for the 'silent preparation phase', with court-set time limits, conditions, oversight by the prospective judge-commissioner, and related amendments to the Civil Code and bestuursverbod rules.
34218.j: The memorandum justifies the new regime by the need to legally anchor an existing practice, improve creditor outcomes, and reduce faillissementsfraude risks through early oversight by the prospective curator and judge-commissioner.
q: The fact that preparation of the bankruptcy usually takes place in secret means that creditors, unless they are involved, cannot themselves stand up for their interests.

Het gegeven dat de voorbereiding van het faillissement in de regel in stilte plaatsvindt, maakt dat de schuldeisers – tenzij zij hierin betrokken worden – daarbij niet zelf voor hun belangen kunnen opkomen.
d: conditions and security attached to prospective curator appointment (court-set)
content rules for the prospective curator's report
p: Creditors lose the ability to request judge-commissioner intervention during the secret preparation phase, and the phase is kept out of public registers, though the curator and judge-commissioner are tasked with protecting creditors and the court supervises the phase.

parties: Asks whether the 'pre-pack' conditions and the time limit for creditor objections will slow the process, and whether curators' quality and the rules for removing them are adequate.
They consider it positive that a statutory basis is provided for the practice of preparing a restart out of bankruptcy before the declaration of bankruptcy.
Zij vinden het positief dat een wettelijke grondslag wordt geboden voor de praktijk van de voorbereiding van een doorstart uit faillissement voorafgaand aan de faillietverklaring
Worried the pre-pack could be misused to cheaply shed staff; asks why works councils are not automatically involved and why the court need not revoke the appointment when misuse is suspected.
These members find it very undesirable if the pre-pack could be used to cheaply get rid of staff or to worsen employees' working conditions.
Deze leden vinden het zeer onwenselijk als de pre-pack gebruikt kan worden om goedkoop van personeel af te komen of om de arbeidsvoorwaarden van het personeel te verslechteren.
Asks how consumers are protected against cases like Neckermann, how the rechter-commissaris's supervisory role is funded, and whether a judge should assess the time needed in each case.
The aforementioned members cite the flash bankruptcy of Neckermann, where during the silent phase purchase agreements were deliberately still concluded with consumers.
Voornoemde leden noemen het voorbeeld van het flitsfaillissement van Neckermann, waar tijdens de stille fase alsnog bewust koopovereenkomsten zijn gesloten met consumenten

Asks whether the silent preparation phase invites fraud, why three courts declined the practice, whether creditors and employees should be able to request the appointment, and how the Estro and Triodus cases compare.
The members asked whether the government is not afraid that precisely the silent preparation phase invites fraudulent conduct and/or improper acts by directors of a business in distress.
De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen of de regering niet bevreesd is dat juist de stille voorbereidingsfase frauduleus gedrag en/of oneigenlijke handelingen uitlokt door bestuurders
Asks what 'with the utmost urgency' means in the court's handling of appointment requests.
These members ask what is understood by 'the utmost urgency'.
deze leden vragen wat wordt verstaan onder «de meeste spoed».

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division questions the desirability of the Wet continuïteit ondernemingen I bill allowing courts to appoint a prospective curator and judge-commissioner before bankruptcy, arguing the safeguards against abuse, loss of independence, and exclusion of other bidders are insufficient and advising reconsideration. The government's reply accepts the main points, clarifying the curator's role, adding a stronger 'meerwaarde' requirement, board liability provisions, supervisory board approval, and a broader directive-based rationale, though it does not fully resolve the independence and transparency concerns.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the opportunity of the proposal because abuse and exclusion risks are insufficiently mitigated by the safeguards.
The Afdeling doubts the independence of the prospective curator under time and information pressure from the debtor.
The meerwaarde criterion should be set in statute with detailed elaboration by general administrative order, not left to court practice.
Risk of abuse of insolvency procedures threatens employees' rights under Directive 2001/23/EC, Art. 5(4), requiring measures against abuse.
Analysis of past pre-pack cases was missing and has been added to the explanatory memorandum.
Supervisory board approval should be required before a request for appointment of a prospective curator.
Concern about competition distortion from pre-pack sales was insufficiently reasoned against VNO/NCW and MKB proposal.

34227.s: The bill amends the Participatiewet, the IOAW and IOAZ, the Pensioenwet and the Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling so that pension savings in lijfrente products (up to €250,000 under conditions, with five-year look-back and €6,000 annual contributions) are not counted as an available asset for social assistance, employment income is exempt for longer periods, and the deadline for voluntary continuation of pension participation is extended from nine to fifteen months after employment ends. Municipalities may by ordinance set a period within which the six-month income exemption must fall, and the Minister may issue regulations on the test for lijfrente savings.
34227.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation power as needed to set out how savings and contributions from earlier years are tested against the thresholds in force at the time of the benefit application.
q: Further rules on the testing and application of the conditions in the second paragraph, under b, shall be set by ministerial regulation.
Bij ministeriële regeling worden nadere regels gesteld met betrekking tot de toetsing aan en de toepassing van de voorwaarden in het tweede lid, onderdeel b.
d: rules on testing and applying lijfrente conditions
Artikel I, C (art. 31, lid 2 onder n Participatiewet, as amended)
municipal ordinance setting period for six-month employment income exemption
Artikel IV, A (art. 8, lid 2 IOAW, as amended)
municipal ordinance setting period for six-month income exemption
Artikel V, A (art. 8, lid 3 IOAZ, as amended)
municipal ordinance setting period for six-month income exemption
p: Artikel I, B (art. 15, lid 2 onder b Participatiewet)

Lijfrente savings are excluded from the mandatory prior-use test for social assistance, subject to a value cap, look-back period and contribution limits, with the municipality retaining discretion to judge individual cases; the transitional clause expires in 2016.
Minister may set detailed rules for testing lijfrente conditions by regulation.

parties: Asks why municipalities are given individual discretion to deviate from the conditions and how that discretion relates to existing statutory powers, and whether the rules are being monitored.
Why is an explicit new individual discretionary option being created for municipal executives here?
Waarom wordt hier expliciet een nieuwe individuele keuzemogelijkheid voor colleges gecreëerd?
Asks for the grounds of the €250,000 and €6,000 thresholds, the criteria municipalities may use, and whether appeal is possible if a municipality includes pension assets in the means test.
Is it possible to appeal if it turns out the municipal executive does include the pension assets in the means test under the Participation Act?
Is het mogelijk om in beroep te gaan als blijkt dat het college het pensioenvermogen wél onderdeel laat zijn van de vermogenstoets in de Participatiewet?
Warns that leaving decisions to municipalities risks unequal treatment across municipalities and asks for uniform statutory rules rather than discretion.
leaving it to the municipal executive to decide whether pension assets must be drawn upon could result in legal inequality across municipalities
het aan het college te laten om te bepalen of het pensioenvermogen aangesproken moet worden, rechtsongelijkheid tot gevolg kan hebben in verschillende gemeenten
Asks how the rules work in practice for people who temporarily stop contributions, how applicants can claim the exemption if a municipality refuses, and how municipalities are to verify holdings.
These members also ask how an applicant for assistance can claim the €250,000 exemption if the municipality is unwilling to grant it.
Ook vragen deze leden hoe een aanvrager van bijstand aanspraak kan maken op de vrijstelling van € 250.000 indien de gemeente die niet wil verschaffen.
Asks for justification of the caps and the interpretation of the five-year test period, and whether averaging of contributions is possible for self-employed with fluctuating income.
These members also ask the government to further justify why averaging of the maximum annual contribution of €6,000 is not permitted.
Ook vragen deze leden aan de regering nader te onderbouwen waarom middeling van de maximale jaarlijkse inleg van € 6.000 niet is toegestaan.

34236.s: The bill amends the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure and related laws to implement EU Directive 2012/29 on minimum rights for crime victims, expanding victims' rights to information, interpretation and translation, assistance, individual assessment, restorative justice and support. It delegates many detailed rules to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulations, with the explanatory memorandum stressing that these delegations concern instruction norms and procedural guarantees.
34236.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying detailed and practical rules are better placed in AMvB or ministerial regulation for legal certainty and easier amendment, and that they implement EU directive requirements.
q: To ensure that the implementation of the victims' rights directive takes place in binding rules, I will include the relevant subjects in a general administrative order or ministerial regulation.

Teneinde zeker te stellen dat de implementatie van de richtlijn inzake slachtofferrechten in verbindende voorschriften plaatsheeft zal ik de betreffende onderwerpen opnemen in een algemene maatregel van bestuur of ministeriële regeling.
d: limiting number of family members entitled to victim rights and priority among survivors
victim support institutions, individual assessment of victims, protective measures
content and provision of information to victims at first contact
rules on victim right to receive information about the case
interpreter assistance and support for victims in understanding and being understood
translation of written information and case documents for victims
rules on restorative justice and mediation between victim and suspect or convicted person
p: Information to victims may be withheld where there is an identifiable risk of harm to the suspect or convicted person, giving prosecutors discretion over notification.
Police, prosecutor, examining judge or judge may refuse a victim's chosen support person or legal representative in the interest of the investigation or the victim, with a duty to give reasons.
Oral translation or summary may replace written translation by exception, provided fair trial is not affected.
Police may replace a copy of the complaint with written confirmation when the investigation's interest requires it, deviating from the general rule.

parties: Asks whether the 16 November 2015 transposition deadline is achievable, what the consequences of late implementation are, and whether Dutch rules go beyond the directive; also asks about enforceability of victims' rights.
These members find it difficult to imagine this given the current date and the usual time needed for a legislative process.
Dit kunnen deze leden zich lastig voorstellen gelet op de huidige datum en de gebruikelijke tijd die nodig is voor een wetgevingstraject.
Asks how undocumented victims can safely use their rights through the criminal process and how the directive's non-discrimination requirement and B9 residence rules apply.

Asks about safe reporting for people without residence status, guarantees that information exchanged will not trigger immigration measures, and about compensation for parents of child sexual abuse victims.

Is the government further willing to include a guarantee that information exchanged with the police or another body regarding possible victimhood will at no time give rise to immigration law measures?

Is de regering verder bereid de garantie op te nemen dat de informatie die wordt uitgewisseld met de politie of een andere instantie, in verband met het mogelijk slachtofferschap van een misdrijf, op geen enkel moment (ook niet in de toekomst) aanleiding zal zijn voor vreemdelingenrechtelijke maatregelen?

Questions whether the directive justifies the heavy burden on police, asks which Raad van State advice points were addressed, and asks for an overview of implementation measures and a fuller impact analysis.
At the same time these members wonder what this directive concretely contributes to that and whether the considerable efforts it requires, especially from the national police, are justified.
Tegelijkertijd rijst bij deze leden de vraag wat deze richtlijn daar nu concreet aan bijdraagt en of dat de forse inspanningen die dat vergt van met name de nationale politie, rechtvaardigt.
Supports minimum norms in principle but insists on clarity about implementation, workload and financial consequences before the law is enacted.

Given the financial and implementation problems the national police currently face, these members believe insight into the additional workload and financial implications is necessary before legislation can actually be introduced.

Gezien de financiële en uitvoeringsproblematiek waar de nationale politie zich op dit moment mee geconfronteerd ziet, zijn voornoemde leden van mening dat inzicht in de bijkomende werklast en financiële implicaties noodzakelijk is, alvorens wetgeving ook daadwerkelijk kan worden ingevoerd.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised submitting the bill implementing Directive 2012/29/EU on victims' rights, but asked for supplementary explanation and amendments: implementation via OM-aanwijzingen is not sufficiently guaranteed, the child's interests and victim information rights (hearing, appeal, cassation, return of goods) need fuller implementation. The minister's nader rapport accepts most points, moving items into a general administrative order (AMvB), adding a fourth paragraph to art. 51aa, widening the appeal information right and art. 413 Sv, but disagrees on cassation hearing information and rejects the 'onverwijld' addition to art. 116 Sv.
concerns: Implementation through OM-aanwijzingen is not sufficiently binding; the obligations should be laid down in generally binding rules, which the minister accepted.

Child's interests under Art. 1(2) of the Directive should be made explicit in the explanatory memorandum and transposition table; the minister added a fourth paragraph to art. 51aa and amended the memorandum.
Information rights on hearing date and place must also apply on appeal and to victims not joined; the minister amended art. 413 Sv so all victims are informed on request.
The Afdeling wanted information on cassation hearings; the minister disagreed, arguing cassation hearings are largely non-substantive and could mislead victims.
The qualifier 'indien en voor zover de wet tot motivering verplicht' in art. 51ac(3) was unexplained and has been removed.
The Afdeling asked for 'onverwijld' return of seized goods under art. 116 Sv; the minister considered the addition unnecessary.

34300-III.s: This bill fixes the 2016 budget statutes for the Ministry of General Affairs (including agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie), the Cabinet of the King, and the Commissie van Toezicht betreffende de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten, in thousands of euros. It is a budget law with no delegation of rule-making power and no change to the institutional balance of power.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA) belonging to this law for the year 2016 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken (IIIA) voor het jaar 2016 wordt vastgesteld.

34344.s: The bill allows pension payouts under defined-contribution and capital arrangements to be variable rather than fixed, with collective and individual allocation mechanisms, new duties of care and information for pension providers, and a choice right between fixed and variable payouts. It also amends the Dutch Pensioenwet and Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling and the wage tax act to permit these variable payouts and changes related supervision and transfer rights.
34344.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to protect pensioners from new risks in the payout phase that they cannot make up by working more, and by the aim of longer investment horizons with higher expected returns.
q: That makes it necessary to give the supervisors a sturdier set of instruments to protect pensioners as well as possible against risks and possible abuse.
Dat maakt het noodzakelijk om de toezichthouders een steviger instrumentarium in handen te geven om pensioengerechtigde zo goed mogelijk te beschermen tegen risico's en mogelijk misbruik.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel D (art. 11) / Artikel 44a(2) Pensioenwet
rules on information provided about variable payouts
collective allocation mechanism and projection interest rate for variable payouts
scenario analysis rules for investment policy
Artikel III (art. 18d Wet op de loonbelasting, lid 5)
rules on application of wage tax exemption for adjustments of pensions
postponement of scenario-based information requirement to a date set by royal decree
entry into force on a date set by royal decree, possibly differing per article
p: Artikel I, onderdeel K (art. 63c) / Artikel II, onderdeel J (art. 75c)
The supervisory authority may order a pension provider running a variable payout to transfer or insure it within a term it sets, on grounds it considers necessary.
Artikel I, onderdeel F (art. 52) / Artikel II, onderdeel E (art. 63)
Pension providers must act in the interest of participants and collect risk-profile information, strengthening protection of participants and beneficiaries.

parties: Asks why the government adopted elements of the Lodders initiative bill and how variable payouts and smoothing of shocks work in practice.
Asks how the bill affects pensions under very low market interest rates and how variable payouts are determined and communicated to pensioners.
Can the government explain which problem for a participant with a premium or capital scheme this bill solves at a very low market interest rate such as the current one?
Kan de regering toelichten welk probleem voor een deelnemer met een premie- of kapitaalovereenkomst opgelost wordt met dit wetsvoorstel bij een zeer lage marktrente zoals de huidige marktrente?
Questions whether participants can make informed choices between fixed and variable payouts and warns of a new advice market and the absence of guaranteed minimum payouts.
Does the government acknowledge that this is far from within everyone's reach, despite the prudent person rule and the know-your-customer principle that pension providers must observe?
Erkent de regering dat dit lang niet voor iedereen weggelegd is, ondanks de prudent person regel en het «ken uw klant» principe dat pensioenuitvoerders moeten hebben?
Worries that the near-unlimited switching right and differing projected rates cause risk selection and erode solidarity, and raises concerns from DNB and European law on compulsory membership.
In particular the almost unlimited switching right worries them, especially when combined with the unjustified distinction between pension funds and insurers regarding the projected rate.
Met name het vrijwel onbeperkte shoprecht baart hen zorgen, zeker als daar het onterechte onderscheid tussen pensioenfondsen en verzekeraars voor de projectierente bij wordt opgeteld.
Welcomes variable payouts but asks about the relationship with the Lodders bill, default options, communication duties, and incentives for providers to use too high projected rates.
What possibilities does the government see to solve this problem?
Welke mogelijkheden ziet de regering om dit probleem op te lossen?

Supports the bill's goal but questions the dilution of the security principle in pension law and the income effects on pensioners, and asks for longer smoothing periods and equal projected-rate rules.
With offering the variable pension payout, this requirement seems in a strict sense to be abandoned.
Met het aanbieden van de variabele pensioenuitkering lijkt deze eis in strikte zin losgelaten te worden.

34425.s: The bill replaces the Wet scheepsuitrusting 2000 with a new Wet scheepsuitrusting 2016 implementing EU Directive 2014/90/EU on marine equipment. It sets requirements for production, conformity assessment, CE-style wheel marking, notified bodies, market surveillance and enforcement, including administrative fines.
34425.j: The memorandum justifies ministerial regulation by saying the detailed and administrative matter is technical and must be updated regularly, making direct delegation to the minister most suitable.
q: This makes direct delegation of the power to set (further) rules to the Minister the most suitable.
Dit maakt dat directe delegatie van de bevoegdheid tot het vaststellen van (nadere) regels aan de Minister het meest geschikt is.
d: rules on equivalence certificates for equipment
manufacturer obligations and wheel marking details
obligations of representatives, importers and distributors
content of EU declaration of conformity
supervision of notified bodies and fees
use of equipment in exceptional cases such as innovation and testing
entry into force of amended annexes and conventions by ministerial decision
p: Allows the minister by regulation to exempt equipment from the marking requirement in exceptional cases, departing from the main obligations of the statute.
Gives the minister power to impose administrative fines directly, in addition to criminal sanctions, shifting enforcement from courts to the administration.
Lets ministerial decision bring amended EU annexes and international conventions into force at a time the minister sets, without a parliamentary step.

parties: Worries the European Commission could set standards that disadvantage the European shipping sector, and asks how member states can push back.

Said members fear that the EC could use this freedom to impose requirements on international standards, which would give the European shipping sector a competitive disadvantage compared with other countries/regions.

Genoemde leden vrezen dat de EC met deze vrijheid koppen op internationale normen kan stellen, waarmee de Europese scheepvaartsector een concurrentienadeel heeft ten opzichte van andere landen/regio's.
Supports the goals of safety and less pollution, but asks what policy choices the government made where the directive left room, and whether the ILT's capacity for market supervision is sufficient.
These members would like to know on which parts there was room and which choices the government made on those parts and why.
Deze leden vernemen graag op welke onderdelen er wel ruimte was en welke keuzes de regering op die onderdelen gemaakt heeft en waarom.
Has noted the bill with interest and has no further questions.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised on the draft Wet scheepsuitrusting 2016 implementing Directive 2014/90/EU, raising points on applicability to Caribbean-registered ships, normative addressees of articles 3 and 4, incomplete market-surveillance implementation, and drafting. The minister's reply accepted some points (clarifying EU-ship definition, article 4 duty on owner, transposition table corrections) and rejected others (Caribbean exclusion kept, article 3 unchanged, market surveillance addressed by reference to existing rules).
concerns: The Council questioned whether ships registered in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom fall within the bill's scope; the minister clarified the definitions but maintained exclusion of Caribbean-registered ships.
Unclear normative addressees and purposes of articles 3 and 4 could cause confusion; article 4 was revised to name the ship owner, article 3 left unchanged.
Implementation of the directive's market-surveillance rule on equipment already on board was incomplete; the minister pointed to existing rules under the Schepenwet and did not add a new provision.
Numerous redactional and transposition-table corrections were adopted, including fixing references and delegation basis for the notified body.

34434.s: The bill amends the Woningwet and the Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht to clarify that ships used for habitation and intended for navigation are not buildings, and to exempt existing houseboats from certain building rules. It also treats existing provincial or municipal permits for houseboats as equivalent to environmental permits and allows floating buildings to be moved and returned under the same permit.
34434.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the legal uncertainty created by the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak ruling of 16 April 2014 and the need to clarify rules for houseboats.
q: Such vessels are not attached to the ground and are moreover not intended to function on site as a dwelling or other building.
Dergelijke schepen zijn niet met de grond verbonden en bovendien ook niet bedoeld om ter plaatse als woning of als ander bouwwerk te functioneren.
d: municipal rules on appearance of houseboats treated as part of welstandsnota
p: Existing provincial or municipal permits and exemptions for houseboats are deemed equivalent to environmental permits, and conditions attached to them become permit conditions, transferring them into the national framework without new individual review.

parties: Asks whether the transitional exemption covers full rebuilding and what the distinction is between new construction and major renovation, and whether specific technical requirements such as ceiling height fit houseboats.
Does this mean that full new construction at the current mooring is also exempted from these requirements?
Betekent dit dat volledige nieuwbouw op de huidige ligplaats ook is uitgezonderd van deze voorschriften?
Questions whether moving the mooring permit into the environmental permit is dropped, reducing legal certainty, and asks for an overview of statutory bases for mooring permits.
With this, the government has made a substantial change compared to the bill that was put out for consultation.
Hiermee heeft de regering een wezenlijke verandering aangebracht ten opzichte van het wetsontwerp dat in consultatie is gebracht.
Argues the bill is a missed opportunity for legal certainty and proposes a different legal basis, including placing the mooring permit under the Wabo and a clearer statutory framework.
In the view of the SP members, the present bill is a missed opportunity.
Naar de mening van de leden van de SP-fractie is er bij het voorliggende wetsvoorstel nu sprake van een gemiste kans.

Asks for clarification of the vessel category, impact assessments on owners and enforcement bodies, and warns that exempting woonschepen from Woningwet health and safety goals could lead to undesirable effects.
Now that the goals of the Woningwet no longer need to be complied with on houseboats, there is a risk that living on houseboats leads to undesirable effects.
Nu die doelen van de Woningwet niet meer nageleefd behoeven te worden op woonschepen, ontstaat het gevaar dat het wonen op woonschepen leidt tot ongewenste effecten.
Asks what the general duty of care (zorgplicht) under the Woningwet will mean for pest control and sewage discharge on houseboats, and whether minor size changes require a new permit.
Will the general duty of care have consequences for pest control on houseboats?
Zal de algemene zorgplicht een gevolg hebben voor de ongediertebestrijding op woonboten?
Asks whether an intermediate solution to an exceptional position is possible and how many such vessels exist, and what the costs would be; also asks how municipalities as enforcers view the bill.
Member Van Vliet asks whether an intermediate solution is possible for the intermediate category of vessels the Council of State refers to.
Het lid Van Vliet vraagt zich af of er geen tussenoplossing mogelijk is voor de tussencategorie schepen, waarop de Raad van State doelt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering advised that the proposed exemption for vessels not withdrawn from navigation in the Woningwet lacked clear criteria and purpose, and should be justified or removed. The government's reply adopted a reformulated exemption for vessels used for residence and intended for navigation, aligned with Binnenvaartwet terminology, and clarified it in the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The new exemption for vessels not withdrawn from navigation lacked clear criteria and its relation to the case law on residential function was unclear, risking enforceability; the government reformulated it using Binnenvaartwet terminology and clarified it in the explanatory memorandum.

The explanatory memorandum did not sufficiently state the purpose of the added paragraph or its consequences for different vessel owners and enforcement bodies, so the Afdeling advised a sound justification or deletion; the government clarified the purpose and the intermediate category of historic vessels.

34443.s: The bill amends the Wet tot veiling van bepaalde verkooppunten van motorbrandstoffen to require lessees of fuel-sales sites on national highways to supply throughput, card-litre and shop-turnover data, certified by an accountant, for the auction bid book. It adds an administrative fine of at most one year's usage fee for non-compliance, and exempts existing contracts from the new obligations.
34443.j: The memorandum justifies the general-measure delegation as a means to improve the auction's effectiveness if needed, and the fine as the appropriate sanction in a closed context with a specialised body and a defined target group.
q: This can be done in case it proves necessary to improve the effectiveness of the auction.
Dit kan worden gedaan in het geval dat dit nodig blijkt te zijn om de effectiviteit van de veiling te verbeteren.
d: further rules on data to be supplied for the bid book
p: The minister may impose administrative fines on lessees for non-compliance, capped at one year's usage fee, with publication after the decision becomes final.

parties: Asks why a separate statute was needed when the Raad van State said the change could be made without one, and whether the shop revenue data is justified given its price-raising effect.
The VVD members note that the Council of State stated in 2012 that it did not consider a regulation in a separate act necessary.
De leden van de VVD-fractie merken op dat de Raad van State in 2012 heeft aangegeven een regeling in een afzonderlijke wet niet nodig te vinden.
Asks whether the lessor could choose to pay the modest fine instead of supplying data, and what can be done to obtain missing information or exclude uncooperative lessors.
Do you consider such behaviour possible?
Asks why the bill stalled since 2012, whether the advice is outdated, and requests an overview of locations and a timetable for auctions.
The CDA members would like an overview of all sales points where auctions have taken place and where so-called existing agreements still apply.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zien graag een overzicht van alle verkooppunten waar veilingen hebben plaatsgevonden en waar die nog de zogeheten «bestaande overeenkomsten» geldend zijn.
Asks for a definition of motor fuel, whether the maximum fine is sufficient or a minimum fine is needed, whether a warning precedes fining, and how missing data is obtained after a fine.
The D66 members ask whether a fine is imposed immediately when data is not supplied, or whether there will first be a warning with a reasonable period to remedy.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of er bij het niet opleveren van de gegevens direct wordt beboet, of dat er eerst sprake zal zijn van een waarschuwing, vergezeld van een redelijke termijn tot herstel.
Asks for an evaluation clause after five years and whether leases awarded on incorrect data can be revised, ideally regulated explicitly in the bill.
Member Van Vliet asks whether an evaluation provision can be included in the act, for example after five years.
Het lid Van Vliet vraagt zich af of in de wet een evaluatiebepaling kan worden opgenomen, bijvoorbeeld na vijf jaar.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the proposed obligation to supply additional biedboek data for fuel station auctions should be placed in the Benzinewet rather than a separate act, that the sanction lacked consideration of circumstances and a delegation clause was too broad, and that the sanction should be justified by nature and seriousness of the offence. The government reply accepted integration into the Benzinewet, added a maximum fine, extended the obligation to holders of data, narrowed the delegation, and adjusted the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: Advice to regulate the obligation by amending the Benzinewet instead of a separate act was followed.
The fixed administrative fine was considered disproportionate; a maximum fine enabling account of circumstances was introduced.
The ministerial delegation to request further data was considered too broad and was narrowed to general administrative measure level.
The sanction did not cover holders of data other than the lessee, which was remedied by extending the obligation and sanction to holders.
The choice for administrative rather than criminal sanctioning was to be justified on nature and seriousness of the offence, which the memorandum now does.

34461.s: The bill extends Dutch Civil Code Book 7 chain liability for unpaid wages to workers performing road goods transport under freight or transport contracts, making employers and their counterparties jointly liable and extending subsidiary liability through the chain. It adds a non-culpability defence for such counterparties and obliges chain parties to disclose information to workers on request.
34461.j: The memorandum justifies the extension by pointing to many wage complaints, Inspectie SZW findings and union cases, and it leaves the assessment of non-culpability to the courts.
q: Ultimately it is up to the court to determine when temporary work is performed in the Netherlands.
Het is in laatste instantie aan de rechter om te bepalen wanneer er sprake is van tijdelijk arbeid verrichten in Nederland.

parties: Asks how the bill differs from the existing WAS, its effectiveness given transport chain complexity, enforcement overlap, cross-border regress and effects on cabotage and competitiveness.
The VVD members ask to what extent this bill differs from the existing Wet aanpak schijnconstructies (WAS).
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen in hoeverre dit voorstel verschilt van de bestaande Wet aanpak schijnconstructies (hierna WAS).

Supports the bill's aim but asks about the size of the problem, the Raad van State's doubts on effectiveness, the exclusion of other transport modes and the timing of further research and evaluation, and how regress works across foreign affiliates.

Strongly supports the aim but asks the government to reply to the Raad van State's view that civil chain liability adds little, to explain the Detacheringsrichtlijn interaction, the criteria for entry into force, the evaluation indicators, and the Inspectie SZW capacity and court workload.

The Raad van State is of the view that extending civil-law chain liability can at most contribute only limitedly to strengthening the legal position of workers and countering unfair competition in the transport sector.

De Raad van State is van mening dat de uitbreiding van de civielrechtelijke ketenaansprakelijkheid hooguit beperkt kan bijdragen aan het versterken van de rechtspositie van de werknemers en het tegengaan van oneerlijke concurrentie in de transportsector.

Asks about WAS practice in courts, the scope of the earlier research, the size of the problem, whether other modes should be covered, and how the liable party can identify and recover from other parties, including foreign ones.
The D66 members ask how it is determined which of the principals is held liable for the entire wage.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen hoe wordt bepaald welke van de opdrachtgevers aansprakelijk wordt gesteld voor het gehele loon?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises the bill extending chain liability for unpaid wages to road goods transport contracts, but asks for reasoning or adjustment because the chain structure makes the liability complex and reduces its effectiveness, and asks for alternatives to be considered. The government's reply accepts the complexity points by clarifying the reference to vrachtbrieven and the Wet Avv route, explains the exclusion of combined transport, and supplements the explanatory memorandum, while maintaining the chosen civil-law approach.
concerns: The Council doubts the chain liability will effectively achieve its goals given the complexity for workers and weak incentives, and asks for reasoned justification; the government adds preventive-effect arguments and supplements the memorandum.

The Council notes that identifying which chain link owes what share of wages is complex and time-consuming; the government points to the duty to provide data under art. 7:616e BW and the joint liability option.

The Council asks whether alternatives such as strengthened public enforcement or EU-level measures were considered; the government explains the Wet Avv art. 10 route and refers to the Commission's 2016 work programme.
The Council asks for justification of excluding combined transport contracts from the scheme; the government clarifies the legal definition under art. 8:40 BW and adds a passage to the memorandum.

34470.s: The bill amends the Tobacco and Tobacco Products Act to regulate nicotine-free electronic cigarettes and refills alongside tobacco and herbal smoking products, extending advertising, sponsorship, packaging, and branding restrictions to these products. It moves the detailed rules on shop presentation and advertising methods from statute to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations, and assigns supervision and enforcement to the NVWA.
34470.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated rules by the need for flexibility to set different presentation rules for specialist shops versus other outlets and for different products.
q: Through the proposed change to subsection 5(b), the detailed rules on regular presentation of tobacco and related products at points of sale are moved to the level of a general administrative order.

Door de voorgestelde wijziging van het vijfde lid, onderdeel b, wordt de invulling van de reguliere presentatie van tabaksproducten en aanverwante producten bij verkooppunten op het niveau van algemene maatregel van bestuur gebracht.
d: I.A.8 (definition speciaalzaak) and I.E.3 (art. 5 lid 5 onder b)
rules on regular presentation of tobacco and related products at points of sale
rules on advertising for tobacco and related products
sales methods and ban on sales without handover by a staff member, including via ministerial regulation on specific products
I.J (art. 9 lid 3) and I.E.5 (art. 5 lid 5 onder c, sub 3)
measures against specific products meeting statutory requirements
p: Replaces the statutory presentation rules with a delegation allowing general administrative orders to set different rules by type of outlet and product, widening executive discretion over retail presentation.

Allows ministerial regulation to set advertising rules and to ban sales methods for product categories, extending executive reach over commercial conduct, though the bill itself defines the core advertising ban.

parties: Asks on what conditions further rules on packaging will be set in lower legislation and whether an impact analysis on EU internal market effects was made.
what conditions must be met before further rules are actually set in lower legislation.
aan welke voorwaarden moet zijn voldaan om daadwerkelijk over te gaan tot het stellen van nadere regels in lagere wetgeving.
Supports the age limit and the need for awareness campaigns, but questions enforcement capacity of RIVM and NVWA and the effectiveness of the three-strikes measure.
Whether there is sufficient capacity at RIVM and NVWA needed as a result of the proposed changes.
Of er voldoende capaciteit is bij het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu en de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit die nodig is ten gevolge van de voorgestelde wijzigingen.

Welcomes stricter rules but asks what 'as much as possible' alignment means, questions delegation of advertising and presentation rules to ministerial regulation, and doubts enforcement capacity of the NVWA.
Can the government explain whether both RIVM and NVWA have sufficient capacity to enforce this?
Kan de regering toelichten of zowel het RIVM als de NVWA voldoende capaciteit hebben om hierop te handhaven?
Asks whether the NVWA was consulted on feasibility, which offences carry criminal penalties, and the basis for expecting limited extra workload for the judiciary.
These members ask whether the NVWA was consulted on the feasibility of the bill.
Genoemde leden vragen of de NVWA geconsulteerd is over de uitvoerbaarheid van het wetsvoorstel.
Supports uniform rules to protect youth health and has no further questions.
and they have no further questions about this bill.
en zij hebben verder geen vragen over dit wetsvoorstel.
Asks why ministerial-regulation powers under Article 17a do not extend to nicotine-free products and why stricter rules than the EU directive are not adopted.
why this provision is not also declared applicable to nicotine-free e-cigarettes, refill packs and cartridges and herbal smoking products.
waarom deze bepaling niet ook van toepassing wordt verklaard op EZN, navulverpakkingen zonder nicotine en patronen zonder nicotine en voor roken bestemde kruidenproducten

34524.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the Protocol to the North Atlantic Treaty on the accession of Montenegro, concluded in Brussels on 19 May 2016, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force on the first day of the third month after publication in the Staatsblad.

parties: Asks the government to outline Montenegro's defence and security reforms and whether Russia threatened economic sanctions.
Can the government briefly outline what the most important reforms have been?
Kan de regering kort schetsen wat de belangrijkste hervormingen zijn geweest?
Supports accession on NATO criteria and asks how likely Russian sanctions or retaliation are.
The PvdA members would like to know how likely the government considers it that Montenegro will actually face sanctions or other retaliatory measures from Russia.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vernemen graag hoe groot de regering de kans inschat dat Montenegro daadwerkelijk te maken krijgt met sancties of andere vergeldingsmaatregelen van Russische zijde.
Doubts the stability claim, citing strong domestic opposition, lack of a referendum, rights concerns, and the long rule of one party and leader.
Can the government address this division? Is there a risk that accession to NATO will further fuel internal division in Montenegro?
Kan de regering ingaan op deze verdeeldheid? Is er een risico dat toetreding tot de NAVO onderlinge verdeeldheid in Montenegro verder aanwakkert?
Supports accession but questions whether reforms, especially rule of law, are complete and worries about Russian reaction and Republika Srpska's defiance of central authority.
That does raise the question of whether Montenegro now 'optimally meets' the political and military obligations and commitments under the NATO treaty?
Dat roept wel de vraag op of Montenegro inmiddels «optimaal voldoet» aan de politieke en militaire verplichtingen en toezeggingen onder het NAVO-verdrag?
Supports accession but asks about NATO member objections, Serbian and domestic positions, Russian threats, corruption and intelligence-sharing risks, and the intelligence services' advice.
The D66 members ask the government to explain how NATO deals with Russia in relation to Montenegro's membership.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering om uitleg te geven over hoe de NAVO omgaat met Rusland in relatie tot het lidmaatschap van Montenegro.

34550-IIB.s: The bill sets the 2017 budget (begrotingsstaat) for the remaining high state bodies and governor cabinets, including the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman and governor cabinets of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, in thousands of euros. It fixes expenditure and receipts figures for each article and takes effect on 1 January 2017.
q: Establishment of the budget statement of the other High Councils of State and Governors' Cabinets (IIB) for the year 2017
Vaststelling van de begrotingsstaat van de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat en Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs (IIB) voor het jaar 2017

34614.s: The bill abolishes the parental contribution (ouderbijdrage) for youth care with residence, effective 1 January 2016, and removes the related provisions from the Jeugdwet, the Besluit Jeugdwet, the Civil Code and the SUWI Act. It includes transitional rules so that contributions owed for 2015 can still be set and collected under the old law.
34614.j: The memorandum justifies removing the delegation basis by noting that the implementing regulation lapses by operation of law, making the transitional regime knowable to municipalities and parents.
q: When a delegation basis is removed, the prevailing view is that the provisions implementing it lapse by operation of law.
Als een delegatiegrondslag wordt geschrapt, is de heersende leer dat de bepalingen die daaraan uitvoering geven van rechtswege vervallen.
d: parental contribution rules for youth care with residence (paragraph 8.2 removed)

v.summary: The Raad van State advised proceeding with the bill abolishing parental contributions for youth care with residence, but objected to amending the Besluit Jeugdwet within the bill and raised transitional-law concerns on the CAK's assessment window and the six-week notification deadline. The government's nader rapport disputes the delegation-status argument, explains the removal of paragraph 8.1 as declaratory, and amends the transitional provisions to meet the Afdeling's concerns.
concerns: The Afdeling advised moving the amendments to the Besluit Jeugdwet out of the bill into a separate amending order in council, which the government did not do, arguing the deletion is declaratory and only for clarity.
The Afdeling argued that deleting paragraph 8.1 by statute could create doubt about whether new rules could later be placed in that paragraph only by law, which the government rejected as unfounded.

The Afdeling noted the three-month CAK assessment period ran from notification rather than entry into force, and asked the bill be adjusted or the explanation clarified; the government shortened the period to three months after entry into force.

The six-week period for parents to report circumstances or invoke the hardship clause ran from entry into force, disadvantaging parents receiving later assessments; the government changed it to six weeks after the contribution is set.

34620-V.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by adjusting commitment and expenditure appropriations and revenues across policy and non-policy articles, following the autumn budget review. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2016 to the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V).
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2016 wijzigingen aan te brengen in: de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V)

34623.s: The bill extends the temporary ambulance care act (Twaz) by changing the definition of ambulance care to require ambulance care professionals, and authorises a ministerial regulation to set registration or diploma requirements for them. It also extends the act's validity from five to seven years, so the existing rules continue while a definitive ordering law is prepared.
34623.j: The memorandum justifies the extension by the impossibility of enacting a definitive ordering law by 2018 due to developments in acute care organisation and the national control room function, and the need to clarify the definition of ambulance care.
q: By ministerial regulation, rules are set on registration in the registers referred to in the Individual Health Care Professions Act, or on the diplomas or certificates an ambulance care professional must hold.

Bij ministeriële regeling worden regels gesteld over de inschrijving in de registers, bedoeld in de Wet op de beroepen in de individuele gezondheidszorg, dan wel de diploma's of getuigschriften, waarover een ambulancezorgprofessional dient te beschikken.
d: registration and diploma requirements for ambulance care professionals

parties: Asks the government to explain its expectation that two years suffices to reach a definitive regulation.
The VVD members ask the government to explain this expectation.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering deze verwachting toe te lichten.
Asks about the variants being studied, the Quality Framework, and the role of patients and staff in the transition, and about the Dutch and European reactions from consultation partners.
The PvdA members asked last year that the various tendering variants be worked out during the extension period.

Namens deze leden is vorig jaar in het algemeen overleg Ambulancezorg/SEH/Acute zorg/Traumazorg verzocht de verschillende varianten van aanbestedingen uit te werken in de periode dat de huidige wet wordt verlengd.

Criticises the government for postponing a definitive choice, questions whether the two-year extension is realistic, asks about Raad van State and European law review, and about the lack of sector support for the government's scenarios.
Once again the government postpones making the right choice.
Andermaal schuift de regering het maken van de juiste keuze voor zich uit.
Questions the ambition of the two-year period, asks for all scenarios to be worked out, and asks why the statutory evaluation did not take place.
The CDA members ask whether this is not too ambitious.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of dit niet al te ambitieus is.
Regrets the extension but accepts it, hopes two years suffices, and asks about guarantees for investment in ambulances and staff.
These members fear the necessary investments in ambulance care will now also be postponed by two years.
Deze leden vrezen dat de nodige investeringen in de ambulancezorg nu ook met twee jaar worden uitgesteld.

Notes a missed opportunity to give sector certainty, questions the 2020 timeline, and asks whether the proportionality review under European law required by the Raad van State has taken place, and how the IGZ enforcement of the 15-minute norm will work.
These members note that the Council of State not only made very critical remarks on the extension but also considers that further review against the European proportionality requirement is needed.

De leden van de D66-fractie constateren dat de Raad van State niet alleen zeer kritische opmerkingen heeft geplaatst bij de verlenging van deze tijdelijke wet, maar ook van mening is dat er een nadere toetsing nodig is aan het Europeesrechtelijke vereiste van proportionaliteit van de wetgeving.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill extending the temporary ambulance care act by two years be revised, because the explanatory memorandum did not realistically justify that a permanent regime would exist by 2020 nor justify the restriction on free movement of establishment and services under EU law. It also advised that the urgent procedure under the Wet raadgevend referendum be properly motivated or removed; the government's reply accepted the need to justify the extension in more detail and kept the urgent procedure but limited its use to where necessary.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum did not convincingly show that a permanent ambulance regime would be in place by 2020, so the extension length needs realistic substantiation.
The extension prolongs a restriction on free movement of establishment and services, which requires an independent substantive justification and a proportionality review under EU law.
The planned evaluation of the Twaz did not take place, and the market scan by the NZa cannot replace it.
The use of the urgent entry-into-force procedure under article 12 of the Wrr should be properly motivated or dropped, since a precautionary inclusion is not a valid ground.

34641.s: The bill creates a new criminal offence for police and special investigation officers who breach their use-of-force instructions causing bodily injury or death, and a specific criminal exemption for lawful force used in line with those instructions. It also introduces a fact-finding investigation procedure (feitenonderzoek) under the Code of Criminal Procedure, allowing investigative powers against an officer without treating him as a suspect.
