34641.j: The memorandum justifies the new fact-finding framework by the seriousness of state force, the need for thorough investigation, and the special position of officers who are obliged to use force when necessary.
q: It is of the greatest importance that, precisely because of its monopoly on force, police use of force, certainly where it results in bodily injury or death, is thoroughly investigated to determine whether the use-of-force instructions were followed.

Het is van het grootste belang dat, juist in verband met haar geweldsmonopolie, naar geweldgebruik door de politie, zeker wanneer dit lichamelijk letsel of de dood tot gevolg heeft, gedegen onderzoek wordt gedaan om te bezien of is gehandeld conform de geweldsinstructie.
d: definition of use-of-force instructions issued under the Police Act 2012 and Special Investigation Services Act
further rules on the fact-finding investigation
p: Allows the public prosecutor and the rijksrecherche to use investigative powers against an officer in a fact-finding inquiry without the officer being a suspect, subject to proportionality and subsidiarity conditions and rights of victims and relatives.
Gives the officer under a fact-finding inquiry the procedural rights of a suspect, protecting him against the new investigation powers.

parties: Asks how the new fact-finding procedure relates to the force instruction, the revised instruction timing, and how legal protection remains optimal without making the officer a suspect.
A frequently heard argument for treating the police officer as a suspect is that legal protection is best guaranteed in this way.](Note: text has been normalized)
Een tot op heden veel gehoord argument om de opsporingsambtenaar als verdachte aan te merken is dat de rechtsbescherming op deze wijze het beste is gewaarborgd.
Stresses that the state's monopoly on force must be handled very carefully and asks how acquittal and prosecution would work under the new offence.
The fact that the state's monopoly on force may be exercised by police officers also means it must be handled with great care.
Het feit dat het geweldsmonopolie van de overheid door opsporingsambtenaren mag worden uitgevoerd, betekent ook dat daar zeer zorgvuldig mee omgesprongen moet worden.
Asks whether the fact-finding investigation expands the Rijksrecherche's powers and how the NOvA's concern about apparent partiality is addressed.
Can the government further address the concerns of the Dutch Bar Association that the appearance of partiality may be created?
Kan de regering verder ingaan op de zorgen van de Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten (hierna: NVoA), dat de schijn van partijdigheid kan worden gewekt?
Supports protecting officers but asks for concrete examples, the relation to the Rijksrecherche's fact-finding practice, and whether powers like house searches are proportionate.

These members ask the government to explain the difference between the current Rijksrecherche practice when an officer used a (fire)weapon causing injury or death and the proposed fact-finding investigation.

De voornoemde leden vragen de regering in te gaan op het verschil tussen de huidige werkwijze van de Rijksrecherche ingeval een opsporingsambtenaar zijn (vuur)wapen heeft gebruikt met letsel of de dood tot gevolg en het voorgestelde feitenonderzoek.
Asks what 'legally relevant doubt' means, whether officers must be told they need not answer questions, and why the instruction's revision is not yet in consultation.

Although the officer during the fact-finding investigation has the same rights as a suspect, these members find nowhere in the explanatory memorandum that the officer is explicitly told he is not obliged to answer under Article 29 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

Ondanks dat de betreffende opspo ringsambtenaar tijdens het feitenonderzoek dezelfde rechten heeft als een verdachte in een opsporingsonderzoek, lezen deze leden nergens in de memorie van toelichting dat de betreffende opsporingsambtenaar expliciet de mededeling krijgt dat hij conform artikel 29 Wetboek van Strafvordering (hierna:

Welcomes the distinction for officers but asks how a fair review of force is guaranteed, whether overlap with ordinary prosecution is desirable, and how minor negligence is excluded from the new offence.
It is however important that there is a proper review of the use of force.
Wel is het van belang dat er sprake is van een goede toetsing van het geweldgebruik.
Asks the government to respond to objections from the OM, Rvdr and Council of State to the concentration clause, including the Military Chamber jurisdiction over the Marechaussee.
Questions whether the proposed maximum sentences are too high compared with existing negligence offences and whether investigative powers after use of force are too broad.
These members note that the maximum penalties proposed in the article are higher than the current maximum penalties.
Voornoemde leden zien dat de in het betreffende artikel voorgestelde strafmaxima hoger zijn dan de huidige strafmaxima

Worries that the new offence lowers the formal threshold for prosecuting officers, risks many article 12 Sv procedures, and questions the independence and role conflict of internal review committees and the hulpofficier.
They ask the government to dispel these concerns.
Zij vragen de regering deze zorgen weg te nemen.
Asks how the position of citizens against the state is protected, how victims are informed, how the lex certa principle is met, and whether an independent evaluation will be carried out.
Can the government identify where this bill guarantees that the position of the citizen relative to the investigating officer is not weakened?
Kan de regering benoemen waar in dit wetsvoorstel wordt geborgd dat de positie van de burger tegenover de opsporingsambtenaar niet verzwakt wordt?
Questions the necessity of the change and why the concentration clause is chosen despite objections, and whether the Ambtsinstructie rather than criminal law should set the standard for lawful force.
Does the government think the criminal-law standard for assessing use of force by investigating officers belongs in the Criminal Code?
Vindt de regering dat de strafrechtelijke norm voor de beoordeling van geweldsaanwending door opsporingsambtenaren in het Wetboek van Strafrecht thuishoort
Questions the rationale for concentrating cases in one court when the OM, Rvdr and Council of State dispute the argument and the change may hinder attendance at hearings.
What is the reason for submitting this proposal anyway?
Wat is de reden dit voorstel toch in te dienen
Supports giving police use of force a special criminal-procedural position but asks that the instruction be clear, workable and supported by training.
These members support giving the investigating officer who used force in the performance of duty a special criminal-procedure position.
Voornoemde leden onderschrijven het voorstel de opsporingsambtenaar die in de uitoefening van de taak geweld heeft gebruikt een bijzondere straf(proces)rechtelijke positie te geven.
Argues the Ambtsinstructie is vague, fails the lex certa principle, sets thresholds for firearms and tasers too low, and risks leaving unlawful police violence unpunished.
According to these members the revised Ambtsinstructie contains vague provisions and does not meet the lex certa principle.
Volgens de leden van de DENK-fractie is er sprake van vage bepalingen in de herziene Ambtsinstructie en voldoet de herziene Ambtsinstructie niet aan het lex certa-beginsel.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against the proposed statutory concentration of cases against police officers who used force in their duties at a single court, since the arguments given did not show the special judicial expertise required, unless better reasoned. The government's reply states that the need for special judicial expertise has now been given a more substantive justification and that the Afdeling's editorial remarks were adopted.
concerns: The Afdeling found that the stated arguments did not meet the criterion of special judicial expertise needed for statutory concentration, and advised dropping it unless reasoned differently; the government responded with a more substantive justification.
The Afdeling made editorial remarks on the explanatory text, which the government says it has taken to heart.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division expressed understanding for giving police officers who use force in the course of duty a special criminal-procedural position, including a fact-finding inquiry, but raised objections on the necessity and proportionality of home and lawyer/confidant search powers and on the precision of the new offence. The Minister's nader rapport accepted most advice: it removed the search of homes and confidants' premises for seizure, added proportionality criteria, extended the suspect's rights, added Article 372 Sr as a pre-trial detention ground, and clarified the culpability and lex certa points.
concerns: Powers in the fact-finding inquiry were not tied to statutory conditions; the Afdeling advised conditions such as a threshold for initiating an inquiry or limits to serious incidents, and the Minister added a proportionality and subsidiarity test in Article 511aa(3) Sv.
The necessity of searching homes and premises of confidants with seizure powers was not justified; the Minister removed the search of confidants' premises and justified the home search more fully.

Intrusive powers against the officer and third parties affect fundamental rights, and the Afdeling asked for safeguards comparable to the regular investigation, which the Minister partly adopted through the proportionality test.

The culpability element of the new offence relating to the use-of-force instruction lacks precision under the lex certa principle; the Minister promised a revised Ambtsinstructie and explanation in the explanatory memorandum rather than statutory precision.
The Afdeling questioned whether the new offence is broader than existing homicide and assault offences; the explanatory memorandum was amended to clarify the culpability link.
Review by the investigating judge of the prosecutor's requests for seizure powers was unclear; the explanatory memorandum now addresses the criteria for that review.
The officer's rights as a suspect were to include the right to request investigative acts from the investigating judge; the Minister confirmed this in the explanatory memorandum.
Article 372 Sr was not listed as a ground for pre-trial detention, creating an inconsistency with the powers available in a fact-finding inquiry; the Minister added it to Article 67(1)(b) Sv.

34730-IIB.s: The bill amends the 2017 budget statute for the other High Councils of State and the Governors' cabinets, adjusting appropriations for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman and Caribbean governors' offices. The explanatory memorandum explains the reductions in the Raad van State's administrative jurisdiction budget and the shift for the KEI digitalisation programme.
34730-IIB.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by a lower projected intake of immigration appeals and by the KEI digitalisation programme, not by any delegation of power.
q: The projected intake in the immigration appeals division has been revised downward.
De instroomraming in het Hoger Beroep Vreemdelingen is naar beneden bijgesteld.

34740.s: The bill amends the Dutch Bankruptcy Act to make bankruptcy procedures more efficient and digital, including a central insolvency register, the option of multiple supervising judges and experts, and the curator's ability to draw up creditor claim lists. It also changes creditor committee rules, verification deadlines, and related procedural provisions in other insolvency laws.
34740.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by citing efficiency gains, tailored procedures for complex bankruptcies, and reduced costs for creditors and the judiciary.
q: It benefits efficiency if the curator is given the power to draw up a list of claims for verification himself.
Zo komt het de efficiëntie ten goede indien de curator de bevoegdheid krijgt om zelf een lijst van vorderingen ter verificatie op te stellen
d: Artikel I, onderdeel K (artikel 67 lid 3 Fw)
designation of court decisions to be published in central insolvency register and content of publication
court or judge-commissioner sets rules of procedure for creditor committee
judge-commissioner may appoint expert to support supervision of bankrupt estate
judge-commissioner may adjust deadline for filing claims
p: Artikel I, onderdeel Y en Z (artikelen 119, 127)
The judge-commissioner gains discretion to decide whether and when verification meetings are held and to set and adjust claim filing deadlines.
Artikel I, onderdeel V en AN (artikelen 109, 176)
The curator may sell goods of limited value without prior approval of the judge-commissioner and may take discretionary decisions on claim lists.
Artikel I, onderdeel AF en AH (artikelen 161a, 168)
Creditors who fail to file claims in time lose enforceability of those claims after bankruptcy termination, subject to a reasonable-inability exception.

parties: Asks on what grounds the rechter-commissaris decides whether to hold a verification meeting and whether affected parties are consulted first.
On the basis of which interests does the rechter-commissaris reach such a decision?
Op basis van welke belangen komt de rechter-commissaris tot een dergelijk besluit?
Asks whether the new advisory committee on insolvency law will include only legal experts or also accountants and financial specialists.

Can the government indicate whether this committee will consist only of legal experts or will have a composition reflecting the various disciplines involved in bankruptcies, such as accountants or financial specialists?

Kan de regering aangeven of deze commissie alleen uit juridische experts zal bestaan of een samenstelling zal krijgen die recht doet aan verschillende disciplines die komen kijken bij faillissementen, zoals accountants of financieel specialisten?
Doubts that giving the curator power to add creditor claims reduces workload and asks how creditors can challenge the curator's decisions.
In what way can creditors challenge decisions of a curator?
Op welke wijze kunnen schuldeisers beslissingen van een curator aanvechten?
Regrets the removal of the hardship clause that would allow late creditor claims in exceptional circumstances and asks the government to reconsider.

Does the government share the view of these members that the hardship clause is precisely meant for the exceptional situation in which a creditor was not and could not have been aware of the filing deadline?

Deelt de regering de mening van deze leden dat de hardheidsclausule juist bedoeld is voor de uitzonderingssituatie waarin een schuldeiser niet op de hoogte is en ook niet kon zijn van de indieningstermijn?

Argues that rechter-commissarissen need financial expertise to detect sham constructions and pre-arranged bankruptcies that target employees, and asks why an independent financial expert is not provided for.
why the bill does not provide for the appointment of an independent financial expert who can support the rechter-commissaris.
waarom het wetsvoorstel niet voorziet in de benoeming van een onafhankelijke financieel deskundige die de rechter-commissaris kan ondersteunen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises proceeding with the bill modernising the bankruptcy procedure, but asks the government to justify more fully why the curator may place creditors' claims on the list himself and to use consistent terminology for registering bankruptcies in the Central Insolvency Register. The minister's nader rapport accepts the terminology point, adopts 'terstond', and explains and expands the justification for the curator's power, while keeping the broad scope.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller justification of the curator's power to place claims on the list for all bankruptcies, not only large ones, taking account of the Raad voor de rechtspraak's objections; the minister expanded the explanation of efficiency benefits and the discretionary nature of the power.

The Afdeling advised consistent terminology ('terstond' rather than 'onverwijld') in both the bill and the explanatory memorandum regarding the speed of registration in the Central Insolvency Register; the minister adopted this.

34803.s: The bill implements EU Regulation 2016/1191 on simplified overlegging of public documents in the EU. It designates the Minister of Justice and Security to appoint a central authority, allows ministerial regulation on its tasks, and adds a fee-related reference for multilingual model forms in the Wet rechten burgerlijke stand.
34803.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by pointing to the need to designate a central authority under the EU regulation and by referring to the usual practice that the signing minister makes the ministerial regulation.
q: Our Minister designates the central authority referred to in Article 15(1) of the regulation.
Onze Minister wijst de centrale autoriteit, bedoeld in artikel 15, eerste lid, van de verordening aan.
d: tasks and powers of the central authority

parties: Asks about possible costs of implementing the law, including whether special equipment or software is needed for IMI correspondence.
They have a single question about the possible costs associated with implementing the law.
Zij hebben een enkele vraag over de mogelijke kosten die zijn verbonden aan de uitvoering van de wet.

Questions whether abolishing legalisation affects the underlying recognition of documents, such as marriages of minors that are valid abroad but not in the Netherlands, and asks how the regulation avoids more administration.
They see added value in facilitating the exchange of official documents between member states.
Zij zien een meerwaarde in het vergemakkelijken van de uitwisseling van officiële documenten tussen lidstaten.
Supports reducing administrative burdens and free movement of public deeds, asking about capacity of The Hague as central authority and whether the 10-working-day target can be met.
It seems useful to these members to reduce administrative formalities and costs for citizens, which is one of the aims of the regulation.
Het lijkt deze leden nuttig administratieve formaliteiten en kosten voor burgers terug te dringen, wat een van de doelen is van de verordening.

Supports the regulation's goals and the designation of The Hague as central authority, and asks why the regulation looks at material recognition of legal facts rather than form and authenticity of documents, and whether administrative burdens for other documents can be limited.
They endorse the aim of this regulation, namely reducing administrative formalities, limiting costs for citizens of supplying translations, and facilitating free movement.

Zij onderschrijven het doel van deze verordening, te weten het terugdringen van administratieve formaliteiten, het beperken van kosten voor het aanleveren van vertalingen door burgers en het vergemakkelijken van het vrije verkeer.

34812.s: The bill amends the Dutch education acts (WEB, WEC, WVO) to create a statutory basis for regional programmes and regional administrative consultation between municipalities and schools to prevent early school leaving and to follow vulnerable young people up to age 23. It also adds consultation obligations on school boards and support plans, and makes the existing specific grant for these regional tasks part of the early-school-leaving grant.
34812.j: The memorandum justifies the regional programme and consultation by the need to give vulnerable young people a sound future and by replacing earlier convenant-based practice with a statutory basis, while stating that existing municipal powers are not changed.
q: This bill provides a statutory basis for regional administrative consultation between municipalities and education institutions and for the regional programme on early school leaving and young people in a vulnerable position.
Dit wetsvoorstel biedt een wettelijke basis voor het regionaal bestuurlijk overleg tussen gemeenten en onderwijsinstellingen en het regionaal programma vsv en jongeren in een kwetsbare positie.
d: further rules for following young people in a vulnerable position
further rules for following young people in a vulnerable position
further rules for following young people in a vulnerable position
content of effect report on regional consultation
p: Municipal mayors and aldermen are given a new duty to follow young people's participation in education and labour up to age 23, with details left to ministerial regulation and a link to ministerial powers.

parties: Asks why mbo level-2 students are exempt from the qualification duty, the post-2021 target, and how municipalities are accountable for results and whether funding depends on performance.
Do results or non-performance of tasks by municipalities affect whether the specific grant is paid in full, in part or not at all, the members ask.
Hebben resultaten of het niet uitvoeren van de taken door gemeenten effect op het wel, deels of niet verstrekken van de specifieke uitkering, zo vragen de leden.
Asks the government to justify putting existing agreements into statute, the shift of the grant from schools to municipalities, and the age-23 cut-off.
They ask the government to further explain why this is necessary.
De leden vragen de regering nader toe te lichten waarom dit nodig is.
Supports the regional approach but worries that transferring education data on the whole age group 16-23 to municipalities raises privacy concerns and needs defining the vulnerable group.

Can the government further define the group of vulnerable young people and explain why the education data of the whole group must be transferred to the municipality rather than only specific cases where needed?

Kan de regering de groep jongeren in een kwetsbare positie nader definiëren en verklaren waarom het nodig is de onderwijsgegevens van de gehele groep over te dragen naar de gemeente in plaats van specifieke gevallen waar het nodig is?
Asks for clarity on the move to a decentralisation grant, the legal basis for the age-23 extension, whether it conflicts with other legislation, and what rights youth and parents gain.
Is this extension of the age limit not in conflict with other legislation, the members ask.
Is deze uitbreiding van de leeftijdsgrens niet in strijd met andere wetgeving, zo vragen de genoemde leden.
Asks how the government will ensure schools register absenteeism properly and act on warning signals, and whether the bill reduces administrative burden.
In what way has the government examined the consequences of this bill for administrative pressure, the members ask.
Op welke manier heeft de regering onderzocht wat de gevolgen van dit wetsvoorstel zijn voor de administratieve druk, zo vragen de leden.
Asks how the bill's youth definition and municipal duties under the age-23 extension fit the Jeugdwet and whether municipalities can be obliged to follow youth who are already employed.

In the impression of these members, article I, part D of the bill now means that municipalities need only follow young people who are already working on the labour market, which would conflict with the aim of the bill.

Naar de indruk van deze leden betekent artikel I, onderdeel D, van het voorstel nu dat gemeenten enkel jongeren moeten gaan volgen die reeds werkzaam zijn op de arbeidsmarkt, hetgeen op gespannen voet zou staan de doelstelling van het voorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill on regional cooperation against early school leaving may proceed but asked for better justification of the temporary specific grant and clearer rules on the role of the state in aligning RMC and labour market regions with the health and labour domains. The government's reply accepted both points and amended the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The temporary nature of the specific grant and the conditions for converting it into a decentralisation grant were insufficiently explained in the bill and memorandum.
The fragmented regional boundaries and differing ministerial steering across the labour, care and education domains need clearer state guidance to allow integrated municipal policy.

34821.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2016/943 by creating a statutory framework (Wet bescherming bedrijfsgeheimen) defining trade secrets and unlawful acquisition, use and disclosure, and setting out civil remedies such as injunctions, recall, destruction and damages. It also amends the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure to add confidentiality rules for trade-secret litigation and amends the Civil Code to set a limitation period.
34821.j: The memorandum justifies the framework as required to implement the directive and to balance trade-secret protection against fundamental rights such as free expression and worker information rights.
q: The protection regime laid down in the directive provides for certain measures that align more with those customary in IP-rights enforcement procedures.
Het beschermingsregime zoals neergelegd in de richtlijn voorziet in bepaalde maatregelen die meer aansluiten bij de maatregelen die gebruikelijk zijn in procedures over de bescherming van IE-rechten.
p: Courts must reject claims where disclosure falls under free expression, whistleblowing, worker representation or other protected interests, limiting private trade-secret enforcement in favour of public-interest disclosures.
Court-ordered confidentiality and restricted access to documents and hearings may limit public and party access to proceedings, subject to proportionality and a right to effective remedy.

parties: Asks why the directive omits TRIPs enforcement minimum norms such as evidence gathering, which may weaken enforcement against trade secret infringement.
These members ask whether it is correct that as a result the enforcement provisions in the Civil Procedure Code that apply to IP rights do not apply to trade secrets.
Deze leden vragen of het klopt dat hierdoor de in het Wetboek van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering opgenomen handhavingsbepalingen, zoals die voor IE-rechten gelden, niet voor bedrijfsgeheimen gelden.
Asks about consequences for SMEs and startups, the relation to the data breach notification duty, and whether the new definition will complicate lawsuits.
Can the government indicate what the consequences of the bill are for these groups?
Kan de regering aangeven wat de gevolgen van het wetsvoorstel zijn voor deze groepen?
Argues the broad trade secret definition could shield harmful or illegal practices and makes it harder for whistleblowers; asks for a narrower public-interest exception and reversed burden of proof.
Can the government sharpen this definition to clarify and broaden the rights of journalists and whistleblowers?
Kan de regering deze definitie verscherpen met het oog op het duidelijk maken en verbreden van de rechten van journalisten en klokkenluiders?
Asks why journalists and whistleblowers acting in the public interest are not explicitly excluded from the infringer definition and how public interest is to be understood.
They ask the government why it did not choose definitions that explicitly exclude whistleblowers and journalists acting in the public interest from the definition of infringer.

Zij vragen de regering waarom niet is gekozen voor definities waarbij klokkenluiders en journalisten die in het algemeen belang handelen expliciet worden uitgezonderd van de definitie van inbreukmaker.
Asks why the Commission did not regulate trade secrets in line with TRIPs and whether enforcement minimum norms and evidence rules are missing.
Is it correct that a rule on evidence gathering is missing from the directive, unlike the TRIPs agreement, making enforcement and proof more difficult?
Klopt het dat een regeling over bewijsvergaring ontbreekt in de richtlijn, in tegenstelling tot de TRIPs-overeenkomst, waardoor de handhaving en bewijsvoering worden bemoeilijkt?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill implementing EU Directive 2016/943 on trade secrets may proceed, but noted that the Raad voor de rechtspraak implementation test had not been considered before the bill was submitted. The minister's reply states that the court's advice, issued 7 September 2017, does not require substantive changes and that the Afdeling's drafting remarks have been incorporated.
concerns: The implementation test by the Raad voor de rechtspraak was not yet incorporated when the bill was submitted; the government states the later advice does not lead to substantive changes.
Several drafting and technical remarks on articles 1, 4, 5, 7 and 8 and the new article 1019ib Rv were adopted in the bill and explanatory memorandum.

34830.s: The bill abolishes the municipalities of Giessenlanden and Molenwaard and establishes a new municipality of Molenlanden from the date of merger. It also reassigns related provisions on taxes, joint arrangements, utilities, electoral districts, judicial districts and safety regions to the new municipality.
34830.j: The memorandum explains the municipalities' existing neighbourhood-based policies and their intention that the new municipality keep focus on the local kernels, without justifying any delegation of power.
q: attention to the kernels, taking into account the distinctiveness and wishes of these kernels, must be a central pillar in the policy of the new municipality
aandacht voor de kernen, rekening houdend met de eigenheid en de wensen van deze kernen, een centrale pijler moet zijn in het beleid van de nieuwe gemeente
d: date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: No concerns; the fractie finds the bill unproblematic and raises no questions.
The bill gives the VVD fractie no reason to make remarks or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
Asks why the merger was chosen so soon after the 2013 merger and why Arkel and Schelluinen were not moved to Gorinchem via boundary correction.
Can the government explain the sentence: 'The presence of Arkel makes the new municipality more diverse and therefore stronger'?
Kan de regering een toelichting geven op de zin: «De aanwezigheid van Arkel maakt de nieuwe gemeente diverser en daardoor sterker.»?
Asks how the Arkel enquiry result, which favoured Gorinchem, was weighed and what the province's role was.
Is the government aware of the survey held in Arkel and its results?
Is de regering bekend met de gehouden enquête in Arkel en de resultaten daarvan?
Asks for involvement of residents and organisations in the process and how accessibility of services is guaranteed in the larger municipality.
These members ask the government to explain again how residents, civil society organisations and local politics were involved in the proposal for municipal merger.

Deze leden vragen de regering om nog eens nader uiteen te zetten hoe de inwoners, maatschappelijke organisaties en de lokale politiek van de betreffende gemeenten betrokken is geweest bij de totstandkoming van het voorstel tot gemeentelijke herindeling.
Questions whether there is majority resident support and why no referendum was held; warns merger may be forced by decentralisation pressures.
According to these members, mergers should only take place from the bottom up, if the population supports them.
Herindelingen zouden volgens deze leden alleen plaats moeten vinden van onderop, als hiervoor steun is van de bevolking.
Asks how the government weighs the Arkel enquiry favouring Gorinchem and whether the bill should be amended.
Besides the formally submitted views, does the government also consider the survey held among Arkel residents important?
Acht de regering, naast de formeel ingediende zienswijzen, ook de enquête die gehouden is onder de bewoners van Arkel van belang?
Asks for explanation of public support in Arkel and Schelluinen and of Gorinchem's position, citing the Raad van State and the Schutte commission.
The ChristenUnie members ask the government to elaborate on public support among residents of Arkel and Schelluinen.
De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie verzoeken de regering nader in te gaan op het maatschappelijk draagvlak onder de inwoners van de kernen Arkel en Schelluinen.
Stresses voluntary, bottom-up merger with broad support but questions the desirability of re-merging so soon and whether the reasons are concrete or general.
For the SGP members, an important starting point is that merger takes place bottom-up, voluntarily and with sufficient support.
Voor de leden van de SGP-fractie is het een belangrijk uitgangspunt dat herindeling van onderop plaatsvindt en dat het vrijwillig en met voldoende draagvlak plaatsvindt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised sending the bill merging Giessenlanden and Molenwaard to the Tweede Kamer, but asked for a substantiated justification of the 'balanced regional relations' criterion, particularly regarding the position of Gorinchem. The minister's nader rapport responded by adding a discussion of Gorinchem's position in the explanatory memorandum and renaming the new municipality Molenlanden.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a substantiated justification that the merger contributes to balanced regional relations, given the omission of Gorinchem's position and the commissie-Schutte's rejection of a three-municipality outcome.

34902.s: This bill amends the 2018 budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations by an incidental supplementary budget, raising the Woonomgeving en bouw article by 95,000 thousand euro. It sets the amendment's effective date to 1 March 2018 and contains no delegation of rule-making power.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2018

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) alle voor het jaar 2018

34911.s: The bill introduces a basis in the Higher Education and Research Act (WHW) for a reduced statutory tuition fee for certain groups of students, such as teacher-training students, to be set by general administrative order. It also adds a transitional provision in the Student Finance Act 2000 allowing higher tuition loans during the transition.
34911.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to an general administrative order by the need for detailed, changeable rules and by the risk of misuse requiring specific conditions.
q: The general administrative order will provide that students following a teacher-training programme receive a halving of the statutory tuition fee for a maximum of two years in total.
In de amvb zal worden geregeld dat studenten die een lerarenopleiding volgen in totaal maximaal twee jaar een halvering van het wettelijk collegegeld ontvangen.
d: height of reduced statutory tuition fee and groups of students
determining groups of students liable for reduced tuition fee
reduced tuition fee for students in certain situations
when payment of the tuition difference does not apply
transitional higher loan amount fixed by royal decree timing
p: The statutory tuition fee categories and eligibility are shifted from the law to a general administrative order, which can distinguish by programme, year, and intake cohort.
A temporary provision allows loans above the amount actually paid, with timing set by royal decree, departing from the normal loan rules.

parties: Asks whether a prior-consultation (voorhang) procedure applies to the general administrative order that sets which groups get the reduced fee, and questions the cost-benefit basis of the choices.
Can the government carry out a cost-benefit analysis of the choice to extend the scheme to career changers entering teacher training, they ask.
Kan de regering een kosten-batenanalyse maken van de keuze om de regeling uit te breiden naar zij-instromers van lerarenopleidingen, zo vragen zij.
Supports the reduction to limit student debt and help address the teacher shortage, while asking practical questions about Open University and flexible students.
These members support this proposal, which will help reduce students' study debts.](Note: evidence paraphrase)
Deze leden steunen dit voorstel dat ervoor zal zorgen dat studieschulden van studenten zal worden teruggedrongen.

Asks whether the reduction will be applied through voucher financing if the experiment succeeds, and asks for justification of the restriction on double teacher-training students and the monitoring of effectiveness.
To what extent have alternatives based on more trust been considered, such as rules requiring repayment of the discount afterwards if the teacher training is not completed?

In hoeverre zijn ook alternatieve mogelijkheden die uitgaan van meer vertrouwen, zoals bijvoorbeeld regels over het achteraf terugbetalen van de korting indien blijkt dat de lerarenopleiding niet is afgemaakt, overwogen?
Asks about the combined financial effect of the fee cut and the planned interest rate increase on lower-income students, and about alternatives such as cutting fees across all years.

Is it correct that, in this context, after their studies students on average end up paying extra because of the planned interest rate rise on the student loan, exceeding the 1,030 euro they save under this bill?

Klopt het in dit kader dat studenten na hun studie de 1.030 euro 1 die ze met het onderhavige wetsvoorstel uitsparen juist na hun studie gemiddeld extra kwijt zijn door de voorgenomen verhoging van de rente op de studielening?
Critical of the bill's effectiveness and the lack of justification; asks why the government does not compensate students who started in 2015–2017 and questions the cost estimates.
Although the members do see tuition fees as a financial barrier to study, they ask, together with the Council of State's advisory division, whether better measures are not available.
Hoewel de leden collegegeld zeker als een financiële drempel zien om te gaan studeren, vragen zij zich met de Afdeling af of er geen betere maatregelen zijn.
Notes the government's inconsistent reasoning about access and instroom effects, shared with the Council of State, and calls the measure largely a political rather than substantive choice.
The members therefore establish that the proposed measure is primarily a political choice rather than a well-founded, substantive one.
De leden stellen derhalve vast dat de voorgestelde maatregel vooral een politieke keuze is en niet zozeer een goed onderbouwde, inhoudelijke keuze is.

Argues the bill is poorly targeted (benefiting children of millionaires) and that the absence of a substantive criterion in the general administrative order threatens equal treatment and invites politically driven exceptions.
The core of the criticism is that a substantive criterion for deviating from the main rule on statutory tuition fees is lacking.
Kern van de kritiek is dat een inhoudelijk criterium voor afwijking van de hoofdregel van het wettelijk collegegeld ontbreekt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against sending the bill on lower statutory tuition fees to parliament until its objections are addressed, mainly that the problem for the generic halving is unclear, effectiveness and efficiency are weakly justified, delegation grounds lack criteria, and the chosen implementation raises practical problems. The minister's reply largely defends the generic and teacher-training measures, accepts adding justification in the explanatory memorandum and a legal framework for the amvb, and keeps the implementation variant with its date.
concerns: The Afdeling found the problem addressed by the generic halving of tuition fees for all first-years unclear and its effectiveness and efficiency insufficiently demonstrated; the government defended it as a qualitative accessibility measure and added argumentation on teacher shortages and monitoring.

The Afdeling advised that the delegation grounds in articles 7.45 and 7.45a(5) be given concrete criteria or a statutory bandwidth; the government refused to add statutory criteria but supplemented the explanatory memorandum on relevant factors.

The Afdeling raised implementation problems with the chosen variant and the 2018 start date, such as credit loans exceeding the reduced fee, mid-year entrants and expected appeals, and asked for alternatives or a later date; the government kept variant 1 for 2018 but set out mitigation measures.
The Afdeling asked for adjustments to the explanatory memorandum, which the government incorporated, including the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens advice.

35028.s: The bill introduces a new Dutch withholding tax (bronbelasting) of 23.9% on dividends and similar profit distributions paid to entities resident in low-tax jurisdictions or in abusive structures, replacing the dividend withholding tax regime. It also makes related changes to corporate income tax, income tax, the General Tax Act, collection rules, and transitional and entry-into-force provisions.
35028.j: The memorandum justifies ministerial designation of low-tax jurisdictions by the need for a published, uniform list for practical application and legal certainty, and the inspector's discretion by the need to respond to varying situations within general principles of good administration.
q: For practical implementation and legal certainty, an exhaustive list of states designated under these criteria will be published annually by ministerial regulation before the tax period.

Ten behoeve van de uitvoeringspraktijk en rechtszekerheid zal jaarlijks, voorafgaand aan het heffingstijdvak, bij ministeriële regeling een uitputtende lijst worden gepubliceerd met op grond van deze criteria aangewezen staten.
d: rules on genuine business reasons reflecting economic reality
rules on withholding obligations and related matters
further rules for fiscal unity tax collection and assurance
p: The inspector may choose whether to assess the withholding tax shortfall against the Dutch withholding agent or the non-resident taxpayer, and the taxpayer may face assessment without proof of the agent's failure.
The inspector may issue information decisions compelling disclosure from foreign entities, with appeal available against such decisions.
Duty to provide information and administrative fines for failing to do so, imposed by the inspector.
Transitional three-year delay before newly designated treaty states are treated as low-tax jurisdictions, giving the executive time to renegotiate treaties.

parties: Welcomes lower corporate tax burdens and asks how much the bill reduces business taxes and how administrative relief will be delivered.
They stress the importance of low burdens on business to attract and retain jobs and to prepare the Dutch economy for the future.
Ze benadrukken het belang van lage lasten voor het bedrijfsleven om banen aan te trekken en te behouden en de Nederlandse economie klaar te maken voor de toekomst.
Questions the government's handling of the dividend tax bill, the reversal after a single lobbying message, and whether the bill was rushed, asking for fuller answers and more parliamentary time.
The government still chooses multinationals over people, and the SP members regret this.
Nog altijd kiest de regering voor multinationals boven mensen en dat betreuren de leden van de SP-fractie.

Welcomes abandoning the dividend tax abolition and anti-avoidance steps but doubts the effectiveness of some measures and questions why a large sum goes to business tax relief while the public sector is under pressure.
Otherwise, this bill is mainly a tax cut for business.
Voor het overige geldt dat dit wetsvoorstel vooral een belastingverlaging is voor het bedrijfsleven.
Asks extensively about the legal durability of the dividend tax under the Fidelity Funds case and the pending Deka case, about the tax race to the bottom, and about anti-avoidance gaps.
Nevertheless, the GroenLinks members are very critical of the new proposal.
Desalniettemin zijn de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie zeer kritisch op het nieuwe voorstel.
Views the new package as a smarter way to keep Nederland attractive and asks for overviews of burdens and of beneficiaries.
The new package, which keeps the dividend tax, contributes in a smarter way to the goal that the Netherlands is and remains attractive for work and enterprise.
Het nieuwe pakket, waarmee de dividendbelasting gehandhaafd blijft, draagt op een slimmere manier bij aan het doel dat Nederland een aantrekkelijk land is en blijft om te werken en ondernemen.
Supports measures to strengthen competitiveness and curb profit flows, and welcomes the substantial corporate tax cut.

These members consider it very important that the government takes measures to strengthen the competitive position of Dutch SMEs and large companies while countering the flow of profits through the Netherlands.

Deze leden achten het van groot belang dat de regering maatregelen treft om de concurrentiepositie van het Nederlandse midden- en kleinbedrijf (mkb) en grootbedrijf te versterken en tegelijkertijd het doorstromen van winsten door Nederland tegengaat.
Asks how the corporate tax reduction, lower employer costs and higher WBSO benefit firms of different sizes.
How do these mentioned benefits work out for Dutch business?
Hoe pakken genoemde voordelen uit voor het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven?
Wants Nederland to remain attractive while stressing international cooperation against avoidance and asks why the bill title changed and which measures are still missing.
Many Dutch people have a direct or indirect interest in international enterprises in the Netherlands.
Vele Nederlanders hebben direct of indirect belang bij internationale ondernemingen in Nederland.

Objects that the Council of State criticised the package's size, that the corporate tax cut is hidden in a bronbelasting bill, and asks about the legislative approach and the EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions.
Is it correct that the Council of State indicated that the size of the package 'does not do justice to a careful treatment of the bills'?
Klopt het dat de Raad van State heeft aangegeven dat de omvang van het pakket «geen recht doet aan een zorgvuldige behandeling van de wetsvoorstellen»?
Questions the structural budgetary effects of keeping the dividend tax, the impact on the EMU balance and the state debt, and warns of a race to the bottom in corporate taxes.
The PvdD members have the impression that if dividend tax revenues disappoint, this will lead to a higher national debt, and ask the government whether this impression is correct.

De leden van de PvdD-fractie hebben de indruk dat indien de opbrengsten van de dividendbelasting tegenvallen, dit tot een vergroting van de staatsschuld zal leiden en vragen de regering of deze indruk correct is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the government's amendment lowering the Vpb corporate tax rates breaks the link with the box 2 rate without explaining why or the effect on the global balance, and recommended either adjusting box 2 or motivating the change in the explanatory note. The Staatssecretaris replied that the explanatory note was supplemented on this point and that editorial comments were followed.
concerns: The Afdeling asked to align the box 2 rate with the Vpb cut or to explain in the explanatory note why the link is dropped and what the effect on the global tax-burden balance is; the government supplemented the explanatory note but did not change the box 2 rate.
The Afdeling made editorial comments in an annex, which the government adopted.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, in its opinion of 10 September 2018, that the draft Wet bronbelasting 2020 (abolition of dividend tax with a conditional withholding tax) be sent to parliament, but asked for a fuller explanation of the prior history and effectiveness of abolishing dividend tax and of the consequences of uncoordinated national tax policy. The government's nader rapport of 14 September 2018 added a historical passage to the explanatory memorandum, expanded on effectiveness and the international dimension, and referred to EU-level discussions, while maintaining its choice for the measure.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a more complete picture of the effectiveness of abolishing dividend tax given the large revenue loss; the government expanded the explanation of indirect effects but did not quantify them, citing the lack of empirical evidence.

The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to cover the prior history of the abolition debate and the 2003 and 2010 critiques of dividend tax; the government added a passage on the history and the budgetary and source-principle rationale.

The Afdeling asked for attention to the consequences of uncoordinated national policy for the dividend tax base internationally; the government referred to OECD and EU cooperation and the EU Code of Conduct discussions and to the withholding tax safeguards for low-tax jurisdictions.

35037.s: The bill amends the Instellingswet WRR so that the chair of the Scientific Council for Government Policy may be reappointed, changing the term 'wederbenoembaar' to 'opnieuw benoembaar' and adding a paragraph allowing twice immediate reappointment for a chair who fills a vacancy occurring within a year before the predecessor would have stepped down. It enters into force on a date set by royal decree.
35037.j: The memorandum gives no justification for delegation; it only describes the existing appointment procedure of article 3 of the Instellingswet WRR.
q: Article 3 of the Instellingswet WRR contains a regulation on the procedure for appointing the chair and members of the Scientific Council for Government Policy.
Artikel 3 van de Instellingswet W.R.R. bevat een regeling voor de procedure tot benoeming van de voorzitter en leden van de Wetenschappelijke Raad voor het Regeringsbeleid.
d: setting the date the act enters into force

parties: D66 understands the rationale for the amendment but asks why the term count is not restarted with each new chair appointment.

35046.s: The bill amends the Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming to add EU Regulation 2018/302 on unjustified geoblocking to the enforcement framework and designates the Europees Consumenten Centrum (part of Stichting Het Juridisch Loket) as the body providing practical assistance to consumers. It enters into force on 3 December 2018 or the day after publication of the Staatsblad if later.
q: The European Consumer Centre, part of the Stichting Het Juridisch Loket, is designated as the body for providing practical assistance to consumers.
Het Europees Consumenten Centrum, onderdeel van de Stichting Het Juridisch Loket, wordt aangewezen als instantie voor het verlenen van praktische bijstand aan consumenten

parties: The VVD welcomes the bill and asks no questions or substantive remarks.
The proposal gives these members no reason to ask questions or make substantive remarks.
Het voorstel geeft deze leden geen aanleiding tot het stellen van vragen of het maken van inhoudelijke opmerkingen.
The CDA asks where the ACM experiences the enforcement complexity and what consequences its broader task load has, given the government says there is no room for national rules.
Can the government indicate exactly where the ACM experiences the complexity and whether other options exist to make enforcement more workable?
Kan de regering aangeven waar de ACM de complexiteit precies ervaart en of eventueel nog andere mogelijkheden zijn de handhaving meer werkbaar te maken?
The D66 asks whether the government knew the ACM's view during negotiations, what it did to limit complexity, and what the implementation costs are for the ACM and how they are funded.
These members ask whether the government was aware of the ACM's position and view during the negotiations on this regulation.
Deze leden vragen of de regering tijdens het onderhandelingsproces over deze verordening op de hoogte was van het standpunt en de mening van de ACM.

35064.s: The bill amends the 2018 budget statement of the Kingdom Relations ministry (fourth supplementary budget), adding about 15.3 million euros in expenditure for emergency relief and reconstruction on the Windward Islands and 150 million euros in expenditure and obligations for the Windward Islands, with other lines shifted. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 31 October of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad publication falls later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV), all for the year 2018
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV), alle voor het jaar 2018

35073.s: The bill amends numerous Dutch statutes (Gemeentewet, Provinciewet, Wet op de Raad van State, Nationale ombudsman, Algemene Rekenkamer, Kaderwet zbo's, etc.) to implement the Wet normalisering rechtspositie ambtenaren, shifting public servants from public-law appointment to private-law employment contracts. It converts appointment powers into powers to conclude, amend and terminate employment contracts, while retaining parliamentary and royal involvement where needed.
35073.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical alignment needed so that existing powers and internal allocation of authority are preserved when the Wnra takes effect.
d: council/college appoints secretary and griffier by employment decision
royal decision on employment contracts for secretariat staff, exemptions by royal decree
AMvB may specify matters where terms of employment may deviate from collective agreement
p: Appointment of local and provincial staff shifts from college or Rijk to employment-contract powers held by the council or provincial states, with the mayor or commissioner executing decisions.
Ombudsman staff appointment shifts to royal decision on proposal of the ombudsman, with exemptions set by royal decree.

parties: Asks about project status, transition pay for civil servants, overlap of two employment regimes within one organisation, and the Gemeentewet changes for the council's griffie.
First, the members of the VVD faction ask about the progress of the present project.
Allereerst vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie naar de voortgang van het onderhavige project.
Asks about the timing feasibility for safety regions, the position of volunteer firefighters, and how all parties are informed of the reform.
These members are of the opinion that passive information provision is insufficient for an operation such as the introduction of the Wnra to go well.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat passieve informatievoorziening onvoldoende is om een operatie als de invoering van de Wrna goed te laten verlopen.

Questions the consistency of the bill's technical approach, the Crown decision mechanism for private-law employment, the Minister of Finance's role over the Algemene Rekenkamer, and whether Staten-Generaal can unilaterally set terms for their staff, arguing this limits collective bargaining freedom and independence of bodies.
Why is it necessary to refer here to the entire group of officials to whom article 3 applies, rather than only to military officials, conscripts and police officials?
Waarom is het nodig om hier naar de gehele groep van functionarissen op wie artikel 3 van toepassing is te verwijzen

35109.s: The bill transfers responsibility for the cadastral and public registry functions on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba from the local public bodies to the national Dienst voor het kadaster en de openbare registers, integrating the BES-era registry rules and the Kadasterwet. It sets out the Kadasters' tasks, staffing, registration requirements and consultation duties toward the island authorities, while delegating many detailed registration rules to the Dienst's board and ministerial regulations.
35109.j: The memorandum justifies centralising responsibility in the Dienst by the need for uniform, practical administration and integration with the existing Kadasterwet framework, while keeping practice close to island needs.
q: The main aim is to integrate these three laws and to assign the tasks and powers regarding the public registers and the cadastre to the Dienst.
Het voornaamste doel is het integreren van deze drie wetten en de taken en bevoegdheden met betrekking tot de openbare registers en het kadaster te beleggen bij de Dienst.
d: additional tasks and market activities for the Kadasters
procedure for consulting the island public bodies
rules on keeping the public registers
form of certified copies and requirements for drawings
requirements for documents for other registrable facts
requirements for general terms and model regulations in registers
p: Responsibility for the island cadastral offices moves from the local public bodies' boards to the national Dienst board, which decides office locations and opening hours, with only consultation rights for the islands.
Island boards are only consulted annually and on policy changes, with the Dienst board remaining free to decide after considering their views.

parties: Asks how the Dienst will manage a separate register for the BES islands, whether tariff increases on one island apply to the others, and what the cost increases mean for residents.
Does this mean the Dienst will manage a separate register for the BES islands?
Betekent dit dat de Dienst straks een apart register voor de BES-eilanden beheert?

Asks the government to explain the basis of its 2011 finding, the seven-year delay, the planning per island, and why tariffs are passed on by public bodies rather than the Kadaster itself, raising administrative burden concerns.
Can the government indicate on what basis this finding was made in 2011?
Kan de regering aangeven op basis waarvan deze constatering in 2011 is gedaan?

35154.s: The bill approves the 2016 Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) between Canada and the EU and its member states for the European part of the Netherlands, as required under Article 91(1) of the Constitution. The explanatory memorandum describes the agreement's trade, investment-court, regulatory cooperation and joint committee arrangements, and notes that the agreement contains no provisions binding individuals directly.
35154.j: The memorandum justifies the Joint Committee's amendment power by arguing that such annexes are of an executive nature relative to the treaty text and that decisions require consensus and prior internal procedures.
q: Deviating from this, Article 30.2(2) provides that the CETA Joint Committee may decide to amend the protocols and a number of annexes to the agreement.
In afwijking daarvan bepaalt artikel 30.2, lid 2, dat het CETA Gemengd Comité kan besluiten om de protocollen en een aantal bijlagen bij het akkoord te wijzigen.
d: Joint Committee decisions amending protocols and annexes of CETA
p: The CETA Joint Committee may amend certain protocols and annexes without a new parliamentary approval, although the memorandum states that decisions require consensus and internal procedures first.

parties: Asks the government for quantified economic data, clarification of trade-facilitation and enforcement, and whether Canadian food labelling (Crispr-Cas) can be checked.
Can the government explain how these talks have developed since the provisional entry into force of this agreement and whether there has been reason to take steps in this direction?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe deze gesprekken zich sinds de voorlopige inwerkingtreding van dit verdrag hebben ontwikkeld en of er aanleiding is geweest om stappen in deze richting te zetten?
Regrets that the CETA approval law can no longer be subject to a referendum, objects to provisional application, and fears regulatory cooperation and the ratchet clause restrict national lawmaking.

Is it true that because of the ratchet clause economies may only further liberalise when making adjustments? On what basis does the government consider this an acceptable limitation of its freedom to draft laws and regulations?

Klopt het dat door de ratchet clausule economieën bij eventuele aanpassingen alleen verder mogen liberaliseren? Op grond waarvan vindt de regering dit een acceptabele inperking van haar vrijheid om wet- en regelgeving op te stellen?
Supports the agreement in general and asks about trade effects, SME benefits and dispute settlement since provisional entry into force.
The members of the CDA faction have taken note with approval of the bill before us.](Note: evidence_en should read: The CDA members have noted the present bill with approval.)
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Views CETA as a modern agreement protecting shared values, and asks how sustainability chapters are enforced and how the dispute mechanism works.
Can the government exhaustively describe the process for settling disputes and the steps this may involve, including the specific consultation procedure?
Kan de regering het proces dat bij de beslechting van geschillen en de stappen die dit kan behelzen, inclusief de specifieke procedure voor consultaties, uitputtend beschrijven?

Opposes CETA for raising CO2 emissions, lacking binding animal, environmental and labour standards, and giving investors a dispute route closed to ordinary citizens; asks for secret outcomes to be made public.
Moreover, the treaty contains a form of investment dispute settlement that is only open to investors and not to ordinary citizens.
Bovendien bevat het verdrag een vorm van investeringsgeschillenbeslechting die slechts open staat voor investeerders en niet voor gewone burgers.
Rejects CETA as neoliberal, argues the investment court system lets multinationals challenge democratic decisions, and questions the economic models and food safety standards.
The SP members argue that the ICS is essentially the same as ISDS: a means for big business to challenge democratic decisions or claim high compensation.
De leden van de SP-fractie betogen dat ICS in essentie hetzelfde is als ISDS; een mogelijkheid voor het grootbedrijf om democratische besluiten aan te vechten of hoge compensaties te eisen.

Wants the investment court to also protect civil society and trade unions, asks who counts as an interested party in amicus procedures, and asks about a plan B if the European Court rules against the ICS.
Why do not all parties that regard themselves as having an interest have access to this procedure?
Waarom hebben niet alle partijen die zichzelf als belang hebbenden beschouwen toegang tot deze procedure?
Welcomes trade with Canada but doubts the growth models, fears harmonisation could lower standards, and argues disputes should go to national and European courts rather than the ICS.
According to the ChristenUnie members, the ICS is also superfluous because the Netherlands and the European Union have a good legal system.
Het ICS is volgens de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie ook overbodig omdat Nederland en de Europese Unie een goed rechtssysteem kennen.

Strongly opposes trade agreements that weaken animal welfare, climate and environmental standards, argues the supranational court undermines national justice, and questions the procedure for ratification rejection and Brexit effects.
The supranational dispute settlement included in CETA undermines the national legal order.
De bovenstatelijke geschillenbeslechting die in CETA is opgenomen, ondergraaft de nationale rechtsorde.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the bill approving CETA (EU-Canada trade and investment agreement), recommending clarification of the joint interpretative instrument, the scope of the agreement regarding the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, and the investment court system's compatibility with EU law. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely adopted the advice on the interpretative instrument and added a passage on the Kingdom's position, but rejected the view that the agreement affects Aruba, Curaçao, Sint Maarten and the BES islands, so the bill proceeds as a regular law for the European part only.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for the explanatory memorandum to clarify the legal status of the joint interpretative instrument and Article 30.1 of CETA, which the government did in the revised text.

The Afdeling argued CETA may affect the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom and should be approved by Rijkswet; the government rejected this, arguing those parts are overseas territories outside EU law scope and cannot accede.
Pending CJEU advice on the compatibility of the investment court system with EU law, the government expects no conflict, which the Afdeling noted but did not resolve in the reply.

35190.s: The bill amends the Dutch Environmental Management Act (Wet milieubeheer) to implement EU Directive 2018/410 on the EU emissions trading system, mainly by replacing the 'inrichting' concept with 'broeikasgasinstallatie', updating references to EU regulations, and adjusting free allocation, permit and enforcement rules. It also enables further rules by general administrative order (AMvB) and ministerial regulation, changes appeal exclusions in the Awb annex, and makes some breaches of EU free-allocation rules criminal offences.
35190.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and changes as necessary to implement the EU directive and its implementing regulations, which are still under negotiation.
q: Notwithstanding Article 3:18 of the General Administrative Law Act, the national allocation decision is adopted no later than 9 months after the date by which the application must be submitted.
In afwijking van artikel 3:18 van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht wordt het nationale toewijzingsbesluit uiterlijk 9 maanden na de dag waarop de aanvraag uiterlijk moet worden ingediend vastgesteld.
d: I, P/Q (Art. 16.24 Wm, new lid 4 and Art. 16.13a, 16.36, 16.34b)
content and adoption of national allocation decision, free allocation changes, permit rules
rules implementing the free allocation modification and emissions allowance provisions
p: Free allocation percentages and allocation rules are set by fixed statutory formulas tied to EU rules, with limited executive discretion.
I, Y (Art. 16.30 lid 3) and I, FF (deletion of Art. 16.35a and 16.35b)
The national allocation decision is adopted within a fixed nine-month period departing from the general Awb time limit, and some procedural protections are removed.
I, Q (Art. 16.19), I, S (Art. 16.20a), and Art. 16.17 change via I, P
The obligation to give the operator a chance to present a view before an ex officio determination based on operator-supplied data is removed.
Individual free-allocation decisions for a single installation are excluded from administrative appeal, narrowing judicial review for affected operators.
Breaches of specified EU free-allocation rules are made criminally enforceable under the Wet economische delicten.

parties: Asks whether the Wm amendment allows interim evaluation of the reduction percentage and whether the use of allocated funds for the electricity sector is monitored for lawful purpose.
Can the government indicate to what extent an amendment of the Environmental Management Act (Wm) allows for an interim evaluation of the reduction percentage?
Kan de regering aangeven in hoeverre een wijziging van de Wet Milieubeheer (Wm) ruimte biedt om tussentijds het reductiepercentage te evalueren?
Asks how the Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit will monitor and check production data from covered companies and whether the second HUF test will be shared with parliament.
Is the government willing to share the second HUF test with the House?
Is de regering bereid om de tweede HUF-toets te delen met de Kamer?
Asks which national implementation choices were made and whether the option to cancel allowances when a power plant closes is included in the bill.
Is it correct that this option is not implemented in the bill?
Klopt het dat in het wetsvoorstel deze mogelijkheid niet wordt geïmplementeerd?
Argues EU targets are too low, criticises the ETS as allowing pollution, and objects to CCS funding through the innovation fund.
These members want the EU to curb greenhouse gas emissions and work towards a truly CO2-neutral economy.
Deze leden willen dat de EU de uitstoot van broeikasgassen aan banden legt en toewerkt naar een werkelijk CO 2 -neutrale economie.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the bill implementing Directive (EU) 2018/410 on the EU ETS should be submitted, but asked for clarification on enforceability and feasibility (including delegation grounds for allocation rules) and for narrowing the transitional provision to the ETS provisions listed in Article 4 of the Directive. The minister's reply states that the bill and explanatory memorandum were amended: the NEa HUF-test was addressed, the delegated and implementing acts now adopted were reflected in chapters 1 and 18 of the Wm, and the transitional provision was adjusted.
concerns: The NEa's enforceability and feasibility concerns about the expected effects of revised free-allocation rules were to be addressed in the explanatory memorandum and the bill, and the bill was amended once the European implementing acts were adopted.

The NEa asked whether additional delegation grounds in the law were needed now; the reply refers to the adopted European acts but does not explicitly explain why no further delegation grounds were added.
The transitional provision referred to an incorrect date and was broader than the Article 4 provisions of the Directive; the provision was narrowed and amended accordingly.

35200-III.s: This is a budget-closing law (Slotwet) for 2018 that amends the expenditure and revenue statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Royal Household Cabinet, the Oversight Committee on Intelligence and Security Services (CTIVD), and the Dienst Publiek en Communicatie agency to reflect actual realisations. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Amendment of the budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Royal Household Cabinet and the Oversight Committee on Intelligence and Security Services, and of the agency budget statement of this ministry, all for the year 2018.

Wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken, het Kabinet van de Koning en de Commissie van Toezicht op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (III), van de begrotingsstaat inzake het agentschap van dit ministerie, alle voor het jaar 2018.

35208.s: The bill temporarily raises the levy on transfers of phosphate rights from 10% to 20% to reduce the total number of phosphate rights, and sets a royal decree date for reverting to 10%. It also keeps the old rule for transfers already notified before entry into force.
35208.j: The memorandum justifies the higher levy by the need to reduce phosphate rights and the proportionality of this measure compared with a generic cut, and notes an exemption power under article 38 for individual hardship.
q: Given the purpose of the measure and the serious objections to a generic cut, the cabinet considers that the proposed increase in the levy meets the proportionality requirement.

Gezien het doel van de maatregel en de grote bezwaren die kleven aan een generieke korting, is het kabinet van oordeel dat de voorgestelde verhoging van de afroming voldoet aan het evenredigheidsvereiste.
d: date on which the levy reverts to 90 percent (royal decree)

parties: Asks for a chronological overview of phosphate production and rights allocation, questions the inconsistent figures and the decision to raise the rate while the ceiling is not exceeded, and questions the absence of an independent market overseer.
These members ask the government to provide a schematic, chronological overview of the following items:
Deze leden vragen de regering schematisch en in een chronologische volgorde een overzicht te verstrekken van
Questions how the bill relates to the state-aid decision, why many safeguards are being created for the sectoral ceilings, and how the representativeness of Eurofins Agro data was determined.
These members also wonder why so many 'locks on the door' are being created to secure the sectoral ceilings.
Deze leden vragen zich ook af waarom er zoveel «sloten op de deur» worden gecreëerd bij het borgen van de sectorale plafonds.
Questions why a production permit was not chosen instead of tradable rights, and how grondgebondenheid is defined, while noting the bill relies on stacked legislation.
The D66 members ask the government why it did not choose a production permit instead of rights.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering waarom niet is gekozen voor een productievergunning in plaats van voor rechten.
Questions the reasons for the very rapid procedure and why the bill was not sent earlier, and is critical of the choice of the 20% rate and how it could be raised further without new legislation.
The GroenLinks members are first of all curious about the reasons why this amendment to the Fertilisers Act is in such a hurry.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie zijn allereerst benieuwd naar de redenen waarom deze wijziging van de Meststoffenwet zoveel haast heeft.
Questions the windfall value of the rights, their fiscal treatment, and whether a system of mandatory offering to government would give better steering than free trade.
Would a system in which the rights are not freely traded but must be offered to the government not be preferable?
Heeft een systeem waarin de rechten niet vrij verhandeld worden maar verplicht moeten worden aangeboden bij de overheid niet de voorkeur

Asks whether the sharp increase in the rate is proportionate, whether it causes postponement behaviour, and how the government determines a disproportionate individual burden under the exemption power.
To what extent is the rather sudden increase of the afromingspercentage a proportionate measure?
In hoeverre is het vrij plotseling verhogen van het afromingspercentage een proportionele maatregel?
Asks where the state-aid decision requires the amount of rights to fall exactly below the ceiling and how the European Commission values the substantial underrun of the ceilings by actual production.
Warns that the measure may lead to early slaughter of dairy cows, criticises the minister's reliance on the existing system, and asks whether the rate of 20% will be sufficient.
Can the government guarantee that raising the afromingspercentage will not lead, or will lead, to the early slaughter of dairy cows?
Kan de regering garanderen dat het verhogen van het afromingspercentage niet leidt, of zal leiden tot het vervroegd slachten van melkkoeien?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the explanatory memorandum should better explain and justify choosing a higher fosfaatrecht rounding percentage (afromingspercentage) over a generic reduction, including the financial effects on affected dairy farmers and the proportionality under the right to property. The minister's nader rapport states the memorandum was supplemented with this analysis and the redactional remark was followed.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller justification of why a higher rounding percentage is preferred over a generic reduction, given the individual burden on affected dairy farmers and the proportionality of the measure.
The Afdeling noted the measure interferes with property under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR and asked that the fair balance be explained, which the government addressed in the memorandum.
The Afdeling made a redactional remark on the bill and explanatory memorandum, which the government adopted.

35235.s: This bill amends the 2019 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, adding an incidental supplementary budget related to the Urgenda climate case. It takes effect on 1 July 2019 with retroactive effect where the gazette is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment of the departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management XII for the year 2019
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat XII voor het jaar 2019

35244.s: The bill approves the 2016 Partnership Agreement between the European Union and its member states on the one hand and New Zealand on the other, for the European part of the Netherlands. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: In the government's view, the Partnership Agreement contains no provisions binding on everyone within the meaning of articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution.
Naar het oordeel van de regering bevat de Partnerschapsovereenkomst geen een ieder verbindende bepalingen in de zin van de artikelen 93 en 94 van de Grondwet.

35262.s: The bill grants a legal basis for processing special categories of personal data and criminal-law personal data in peer quality reviews of lawyers, notaries and bailiffs, and makes various technical and procedural amendments to the Advocatenwet, Gerechtsdeurwaarderswet, Wet op het notarisambt and Wet positie en toezicht advocatuur. It also shifts some regulatory matters to ministerial and bylaw level and removes some delegation grounds that previously allowed restricting freedom of expression by lower instruments.
35262.j: The memorandum justifies the new processing basis by the need for effective quality reviews, with confidentiality duties and professional rules as safeguards, and the removal of delegations by the need to respect Article 7 of the Constitution.
q: Article 7 of the Constitution provides that only the formal legislature can determine the scope of freedom of expression.
Artikel 7 van de Grondwet bepaalt dat alleen de formele wetgever de omvang van de vrijheid van meningsuiting kan bepalen
d: confidentiality breaches of lawyers, previously by college van afgevaardigden regulation
seat of disciplinary colleges set by bestuursreglement instead of AMvB
Artikel III, onderdeel C (Art. 22 Wet op het notarisambt)
notary duty of confidentiality exceptions removed from delegation by AMvB
p: Removes the power of the college van afgevaardigden to set by regulation when lawyers' confidentiality may be breached, reserving that power to the formal legislature in line with Article 7 Grondwet.
Artikel III, onderdeel C (Art. 22 Wet op het notarisambt)
Removes delegation allowing lower regulation to set when notaries' confidentiality may be breached, so only the formal legislature can do so.
Sets out grounds and procedure for striking lawyers from the roll, including court decision and appeal routes.

parties: Asks whether the Data Protection Authority's objections about missing specific safeguards for special personal data will be addressed, since the explanatory memorandum pays little attention to them.
