The members in question ask the government whether it will go further into these objections from the AP, since the explanatory memorandum pays little attention to them.
De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen de regering of zij verder in wil gaan op deze bezwaren van de AP nu daar in de memorie van toelichting niet veel aandacht aan wordt besteed.
Asks the government to explain the disagreement over the collection of filing fees in disciplinary cases and why it must be addressed in a later amendment.
Can the government explain what the disagreement consists of and why it is such that a change to the filing fee arrangement must be included in a subsequent amendment to the Advocatenwet?

Kan de regering uiteenzetten waaruit dat verschil van mening dan bestaat en waarom dat verschil zodanig is dat een wijziging van de regeling van het griffierecht in een volgend wijzigingsvoorstel van de Advocatenwet moet worden meegenomen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raised no substantive remarks on the draft bill amending the Advocatenwet, Gerechtsdeurwaarderswet, Wet op het notarisambt and Wet positie en toezicht advocatuur to create a legal basis for processing special personal data for quality checks of lawyers, bailiffs and notaries, and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's reply (nader rapport) notes that a minor technical amendment to article 9j of the Advocatenwet was added, agreed with the Nederlandse orde van advocaten.

35271.s: The bill amends the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 so that persons refused entry at the border after an asylum application can be held in border detention during the appeal period and while a court considers an interim measure or appeal, based on Article 6(3) instead of being released after four weeks. It removes the four-week limit on postponing the entry refusal and the automatic entry refusal upon rejection of the asylum application, delaying the refusal until appeal avenues are exhausted.
35271.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary to comply with CJEU rulings Gnandi and C. requiring suspensive effect of appeals and proper legal basis for detention during appeal.
q: To ensure that border detention remains possible in the appeal phase following the rejection decision, this bill amends Articles 3 and 6 of the Vw 2000.
Om te bewerkstelligen dat grensdetentie mogelijk blijft in de beroepsfase na de afwijzende beslissing, worden door dit wetsvoorstel wijzigingen aangebracht in de artikelen 3 en 6 van de Vw 2000.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel B, punt 2 (Art. 6 lid 6 Vw 2000)
Minister decides on imposing detention measure on persons refused entry
p: Removes the four-week limit on postponing the entry refusal, allowing the executive to keep asylum seekers in border procedures for an open-ended period.
Artikel I, onderdeel B (Art. 6 lid 3 en 6 Vw 2000)
Allows detention of asylum seekers during the appeal period and pending court decisions on interim measures, with the executive setting the detention on its own authority.

parties: Asks what the consequences are if the preliminary relief judge allows the appeal to be awaited when the IND has not decided within four weeks.
These members wholeheartedly support the aim of this bill, in that a statutory basis for border detention after rejection of a border asylum application must be provided with great urgency.

Deze leden onderschrijven van harte het doel van onderhavig wetsvoorstel, in de zin dat met grote spoed moet worden voorzien in een wettelijke basis voor grensdetentie na afwijzing van een aan de grens ingediend asielverzoek.
Argues EU rules prevent the Netherlands from setting its own admission policy and calls for abolishing them and a full asylum stop.
Does the government share the view that we should therefore rid ourselves of these dangerous and absurd EU rules as quickly as possible?
Deelt de regering de mening dat we dan ook zo snel mogelijk van deze gevaarlijke en idiote EU-regels af moeten?
Asks why no statutory basis for detention during the appeal phase was ever created and how the Gnandi and C c.s. case law will be codified and consulted on.
These members ask how it is that a statutory basis for this was never created in existing Dutch legislation.
Deze leden vragen hoe het komt dat hiervoor in de bestaande Nederlandse wetgeving nooit een wettelijke grondslag is gecreëerd.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the draft bill amending the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 to adjust the legal basis for detention of asylum seekers refused or not admitted after an asylum application at the border, and advises submission to the Tweede Kamer. Because the Afdeling raised no concerns, the government reply (nader rapport) is limited to noting that only minor editorial improvements were made.

35280.s: The bill establishes a defence materiel budget fund to manage investments in and upkeep of Defence equipment, ICT and infrastructure over a 15-year horizon, administered by the Minister of Defence. It allows an general administrative order (AMvB) to exclude certain expenditures from the fund, subject to a four-week parliamentary pre-submission period, and requires an evaluation within seven years.
35280.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the AMvB power by stating that the fund's scope concerns operational matters, and pairs it with parliamentary involvement via pre-submission so Parliament can exercise its control.
d: excluding specified financial obligations and expenditures from fund financing
p: The executive may by AMvB exclude specified expenditures from the fund, a discretionary scope decision, though subject to parliamentary pre-submission.
The fund is placed under the Minister's management with a multi-year budget, reducing the granularity of annual parliamentary budget control, though a 15-year overview is provided.

parties: Demands that parliament's information position and budgetary right remain fully unchanged, and asks why the Defence Projects Overview would be dropped.
The VVD members demand that the House's information position remain fully the same.
De leden van de VVD-fractie eisen dat de informatiepositie van de Kamer volledig gelijk blijft.
Opposes the fund as bureaucratising and weakening parliamentary control over the equipment budget, calling it an attack on democracy.
The PVV members believe the budget fund leads to bureaucratisation and a deterioration of parliamentary control over the equipment budget.
De leden van de PVV-fractie menen dat het begrotingsfonds leidt tot bureaucratisering en verslechtering van de parlementaire controle op de materieelbegroting.

Welcomes the fund's predictability but asks about the 1% year-end margin, the lost project details in the fund budget, and whether the Defence Projects Overview will be maintained to protect the House's information position.
Does the government acknowledge that this would mean a deterioration of the House's information position?
Erkent de regering dat dit een verslechtering van de informatiepositie van de Kamer zou betekenen?
Supports the fund's aim but insists the House's budgetary right must not be weakened and proposes further subdivision of equipment investment articles.
The D66 members stress that the House's budgetary right must in any case not be weakened compared with the existing situation.
De leden van de D66-fractie benadrukken dat het budgetrecht van de Kamer ten opzichte van de bestaande situatie in ieder geval niet verzwakt mag worden.
Sees no serious reasons for the fund and asks for more specific information, including Defence Projects Overview-type reporting and finer article breakdown, to keep oversight.
The SP members believe many possibilities remain to obtain information from the government on defence equipment procurement policy.
De leden van de SP-fractie menen dat er veel mogelijkheden overblijven om informatie van de regering over het beleid voor Defensiematerieelverwerving te verkrijgen.

Asks whether the fund could be cut back by future government decisions and whether it is protected against misuse for non-materiel spending; asks the government to justify exemptions by general administrative order.
Article 5, paragraph 4, of the Act does allow, via a prior general administrative order, certain financial obligations and expenditure to be excluded from financing from the fund.

Artikel 5, lid 4, van de wet biedt wel de mogelijkheid via een voorgehangen algemene maatregel van bestuur bepaalde financiële verplichtingen en uitgaven uit te zonderen van financiering en bekostiging uit het fonds.
Asks about the relationship between the revenue, expenditure and multi-year overview articles and the reach of the planning horizon, and how the fund affects the House's budgetary right.
In general terms, the SGP members ask how the Defence Materiel Budget Fund affects the Second Chamber's budgetary right.
In algemene zin vragen de leden van de SGP-fractie hoe het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds het budgetrecht van de Tweede Kamer beïnvloedt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Wet defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds and raised no remarks, recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The text includes no government reply (nader rapport) beyond the transmittal letter from the Minister of Defence.

35307.s: The bill amends the Dutch VAT Act 1968 to implement EU Directive 2018/1910 on call-off stock arrangements and intra-EU trade, treating certain stock movements as non-supplies and setting record-keeping, register and reporting duties. It also adds reporting obligations on ICP declarations with effect from 1 January 2020.
35307.j: The memorandum explains that the practical arrangement is an alternative to ministerial rules under the existing delegation and that the changes implement the directive's original intent.
q: This practical arrangement takes effect on 1 January 2020 and is an alternative to the detailed rules given by ministerial regulation under Article 9(2)(b) of the VAT Act 1968 in conjunction with Article 12(5) of the Implementing Decree.

Deze praktische regeling treedt in werking met ingang van 1 januari 2020 en is een alternatief voor de op grond van artikel 9, tweede lid, onderdeel b, Wet OB 1968 juncto artikel 12, vijfde lid, van het Uitvoeringsbesluit OB 1968 bij ministeriële regeling gegeven nadere voorschriften.
d: practical arrangement on call-off stock register and substitute customers

parties: Asks how contradictory evidence documents will be handled under the new VAT rules, a question about how the evidentiary framework works in practice.
The VVD members ask how contradictory evidence documents will be dealt with.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe wordt omgegaan met tegenstrijdige bewijsstukken.
Questions the implementation feasibility and the Tax Administration's handling of stock-on-call rules and incoming EU messages, and asks the government to respond to the tax advisers' organisation.
The CDA members are very alarmed by the implementation test.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn erg geschrokken van de uitvoeringstoets.
Asks for more explanation of the new evidentiary presumption, including what counts as an independent party, and how the extra enforcement staff fits with the fraud-resistance aim.
The D66 members ask for more explanation of the new evidentiary presumption.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen om meer uitleg over het nieuwe bewijsvermoeden.
Asks whether the bill affects the chance of tax avoidance and VAT fraud, without a stated position on checks.
These members ask the government whether this bill has consequences for the chance of tax avoidance.
Deze leden vragen de regering of dit wetsvoorstel gevolgen heeft voor de kans op belastingontwijking.
Has no further questions or remarks at this stage.
They currently have no further questions or comments.
Zij hebben op dit moment geen nadere vragen of opmerkingen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an advisory opinion on a draft bill amending the Wet op de omzetbelasting 1968 to implement a directive on harmonising and simplifying trade between Member States. The Afdeling had no remarks and advised submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer, and the government's reply thanked it and noted only minor redactional and technical improvements.
concerns: The bill and explanatory memorandum were adjusted with some redactional and technical improvements.

35316.s: The bill amends the Dutch Municipal Debt Assistance Act to let municipalities proactively offer debt assistance after creditors signal payment arrears, and to clarify the legal basis for sharing personal data with creditors, health-related providers and other bodies. It also allows a five-year ministerial regulation to designate new signals and data-providing creditors for pilots, and provides for an evaluation within five years.
35316.j: The memorandum justifies the new data powers and ministerial pilot regulation by the need to legally clarify early-warning powers and to enable innovation in detecting people with problematic debts.
q: This legal uncertainty is an obstacle to investing on a larger scale in early detection, while it is desirable to identify problematic debts in time, that is, at an earlier stage.

Deze juridische onzekerheid is een belemmering om op grotere schaal in vroegsignalering te investeren, terwijl dit wenselijk is om problematische schulden tijdig, dat wil zeggen in een eerder stadium, in beeld te krijgen.
d: signals of creditor payment arrears triggering municipal outreach
conditions attached to debt assistance decisions
persons and bodies that must provide data, with conditions
designation of alternative creditor signals for five-year pilots
designation of creditors who must supply pilot signals
outsourcing of debt assistance tasks to third parties and organisations
p: Municipalities gain broad authority to process sensitive personal data, including health and criminal-law data, and to reuse social-domain data without the citizen's consent.
A ministerial regulation can designate new signals and data-providing creditors for pilots, departing from the statute's own signal list, for up to five years.
Municipalities may outsource execution and some decision-making to private or volunteer bodies, while citizens retain objection and appeal rights against the municipality.
Formal written decisions are required and made appealable, which strengthens citizens' legal protection against the municipality.

parties: Asks about administrative burden on citizens, handling of data leaks and unauthorized access to personal data, and whether debtors can always refuse help.
Furthermore, the VVD members ask the government about the safeguards with which municipalities can fulfil their responsibility for processing personal data for debt assistance.
Verder vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie de regering naar de waarborgen waarmee gemeenten de verantwoordelijkheid voor het verwerken van persoonsgegevens voor schuldhulpverlening kunnen invullen.
Asks about monitoring of early detection, how parliament is informed about AMvB and ministerial regulation, and why the Nationale ombudsman's advice on statutory response deadlines is not adopted.
Why does the government not adopt this advice?
Waarom neemt de regering dit advies niet over?
Asks how Parliament will be informed on ministerial regulations for additional signals and whether a voorhang procedure applies to the AMvB enabling municipalities to act on their own initiative.
They ask whether a preliminary submission to Parliament (voorhang) will follow when drafting such an AMvB.
Zij vragen of er bij het opstellen van een dergelijke AMvB een voorhang volgt.
Concerned about municipal implementation costs and capacity, asks about a follow-up implementation test under the Financiële Verhoudingswet.

Furthermore, these members ask whether the government intends to carry out a follow-up implementation test on organisational and financial matters, in line with Article 2 of the Financiële Verhoudingswet.
Voorts vragen deze leden of de regering voornemens is om een vervolg uitvoeringstoets op organisatorisch en financieel gebied uit te voeren, conform Artikel 2 van de Financiële Verhoudingswet.

Argues that experimentation power to designate new data via ministerial regulation is undesirable and should be set by AMvB with heavy voorhang and limited to two years; also demands GDPR compliance, retention limited to six months, and data-leak safeguards.
propose doing this by AMvB with heavy voorhang and also limiting the experimentation scope to two years.
stellen voor dit per AMvB met zware voorhang te doen en de experimenteerruimte tevens te beperken tot twee jaar.
Asks the government to address possible tension or conflict between parts of the bill and privacy law (AVG), and whether commercial parties may exchange data.
ask whether the government can explicitly address the possible tension or conflict with privacy legislation and regulations of parts of the bill.
vragen of de regering expliciet kan ingaan op de mogelijke spanning of strijdigheid met privacywetgeving en -regelgeving van onderdelen van het wetsvoorstel.

Notes the bill regulates creditor cooperation only in very general terms, lacks powers needed for effective debt assistance, and introduces a new obligation for municipalities to do early detection while downplaying it.

note that the bill only states in very general terms that municipalities must make agreements with creditors, and that powers which regularly prove necessary for adequate follow-through of debt assistance are missing.

constateren dat het wetsvoorstel slechts in zeer algemene zin benoemt dat gemeenten afspraken moeten maken met schuldeisers en dat bevoegdheden die regelmatig nodig blijken voor adequate doorzetting van de schulphulpverlening ontbreken.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion supports the bill strengthening municipal early signalling of debt problems and data exchange, but raises objections on health data processing, a ministerial-regulation power to designate signals, implementability, and the missing deadline for offering a first conversation. The government reply adapts the bill: it clarifies the health data grounds, deletes the tax-data provision and the ministerial power, and reframes the deadline wording.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that delegating to a ministerial regulation the power to designate debt signals for five years exceeds acceptable delegation limits and should be dropped.

Processing of health data (social support and youth care) for debt assistance needs a justification under the AVG; the Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to specify which health data are necessary.
The bill lacked a deadline for the municipality to offer a first conversation after receiving a signal, leaving the timing to municipal discretion contrary to the legislator's intent.
The Afdeling doubted municipalities could implement the expanded duties and data exchange in the short term given the large potential demand and need for staff, funding and ICT.
The Afdeling asked for clarification of whether the medical confidentiality duty would be breached, and for consistency in consent requirements compared with the Wmo 2015.
Tax-data disclosure by the Belastingdienst needed a more convincing justification or should be removed, as existing law may already cover it.

35352.s: The bill amends the primary, secondary, expertise-centre and Caribbean Netherlands education laws to require schools to actively promote citizenship and social cohesion, including knowledge of and respect for the democratic constitutional state's basic values. It requires school boards to foster a school culture consistent with those values and leaves the content and form of citizenship education largely to schools' freedom of education.
35352.j: The memorandum justifies the duty by the need to clarify the statutory citizenship mandate and expressly preserves school freedom and inspectorate restraint rather than delegating new powers.
q: Schools have a high degree of freedom to give content to the citizenship mandate themselves.
Scholen hebben een hoge mate van vrijheid om zelf invulling te geven aan de burgerschapsopdracht.

parties: Asks whether the bill suffices to sanction schools like SIO and Cornelius Haga Lyceum and how the Inspectorate will intervene quickly.
Is the government of the opinion that this bill is sufficient to judge in future that SIO, but also comparable schools and foundations, have acted in breach of the current civic-education duty?

Is de regering van mening dat dit wetsvoorstel voldoende is om voortaan te oordelen dat SIO, maar ook vergelijkbare scholen en stichtingen, in strijd met de huidige burgerschapsopdracht hebben gehandeld?
Asks how learning outcomes will be monitored and how the Inspectorate will intervene, and how the bill relates to the Remkes recommendations.
What are the possibilities for the Inspectorate to intervene if this monitoring shows that development is insufficient, lagging or not continuous, the members ask?
Wat zijn de mogelijkheden voor de Inspectie om in te grijpen indien uit deze monitor blijkt dat de ontwikkeling onvoldoende is, achterblijft of niet ononderbroken is, zo vragen de leden?
Welcomes the stricter civic-education duties and school duty of care, but asks about the bill's intended effect and evaluation.
These members consider it a good thing that the requirements of civic education are being tightened and that schools receive a duty of care to promote democratic rule-of-law values.
Deze leden vinden het een goede zaak dat de eisen van burgerschapsonderwijs worden aangescherpt en scholen een zorgplicht krijgen om democratisch-rechtsstatelijke waarden uit te dragen.
Asks how the civic-duty bill relates to the Curriculum.nu overhaul and whether support and funding for teachers is sufficient.
Does the government agree with these members that structurally more money and support is needed for education, the members ask?
Is de regering het met deze leden eens dat er structureel meer geld en ondersteuning nodig is voor het onderwijs, zo vragen de leden?
Asks how structural and serious breaches of the school-culture duty will be defined and when the Inspectorate can act, and raises concerns about segregation.
The aforementioned members ask how the government defines structural and serious.
Voornoemde leden vragen hoe de regering structureel en vergaand definieert.
Supports binding national rules on a common core of civic education, citing poor Dutch results.
These members therefore consider further regulation necessary that formulates and statutorily anchors a common core of the general civic-education duty for schools in primary and secondary education.

Deze leden achten nadere regelgeving dan ook noodzakelijk die een gemeenschappelijke kern van de algemene burgerschapsopdracht voor scholen in het funderend onderwijs formuleert en wettelijk verankert.
Worries that a school-culture duty and detailed definitions undermine the freedom of education under Article 23 and the Inspectorate's restraint.
Does the government with this not encroach too much on the waters of schools?
Komt de regering hiermee niet teveel in het vaarwater van scholen?
Warns the bill increases legal uncertainty and burdens, notes the Council of State's objections, and questions the vague basic values and the duty of care.
These members are concerned that the bill, contrary to its intention of clarification, may actually lead to even greater uncertainty for schools and the accompanying legal uncertainty.

Deze leden maken zich zorgen dat het wetsvoorstel in tegenstelling tot de bedoeling om tot verduidelijking te komen, juist tot nog grotere onduidelijkheid voor scholen en de daarmee gepaard gaande rechtsonzekerheid kan leiden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill clarifying and strengthening the civic education mandate in primary, special and secondary education, but objects that the proposed school-culture duty of care is too open-ended and hard to enforce, recommending replacing it with an accountability obligation and a restrained inspectorate. The minister's reply largely rejects the alternative accountability-only formulation, keeps a positively formulated duty of care, but narrows the norm to school culture rather than individual utterances and clarifies the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Council warns the school-culture duty of care touches the tension between freedom of education, freedom of expression and non-discrimination and should be framed as accountability, with restrained inspection.
The Council finds the duty of care insufficiently objectifiable and too open to enforce as a funding condition, and calls for a clearer assessment framework.
The Council notes that schools will find it hard to know what is expected without kerndoelen and eindtermen, and that inspection will struggle to assess compliance.
The Council asks that the bill's reference to the civic dimensions and the link to core objectives be made more explicit in the explanatory memorandum.
The Council asks for a fuller response to teacher concerns about workload and the regulatory burden of the bill, which the minister addresses only briefly.

35361.s: This bill implements the revised EU Audiovisual Media Services Directive into the Dutch Mediawet 2008, extending rules to video-platform services, tightening advertising, children's programming, accessibility and content-incitement rules, and tasking the Commissariaat with new supervision and list-keeping duties. It is largely a transposition of EU obligations with few new executive discretions.
35361.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as required by the EU directive and grounds the video-platform codes in the Grondwet's free-expression and prior-permission rules.
q: The Commissariaat supervises the actual drafting of the code of conduct and takes an active role in supporting video platform providers.
Het Commissariaat houdt toezicht op het daadwerkelijk opstellen van de gedragscode, en neemt hierin een actieve houding aan ter ondersteuning van aanbieders van videoplatformdiensten.
d: codes of conduct for video platform providers under supervision of the Commissariaat
p: Allows modified distribution of broadcast content by overlay under listed conditions, with the media provider's consent required for commercial purposes.

parties: Asks why only mandatory provisions were transposed, whether an impact assessment exists, and how the Commissariaat supervises video platforms.
This is due to the tight timeframe of 21 months available for implementation.
Dit vanwege het krappe tijdspad van 21 maanden die er is voor de implementatie.
Criticises transposing only mandatory provisions as a missed opportunity and questions enforceability of the self-regulatory codes, citing Raad van State concerns.
Furthermore, these members have critical questions as to whether the proposals will not be too non-committal and whether they will be sufficiently enforced.
Daarnaast hebben deze leden kritische vragen of de voorgestelde voorstellen niet te vrijblijvend zullen zijn en of ze voldoende zullen worden gehandhaafd.
Asks about the country-of-origin principle for video platforms outside the EU, constitutional limits under Article 7 Grondwet, and the Commissariaat's powers.
These members read that video platform services do not fall under the concept of 'television' and therefore Article 7 of the Constitution need not be taken into account.
Deze leden lezen dat videoplatformdiensten niet onder het begrip «televisie» vallen en derhalve geen rekening gehouden hoeft te worden met artikel 7 van de Grondwet.
Disappointed the government implemented only the minimum; asks for fuller answers on quotas, sanctions, and hate-speech obligations.
Nevertheless, these members are disappointed that the government has chosen to implement only the minimum necessary from the European revision directive.
Niettemin zijn deze leden teleurgesteld dat de regering ervoor heeft gekozen enkel het minimaal noodzakelijke van de Europese herzieningsrichtlijn te implementeren.
Questions why only mandatory provisions were taken, the lack of consultation with disability organisations, and the lenient advertising and accessibility rules.
These members would like to learn for each of the eight non-mandatory provisions why it was so complex to put them into legislation in time.
Deze leden zouden graag van elke van de acht niet-verplichte bepalingen vernemen waarom het zo complex was om deze tijdig in wetgeving te gieten.
Asks about the value of non-binding platform codes, classification system fragmentation, and protection of minors up to age 16 versus 18.
This raises for these members the question of what the value of such a code of conduct will be.
Dit roept bij deze leden de vraag op wat de waarde zal zijn van een dergelijke gedragscode.
Asks why stricter advertising norms were not adopted, questions the effectiveness of Reclame Code Commissie supervision, and asks about accessibility consultation.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises on the bill implementing the revised Audiovisual Media Services Directive, raising concerns about freedom of expression under Article 7 of the Constitution, the legal basis for co- and self-regulation (notably the Advertising Code's lack of binding enforcement and government oversight of video platform codes of conduct), and the need for clearer explanation. The minister's reply largely accepts the points: it clarifies the constitutional regime, revises the article on video platform measures, and expands the explanatory memorandum on co- and self-regulation and the Commissariat's enforcement powers, though it does not change the core structure of the bill.
concerns: The Council asks clarification of whether Article 7(2) or 7(3) of the Constitution governs video platform services and the ban on prior permission, which the government accepts and adds to the explanatory memorandum.
The Council warns that ex ante filtering measures could conflict with freedom of expression, and the government revises the provision to a limitative list of measures excluding prior content control.
The Council says the explanation of permissible measures for platforms is lacking, creating legal uncertainty; the government adds clarification but keeps the regime largely as drafted.

The Council finds that co- and self-regulation through the Advertising Code lacks adequate government control and effective enforcement; the government defends the existing system and supplements the explanation rather than revising the bill.

The Council says that for video platforms, government involvement in drafting codes of conduct and a fallback regulation are unclear; the government clarifies the Commissariat's supervisory and enforcement role without adding a statutory fallback.
The Council lists several drafting and transposition-table remarks, which the government says have been incorporated.

35415.s: The bill amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment by appropriating an additional 13.8 billion euros, mainly for labour market and social assistance measures responding to the COVID-19 crisis. It takes effect on 18 March 2020, retroactively if published later, and implements the budget change without delegating new rule-making powers.
35415.j: The memorandum justifies the extra spending by the expected cost of an open-ended scheme for business loans, supplementary assistance and implementation costs, with municipalities compensated afterwards.
q: Municipalities will be fully compensated through ex-post calculation for the additional demand for supplementary assistance, business capital and implementation costs.
Gemeenten zullen via nacalculatie volledig gecompenseerd worden voor het extra beroep op aanvullende bijstand, bedrijfskapitaal en voor uitvoeringskosten.

35424.s: The bill temporarily allows provincial states, municipal councils, water board general boards and island councils in the Caribbean public bodies to deliberate digitally, with members voting remotely or by mail, while decisions remain with the elected body. It sets a sunset date of 1 September 2020 and grants ministers and the commissioner or mayor discretion to set technical rules and deadlines by ministerial regulation.
35424.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary digital procedures by the COVID-19 restrictions on gatherings and the need for decentralised bodies to keep functioning, and it rejects alternatives such as relaxing quorum rules.
q: This bill is explicitly a temporary deviation; it is not intended to undermine the principle that the most important decision-making takes place in a public physical meeting of the decentralised representative body.

Dit wetsvoorstel is nadrukkelijk een tijdelijke afwijking, het is niet bedoeld om afbreuk te doen aan het principiële uitgangspunt dat de belangrijkste besluitvorming plaatsvindt in een openbare fysieke vergadering van de decentrale volksvertegenwoordiging.
d: rules on voting procedure for remote and mail ballots
technical requirements and access to digital environment, deliberation and decision-making
setting alternative deadlines for financial and other statutory time limits
chair may switch to a mail vote instead of an open vote
p: The chair of the council or assembly sets the deadline and order for receiving mail ballots and announces results, giving the presiding officer discretion over the voting process.
Meetings may be held in a digital environment with public live streaming, and the chair must be able to maintain order, leaving practical conduct to the presiding officer.

parties: The party worries that the bill does not clearly leave the power to choose digital voting with elected representatives rather than mayors, dijkgraven or commissioners of the King, and asks how individual members' right to request roll-call votes is preserved.
The bill, however, does not appear to place that competence with the elected representatives.
Het wetsvoorstel lijkt die bevoegdheid echter niet bij de volksverte-genwoordigers te leggen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supported the temporary bill allowing digital meetings and voting for provincial, municipal, water board and island councils during the COVID-19 outbreak, but advised adding a fixed expiry date with extensions of at most six weeks and better preparation for the Bonaire and Saba island councils. The government accepted the sunset clause, set 1 September 2020 as the expiry date with extensions of at most two months, and explained the support programme for island councils.
concerns: The bill lacked an expiry date for the temporary arrangement, which the Afdeling advised to add with extensions by royal decree of at most six weeks; the government adopted a 1 September 2020 expiry date with extensions of at most two months.

The Afdeling noted that implementation for the island councils of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba had not been consulted or explained; the government referred to a support programme and early contact with Saba but did not add a dedicated consultation.
The Afdeling proposed a redactional correction in article 2.5, first paragraph, replacing 'schriftelijke' with 'geheime', which was adopted.

35433.s: The bill amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) through a second incidental supplementary budget concerning reinsurance of supplier credits. It adjusts commitments and expenditure figures for several budget articles, including an increase of 12,070,000 thousand euros in export credit insurance commitments.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IX) for the year 2020.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IX), voor het jaar 2020.

35442.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality by a supplementary budget of 700 thousand euros in spending obligations and 2,700 thousand euros in expenditure under the emergency jobs and economy package. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 20 April 2020, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) for the year 2020
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV), voor het jaar 2020

35450-IIB.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2020 budget of the miscellaneous high state bodies, governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, raising spending and commitments mainly for the Council of State (advisory and administrative jurisdiction) and the National Ombudsman, with effect from 1 May 2020. It is a budgetary appropriation law that does not delegate rule-making power or alter the powers of oversight bodies.
35450-IIB.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget increases by additional tasks for the Council of State from implementing the Climate Act and higher expected appeals by foreign nationals, without invoking new powers.
q: The Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate contributes to additional tasks the Council of State has as a result of implementing the Climate Act.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (EZK) draagt bij aan extra taken die de Raad van State heeft naar aanleiding van de uitvoering van de Klimaatwet.

35451.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (third incidental supplementary budget) to fund an emergency employment and economy package and a bridging facility for IHC. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect on 7 May 2020, retroactively if published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2020
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2020

35460.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat with an incidental supplementary budget for extra COVID-19 measures in the Caribbean Netherlands. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively from 1 May 2020.
q: Having considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35505.s: This supplementary budget amendment for 2020 adjusts the Ministry of Finance budget to implement KLM support measures, including a 3.16 billion euro loan-related item and a 1 billion euro repayment line. The bill mainly modifies budget appropriations and takes effect retroactively from 26 June 2020, with no notable delegation of rule-making power.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IX) for the year 2020.
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IX), voor het jaar 2020.

35514.s: The bill amends the Financial Supervision Act (Wft) on remuneration of financial institutions: it adds a five-year retention period for shares and similar instruments in fixed pay, requires institutions to explain how pay relates to their societal function, narrows the exemption from the bonus cap for non-CAO staff to exceptional cases with annual notification to the supervisor, and extends the supervisor's approval period for retention awards from six to nine weeks where the ECB is involved. It also lets the government set further rules by general administrative order (AMvB) implementing binding EU acts, and adds transitional arrangements.
35514.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB power by limiting it to implementing binding EU acts and EBA guidelines, responding to Council of State advice that the earlier delegation was too broad.
q: In response, the bill provides for the proposed new second paragraph of article 1:111 Wft a revised, narrower basis for setting additional rules on the components to be treated as fixed or variable pay.

Naar aanleiding daarvan voorziet het onderhavige wetsvoorstel voor het voorgestelde nieuwe tweede lid van artikel 1:111 Wft in een aangepaste, beperktere grondslag voor het stellen van aanvullende regels over de als vaste of variabele delen van de beloning aan te merken bestanddelen.
d: additional rules on fixed and variable pay components implementing binding EU acts
p: Allows executive rules by AMvB on pay components, limited to implementing binding EU acts after the Council of State's criticism of a broader delegation.
Exemption from the bonus cap for non-CAO staff is limited to exceptional cases and excludes internal control and consumer-facing staff, with annual notification to the supervisor.
Extends the supervisor's decision period on retention-award consent from six to nine weeks where the ECB is involved.

parties: Asks whether fintech start-ups can be carved out and whether claw-back is still possible for evident mismanagement, noting Council of State concerns about property rights.
These small firms are challengers to established financial firms and like to set up in the Netherlands.
Deze bedrijfjes zijn de uitdagers van de gevestigde financiële bedrijven en vestigen zich graag in Nederland.
Asks for specification of exceptional cases, scope of retention rules and why claw-back was dropped, including the precise European-law objections.
The PVV members ask to specify what falls under 'exceptional' cases.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen te specificeren wat er onder «uitzonderlijke» gevallen valt.
Asks whether further measures are expected, how culture change beyond regulation is pursued, and whether start-ups should be exempted.
On the statutory retention period for shares as fixed pay, the CDA members ask why start-ups and scale-ups are not exempted from this period.
Ten aanzien van de wettelijke retentieperiode van onder meer aandelen als vaste beloning vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie waarom startups en scale-ups niet zijn uitgezonderd van deze periode.
Asks for justification of the five-year retention period, the terminology used, and clarity on the bonus-cap exception categories and evaluation.
Questions the justification for statutory retention and the bonus-cap exception, asks whether arbitrary application can be prevented and how supervisors can act objectively.
The GroenLinks members ask how an arbitrary situation regarding the exception ground can be prevented.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen hoe een arbitraire situatie ten aanzien van de uitzonderingsgrond voorkomen kan worden.
Regrets the absence of claw-back for bank executives receiving state aid, asks why control stops at top pay, and wants measurement of effects reported to parliament.
The SP members regret that no claw-back arrangement has been included for pay of (top) executives of financial institutions receiving state aid.
De leden van de SP-fractie betreuren het dat er geen claw back -regeling bij beloningen van (top)bestuurders van financiële instellingen die staatssteun ontvangen is opgenomen.
Calls the bill very watered down, notes claw-back is omitted and that pay rules can still be circumvented; asks about enforceability and retention scope.
For example, the so-called claw-back is not included in legislation and possibilities remain to circumvent the rules on pay policy in the financial sector.
Zo wordt de zogeheten claw back niet in wetgeving opgenomen en blijven er mogelijkheden bestaan om de regels ten aanzien van beloningsbeleid in de financiële sector te omzeilen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division raised concerns that the proposed five-year share retention period for financial sector staff could infringe property rights, particularly for shares already transferred, and asked for a clearer transitional regime and explanation of proportionality. The government's reply adopted a grandfathering clause for instruments already acquired, kept the one-year transition period with added explanation, and accepted a drafting correction.
concerns: The retention requirement may infringe the protected right to undisturbed enjoyment of property, and the government's reply added grandfathering for instruments already acquired.

A one-year transition period may be disproportionate given five-year retention periods, so the explanatory memorandum needed further justification; the one-year period was kept with added clarification.
References to European supervisory authority guidelines in the proposed Wft article were deleted as superfluous and undesirable.

35532.s: The bill amends the Dutch Constitution to change the election and term of the Eerste Kamer: members would serve six years, with half elected every three years, and the election would no longer be tied to the provincial elections. It also includes transitional provisions delaying entry into force until the Kieswet is adapted, and a coordination clause in case a related constitutional change enters into force first.
35532.j: The memorandum justifies the transitional and election-implementation provisions by the need to adapt the Kieswet before the new term can take effect and to avoid disrupting the ongoing election process.
q: For that reason the first paragraph includes a provision to prevent the amendment of the Constitution from entering into force before the Kieswet has been adapted.
Daarom is in het eerste lid een voorziening opgenomen om te voorkomen dat de wijziging van de Grondwet in werking treedt op het moment dat de Kieswet nog niet is aangepast.
d: nadere vormgeving of election of Eerste Kamer via Kieswet
p: Broadens the legal basis so that the statute sets the term of a newly installed Eerste Kamer after dissolution, rather than a fixed constitutional term.

parties: Welcomes the bill as creating a more balanced two-chamber system and asks how provincial elections can avoid lower turnout.
The VVD members consider that a good thing.
Dat achten de leden van de VVD-fractie een goede zaak.
Supports the bill as correcting a flaw from 1983 and strengthening the Eerste Kamer's role as chambre de réflexion, but wants clarity on side effects for small parties before judging it.
These members are convinced that as a result of the proposed change in the method of election, the Eerste Kamer will fulfil the role of chambre de réflexion all the more strongly.
Deze leden zijn ervan overtuigd, dat de Eerste Kamer als gevolg van de voorgestelde verandering in de wijze van verkiezing des te sterker de rol van «chambre de réflexion» zal vervullen.
Asks for justification of the bill against advisory commission recommendations, the democratic legitimacy of delayed electoral effects, and the relation to a terugzendrecht proposal.
A sound justification is therefore desirable, and the D66 members would welcome further substantiation from the government of the usefulness and necessity of this proposal.
Derhalve is een deugdelijke motivering gewenst en ontvangen de leden van de D66-fractie van de regering graag nadere onderbouwing van het nut en de noodzaak van het onderhavige voorstel.
Does not understand why the bill is proposed, sees no request from either chamber or from the state commission, and asks the government to consult the Eerste Kamer and withdraw the bill if unwanted.
These members ask the government to consult the Eerste Kamer about the desirability of this proposal and to withdraw it if this wish does not appear to exist in the Senate.
Deze leden vragen de regering in overleg te treden met de Eerste Kamer over de wenselijkheid van dit voorstel en het in te trekken als deze wens in de senaat niet zou blijken te bestaan.
Values proportional representation and minority representation and will not support a change that makes it harder for minorities to be represented in the Eerste Kamer.

A change to the system that undermines the principle of proportional representation and makes it harder for minorities to be represented in the Eerste Kamer will not receive the support of these members.

Een stelselwijziging die afbreuk doet aan het uitgangspunt van evenredige vertegenwoordiging, en ertoe leidt dat het moeilijker wordt voor minderheden om vertegenwoordigd te worden in de Eerste Kamer, zal niet op steun van genoemde leden kunnen rekenen.
Doubts the bill achieves its stated aim, questions the alleged problem, and raises concerns about the lengthy and uncertain effects of the proposed system and possible dissolution.
The SGP members do not get the impression that the present proposal to amend the Constitution meets the aim the government has in mind with it.
De leden van de SGP-fractie krijgen niet de indruk dat het voorliggende voorstel om de Grondwet te wijzigen beantwoordt aan het doel dat de regering ermee heeft.
Shares the Raad van State's reservations, finds it hard to assess the bill without details, and asks for fuller overviews of advantages and disadvantages and of transitional law.
These members would therefore, in line with the advice of the Raad van State, like to receive further explanation from the government of what the disadvantages of this proposal could be.
Deze leden zouden daarom, in lijn met het advies van de Raad van State, graag een nadere toelichting van de regering ontvangen wat de nadelen van dit voorstel zouden kunnen zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division found no constitutional obstacles to a bill extending Eerste Kamer terms from four to six years with staggered half-renewal, but found the explanatory memorandum insufficiently reasoned, particularly on drawbacks, interaction with other pending reforms, Kieswet implementation choices affecting small parties and provincial influence, transitional arrangements, and entry into force. The government reply accepted most points, expanded the memorandum, added an entry-into-force clause, and deliberately left implementation choices to the ordinary legislator.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum must give a fuller assessment of the advantages and disadvantages of the proposed electoral change, in particular the lagged democratic legitimacy and effects on smaller parties.
The memorandum must explain the coherence with other pending proposals affecting the Eerste Kamer, including the non-resident voting proposal and the suspensive return power.

Implementation choices in the Kieswet (group versus full system, remainder seat allocation) affecting small parties and provincial influence need fuller treatment in the memorandum; the government added a section but declined to fix these choices in the constitutional bill.
The transitional provision should explain why the 1956 lottery method was not used and why the Senate should not decide its own rotation.
An additional article should ensure the constitutional amendment enters into force only once the Kieswet has been amended accordingly.

35541.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (fifth incidental supplementary budget for the economic support and recovery package), adjusting commitments, expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force date as 28 August 2020, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2020
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2020

35550.s: The bill adds a statutory basis to the General Administrative Law Act allowing the highest administrative courts (Council of State, Central Appeals Tribunal, Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal) to invite non-parties to submit written observations (amicus curiae) in cases before large or multi-judge chambers, and amends the General Tax Act and the Judicial Officers Act so that members of other highest courts can be appointed as extraordinary councillors at the Supreme Court, raising the cap from fifteen to twenty. The aim is legal unity and development of case law.
35550.j: The memorandum justifies the amicus curiae power by the need for broader insight into societal consequences of rulings and by the experiment and evaluation report recommending a clear statutory basis.
q: Involving non-parties in the form of an amicus curiae power for the highest administrative judge fits that ambition.
Het betrekken van anderen dan partijen in de vorm van een amicus curiaebevoegdheid voor de hoogste bestuursrechter, past in die ambitie.
p: Allows the highest administrative courts to invite non-party observations, with parties given the right to respond and a hearing option, which broadens input into judicial decision-making rather than shifting power to the executive.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Awb, the Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen, the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie and the Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren on amicus curiae and cross-appointments at the highest courts, and raised no remarks. The Minister for Legal Protection replied in a nader rapport that the bill was updated only by a passage on the prejudicial procedure in the Tijdelijke wet Groningen and by correcting minor errors in the explanatory memorandum.

35604.s: The bill extends by five years (from seven to twelve years) the national power under Article 115 of the Aliens Act 2000 to take and process biometric data of foreigners, which would otherwise lapse on 1 March 2021. It also requires the Minister to report to Parliament within three years on the necessity, effectiveness and effects of the biometrics law, with a view on continuing the powers in whole or part.
35604.j: The memorandum justifies the extension by the Wbvk's contribution to identity verification in the migration chain and the need for quantitative evidence before a definitive decision, with a registration facility to be introduced during the extension period.
q: In Article 115 of the Aliens Act 2000, first and second paragraph, "seven years" is replaced by "twelve years".
Artikel 115 van de Vreemdelingenwet 2000, eerste en tweede lid, wordt «zeven jaar» vervangen door «twaalf jaar».
p: Extends the executive's power to take and process biometric data of foreigners by five years, with a reporting obligation attached to a later evaluation.

parties: Asks how the possible intrusion on the privacy of foreigners will be qualified and weighed in the evaluation due three years after entry into force, in light of the CJEU ruling in case C-70/18.
These members ask how the possible intrusion on the personal sphere of the foreigner will be qualified and weighed in the renewed evaluation, three years after entry into force of this law?

Deze leden vragen op welke manier de mogelijke inbeuk op de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de veemdeling wordt gekwalificeerd en meegewogen in de hernieuwde evaluatie, drie jaar na inwerkingtreding van de onderhavige wet?
Asks what will happen to biometric data stored under the Wbvk if future EU systems take over its purpose, whether it will be exported or destroyed.
These members ask the government to make clear what will happen to all biometric data stored under the Wbvk?
Deze leden vragen de regering duidelijk te maken wat zal gebeuren met alle biometrische gegevens die onder de Wbvk opgeslagen zijn?

Critical that the bill originally sought an indefinite extension without demonstrated effectiveness, necessity and proportionality; welcomes the switch to a five-year term with evaluation and asks how quantitative data will be gathered.

Although the D66 members generally understand the purpose of the bill, they are critical that the government initially wanted to extend the bill for an indefinite period, without the effectiveness, utility and necessity of taking and processing biometric data of foreigners being clearly demonstrated.

Alhoewel de leden van de D66-fractie in het algemeen begrip hebben voor het doel van het wetsvoorstel, zijn zij kritisch op het feit dat de regering het wetsvoorstel in eerste instantie voor onbepaalde duur wilde verlengen, zonder dat de effectiviteit, nut en noodzaak van het afnemen en verwerken van biometrische gegevens van vreemdelingen duidelijk was aangetoond.

Questions the evidential basis for necessity and effectiveness, notes the lack of SMART objectives and baseline, and raises privacy, ethnic profiling and stigmatisation concerns, asking how the government weighs these against the benefits.

How does the government weigh this deficient justification of the necessity and utility of the bill against the disadvantages, such as setting lower privacy standards for foreigners and the resulting distinction, the increased risk of ethnic profiling and the stigmatising effect of the bill?

Hoe weegt de regering deze gebrekkige onderbouwing van de noodzaak en het nut van het wetsvoorstel tegenover de nadelen, zoals het stellen van lagere privacy-standaarden voor vreemdelingen en het daaruit volgende onderscheid, de vergrote kans op etnische profilering en de stigmatiserende werking van het wetsvoorstel?

Notes the government admits insufficient quantitative proof that biometric data solves the problems, and asks for clarity on the new measurement method and when it will be available, and for it to be sent to the Chamber before plenary.
These members ask whether the government also sees this shortcoming in the bill? They ask the government by what time it can provide clarity on this measurement method?
Deze leden vragen of de regering dit gebrek in het wetsvoorstel ook ziet? Zij vragen de regering op wat voor termijn zij wel met duidelijkheid over deze meetwijze kan komen?
Asks whether foreigners can refuse to hand over biometric data and what happens if they refuse, and how verification and disputed identities are handled in practice.
Can the government indicate whether it is possible for foreigners not to hand over biometric data? What happens to these persons if they refuse to cooperate?
Kan de regering aangeven of het voor vreemdelingen mogelijk is geen biometrische gegevens af te staan? Wat gebeurt er met deze personen als zij weigeren medewerking te verlenen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division accepts the temporary five-year extension of the national power to take and process biometric data of aliens, but asks that the planned re-evaluation give clear answers on effectiveness, necessity and proportionality and that the explanatory memorandum address how this will be achieved. The government's reply accepts that a quantitative picture is needed, commits to a ketenbrede registration facility for irregularities and annual reporting to parliament, and adapts the bill title to reflect its temporary nature.
concerns: The Afdeling asks how the re-evaluation will give conclusive answers on effectiveness, necessity and usefulness of the biometric power, given the lack of quantitative data; the government now accepts a quantitative registration facility but did not make it a precondition.

The Afdeling notes that the intrusion into privacy requires empirical justification before a definitive decision, and the government acknowledges this and commits to weighing privacy intrusion in the re-evaluation.
The Afdeling advises changing the bill title because the extension is temporary rather than a permanent continuation, and the government adapted the title accordingly.

35613.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2019/1158 by amending the Wet arbeid en zorg and Wet flexibel werken, introducing paid parental leave benefits (nine weeks at 50% of daily wage) administered by UWV, and restricting collective agreements from deviating to the worker's detriment. It also extends rights to flexible working, adds anti-discrimination protections enforceable through the College voor de rechten van de mens, and makes related technical amendments to other social security laws.
35613.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated rules on daily wage determination as necessary for cases such as prolonged incapacity or short employment, and UWV control rules as needed to prevent abuse.
q: By general administrative order, further and where necessary deviating rules are set regarding the determination and revision of the daily wage.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden ten aanzien van de vaststelling en de herziening van het dagloon nadere en zo nodig afwijkende regels gesteld
d: detailed and possibly deviating rules on determining and revising daily wage for parental leave benefit
further rules on benefit calculation where employer receives wage-cost subsidy
control rules set by UWV for benefit administration
p: Gives the College voor de rechten van de mens power to investigate discrimination complaints under the new leave and flexible working protections.
UWV may pay further benefit instalments without a formal decision where no need for a decision is reasonably assumed.

parties: Asks for a schematic overview of the directive's obligations versus existing Dutch rules, the budgetary effects of the nine-week period, and how the complexity of leave schemes will change.

They also ask that this overview show which requirements already apply in the Netherlands, which Dutch legal requirements go further than the European ones, and which current Dutch requirements do not yet meet the directive.

Zij vragen in dit overzicht tevens weer te geven welke eisen nu al in Nederland gelden, welke Nederlandse wettelijke eisen ruimer zijn dan de Europese eisen en welke huidige Nederlandse wettelijke eisen nog niet aan de richtlijn voldoen.

Asks why the minimum standards on paternity leave are not fully met, why military personnel may defer leave to nine months, and what the implications of the employer-related exception in Article 4:7 are.
Can the government indicate why the minimum standards are not fully met and what would be needed to comply with them?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom niet volledig voldaan wordt aan de minimumnormen en wat er nodig is hier aan wel te voldoen?
Supports the goal of a more equal division of care tasks and higher female labour participation, while asking how other EU countries regulate parental leave and why 50 percent pay was chosen.
They endorse the aim of achieving a more equal division of care tasks.
Zij onderschrijven de doelstelling om te komen tot een meer gelijke verdeling van zorgtaken.

Regrets that only 50 percent of the nine weeks is paid, sees risk of social inequality and that leave may not be usable by everyone, and asks about formalising domestic work and the directive's acceptable pay level.

Argues the 50 percent pay level will deter fathers and low-income workers from taking leave, that the directive requires leave to be affordable, and asks how compliance and the situation of domestic and zero-hour workers will be ensured.
For these members it is clear that for many income groups a 50 percent income loss is too much.
Voor deze leden is het klip en klaar dat voor veel inkomensgroepen 50 procent inkomensverlies te veel is.

Questions the subsidiarity and proportionality of the EU directive and asks for minimal implementation, and objects to employers bearing two-thirds of the cost and to workers falling below the social minimum.
How does the government assess the subsidiarity and proportionality of this proposal, and what consequences does it draw from that?
Hoe beoordeelt de regering de subsidiariteit en proportionaliteit van dit voorstel, en welke consequenties verbindt de regering daaraan?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet betaald ouderschapsverlof implementing EU Directive 2019/1158, raising concerns about the proposed exception for military personnel on birth leave, which may conflict with the directive's requirement that leave be taken around the time of birth. The government's reply accepted the point and shortened the military personnel's window to nine months after birth, while making several additional technical amendments.
concerns: The exception for military personnel allowing birth leave up to one year after birth may not be reconcilable with the directive's requirement that paternity leave be taken around the time of birth.
A redactional annex asks the government to explain how transmission of the child's BSN by the Minister of BZK to UWV relates to Article 6(1) and (3) GDPR.

35622.s: The bill abolishes the municipality of Beemster and transfers its territory to the municipality of Purmerend through a boundary change. It also removes references to Beemster from several related statutes and sets entry into force by royal decree.
q: This law enters into force at a time to be determined by royal decree.
Deze wet treedt in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: date of entry into force of the law

parties: Welcomes the merger as initiated by the municipalities themselves and raises no comments or questions.
The bill gives the VVD members no reason to make comments or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
Asks the government to add the merger advice and the province's opinion as annexes so parliament can scrutinise the basis of the bill, and asks what the citizen consultations yielded.
These members request that the government add the merger advice with its accompanying documents and the province's opinion as annexes to the memorandum in reply to the report.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering het herindelingsadvies met de bijbehorende documenten en de zienswijze van de provincie alsnog als bijlagen op te nemen bij de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag.
Questions why municipalities now need more administrative capacity and why no referendum was held in the participating municipalities, which bears on citizens' voice in the change.
Can it further be explained why no referendum was held in all participating municipalities?
Kan er voorts worden ingegaan op waarom er geen referendum in alle deelnemende gemeenten is gehouden?
Acknowledges that a merger strongly affects residents and hopes it benefits the community, without formally challenging the process.
These members are aware that a merger of municipalities is not merely an administrative exercise but also has a major impact on the residents of the municipalities concerned.
Genoemde leden zijn zich er van bewust dat een samenvoeging van gemeenten niet enkel een bestuurlijke exercitie is, maar ook een grote impact heeft op de inwoners van de betrokken gemeen-ten.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill to merge the municipalities of Beemster and Purmerend and raised no objections, recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's reply simply forwards the bill, as the advice gave no reason for substantive remarks.

35703.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adding 644.5 million euro in expenditure for the third incidental supplementary budget on Corona measures. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect retroactively from 15 January 2021.

35712.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (Koninkrijksrelaties) and the BES-fund, adding supplementary funds for food aid, hygiene products and liquidity support to the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom in response to COVID-19. It also increases funding for rule of law items such as prison construction, border control and customs staffing.
35712.j: The memorandum justifies the additional spending by the COVID-19 crisis and the Caribbean countries' appeal to solidarity under article 36 of the Statute for the Kingdom.
q: The coronavirus crisis has left deep marks on the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.
De coronacrisis laat diepe sporen achter op de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk.

35730.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality by an incidental supplementary budget for an emergency package for jobs and the economy, adding about 209 million euro in commitments and 224 million euro in expenditure, mainly to agriculture and horticulture support. It also fixes the budget in thousands of euros and sets the entry-into-force date as 1 January 2021 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
35730.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget change by delays in establishing control protocols and by a supplementary budget for the economic emergency package; no new delegated powers are justified.
q: So it is that We, having heard the Advisory Division of the Council of State and in joint consultation with the States General, have resolved and decreed as follows.
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan

35811.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij (maritime security of merchant shipping) ahead of its entry into force, mainly to adjust certification and licensing rules, shift duties and information obligations to shipowners and captains, and add powers for processing sensitive personal data and cooperating with foreign authorities. It also adds a three-year enforcement work plan and an annual report by the Minister, and new delegation bases for general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
35811.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to implement the statute in an administrative order, after drafting exposed practical gaps, and cites the need for effective enforcement and a legal basis for processing sensitive data under the GDPR.
q: An additional legal basis is also necessary for processing special categories of personal data when implementing the act.
Ook is een aanvullende grondslag noodzakelijk met het oog op de verwerking van bijzondere persoonsgegevens bij de uitvoering van de wet.
d: protective measures that may reasonably be applied by the shipowner
grounds for refusing permission to use private maritime security
information shipowner and licence holder must provide to captain or team leader
responsibility of the captain for ship and crew safety and compliance
ISO certificates required as basic conditions for a licence
retention, destruction and other safeguards for sensitive personal data
rules for captain's reports to the public prosecutor
p: Licence conditions are moved from a statutory set of rules to an administrative order and the Minister's suspension and revocation powers are extended, with the statute giving only general criteria.

Allows the Minister to process criminal-law and health data of licence applicants and deployed guards, and to exchange data with foreign authorities, with safeguards left to a general administrative order and the GDPR and confidentiality duties.
Creates administrative fine powers against shipowners, captains and team leaders for breaches of new information and verification duties, with amounts set by ministerial regulation.
Gives the Minister and inspectors a basis to exchange information, including personal data, with foreign authorities, without naming the recipient authorities or countries in advance.

parties: Supports the repair law and urges the government to bring the WtBK into force by 1 January 2022, while asking that stakeholders be kept involved and that permit processing be fast, including during weekends.
These members also call on the government to keep all stakeholders, who have been waiting so long for this law to enter into force, involved in the process.
Deze leden roepen de regering ook op alle belanghebbenden, die al zo lang wachten op de inwerkingtreding van deze wet, betrokken te houden bij het proces.
Co-initiator supporting the repair law; raises the weekend availability of the Kustwachtcentrum and asks for prompt handling of permit requests within 48 hours.

The VVD and CDA members ask the government whether, given the rapid developments on the spot market and the importance for shipowners of knowing quickly where they stand, it shares the view that permission should be granted within 48 hours.

De leden van de VVD-fractie en de CDA-fractie vragen de regering of zij, gezien de snelle ontwikkelingen van de spotmarkt en het belang van reders om snel te weten waar ze aan toe zijn, de opvatting deelt dat toestemming binnen 48 uur zou moeten worden verleend.

Asks how the broadened definition of private maritime security personnel works in practice, what vetting the ILT applies to foreign firms, and whether ILT supervision and enforcement should receive top priority given the outsourcing of state force.
Does the government agree that establishing private security carries a risk, since it outsources the state's coercive power?
Is de regering het ermee eens dat het instellen van particuliere beveiliging een risico met zich meedraagt, aangezien het de zwaardmacht van de overheid uitbesteedt?

Opposes private maritime security in principle, holding that protecting merchant shipping is a state task for the navy; asks whether the whole law should be withdrawn and questions the adequacy of data transfers to third countries.
These members have always maintained that securing merchant shipping is a task of the state and in this case of the navy.
Deze leden hebben altijd uitgedragen dat beveiliging van de koopvaardij een taak van de staat is en in dit geval van de marine.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the Reparatiewet WtBK lacks adequate statutory safeguards for processing special and criminal personal data by the ILT and insufficient explanation of safeguards for international data transfers to third countries. The government's nader rapport accepted the advice, added a delegation basis for safeguards and expanded the explanation on transfers, and also added a captain's duty not to sail when conditions are unmet.
concerns: The statutory basis for processing criminal and health data lacks the specific safeguards (data subject rights, retention periods) required by the GDPR, which the government addressed by adding a delegation basis for such rules.

The explanation of safeguards for transferring personal data to third-country authorities under GDPR Chapter V is inadequate and should specify the appropriate safeguards, which the government expanded in the explanatory memorandum.
The government added a delegation basis in the Besluit and Regeling for rules on retention, destruction and other safeguards, and a sub-delegation for embarkation rules.

35901.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations by a third incidental supplementary budget, adding funds for housing, energy transition in buildings (including 89 million for school ventilation and an emissions-low building products programme) and other articles. It sets the amendment in thousands of euros and makes it effective from 1 September 2021.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement accompanying this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35910.s: The bill introduces a per-kilometre truck charge (vrachtwagenheffing) on designated road sections, collected through private service providers under the EETS framework, with enforcement by designated supervisors and administrative fines. It abolishes the heavy motor vehicle tax, lowers the motor vehicle tax for trucks, and earmarks net revenue for a multi-year innovation and sustainability programme for the transport sector.
35910.j: The memorandum justifies delegation to the Minister and ministerial regulations on the basis of the need for technical detail, EU directive implementation and the need to respond quickly to traffic diversion, with the emergency power limited and tied to a later bill.
q: The bill contains a basis to adjust, in advance of a statutory amendment, by means of a ministerial regulation.
Het wetsvoorstel bevat een grondslag om, vooruitlopend op een wetswijziging, door middel van een ministeriële regeling bij te sturen.
d: start and end of road sections
periods during which device obligations are suspended
use of technical devices and data processing by supervisors
detention, sale and destruction of seized trucks
emergency designation of road sections and zero tariff
p: Supervisors may record vehicle data, photos and onboard unit information with technical devices along roads and process it for enforcement.
The Minister may impose administrative fines with escalating surcharges and enforcement without judicial route for the charge itself.
Supervisors may detain trucks and immobilise them, and the Minister may dispose of vehicles after twelve weeks without recourse to a decision.
Payment obligations are routed to private civil law, excluding administrative law protections such as appeal to the administrative court against the charge.
In emergencies the Minister may change tariffs or set zero tariffs by ministerial regulation, subject to a later bill and an 18-month window.

parties: Asks how to prevent freight shifting to light vehicles and how enforcement capacity will be secured, and whether future cost overruns burden the reinvestment programme.
These members ask the government how the bill can ensure that future setbacks do not burden the reinvestment programme.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe er in het wetsvoorstel voor kan worden gezorgd dat toekomstige tegenvallers niet ten laste komen van de terugsluis.
Opposes the charge as an expensive, burdensome measure and asks about enforcement risks, fraud and defective onboard units.
The PVV members ask the government why it introduces this expensive, technically complicated and paternalistic measure that makes no positive contribution to our economy.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen aan de regering waarom zij deze dure, technisch ingewikkelde en betuttelende maatregel invoert, welke geen positieve bijdrage levert aan onze economie.
Probes enforcement capacity of the ILT, the basis for road designation, privacy of data, and the costs and governance of the system.
How will the government ensure sufficient enforcement capacity, not only through cameras and systems but also roadside enforcement?
Hoe gaat de regering zorgen voor genoeg handhavingscapaciteit, niet alleen via camera's en systemen, maar ook handhaving langs de weg?
Supports the principle but objects to outsourcing a public tax-collection task to commercial providers with limited democratic control, and questions enforceability.
Tax collection is a public task and must also serve a public interest.
Belastingheffing is een publieke taak en dient eveneens een publiek belang.
Supports a truck charge but regrets delay and asks about tariff basis aligned with CO2 and future charging for passenger transport.
These members therefore regret that the charge will only become a reality in 2027 instead of the originally intended 2023–2024.
Deze leden betreuren het daarom dat de heffing pas in 2027 een feit zal zijn, in plaats van de initieel beoogde 2023–2024.
