Welcomes the bill but criticises the lack of a separate zero-emission tariff category and the delayed implementation.
In the current bill, zero-emission vehicles fall in the same tariff category as Euro VI vehicles with combustion engines.
In het huidige wetsvoorstel vallen nul-emissievoertuigen in dezelfde tariefcategorie als Euroklasse VI-voertuigen met een verbrandingsmotor.

Opposes net burden increases and worries the reinvestment will mainly compensate for diesel excise loss; asks for oversight of the process and funding for measures against rat-running on unpriced roads.
This is a disguised way to punish the sector for driving fewer kilometres and therefore not a good incentive.
Dit is een verkapte manier om de sector te straffen voor het rijden van minder kilometers en daarmee geen goede impuls.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet vrachtwagenheffing, a kilometre charge for lorries, raising concerns about alternatives considered, the choice of private-law payment and collection, the statutory role of the transport sector in the multi-year programme, EU law compatibility, and personal data grounds and retention periods. The minister's nader rapport accepts most remarks, amends the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly, but defends the private-law collection route, the EU law compatibility and the link between the MRB reduction and the charge.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether alternatives such as raising the Eurovignet or excise duty were adequately examined, and the minister added explanation to the memorandum while still defending the charge.
The Afdeling argued the tariff differentiation by weight class is too limited relative to the polluter-pays principle; the government defended weight-based differentiation and explained the choice.

The Afdeling argued that payment and collection should follow the administrative law route and that the bill lacked statutory guarantees for the private-law system; the government kept the private-law route but added statutory requirements for invoices, complaints and the service agreement.
The Afdeling noted gaps in the statutory framework for the EETS area declaration; the government added provisions and clarified the framework.

The Afdeling advised dropping the statutory anchoring of the transport sector's role in preparing the multi-year programme, which the government accepted by reframing it under general administrative law.

The Afdeling asked for an explanation of compatibility with the Eurovignette Directive and EU non-discrimination and free movement rules in light of the German toll judgment; the government added explanation but maintained that the charge is compatible.

The Afdeling required an explicit statutory basis for processing personal data through roadside cameras and on-board units and for retention periods for the register; the government added these provisions.
The Afdeling made redactional remarks, which the government adopted, including corrections to references and the explanatory memorandum.

36018.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations by adjusting appropriations, mainly for Groningen earthquake reinforcement and the housing market. It takes effect on 26 January 2022 and is an incidental supplementary budget with no delegation of rule-making power.
36018.j: The memorandum explains that the supplementary budget was announced to parliament in advance and that no reliance is placed on an exceptional budget-law provision, so formal parliamentary authorisation is awaited.
q: In this case formal authorisation by the States General will be awaited.
Hierbij zal gewacht worden op formele autorisatie van de Staten-Generaal.

36036.s: The bill tightens the fight against handling stolen goods and money laundering by amending the Dutch Criminal Code so that dealers and traders in second-hand or unclaimed goods must register purchases in a national digital register (DOR), observe a five-working-day holding period, and report to the municipality via a digital counter (DOL). It also removes the old article 90bis, deletes article 437bis, and delegates detailed rules on the categories of goods, the register, the holding period and the reporting procedure to a general administrative order (AMvB).
36036.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to an AMvB by the need for detailed, uniform technical rules and the Council of State's advisory role, while noting the Constitution permits such delegation for criminal provisions.
q: Criminal provisions such as the present articles 437 and 437ter of the Criminal Code, which are partly elaborated by general administrative order, do not occur often in the Criminal Code, but are not unique either.

Strafbepalingen als de onderhavige artikelen 437 en 437ter Sr die voor een deel bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden uitgewerkt, komen in het Wetboek van Strafrecht niet veel voor, maar zijn ook geen unicum.
d: categories of second-hand goods, register, holding period, reporting rules
Artikel I B (art. 437, lid 1, onder f)
holding period for acquired second-hand goods
digital reporting facility (DOL) and reporting rules for dealers
p: Artikel I B (art. 437, lid 1, onder a, b, e, g-j)
Obliges dealers to register sellers' identifying personal data and to produce records, inspection and documents on request of officials, expanding investigative access to private transaction records.
Centralises mandatory registration of dealers in a national digital system, reducing municipal discretion over the form of the purchase register.

parties: Asks whether the College van procureurs-generaal's concerns about the bill's construction have been resolved, and questions the feasibility of the five-day holding period and the burden on sectors such as scrap and art dealers.
Is it correct, as the College assumes in its advice, that acting in breach of any provision of the new AMvB is made punishable through the newly proposed article 437 Sr?
Klopt het, zoals het College veronderstelt in haar advies, dat het handelen in strijd met enig bepaling van de nieuwe AMvB strafbaar wordt gesteld middels het nieuwe voorgestelde artikel 437 Sr?
Argues parliament should have control over which goods are subject to registration, which is currently delegated to an AMvB, and questions why the holding period is not set in the statute itself.
The members consider it desirable that parliament has control over the specific categories that become subject to registration.
De aan het woord zijnde leden achten het wenselijk dat het parlement zeggenschap heeft over de specifieke categorieën die registratieplichtig worden.
Questions the effectiveness of leaving register use to municipalities and the enforcement capacity of the police, and asks how non-compliance will be detected and prosecuted.
The vast majority of municipalities are on the right track.](Note: the CDA's core concern is on enforcement; the stated evidence reflects the municipal implementation question.)
Het overgrote deel van de gemeenten is op de goede weg.

Supports effective action against handling but worries about proportionality of large-scale data processing of traders' and citizens' personal data, retention periods, and whether online marketplaces are excluded.
Can the government explain to what extent this is proportionate?
Kan de regering uiteenzetten in hoeverre dit proportioneel is?

Asks whether a national digital register is necessary and proportionate, questions data controller responsibilities, and raises concerns about GDPR compliance and the free movement of goods and services.
Especially given the high share of bona fide transactions, the question is whether this is proportionate (necessary).
Zeker gelet op het hoge percentage van bona fide transacties, is het de vraag of dit propor tioneel (noodzakelijk) is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill strengthening the fight against handling stolen goods and money laundering by nationally standardising registration, reporting and retention duties for second-hand goods dealers, asking for justification of the four-year data retention period and of the bill's compatibility with EU free movement and the Services Directive. The government's reply accepted the advice and amended the explanatory memorandum to better justify the retention period and address EU law aspects.
concerns: The retention period of four years for registered data in the Digitaal opkopersregister needs substantive justification under the GDPR necessity principle, which the explanatory memorandum lacked.
The explanatory memorandum must address the bill's relationship to EU free movement rules and the Services Directive and justify the duties as necessary and proportionate.

36063.s: The bill amends the Dutch international tax assistance act to implement EU Directive 2021/514 on administrative cooperation, including new reporting duties for digital platform operators, rules on joint audits, and data-breach procedures. It also adds administrative fines for intentional or grossly negligent non-compliance by platform operators and extends the exchange of information with other states.
36063.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as a way to keep the detailed verification rules strictly aligned with the EU directive without adding requirements beyond it.
q: These collection and verification requirements will be included in a general administrative order, closely following Directive (EU) 2021/514 and imposing no requirements beyond those the directive prescribes.

Deze verzamel- en verificatievereisten worden opgenomen in een algemene maatregel van bestuur, waarbij strikt wordt aangesloten bij Richtlijn (EU) 2021/514 en geen andere vereisten worden gesteld dan die richtlijn voorschrijft.
d: verification and collection requirements for reporting platform operators
rules on how platform data is provided to the Minister
p: Allows the Minister to conduct joint audits with foreign tax authorities on Dutch taxpayers, with the foreign officials' conduct bounded by Dutch law.
Empowers the Minister to impose administrative fines on platform operators for intentional or grossly negligent non-compliance, up to the sixth fine category.

parties: Asks whether Dutch reporting can be kept simple, whether the switch-off mechanism and comparable-information assessment are workable, and how the cost of the measure relates to expected revenue.
The VVD members are shocked by the implementation assessment submitted with the bill.</br>
De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn geschrokken over de uitvoeringstoets die bij het wetsvoorstel is ingediend.

Asks how foreign tax authorities might act on their own initiative against Dutch citizens, how abuse of power by other states is prevented, and how Dutch fiscal sovereignty and data sharing with third parties are safeguarded.
The PVV members also want to know to what extent Dutch fiscal sovereignty is undermined by implementing this directive.
De leden van de PVV-fractie willen ook weten in hoeverre de Nederlandse fiscale soevereiniteit wordt ondermijnd met de implementatie van deze richtlijn.
Questions whether the switch-off mechanism is a deliberate loophole, whether privacy is violated, and whether the reporting system is watertight and should be made binding.
The SP members ask the government whether there is a privacy violation and to what extent.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering of er sprake is van privacy schending en in welke mate.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending the Wet op de internationale bijstandsverlening bij de heffing van belastingen to implement EU Directive 2021/514 on administrative cooperation in tax matters (digital platform data exchange). The Afdeling made no remarks and advised submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer; the government's nader rapport notes only minor redactional and technical changes.

36081.s: The bill extends the operation of articles 2c and 4 of the Wet verplaatsing bevolking (Population Relocation Act), which were activated in March 2022 to address the reception of Ukrainian displaced persons. It also amends article 4 to clarify the basis for ministerial regulations, deletes articles 12 and 15, and removes references to Commissarissen Verplaatsing Bevolking from article 18.
36081.j: The memorandum justifies the extension by the exceptional scale of displaced persons from Ukraine, which it calls a national crisis requiring deviation from existing structures.
q: There is indeed a national crisis regarding the reception of displaced persons from Ukraine, which may affect every municipality and safety region.
Er is immers sprake van een landelijke crisis ten aanzien van de opvang van ontheemden uit Oekraïne, die elke gemeente en veiligheidsregio kan raken
d: tasks of the mayor regarding displaced persons, set by ministerial regulation
p: Extends the operation of emergency articles 2c and 4 without a new end date, keeping executive emergency powers in force beyond the original activation.
Allows ministerial regulations to set rules on the mayor's tasks in place of ministerial directives, widening executive rule-making without parliamentary involvement.
Deletes article 12 on subsidies to municipalities, which removes a statutory basis that the memorandum says is replaced by general rules.

parties: Questions whether the Wvb, designed for other circumstances, is a valid basis for emergency powers and whether a separate law is needed.
Can the government explain and justify why this law currently provides a correct basis for activating the powers arising from it in these circumstances?
Kan de regering toelichten en onderbouwen waarom deze wet op dit moment in deze omstandigheid een juiste grondslag biedt voor het activeren van bevoegdheden die uit deze wet voortvloeien?
Asks why regular asylum seekers cannot fall under the law and what has been done on long-term reception capacity.
Can the government explain why it is not possible to bring regular asylum seekers within the scope of this law?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom het niet mogelijk is reguliere asielzoekers binnen de reikwijdte van deze wet te laten vallen?
Demands a guarantee that no private properties will be requisitioned from businesses, municipalities or citizens for refugee reception.
These members want the government to guarantee that no properties will be requisitioned from businesses, municipalities and/or citizens for the reception of refugees.
Deze leden willen van de regering de garantie krijgen dat er geen panden worden gevorderd van bedrijven, gemeenten en/of burgers ten behoeve van de opvang van vluchtelingen.
Asks when the government will consider invoking further emergency powers such as requisitioning vacant properties, and when the temporary measure will end.
The CDA members note that the government states this statutory task of the mayor is currently not accompanied by activation of (further) emergency statutory powers.

De leden van de CDA-fractie merken op dat de regering aangeeft dat deze wettelijke taak van de burgemeester op dit moment nietgepaard gaat met de activering van (verdergaande) noodwettelijke bevoegdheden.
Stresses that emergency law must be used with restraint, questions the necessity and choice of this instrument over faster ordinary legislation, and doubts the vague end criterion.
As said, emergency law must be used with restraint. Why did the government nonetheless choose this instrument?
Zoals gezegd moet het noodrecht terughoudend worden ingezet. Waarom is de keuze van de regering dan toch op dit middel gevallen?
Asks why problems in regular asylum reception did not justify emergency law and what criteria govern use of available emergency powers.
These members ask the government to explain why these problems have not given rise to activating state emergency law.
Deze leden vragen de regering uiteen te zetten waarom deze problemen geen aanleiding hebben gevormd om staatsnoodrecht te activeren.
Asks what the decisive reason was to use the Wvb now when it was not used in earlier refugee crises, and whether a sunset clause was considered.
What makes it necessary to use this law now but not in earlier refugee crises?
Wat maakt dat er nu wel een noodzaak is tot inzet van deze wet, maar in eerdere vluchtelingencrises niet?
Objects that parliament was not informed beforehand and that less parliamentary control results; asks for an escalation ladder and questions proportionality given the law's original purpose.
The SGP members note that with the introduction of emergency law there is also less say for parliament.
De leden van de SGP-fractie constateren dat met het instellen van het noodrecht er ook minder zeggenschap voor het parlement is.
Questions the necessity of emergency law when alternatives such as state property and holiday parks were available, and asks about the scope of forced relocation and requisitioning.
They question its necessity because emergency law may only be used with the greatest possible restraint.
Zij stellen vraagtekens bij de noodzaak ervan omdat noodrecht alleen met de grootst mogelijke terughoudendheid mag worden ingezet.
Argues the situation is not a genuine emergency, that the measure disproportionately infringes property rights and legal certainty, and that the asylum crisis stems from government failure.
The BBB member has taken note of the bill before us.
Het lid van de BBB-fractie heeft kennisgenomen van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises on a bill extending the operation of articles 2c and 4 of the Wvb (Population Relocation Act) for the Ukrainian refugee crisis, raising points on emergency-law justification, duration, the legal basis of the Ministerial Regulation, and proposed amendments to articles 12, 15 and 18. The government's reply largely accepts the points on justification, duration and the legal basis (amending article 4(2) to clarify the delegation), but maintains the technical amendments to articles 12, 15 and 18 and explains why they must be included in this bill.
concerns: The Council requires a fuller justification of the extraordinary circumstances and why regular law is insufficient for emergency invocation; the government added explanation to the memorandum.
The Council notes article 4(2) Wvb lacks a clear delegation basis for a ministerial regulation; the government amends the article to make the delegation explicit.
The Council asks clarification of when the emergency measures will be reversed; the government explains the conditions but states that the duration is tied to regular structures being restored.
The Council questions whether article 2c extends the ministerial power under article 4; the government argues it is not an extension but use of the Act as intended by the legislature.
The Council advises deferring and removing the proposed amendments to articles 12, 15 and 18 as unsuited to a continuation act; the government keeps them as necessary and linked to activation.

36100-III.s: This Slotwet (final budget adjustment act) amends the 2021 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Royal Cabinet, the Commission for Oversight of Intelligence and Security Services, and the agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie, showing realised spending against budgeted amounts. The memorandum explains the underspending as due to lower-than-expected ICT and travel costs, vacancies and COVID-19 effects.
q: This is caused by an incompletely filled staff establishment, COVID-19 and lower ICT expenditure than originally expected.
Dit wordt veroorzaakt door een niet volledig bezette formatie, COVID-19 en lagere ICT-uitgaven dan oorspronkelijk verwacht.

36108.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) through a third incidental supplementary budget concerning the Air France-KLM share issue. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect from 16 June 2022, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2022
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB), alle voor het jaar 2022

parties: Asks the government to explain the claimed public interest and the benefits of a 9.3 percent stake versus 2 percent, and whether conditions on bonuses can be set.
The government states that maintaining the Dutch stake at 9.3 percent concerns a public interest. Can the government explain this further?
Het op peil houden van het Nederlandse belang op 9,3 procent betreft volgens de regering een publiek belang. Kan de regering dit nader toelichten?
Asks how the proceeds will be used, when state support will be fully repaid, and whether the forthcoming participation framework will be applied to this transaction.
Is the proposed transaction being assessed against the criteria of that future framework, these members ask.
Wordt de voorliggende transactie bekeken met de criteria uit dat toekomstige afwegingskader, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks detailed questions on share prices, repayment of state loans, the bonus of the CEO and the share of proceeds used to repay French state capital.
The PVV members want to know whether this is true and what it means.
De leden van de PVV-fractie willen weten of dit kopt en wat dit betekent.
Doubts the public interest of preventing dilution and asks how the government will address excessive executive bonuses and the corporate culture.

The CDA members are concerned about the corporate culture in light of the remuneration policy and note that with the current nine percent stake the Netherlands has not succeeded in preventing undesirable developments such as excessive executive bonuses.

De leden van de CDA-fractie maken zich zorgen over de bedrijfscultuur in het licht van het beloningsbeleid en constateren dat Nederland er met het huidige belang van negen procent niet in geslaagd is ongewenste ontwikkelingen zoals te hoge bonussen voor bestuurders tegen te houden.
Says the state's current stake has had little influence, questions the public interest, and asks for a more active shareholder role on bonuses, workers, sustainability and hub policy.
These members have repeatedly noticed in recent years that the current position of the Dutch State within Air France-KLM has been anything but decisive.
Deze leden hebben de afgelopen jaren meermaals gemerkt dat de huidige positie van de Nederlandse Staat binnen Air France-KLM allesbehalve doorslaggevend is geweest.

Uncomfortable with investing public money in a company with poor working conditions and bonuses, but accepts the argument of a full voice at the table; asks about compliance with the 2020 rescue conditions.

These members find it difficult to explain why 220 million euros of public money should now be put into a company that does not behave according to the standards expected of a partly state-owned company.

Het is volgens deze leden lastig uit te leggen om nu 220 miljoen euro aan publiek geld in een bedrijf te steken dat zich niet gedraagt volgens normen die van een bedrijf (dat deels in staatshanden is) verwacht mogen worden.
Asks for a cost-benefit analysis, measurable results of the earlier stake, and whether the investment is consistent with the climate crisis and the Comptabiliteitswet.
The GroenLinks members ask whether the government can explain the added value of this investment by means of a cost-benefit analysis according to the broad welfare principle.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen of de regering middels een kosten-batenanalyse volgens het brede welvaartsprincipe, de meerwaarde van deze investering toe kan lichten.
Says the justification under the Comptabiliteitswet is seriously inadequate on public interest, effectiveness and climate, and questions budget cover and the deadline for a parliamentary decision.

The content of the letter, as well as the separately attached justification of the policy choice, falls seriously short on a number of important points such as necessity, public interest, effectiveness of the instrument, efficiency, consistency and secondary effects.

De inhoud van de brief, alsmede de apart bijgevoegde onderbouwing van de beleidskeuze, schieten schromelijk tekort op een aantal belangrijke punten zoals noodzaak, publiek belang, effectiviteit van het middel, efficiëntie, consistentie en secundaire effecten.
Asks what the earlier stake delivered, why the government now sees a public interest in keeping the stake when it accepted dilution last year, and whether a higher stake was considered.
Can the government make clear why a decline from 14 percent to 9.3 percent does not harm this public interest, but a further decline would?
Kan de regering inzichtelijk maken waarom een afname van 14 procent naar 9,3 procent dit publieke belang niet schaadt, maar een verdere afname wel?
Objects that the cost is not covered and adds to public debt, asks why the promised budgetary cover was not provided, and asks about expected returns and share price risk.
Is it correct that the costs are entirely charged to the national debt, so that the costs are in effect shifted to the future?
Klopt het dat de kosten geheel ten laste komen van de staatsschuld, waarmee de kosten feitelijk door worden geschoven naar de toekomst?

36126.s: The bill amends the Wet studiefinanciering 2000 so that the student transport product is no longer loaded onto an OV-chipkaart but linked to a technology-neutral carrier defined by ministerial regulation. It also shifts technical details such as carriers, linking methods and termination procedures to ministerial regulation to make the law future-proof.
36126.j: The memorandum justifies delegating technical details to ministerial regulation so that rules can be adjusted quickly when payment technology changes.
q: When new carriers are introduced for students or other technical changes occur in the OV payment systems, the laws and regulations on the travel allowance can be adjusted more quickly if needed.

Op het moment dat er voor studenten nieuwe dragers bij komen of er andere technische wijzigingen plaatsvinden in de OV-betaalsystemen, kan de wet- en regelgeving rondom de reisvoorziening (indien nodig) sneller worden aangepast.
d: Artikel I, E (artikel 3.25, tweede lid, en 3.24, vijfde lid WSF 2000)
designation of carriers and method of linking the travel product
Artikel I, G (artikel 3.27, achtste lid WSF 2000)
manner in which the travel product is terminated
Artikel I, E (artikel 3.24, vijfde lid WSF 2000)
rules on application and granting of cash travel allowance and implementation rules
p: Core technical rules for the travel product and carriers are moved from the statute to ministerial regulation, reducing parliamentary control over these details.

parties: Praises the government's proactive approach and technology-neutral legislation; has no further questions or remarks.
They compliment the government on the proactive approach and the aim of technology-neutral legislation.
Zij complimenteren de regering met de proactieve aanpak en het streven naar techniekonafhankelijke wetgeving.
Asks when DUO will pass on to the Regisseur Studenten Reisrecht that a student no longer has travel rights, and how retroactive deregistration fines are being prevented.
The CDA members would like to know when DUO will proceed to this.
De leden van de CDA-fractie willen graag weten wanneer DUO hier toe over gaat.
Asks in which cases students must still stop their product themselves, when DUO notifies the RSR, and how communication to students will be concretely organised.
They see this amendment as a positive change and it is important that it is well communicated to students.
De leden van de SP-fractie zien deze wetswijziging als een positieve verandering en het is belangrijk dat deze wijziging goed wordt gecommuniceerd naar studenten.

Asks why automatic stopping via the backoffice is not possible when a student is not enrolled, and whether leniency can be shown during the transition period for students who forget to stop an old OV-chipkaart and receive fines.
Is it possible during the transition period to be more lenient toward students who use an old OV-chipkaart and forget to stop it, and as a result receive a fine?

Is het mogelijk om gedurende de overgangsperiode coulanter te zijn voor studenten die gebruikmaken van een oude OV-chipkaart en deze vergeten stop te zetten en hierdoor te maken krijgen met een boete?
Asks what more the minister can do to reduce OV fines, including whether the product can be stopped automatically when its validity expires.
The ChristenUnie members ask the minister what more he can do to further reduce the number of OV fines on this point.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen de Minister wat hij nog meer kan doen om het aantal OV-boetes op dit punt verder terug te dringen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill amending the Wet studiefinanciering 2000 to introduce new payment methods in public transport raises no remarks and may be submitted to the House of Representatives. The minister's reply notes only a minor adjustment to the explanatory memorandum following DUO's final implementation test.

36135.s: The bill amends article 19(7) of the Zorgverzekeringswet so that the mandatory health insurance deductible stays frozen at its current level for the years 2023 through 2025 rather than being indexed. It enters into force on a date set by royal decree.
36135.j: The memorandum explains the indexation mechanism and that increases occur by ministerial regulation when the indexed amount differs by at least EUR 5, but the bill itself only freezes the amount.
q: The third paragraph contains the delegation basis for the actual increase of the mandatory deductible by ministerial regulation.
Het derde lid bevat de delegatiegrondslag voor de daadwerkelijke verhoging van het verplicht eigen risico bij ministeriële regeling.

parties: Supports the freeze and per-treatment payment in principle but asks for the status of monitoring cumulation of co-payments and timing of the first monitor.
Those members are curious about the state of affairs on this point and when they expect the first monitor.
Genoemde leden van zijn benieuwd naar de stand van zaken op dit punt en wanneer zij de eerste monitor verwachten kunnen.
Asks the government to explain its trade-offs, to show how it monitors whether people avoid necessary care, and to share the underlying projections.
Can the government indicate how this balance is made transparent?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe dit evenwicht inzichtelijk wordt gemaakt?

Supports the freeze but asks how many financially vulnerable elderly people wrongly do not receive the healthcare allowance and whether allowances should be granted automatically, as the Ombudsman advised.
The CDA members ask whether the government can indicate how many of these financially vulnerable elderly people wrongly do not receive the healthcare allowance.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de regering kan aangeven hoeveel van deze financieel kwetsbare ouderen ten onrechte geen zorgtoeslag ontvangen.
Calls the deductible an unjust penalty for being ill that should be abolished, and criticises financing the freeze through higher premiums rather than fiscal or income-based options.
However, they maintain that the deductible is an unjust penalty for being ill, which should be abolished as soon as possible.
Wel blijven zij van mening dat het eigen risico een onrechtvaardige boete is op ziek zijn, die zo snel mogelijk moet worden afgeschaft.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advised that the bill freezing the mandatory deductible (eigen risico) until 2025 needs a better justification, since the freeze weakens the cost-containing effect and is untargeted toward low- and middle-income chronically ill people. The minister's reply defends the freeze, points to existing measures such as the healthcare allowance and municipal support, and adds clarifications to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The freeze undermines the cost-containing (remgeldeffect) of the deductible and makes the goal of controlling healthcare cost growth harder, which the explanatory memorandum should address.

The freeze is untargeted, benefiting all insured persons although the problem concerns a specific group of low- and middle-income chronically ill people, so a more targeted measure would be preferable.
The explanatory memorandum should be supplemented with a fuller motivation of the choice for the freeze over other instruments.

36144.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund through a second incidental supplementary budget, shifting spending and commitment amounts across materiel and infrastructure articles and adding a 1,095,000 thousand euro commitment on the Air materiel and Infrastructure lines. It takes effect on 1 May 2022 with retroactive effect provisions if published later.
36144.j: The memorandum excerpt justifies the change by explaining that the manufacturer's altered MQ-9 configuration requires ordering four aircraft with the same configuration before a deadline, without a delegation justification.
q: The Netherlands has until 31 August to order four MQ-9 aircraft with the same configuration from the US MQ-9 Program Office, with delivery planned for 2025.

Nederland heeft tot uiterlijk 31 augustus aanstaande de mogelijkheid om bij het Amerikaanse MQ-9 Program Office vier MQ-9 toestellen te bestellen met dezelfde configuratie, waarbij levering is voorzien in 2025.

36153.s: The bill amends the Dutch implementing act for the EU evidence regulation to adapt it to the recast Regulation 2020/1783, including new rules for designating courts, digital communication and attendance at cross-border evidence-taking via video links. It also sets out which Dutch courts handle incoming and outgoing evidence requests and empowers the Minister and the executive to set further rules by ministerial regulation and general administrative order.
36153.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to flesh out digitalisation and central authority tasks, which the EU regulation leaves to national implementation.
q: By ministerial regulation of Our Minister for Legal Protection, further rules may be laid down on how the central authority carries out its tasks under Article 4(1) and (3) of the regulation.

Bij regeling van Onze Minister voor Rechtsbescherming kunnen nadere regels worden gesteld met betrekking tot de wijze waarop het centraal orgaan zijn taken, bedoeld in artikel 4, eerste en derde lid, van de verordening, uitvoert.
d: how the central authority performs its tasks

parties: Asks whether sufficient consultation, time and attention exist for IT connection to e-CODEX and how implementation decisions are taken, and whether transitional law is needed.
The VVD members, following several consulted organisations, ask whether there is sufficient consultation, time and attention to enable the connection of IT systems to e-CODEX.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen in navolging van een aantal geconsulteerde organisaties of er voldoende overleg, tijd en aandacht is om de aansluiting van IT-systemen op e-CODEX mogelijk te maken.

Asks why the Dutch Data Protection Authority was not consulted, whether it is involved in the technical design, how Dutch procedural safeguards for hearings at embassies are ensured, and how Parliament can be informed in advance, possibly via a Council of State advice.
Can the government explain why the Dutch Data Protection Authority was not asked for advice in preparing this bill?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens niet om advies is gevraagd in de voorbereiding van dit wetsvoorstel?
Has no further questions at this stage.
The CDA members have taken note of the bill and for now have no further questions.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetvoorstel en hebben vooralsnog geen verdere vragen.

Questions the regulation applying since 1 July before technical e-CODEX connection is ready, and asks how the quality of hearings abroad is guaranteed and which problem Article I part M solves, with no answers found in the explanatory memorandum.
How is the quality of this form of evidence regulation guaranteed?
Hoe wordt de kwaliteit van deze vorm van bewijsverordening gewaarborgd?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in April 2022 that the explanatory memorandum to the draft implementing act for the Evidence Regulation (EU) 2020/1783 should be supplemented so that it is independently readable, since for seven of nineteen provisions there was no article-by-article commentary. The Minister's reply of June 2022 accepts the point, explains that unchanged articles were reissued without commentary to avoid repetition, and reports that the bill and memorandum were amended accordingly.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum lacks article-by-article commentary for many provisions and should be supplemented so it is independently readable.

36162.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the Protocols of 5 July 2022 on the accession of Finland and Sweden to the North Atlantic Treaty, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: In the government's view these Protocols contain no provisions binding on everyone within the meaning of Articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution.
Naar het oordeel van de regering bevatten deze Protocollen geen een ieder verbindende bepalingen in de zin van de artikelen 93 en 94 van de Grondwet.

parties: Thanks the government for quick documents and has no questions or remarks on the protocols.
They have no questions or comments on this.
Zij hebben hierover geen vragen en opmerkingen.
Has no further questions or remarks at this stage.
These members currently have no further questions or comments.
Deze leden hebben op dit moment geen verdere vragen of opmerkingen.
Asks whether Turkey's human rights violations and detention of political prisoners will be raised, and whether the memorandum could lead to rights violations.
Does the government share the view that the trilateral memorandum between Turkey, Sweden and Finland must not in any way lead to human rights violations in Turkey?
Deelt de regering de opvatting dat het trilaterale memorandum tussen Turkije, Zweden en Finland op geen enkele wijze mag leiden tot mensenrechtenschendingen in Turkije?
Questions the legal basis of the memorandum and whether extradition requests against Kurds respect basic rights and fair legal process.
Can the government ensure that basic human rights and the right to a fair legal process remain guaranteed here, and if so, how?
Kan de regering verzekeren dat basale mensenrechten en het recht op een eerlijke juridische rechtsgang ook hier gewaarborgd blijft en zo ja, hoe kan de regering dit verzekeren?
Asks about NATO effects, accession criteria, military consequences and formal steps remaining before accession takes effect.
Can you explain whether and how Finland and Sweden meet all the accession criteria NATO applies to (potential) new members?
Kunt u toelichten of en op welke wijze Finland en Zweden voldoen aan alle toetredingscriteria die de NAVO hanteert voor (potentiële) nieuwe leden?
Supports accession but considers approval within one day bizarre and wanted more time for parliamentary scrutiny.
He has one remark: the idea that laws of this kind must be approved by the House within a day is bizarre.
Hij heeft één opmerking: het idee dat dit soort wetten binnen een dag door de Kamer goedgekeurd moeten worden, is bizar.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill approving the protocols on Finland's and Sweden's accession to NATO raises no substantive remarks and should be submitted to the House of Representatives. The text contains no separate government reply, as the advice itself found nothing to address.

36171.s: The bill makes it a criminal offence to obtain, disseminate or otherwise make available personal data of another person with the intent to instil fear, cause serious nuisance, or seriously hinder that person in their office or profession (doxing), in both the Dutch Criminal Code and the Caribbean Netherlands code. It also extends criminal investigation powers, such as ordering content to be made inaccessible, to these offences.
36171.j: The memorandum justifies the new offence by the need to protect personal liberty and privacy against intimidation, and argues the investigative powers are proportionate because they apply only to offences carrying pretrial detention and require a rechter-commissaris authorisation.
p: Adding the new offence to the list of offences for which pretrial detention and special investigative powers (such as ordering content made inaccessible) become available extends police and prosecutorial powers, subject to the existing judicial authorisation requirements.

parties: Asks how judges would assess journalistic or whistleblower defences and whether the ernstige overlast qualifier is necessary, raising questions about judicial assessment of the offence.
What tools does the judge have for such defences to assess whether there is a 'misconduct' that could not otherwise have been exposed other than through doxing?
Welke handvatten heeft de rechter bij zulke verweren om te beoordelen of er sprake is van een «misstand» die op geen andere manier aan de kaak kon worden gesteld dan via doxing?
Supports criminalisation but questions whether civil procedures for takedown are fast enough and raises concerns about enforcement capacity.
Can the government explain why it considers no additional investment necessary?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom zij geen additionele investeringen noodzakelijk acht?
Questions the added value over existing offences, the data-minimisation obligations, and whether victims are helped quickly enough to remove material.
To what extent does the criminal offence of doxing really add anything to the Public Prosecution Service's arsenal for punishing unwanted (online) behaviour?
In hoeverre voegt het strafbare feit doxing nu echt nog iets toe aan het arsenaal van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) om ongewenst (online) gedrag te bestraffen?
Asks whether journalists need an explicit exemption and how the prosecutor's order to make data inaccessible relates to self-regulation and speed.
Raises concerns about the vague scope of 'obtaining' data and its effects on investigative journalists, and asks for non-criminal measures to make criminal law the ultimum remedium.
Can the government further indicate how this group is protected within the present bill?
Kan de regering nader aangeven hoe deze groep beschermd is binnen voorliggend wetsvoorstel?
Questions the enforceability of criminalising merely obtaining personal data, the scope of the offence for sharing with a requester, and police capacity.
Intimidating purposes only become apparent after the data is distributed or otherwise made available, so control is practically impossible.
Intimiderende doeleinden openbaren zich pas na het verspreiden of anderszins ter beschikking stellen van persoonsgegevens van een ander of een derde.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory opinion supports criminalising the use of personal data for intimidating purposes (doxing) but advises narrowing the scope, dropping the 'zich verschaffen' element, removing the justification ground, better motivating enforcement capacity and Caribbean Netherlands aspects. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts most points: it adds examples and enforcement motivation, drops the justification ground and the 'zich verschaffen' element is retained, and adds Caribbean and consultation details.
concerns: The scope of the offence is very broad and needs separate justification for doxing unrelated to a person's office, profession or social function.
Retaining 'zich verschaffen' in the offence lacks added value and raises evidentiary problems; the Afdeling advised dropping it.
The justification ground for good-faith public-interest actors is unnecessary and may confuse application; the Afdeling advised removing it.
Expected enforcement and capacity costs are insufficiently motivated given the broad offence; a fuller justification and an invoeringstoets after one year were advised.
The internet consultation responses should be reported in the explanatory memorandum.
Caribbean Netherlands aspects should be addressed, the relevant BES articles cited and the title should name the BES codes.

36207.s: The bill adds a fifth paragraph to article 28 of the Invorderingswet 1990 allowing an algemene maatregel van bestuur to specify cases and conditions in which no collection interest is charged because of exceptional circumstances. It also extends existing references in the Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen and the Mijnbouwwet so that the implementing decree applies there too, effective 1 January 2023.
36207.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need to act quickly in exceptional circumstances, since amending an amvb is faster than amending a statute.
q: To respond more quickly to the wish not to charge collection interest in cases of exceptional circumstances, it is proposed to amend the Invorderingswet 1990 on this point.

Om sneller te kunnen inspelen op de wens om in geval van uitzonderlijke omstandigheden geen invorderingsrente in rekening te brengen, wordt voorgesteld de Invorderingswet 1990 (IW 1990) op dit punt te wijzigen.
d: cases and conditions for waiving collection interest
p: Allows an algemene maatregel van bestuur to define exceptions to the statutory duty to charge collection interest, with no parliamentary approval or stated limits on the conditions set.

parties: Asks for concrete examples of exceptional circumstances, the assessment criteria, and whether they will change after the law takes effect.
Furthermore, these members ask what assessment criteria exist regarding 'exceptional circumstances'?
Voorts vragen deze leden welke toetsingscriteria bestaan ten aanzien van «uitzonderlijke omstandigheden»?
Objects that the exceptional circumstances are not set out in the statute itself and asks how the Chamber will be involved in the delegated regulation.
These members ask whether those circumstances should not in fact be formulated in this law itself.
Deze leden vragen of die omstandigheden juist niet in deze wet zouden moeten worden geformuleerd.
Supports the purpose of the law without raising specific objections in this text.
These members endorse the purpose of the law.
Deze leden onderschrijven het doel van de wet.
Asks whether the power to suspend collection interest could be used more often than desirable and whether it should be limited to a collection pause.
Has the government considered shaping this measure so that it applies only to situations involving a collection pause?
Heeft de regering overwogen deze maatregel zodanig vorm te geven dat de maatregel alleen van toepassing is op situaties waarin sprake is van een invorderingspauze?
Asks why no evaluation provision is included and whether a review after some years of the use of the delegated power would be desirable.
The members of the ChristenUnie faction ask why no evaluation provision has been included.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen waarom niet voorzien is in een evaluatiebepaling.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft bill (Belastingplan 2023 package, AOW and kindgebonden budget measures) and found no remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport simply transmits the advice and the bill, with no substantive reply needed.

36216.s: The bill amends numerous social security, labour, housing enforcement, childcare and related statutes, mostly technical wording corrections, with some substantive changes such as extending maternity leave for multiple births, expanding childcare supervision, and allowing a ministerial regulation to set the duration of a temporary increase of the garnishment-free amount. It also grants the Labour Inspectorate and other bodies expanded data-processing and information-gathering powers.
36216.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial delegation for the garnishment-relief period by the need to respond quickly to housing market developments, which statute cannot do flexibly.
q: Through delegation to the Minister of Social Security and Employment it is better possible to respond timely to developments in the housing market and adjust the duration of the period where necessary.

Door delegatie aan de Minister van Sociale Zekerheid en Werkgelegenheid is het beter mogelijk om tijdig in te spelen op ontwikkelingen op de woningmarkt en waar nodig de duur van de termijn aan te passen.
d: duration of temporary increase of garnishment-free amount
rules on exemption from learnability test
ARTIKEL XIII (art. 2:16 lid 4 and 3:19 lid 13 Wajong)
indefinite application of income exemption to designated groups of young disabled people
possible further rules on premium reduction (implied by design)
annual adjustment of garnishment-free amounts by publication in Staatscourant
Minister may set deadline for providing information and demand inspection of records
rules on transfer and processing of health data
possible extension of maternity leave via administrative determination of hospitalisation days
p: Expands the Labour Inspectorate's ability to process citizens' data, including civil service numbers and health data, for supervisory purposes.
ARTIKEL VIII and IX (BES ouderdoms- en weduwenverzekering)
Obliges persons to provide information to the Minister on request, including identification numbers, with no stated limits on scope.
Lets the Minister set the period for temporary garnishment relief by ministerial regulation rather than statute.
Extends child benefit eligibility to non-foreign children without requiring lawful residence, broadening executive discretion in eligibility.

parties: Asks whether the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens was consulted on balancing privacy against the value of a good report by the Arbeidsinspectie.
The VVD members ask whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority was consulted in weighing the protection of individuals' privacy against the importance of drafting a good report.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen zich af of de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens heeft meegedacht bij de afweging tussen de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van betrokkenen enerzijds en het belang van het opstellen van een goed verslag.

Asks for safeguards on representativeness and balance in combined childcare parent committees and on the quality of inspections of host-family care, and whether lower regulation would be more appropriate.
In addition, these members ask about safeguards to ensure the representativeness and balance of decision-making in a combined parent committee.
In aanvulling daarop vragen deze leden naar waarborgen om de representativiteit en de evenwichtigheid van de besluitvorming in een gecombineerde oudercommissie te waarborgen.
Asks why the SVB proposal on shared housing costs was not adopted in the Verzamelwet.
Why did the government not adopt this SVB proposal in the present Verzamelwet, ask these members.
Waarom heeft de regering dit voorstel van de SVB niet overgenomen in onderhavige Verzamelwet, zo vragen deze leden.

Asks how risk-based inspection prioritisation based on personal data avoids discriminatory effects, and why the words 'in redelijkheid' were not removed despite the Raad van State advice; also asks how debtors learn of a higher exempt amount.
The GroenLinks members ask how the government prevents risk-based prioritisation of inspections based on personal data from operating in a discriminatory way.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen hoe de regering voorkomt dat een risicogerichte prioritering van de inspecties op basis van persoonsgegevens discriminerend werkt.
Objects that a political choice to intensify childcare supervision is placed in an omnibus bill and questions the motivation for intensified supervision before sector professionalisation.
Does the government agree with these members that such a political choice does not belong in an omnibus bill, which should contain only uncontested intentions and technical amendments?

Is de regering het met deze leden eens dat een dergelijke politieke keuze niet thuishoort in een verzamelwet, waarin enkel onomstreden voornemens en technische wijzigingen een plaats horen te krijgen?
Asks whether consent of the worker should be a necessary condition for recording identifiable data in the inspectorate's report, or at least a right to object.
Given this large individual interest of the worker, why was necessary consent of the worker not chosen?
Waarom is er gezien dit grote individuele belang van de werknemer niet gekozen voor een noodzakelijke toestemming van de werknemer?
Has taken note of the bill without further input.
The BBB member has taken note of the amendments to several laws of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and several laws of other ministries (Verzamelwet SZW 2023), but has no further input.

Het lid van de BBB-fractie heeft kennisgenomen van de Wijziging van enkele wetten van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid alsmede enkele wetten van andere ministeries (Verzamelwet SZW 2023), maar heeft verder geen inbreng.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised the minister to better justify the proposed softening of the irreducibility requirement for NLA reports under the Waadi and Wet AVV, weighing workers' interests, and to adjust the bill if needed. The government's reply rejects the call for worker consent to be decisive, argues GDPR grounds rest on a public task and that privacy is adequately protected, and adds clarifications and technical changes.
concerns: Privacy of workers and job seekers could be unduly harmed by allowing identifiable data in NLA reports without consent; government holds protection sufficient and consent not decisive.
The proposed softening of the irreducibility requirement was insufficiently motivated; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented with examples and proportionality/subsidiarity reasoning.
Justification of the proposal in relation to the GDPR was requested; the government reframed the legal basis as a public-interest task and added explanation.
Redactional remark to delete 'in redelijkheid' in the Wet kinderopvang provision was addressed, with the government explaining retention for gastouderopvang.

36225.s: The bill creates a legal framework for multi-agency case consultations (casusoverleg) on the person-focused approach to radicalisation and terrorist activities, allowing participating bodies such as municipalities, police, prosecutors, probation and the Child Protection Board to share and jointly process personal data, including sensitive data. It sets safeguards such as a screening weegploeg, retention limits, audits, a legality advisory committee and confidentiality, and amends the Wet politiegegevens and the Wet justitiële en strafvorderlijke gegevens to allow data flows to these consultations.
36225.j: The memorandum justifies the data-sharing powers by the need for effective multidisciplinary cooperation against radicalisation and terrorism, and the proportionality of the interference with privacy given the safeguards.
q: The bill limits which data may be processed by whom and under what conditions, and requires a weegploeg to assess beforehand whether a case discussion is needed and with which participants.

Het wetsvoorstel begrenst welke gegevens door wie onder welke voorwaarden mogen worden verwerkt, en vereist dat een weegploeg voorafgaand aan een mogelijke casusbespreking toetst of bespreking nodig is, en met welke deelnemers.
d: further rules on participants' legal tasks and powers
weegploeg may admit third parties on an incidental basis
rules on joint controller responsibilities and data subject rights
composition and working method of legality advisory committee
content and execution of privacy audits
p: Creates a standing framework for executive bodies to pool and jointly analyse sensitive personal data on persons linked to radicalisation, with purpose limitation and a deferred annual report as the main constraints.
A police, prosecution and mayor triage team decides on its own, using listed criteria, whether a case is discussed and which parties participate, with only limited external review.
Permits processing of data revealing ethnicity, religious or political beliefs and health, and criminal-law data, where necessary for the consultation's purpose.
Adds new routes for police, prosecution and enforcement data to flow to the consultations, overriding the existing purpose-limitation barriers unless serious reasons oppose it.
Privacy audits are run by the consultation itself, with copies sent to the Data Protection Authority, rather than by an independent external overseer.

parties: Asks whether the bill fits the coalition agreement's approach and how it addresses municipal knowledge gaps and NCTV and DJI participation in case consultations.
These members ask the government whether it shares the view that this bill is consistent with the text and purpose of this passage of the coalition agreement.
Deze leden vragen de regering of zij de mening deelt dat onderhavig wetsvoorstel aansluit bij de tekst en strekking van deze passage van het coalitieakkoord.
Alarmed that data was exchanged for about eight years without a proper statutory basis and asks about possible negative consequences for affected persons.
it is very worrying that apparently for eight years personal data was exchanged without a sound statutory basis.
is het zeer zorgelijk dat er blijkbaar acht jaar lang uitwisseling van persoonsgegevens heeft plaatsgevonden zonder degelijke wettelijke grondslag.
Asks whether participating organisations are a closed list or whether only a necessity criterion applies.
These members ask the government whether there is an exhaustive list of organisations that may take part in the case consultation.
Deze leden vragen aan de regering of er sprake is van een limitatieve lijst van organisaties
Worries that too much data is shared with too many irrelevant bodies and asks why personal data must go to knowledge institutions.
In that light they consider it important to prevent unnecessarily large amounts of data being shared by too many (non-relevant) bodies.
Daarbij achten zij van belang dat moet worden voorkomen dat er onnodig te veel gegevens worden gedeeld door te veel (niet-relevante) instanties.
Supports a specific statutory regime but stresses care with sensitive, uncertain information and asks whether a legality advisory committee like the WGS should be added.
These members therefore ask, following the Council of State and the WGS, whether a legality advisory committee should not be provided for.
Deze leden vragen daarom in navolging van de Afdeling of niet, in navolging van de WGS, voorzien moet worden in een rechtmatigheidsadviescommissie
Asks for clearer boundaries between activism with minor offences and extremism and for a broader definition of terrorist activities, and whether the bill covers online radicalisation.
These members ask the government to set out more clearly when there is activism involving minor offences.
Deze leden vragen de regering helderder te schetsen wanneer sprake is van activisme met lichte overtredingen.
Supports a solid legal basis for existing practice but asks about sharing with third parties, legal persons and the limits of the bill's scope.
These members support the need for a sound statutory basis for the case consultations that already take place.
Deze leden onderschrijven de noodzaak om tot een gedegen wettelijke grondslag te komen voor de casusoverleggen die nu al plaatsvinden.
Asks whether the undefined term terroristic activities satisfies GDPR and ECHR Article 8 foreseeability requirements and whether mayors have the capacity for data protection duties.
That mainly serves the interests of participants in the multidisciplinary case consultations, but conflicts with the interests of persons whose data may be processed.
Dat dient met name het belang van de deelnemers aan de multidisciplinaire casusoverleggen, maar is strijdig met de belangen van eventuele betrokkenen
Fears ethnic profiling and racist decision-making through processing of data on race and ethnic origin and the involvement of child protection, and asks for the ethnicity and race data to be removed.
This member asks the government to delete from the bill the possibility of processing personal data on race and ethnicity.
Dit lid verzoekt de regering om de mogelijkheid die wordt vervaardigd om persoonlijke gegevens omtrent ras en etniciteit te verwerken te schrappen uit het wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised on a draft bill on data processing in the person-oriented approach to radicalisation and terrorism at local case consultations, raising concerns about alignment with the WGS, Zorg- en Veiligheidshuizen, purpose limitation, categories of data, the mayor's coordinating role, private participants, safeguards and the GDPR/Directive relationship. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts most points, amending the bill with safeguards from the WGS, clarifying definitions and participants, and shifting the coordinating role to the mayor.
concerns: Advised clarifying the relationship between this bill, the WGS and the regulation of Zorg- en Veiligheidshuizen to avoid unforeseeable legal frameworks, which the government followed by adding article 21 and aligning safeguards.
Advised aligning safeguards (audits, legality committee, access and security rules, limits on private participants) with the WGS given the sensitivity of data, which the government largely adopted.

Advised clearer definition of the purpose and of the categories of personal data to satisfy purpose limitation; government added objective criteria and a definition of radicalisation but did not define terrorist activities in the statute.
Advised justifying under GDPR article 23 the deviation from the purpose limitation principle; government added a fuller justification in the memorie van toelichting.
Advised specifying in the text the statutory tasks and powers on which participation is based and separating mayor and college as participants; government adopted both.

Questioned whether the coordinating (regie) role should lie with the college rather than the mayor; government reconsidered and assigned the role to the mayor, removing the college from the weegploeg.
Advised clarifying the position of the Minister of Justice and Security as participant and limiting participation of private parties to incidental basis, which the government implemented.
Advised addressing the relationship between the GDPR and Directive (EU) 2016/680; government added explanation that the case consultations fall under the GDPR.
Advised regulating responsibility for handling data-subject requests under joint controllership, which the government addressed through a delegation basis in article 11.

36243.s: The bill bars judges and certain other judicial officials from simultaneously holding a seat in the Senate, House of Representatives or the European Parliament, and extends related incompatibility rules to other judicial positions. It also introduces statutory duties for judicial officials to hold and report certain financial interests, to run an integrity policy, and makes several technical changes to the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie and related acts.
36243.j: The memorandum justifies the new incompatibilities and financial-interest rules by the need to protect judicial independence and integrity, following GRECO recommendations and the judiciary's own guidance.
d: designation of officials required to report financial interests
p: Judicial officials must report financial interests to the functional authority, which designates who is subject to the reporting duty and the financial interests that may not be held.
Artikel V A (art. 5 Wet op de Raad van State, lid 6)
Extends the incompatibility and financial-interest provisions to Administrative Jurisdiction Division members of the Council of State, a limiting safeguard rather than an executive gain.

parties: Asks why an transitional period delays the incompatibility ban until 2029 and how financial-interest reporting will be coordinated and enforced in practice.

These members ask why the government nevertheless chose a transitional period, so that in effect it lasts until the 2029 elections before the bill stops judges from combining the office of European Parliament member with the office of judge.</br>

Deze leden vragen waarom de regering toch gekozen heeft voor een overgangsperiode, waardoor het effectief duurt tot de verkiezingen van 2029 voordat het wetsvoorstel ertoe leidt dat rechters het ambt van Europees Parlementslid niet meer mogen combineren met het ambt van rechter.
Questions why the incompatibility is not extended to municipal councils and provincial states, and asks whether a narrower same-municipality ban was considered.

Can the government further explain why these instruments are not considered sufficient when a judge is a member of the European Parliament or the States General, but are considered sufficient when a judge is a member of a municipal council or provincial states?

Kan de regering nader toelichten waarom deze instrumenten niet toereikend worden geacht indien een rechter lid is van het Europees Parlement of de Staten-Generaal maar wel indien deze lid is van de gemeenteraad of provinciale staten?
Asks how the new reporting duty relates to the existing recusal rules and the impartiality guidance, and whether it risks duplication.
How does the government ensure that this statutory regulation is perhaps duplicative?
Hoe waakt de regering ervoor dat deze wettelijke regeling wellicht dubbelop is?
Wants the case allocation code and the appointment of court board members anchored in statute, a mandatory publication of judgments, and a separate judiciary budget.
Why does the government not choose to elevate the Code for case allocation to statute with this legislative amendment?
Waarom kiest de regering er niet voor om de Code zaakstoedeling bij deze wetswijziging te verheffen tot wet?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the amendments by MPs Helder and Vondeling, extending the judge incompatibility ban to members of provincial states, municipal councils and water boards, lack sufficient justification and would disproportionately restrict passive voting rights, so restraint is advised. The government's reply (nader rapport) agrees, recommends the Tweede Kamer reject the amendments, and asks that affected groups be consulted.
concerns: Extending the incompatibility ban to decentral representatives substantially restricts passive voting rights, which requires overwhelming justification that is absent.
The blanket ban goes further than necessary; existing instruments such as recusal and challenge (verschoning and wraking) are more proportionate.
No sufficient evidence shows existing safeguards fail in practice, so a generic statutory incompatibility is not shown to be necessary.
Constitutional principles of separation of powers, judicial impartiality and passive voting rights are in tension and not clearly resolved by case law.
Affected groups such as municipal councillors and water board members were not consulted before the amendments were proposed.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the bill banning simultaneous service as a judge and as a member of the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer or European Parliament, and the related financial-interest and integrity rules, but asks for a fuller explanatory memorandum on whether these incompatibilities belong in the Constitution, how the exclusion of provincial and municipal councils fits the rationale, and how the European Parliament exclusion relates to EU rules. The government's nader rapport reports that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on each of these points and that the redactional remarks were followed.
concerns: The Afdeling asks whether the incompatibilities should be regulated in the Constitution rather than by ordinary law; the government sees no need to amend Article 57 and supplemented the explanatory memorandum.

The explanatory memorandum should better justify why the incompatibility does not extend to provincial states and municipal councils given the rationale of impartiality and the restriction on passive voting rights.
The explanatory memorandum should address the EU Act on direct elections and whether the national ban on European Parliament membership complies with the conditions for extending incompatibilities.
Redactional remarks on the preamble were adopted, adding 'mede' to the considerans.

36252.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate by enacting the tenth incidental supplementary budget on measures related to high energy prices, in thousands of euros. It sets entry into force at 15 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate for 2022
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

36270.s: The bill gives the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate a statutory task and power to inform, advise and support non-vital businesses on digital vulnerabilities, threats and incidents, including requesting and sharing data (including personal data) with other government bodies. It also restricts disclosure of confidential business data under the Open Government Act and amends the Network and Information Security Act to add this minister as a recipient of shared information.
36270.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary under the legality principle to process information, including personal data, for improving digital resilience, and as a necessary and proportionate measure protecting public security.
q: Processing and disseminating information (including personal data) by the government to improve the digital resilience of non-vital businesses can, in line with the principle of legality, only occur if there is a statutory task underlying it.

Het verwerken en verspreiden van informatie (waaronder persoonsgegevens) door de overheid ten behoeve van de verbetering van de digitale weerbaarheid van niet-vitale bedrijven kan, conform het legaliteitsbeginsel, alleen als er een wettelijke taak aan ten grondslag ligt.
d: entry into force by royal decree, possibly differing per article
p: Allows the minister to request data from legal persons and bodies, and allows them to disclose personal data even where incompatible with the original purpose, without an obligation to comply.
Lets the minister share confidential business data, including without consent of vital providers, with other government bodies and removes such data from Open Government Act disclosure.

parties: Questions whether the DTC has sufficient staff capacity (23 fte for about 2 million entrepreneurs) and whether capacity is measured and evaluated.

Given that the DTC has 23 fte and a target group of 2 million entrepreneurs, these members are concerned about the feasibility and effective implementation of the substantial expansion of information provision.

Gegeven het feit dat het DTC beschikt over 23 fte en het een doelgroep behelst van 2 miljoen ondernemers maken deze leden zich zorgen over de haalbaarheid en effectieve uitvoering van voorliggende substantiële uitbreiding van informatievoorziening.
Asks how the sharing of threat information could leak sensitive data of businesses with insufficient digital security, and what safeguards exist.
The members request the government to explain how this can be prevented.
De leden verzoeken de regering toe te lichten hoe dit voorkomen kan worden.
Asks how the government will ensure the DTC is adequately equipped to inform and help small and medium-sized businesses facing digital threats.
These members ask which steps the government is taking to ensure the Digital Trust Center (DTC) is sufficiently equipped to inform and help vulnerable SMEs facing digital threats.
Deze leden vragen welke stappen de regering zet om ervoor te zorgen dat het Digital Trust Center (DTC) voldoende toegerust is om het kwetsbare mkb te informeren en helpen bij digitale dreigingen.

Questions why the Minister of Economic Affairs needs data-processing powers already assigned to the Minister of Justice and Security, and whether tasks should be consolidated to avoid unnecessary data sharing and unclear responsibility.

Although these members understand that the government sees a difference in roles, they ask whether it would nonetheless be more logical to assign the tasks under this proposal to the Minister of Justice and Security.

Hoewel deze leden begrijpen dat de regering hier een verschil in rollen ziet, vragen zij of het desondanks niet meer voor de hand ligt dat de taken die met dit voorstel bij de Minister van EZK komen te liggen ook worden belegd bij de Minister van JenV.
Argues the bill is redundant because the Wbni already provides powers, and asks the government to withdraw it to reduce regulatory burden.
The BBB member therefore urgently requests the government to withdraw this superfluous bill and thus contribute to the desired reduction of regulatory burden for entrepreneurs and citizens.

Het lid van de BBB-fractie verzoekt de regering dan ook met klem dit overbodige wetsvoorstel in te trekken en zo een bijdrage te leveren aan de zo gewenste vermindering van de regeldruk voor ondernemers en burgers.
Worries the extra DTC task could fragment threat information and asks for a streamlined information channel such as a single desk.
The said members are concerned that the present proposal leads to fragmentation of information and that this could have a counterproductive effect.
Genoemde leden maken zich zorgen dat voorliggend voorstel leidt tot versplintering van informatie en dat dit juist een averechts effect kan hebben.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that a separate statute for the Minister of EZK's digital resilience tasks for non-vital businesses is not necessary, that the bevoegdheid for processing personal data should preferably be placed in the Wbni, and raised issues on overlapping NCSC/DTC analyses, sector expectations, market activities, and data transfers to Caribbean Netherlands. The government replied that it maintains the separate law, clarified the division of tasks, added a legal basis for Caribbean Netherlands data exchange, and updated the explanatory memorandum on several points.
concerns: The Afdeling considered a separate statute unnecessary and preferred placing the personal data powers in the Wbni, which the government did not accept, citing differences in nature, role and target group.
The explanatory memorandum should clarify the relationship with the pending Wbni amendment, which the government addressed by adding explanation.
Overlapping analyses, onderzoeken and adviezen from NCSC and DTC could lead to conflicting advice; the government described separated target groups and cooperation, with the memorandum supplemented.
Expectations in the sector that government information covers cyber risks may undermine businesses' own responsibility; the memorandum was supplemented on this.
Clarify whether the tasks constitute economic activities under the Wet markt en overheid and state aid rules; the government argued they are not economic activities and supplemented the memorandum.
Absence of a legal basis under the AVG for transferring personal data to Caribbean Netherlands; a new article was added and the memorandum addresses AVG compliance.

36306.s: The bill sets nationwide quality, financing and supervision rules for childcare in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including licensing by the island authority, minimum staff qualifications, parental fees and a government childcare allowance. It delegates many detailed rules to general administrative orders (AMvB), ministerial regulations and island ordinances, and gives the island authority power to refuse or revoke licences and close facilities.
36306.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying detailed and frequently changing rules are better set at lower level for flexibility, mirroring the Dutch mainland Wet kinderopvang approach.
q: Where more technical details or parts that change regularly are concerned, subdelegation to the Minister will be chosen.
Waar het gaat om meer technische details of onderdelen die regelmatig wijzigen zal gekozen worden voor subdelegatie aan de Minister.
d: nadere regels on licence application, examination and quality commission
circumstances allowing refusal of childcare contract; contract content
aspects of responsible childcare and tasks of island support
conditions for childcare centres; island rules on language, nutrition, partners
maximum number of subsidised day parts per month on island advice
height and indexation of childcare allowance
administration of records and retention periods
period without extra-support children allowing licence suspension
p: The minister may immediately close a childcare centre or home childcare in whole or part for a period he sets, where a direct and serious danger is found, informing the island authority afterward.
The minister may impose penalty orders and administrative fines on providers, subject to general administrative law procedures.
The minister may grant allowances outside the normal conditions and may amend or withdraw allowances, including recovering amounts paid in error.
Supervisory officials may enter a home where a childcare facility is located without the occupant's consent.

parties: Asks why no labour requirement is included, how the two-tier inspection structure is guaranteed in Caribisch Nederland, and whether the Adviescollege Toetsing Regeldruk advice can be shared with the House.
Why was it deliberately chosen not to include this aspect when setting the frameworks for the childcare system in Caribisch Nederland?
Waarom is er bewust gekozen om dit aspect niet mee te nemen bij de vaststelling van de kaders voor het kinderopvangstelsel in Caribisch Nederland?

Asks how uniform fees are guaranteed to be cost-covering without excess profit, how segregation and unlawful refusals are prevented, how inspectors interpret rules consistently across islands, and how supervision is published.

How is it ensured that the uniform fee is cost-covering, does not lead to excessive profits for providers, is low enough to ensure accessibility, and leaves room for good quality and working conditions for pedagogical staff, these members ask.

Hoe wordt geborgd dat de uniforme vergoeding kostendekkend is, niet leidt tot te hoge winsten van aanbieders, laag genoeg is om toegankelijkheid te verzekeren en ruimte biedt voor goede kwaliteit en arbeidsvoorwaarden voor pedagogisch medewerkers, zo vragen deze leden.
