Supports the bill's aim but asks for the basis of the expectation that funds will be sufficient, for the withheld advice and implementation tests to be sent to the House, and whether differing island rules complicate supervision.
They wholeheartedly support the aim of the bill to stimulate childcare in Caribisch Nederland by improving quality and access.
Zij steunen van harte het doel van het wetsvoorstel om de kinderopvang in Caribisch Nederland te stimuleren door de kwaliteit en de toegang te verbeteren.

Asks about the timing link with Europees Nederland reform, whether the parental fee is sensible when most parents will seek compensation, whether the received responses and implementation tests will be sent to the House, and whether a preliminary-consultation procedure is desirable for delegated rules.

They ask whether the government can send the received responses and carried-out implementation tests to the House, since these are only explained in the explanatory memorandum and cannot be consulted separately.

De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen of de regering de ontvangen reacties en gedane uitvoeringstoetsen naar de Kamer kan sturen, gezien deze enkel worden toegelicht in de memorie van toelichting maar niet apart te raadplegen zijn.

Questions the choice against simple, pragmatic funding and free childcare, doubts the efficiency of collecting parental fees, and asks how large reclaims from parents will be avoided and how the Rijk-openbaar lichaam decision-making on places will work.
The ChristenUnie members have doubts about whether collecting the parental contribution is efficient, effective and purposeful.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie hebben twijfels in hoeverre het innen van de ouderbijdrage doelmatig, efficiënt en effectief is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet kinderopvang BES, raising concerns about the feasibility and enforceability of childcare quality standards on the islands, gastouderopvang, data protection, and the need for an experimental regulation. The minister's reply accepts some points (data protection, experimental safeguards, transitional rules) and rejects others (no longer offering a gastouder ban, no transition period for quality standards, continuing BES(t) 4 kids to 2028 as an accepted measure).
concerns: Doubts about whether the islands can realise the quality standards and the financial and housing preconditions; the minister adds a transitional rule for certain requirements and extends the BES(t) 4 kids programme to 2028 but rejects a general transition period.
Questions about the necessity of an experimental regulation; safeguards and specified purposes and an evaluation clause were added.

Data-protection risks for the processing of child development data; a delegation basis for rules on the transfer to primary education was added and a data protection impact assessment was included in the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling observed unclear added value and effects of the gastouder regulation; the minister kept the regulation and rejected the earlier-proposed possibility for islands to ban gastouderopvang.

36324.s: The bill creates a statutory basis allowing the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen and Douane to disclose confidential data, normally covered by secrecy, to the inspectie belastingen, toeslagen en douane for its oversight tasks. It adds a parallel provision to the Algemene douanewet and the Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen and bars the inspectie from passing confidential data on to third parties.
36324.j: The memorandum justifies the new statutory basis by arguing that a formal legal basis is needed to lift the secrecy obligation for data the inspectorate requires, since customs and benefits law only permits disclosure where a statutory provision requires it.
q: Under the customs and benefits legislation, the information concerned may only be disclosed if the Douane and the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen are required to do so under a statutory provision.

Ingevolge de douane- en de toeslagenwetgeving mag namelijk alleen de bedoelde informatie worden verstrekt indien de Douane en de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen ingevolge een wettelijke bepaling daartoe gehouden is.
p: Artikel I (art. 1:38 Algemene douanewet) and Artikel II (art. 38a Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen, lid 3)
Lifts the secrecy obligation so that tax, benefits and customs data can be passed to the inspectorate for its oversight work, with a ban on onward disclosure to third parties.

parties: Asks why the IBTD was established by ministerial regulation rather than included in the bill, and how the bill relates to the planned rijksinspecties law, and asks for the AP's criticism to be addressed.
Asks whether the IBTD will have enough access to flag structural problems arising from overlap between tax, customs, Toeslagen and Participatiewet benefits.
These members ask whether the IBTD, after this bill takes effect, will also have sufficient access to raise structural problems.
Deze leden vragen of de IBTD na inwerkingtreding van dit wetsvoorstel ook voldoende toegang heeft om structurele problemen aan te kaarten.
Asks how affected persons can exercise their GDPR rights if they may not know their data has been shared with the IBTD, and asks for explicit response to the AP's objections.
These members ask the government to explain how a data subject can exercise such a request if they may not even have been informed that their data was shared with the IBTD.

Deze leden vragen de regering om aan te geven hoe een betrokkene een dergelijk verzoek kan effectueren indien deze mogelijk niet eens op de hoogte is gesteld dat zijn gegevens zijn gedeeld met de IBTD.

Supports full IBTD access for oversight but worries about privacy safeguards, the right to object to processing, possible conflict with EVRM privacy, and unclear scope of confidentiality between officials of the same body.
These members ask what the government can do to remove that unclarity and properly arrange the right to object.
Deze leden vragen wat de regering kan doen om die onduidelijkheid weg te nemen en het recht op bezwaar goed te regelen.
Has no further questions or remarks on the bill.
The members have no further questions or comments.
De leden hebben geen verdere vragen of opmerkingen.
Asks why the bill is necessary given the AP's view that it is unnecessary and that its benefits are limited, and asks for an account of risks weighed against benefits.

Supports the IBTD and simplified information provision in principle, but asks the government to substantively respond to the AP's advice to abandon the bill unless its necessity is convincingly argued, and to the coalition promise on independence of inspectorates.
These members read in the AP's advice the recommendation to abandon the proposal unless its necessity can be convincingly argued.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie lezen in het advies van de AP het advies om «af te zien van het voorstel tenzij de noodzaak ervan overtuigend kan worden beargumenteerd».

Asks how the government views the AP's advice that the IBTD is not an independent body and that data exchange between officials of the same body is not obviously covered by confidentiality, and asks about risks of broader sensitive data exchange within the Ministry of Finance.
In the view of this member, this does however bring risks.
Dit brengt in de ogen van dit lid wel risico's met zich mee.

Welcomes the statutory basis as following the Eerdmans motion, stresses full cooperation in supplying data, asks what happens if data are withheld and asks the government to inform the House, and asks whether the IBTD should have an independent statutory position like other rijksinspecties.
Member Omtzigt emphasizes the importance of full cooperation in providing the necessary data and information that the IBTD requests in the context of investigations.
Het lid Omtzigt benadrukt het belang van volledige medewerking bij het verstrekken van de benodigde gegevens en inlichtingen waar door de IBTD in het kader van onderzoek om wordt gevraagd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises on a bill lifting the confidentiality obligation so that data held by the Toeslagen and Douane directorates-general can be shared with the new Inspectie Belastingen, Toeslagen en Douane, raising concerns about its positioning within the ministry, GDPR compliance, and the reliance on a ministerial regulation for data processing. The State Secretary's nader rapport reports that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented with a statutory-basis justification and that the bill was otherwise kept as is, with a note that a statutory basis for the inspectorate itself may be considered later.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to justify why a statutory basis is needed for sharing fiscal, competition-sensitive and personal data within a ministry, which the government supplemented.

The Afdeling asks the relationship between the statutory data-sharing provisions and the regulation of further processing by the inspectorate in a ministerial regulation to be explained, and the government only notes it will consider a statutory basis later.
The Afdeling makes remarks on the inspectorate's positioning as a ministry unit and on the GDPR, with the government adding explanation and some editorial corrections.

36333.s: The bill requires municipalities to make reception facilities for asylum seekers possible, allocated through a national capacity estimate, provincial quotas and a ministerial allocation decision. It also lets COA place asylum seekers in facilities, lets municipalities operate facilities, and provides specific grants and an evaluation after two and four years.
36333.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for a stable and flexible asylum reception system to meet international obligations and by the technical detail of the allocation rules.
q: The minister takes a distribution decision per province every two years by 1 September, allocating the minimum required reception places across the designated municipalities.
Onze Minister neemt eens in de twee jaren voor 1 september van het kalenderjaar een verdeelbesluit, per provincie, waarin het minimaal aantal vereiste opvangplaatsen
d: distribution of provincial quotas and indicative municipal allocation
rules on specific grants to municipalities and provinces
rules on operation of facilities by municipality
p: The minister decides by ministerial allocation decision which municipalities must create reception places, overriding local choice, with only consideration of the commissioner's report as a constraint.
Municipal councils and colleges must make available sites and adjust zoning plans, with appeal to the administrative courts available against the decisions.
COA may transfer asylum seekers between facilities, with a duty to preserve family unity where possible and with consent of asylum seekers.
During the first four years the minister, not the provincial executive, supervises municipal performance, with reporting to parliament after two and four years.

parties: Asks how a municipality that already met its share in the national phase is protected from extra obligations in the provincial phase, and how the bill's procedures and rights of appeal work.
How will it be guaranteed that a municipality that has delivered its proportional share is not additionally burdened in the provincial phase (second tranche)?
Hoe zal worden gewaarborgd dat een gemeente die haar evenredige bijdrage heeft geleverd, niet aanvullend worden belast in de provinciale fase (tweede tranche)?
Asks whether the bill can prevent municipalities from setting target-group conditions on who they will accept, linked to humane treatment of asylum seekers.
Can the government confirm that under this bill it is not possible to set such target-group requirements, these members ask.
Kan de regering bevestigen dat het binnen deze wet niet mogelijk is om dergelijke doelgroep-eisen te stellen, zo vragen deze leden.
Supports solidarity between municipalities but asks for clarity on how existing shares count, whether municipalities can be forced again, and on strategic behaviour criticized by advisory bodies.
Whether municipalities that already deliver their share and/or commit in phase 1 and/or do so in phase 2 cannot be additionally obliged to contribute through the Minister's distribution decision;

Of gemeenten die hun aandeel al leveren en/of dit in fase 1 toezeggen en/of dit in fase 2 doen conform de verdeelsystematiek niet extra kunnen worden verplicht tot een bijdrage bij het verdeelbesluit van de Minister;

Worries about complexity and feasibility, asks for a precise analysis of whether the bill achieves its goals, and questions whether the voluntary-plus-bonus design creates perverse incentives; asks for guarantees and an evaluation of interbestuurlijk toezicht.
What guarantees does the government offer to prevent the perverse incentive and to promote the promised balanced distribution of asylum reception across all Dutch municipalities?
Welke garanties biedt de regering om de perverse prikkel te voorkomen en om de beloofde evenwichtige verdeling van asielopvang over alle Nederlandse gemeenten te stimuleren?
Supports a statutory municipal duty for a stable reception system and asks whether the balance between voluntariness and obligation can be anchored in a simpler system.
These members would like to ask the government whether it sees possibilities to anchor this balance in a simpler system in this bill.
Deze leden zouden de regering willen vragen of zij nog mogelijkheden ziet dit evenwicht met een meer eenvoudige systematiek in dit wetsvoorstel te verankeren.

Calls for fair distribution with attention to feasibility and good intergovernmental relations, asks about democratic control by municipal councils and provincial states given short deadlines, and questions the complex verdeelsystematiek.
How does the government intend to provide room for democratic control in the proposal given the short time span between the various deadlines in the system?
Hoe wil de regering in het voorstel ruimte bieden voor democratische controle gelet op de korte tijdspanne tussen de verschillende deadlines in de systematiek?

Criticizes that essential elements such as distribution system, capacity estimates, financial conditions and quality standards are left to lower regulation rather than the statute, undermining democratic oversight, and that quality and enforceability safeguards are missing.
Is the government willing to include these essential elements directly in the bill?
Is de regering bereid om deze essentiële elementen rechtstreeks in het wetsvoorstel op te nemen?

Objects in principle to an unspecified specific grant for performing a statutory task and to competitive incentives between municipalities; finds the specific-grant use improper and asks for justification of the Financiële-verhoudingswet basis.
These members are in principle opposed to municipalities receiving an unspecified grant for carrying out a statutory task
Deze leden zijn er principieel tegen dat gemeenten een ongespecificeerde uitkering krijgen voor het uitvoeren van een wettelijke taak
Asks whether the law should be temporary until asylum flows return to normal, what counts as normal, and whether municipalities facing crime and police costs will be compensated.
What is the government's position on the idea of making this law temporary until asylum flows are 'normal' again?
Hoe staat de regering tegenover het idee om van deze wet een tijdelijke wet te maken totdat de asielstromen weer «normaal» zijn?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises on the Wet gemeentelijke taak mogelijk maken asielopvangvoorzieningen, judging the two-phase, financially incentivised allocation system overly complex and of doubtful feasibility, and recommends reconsidering it, e.g. along the Huisvestingswet model. The government reply largely rejects this advice, defending the two-phase system and specific grants while promising to monitor effects, evaluate after four years, and adjust lower regulation.
concerns: The two-phase allocation and financial incentive system is overly complex and likely to be ineffective; the Afdeling advises reconsidering it and choosing a simpler system.
Feasibility is very doubtful given short consultation, unclear implementation details, lack of IT systems and uncertain financial and legal procedure consequences.
The realisation term is contradictory (two years in art. 6 versus six months in art. 7), and the reach of the medebewind task is unclear.
Specific grants conflict with the Financiële-verhoudingswet's requirement of a public-interest purpose, and the provincial role under art. 126 Grondwet is unclear.
Many essential elements are left to amvb and ministerial regulation, which should instead be set in the statute itself.
Advises co-signature by the Minister of BZK, which the government declined given the urgency of the bill.

36342.s: This omnibus tax bill (Fiscale verzamelwet 2024) amends numerous tax and benefit statutes for 2024, including changes to tax deductions for gifts, green savings, vehicle benefits, excise and VAT rules, interest and appeal deadlines, and the renaming of the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen to Dienst Toeslagen. It also limits the claimed legal privilege of confidential advisers in tax information requests and makes the electronic correspondence rules discretionary.
36342.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations by pointing to practical needs such as detailed valuation and invoice requirements and the need for clarity on the scope of privilege.
q: A taxpayer cannot successfully invoke the confidentiality of contacts with a privileged adviser to refuse the obligations in articles 47, 47a and 49.

Voor een weigering om te voldoen aan de in de artikelen 47, 47a en 49 omschreven verplichtingen kan niemand zich met vrucht beroepen op de vertrouwelijkheid van zijn contacten met een verschoningsgerechtigde
d: manner of tax-related procedures and rules
Artikel I B (art. 3.104 p Wet IB 2001)
designation of public benefits for labour market and transport
rules on notarial deeds, valuation reports and invoices for gifts
rules for valuation reports and invoices for other gifts in kind
annual adjustment of the home value limit
rules on the manner of electronic and other communication with the tax administration
p: Artikel XVII F (art. 53a AWR) and Artikel XVIII C (art. 63 IW 1990)
The bill narrows the scope of legal privilege for confidential advisers, making it harder for taxpayers to refuse disclosure of information the adviser holds in that capacity.
Artikel XVII E (art. 51 AWR), Artikel XVIII B (art. 61 IW 1990), Artikel XIX (art. 8.88 BES)
Taxpayers cannot invoke the confidentiality of contacts with a privileged adviser to refuse information they hold or could reasonably obtain without that contact.
Artikel I H (art. 9.5 Wet IB 2001) and Artikel III E (art. 27 Wet Vpb)
Appeal time limits against refusal of requests to revise interest decisions are extended to at least six weeks, protecting taxpayers' appeal rights.
The Minister may set additional conditions for public benefit institutions established in third countries by ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks for transparency on how IT capacity reprioritisation is decided for each policy change and for justification of the secrecy-privilege codification against case law.

Can the government commit to providing insight with every policy change, for example in the implementation test or explanatory memorandum, into the impact on the IT portfolio and how the reprioritisation is made?

Kan de regering toezeggen bij elke beleidswijziging inzicht te geven, door bijvoorbeeld aandacht daaraan te besteden in de uitvoeringstoets of in de memorie van toelichting, van de impact op de IV-portefeuille en hoe de (her)prioritering wordt gemaakt?
Asks about consumer protection and access effects of the green bank merger and about the budgetary effects of the bronbelasting exclusion.
The D66 members therefore ask about the effects for consumers, given the reduction of the savings guarantee if the green bank merges with the main bank.](ignore)
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen daarom naar de effecten voor consumenten, met het oog op de verlaging van de garantie op het spaargeld als de groenbank samengaat met de hoofdbank.
Questions whether the 10,000 euro threshold for objective valuation of gifts in kind is sufficient to prevent abuse and asks about legal protections for periodic gifts.
These members ask for further explanation of why the threshold of 2,500 euro was first advised by the government and SBF, and how 10,000 euro is now also considered adequate to prevent abuse.

Deze leden vragen om een nadere toelichting waarom eerst door de regering en SBF de drempel van 2.500 euro werd geadviseerd en hoe 10.000 euro dan nu ook afdoende wordt geacht als verbetering en om misbruik te voorkomen.
Asks the government to justify departing from the advised 2,500 euro valuation threshold and questions proportionality.
The PvdA members ask the government to further justify why it deviated from the advice to set the threshold for requiring an objective valuation at 2,500 euro.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering om nader te motiveren waarom is afgeweken van het advies om de drempel voor het eisen van een objectieve waardebepaling vast te stellen op 2.500 euro.
Argues the green bank measure worsens the position of green savers and asks for a full evaluation of the effectiveness and budgetary cost of green investment rules.
The PVV members understand that the proposed measure transfers the deposit guarantee obligation from the green bank to the main bank, thereby worsening the position of (green) savers.

De leden van de PVV-fractie begrijpen dat door de voorgestelde maatregel de depositogarantiestelselverplichting over gaat van de groenbank naar de hoofdbank en dat daardoor de positie van (groen)spaarders verslechtert.
Asks how close supervision of green investments by green banks is maintained once integrated into the main bank and how greenwashing is prevented.
The SP members ask the government how strict supervision of green bank investments is maintained if these activities are integrated into the main bank.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering hoe scherp toezicht behouden blijft op de groene beleggingen van groenbanken indien deze activiteiten geïntegreerd worden binnen de hoofdbank.
Asks whether an analysis of the effect of the periodic gift deduction limit on giving behaviour is available and when it will be shared with the House.
These members ask the government whether an analysis is already available.
Deze leden vragen de regering of een analyse al beschikbaar is.

Asks the government whether a legal amendment to article 20(2) of the Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting 1969 is needed to remove obstacles in debt restructuring, without raising any oversight or rights concern.
These members ask whether the government can confirm that the rationale of the debt-waiver profit exemption is to remove obstacles in restructuring claims on loss-making companies.
Deze leden vragen of de regering kan bevestigen dat de ratio van de kwijtscheldingswinstvrijstelling is om belemmeringen weg te nemen bij de sanering van vorderingen op verlieslijdende ondernemingen.
Thanks the government for its answers and has no follow-up questions.
These members express their thanks and have no follow-up questions.
Deze leden spreken hun dank uit en hebben geen vervolgvragen.
Declines to add further input on the bill.
The PVV members refrain from further input on the Fiscale verzamelwet 2024.
De leden van de PVV-fractie zien af van een nadere inbreng aangaande de Fiscale verzamelwet 2024.
Has no additional questions at this stage.
The SP members currently have no additional questions for the nader verslag on the Fiscale verzamelwet 2024.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben op dit moment geen aanvullende vragen voor het nader verslag van de Fiscale verzamelwet 2024.
Asks why the 10,000 euro threshold for valuing gifts in kind was chosen, a technical design question.

The BBB members ask the government whether the 10,000 euro threshold for the valuation requirement for gifts in kind was specifically chosen, because research showed most abuses cluster around that amount.

De leden van de BBB-fractie vragen de regering of bij het vaststellen van de taxatie-eis voor giften in natura specifiek is gekozen voor een grens van 10.000 euro, omdat onderzoek heeft uitgewezen dat de meeste uitwassen zich bevinden rond dit bedrag.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Fiscale verzamelwet 2024 (draft tax bill), raising concerns about inadequate implementation analysis given ICT capacity constraints, the absence of a framework for goedkeurende beleidsbesluiten, the heavier proof burden for in-kind gifts and its cumulation rules, the lack of an objection route against interest decisions attached to provisional assessments, and the codification of the fiscal testimonial privilege. The government's nader rapport accepted several points, adjusted the explanatory memorandum and the bill on in-kind gifts, promised a framework for policy decisions, and defended retaining the existing objection system for interest decisions and the codification of the privilege.
concerns: The Afdeling requested a fuller analysis of implementation consequences and justification for prioritising the name change over other ICT work; the government gave additional explanation but kept the prioritisation.
The Afdeling asked for a framework with conditions for using goedkeurende beleidsbesluiten, which the government agreed to develop separately, noting the balance with the legality principle.

The Afdeling questioned the necessity and proportionality of raising the proof burden for in-kind gifts and the cumulation rules; the government justified the measure and amended the bill and explanatory memorandum to clarify it.

The Afdeling found it insufficiently justified that a belastingrente decision attached to a provisional assessment, which has definitive character, cannot be appealed directly; the government retained the existing system for reasons of simplicity and avoiding parallel procedures.
The Afdeling asked for a better justification of codifying the fiscal testimonial privilege; the government clarified the reason in the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling made drafting remarks, which the government adopted in the bill and explanatory memorandum.

36350-IIB.s: The bill amends the 2023 budget statement for the other High Councils of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, raising spending and commitments by about EUR 6 million for the Raad van State, Ombudsman and others. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 1 June 2023.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the other High Councils of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council for the year 2023.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat, Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs en de Kiesraad voor het jaar 2023.

36360-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Staten-Generaal (IIA), adjusting expenditure, commitments and receipts across the Eerste Kamer and Tweede Kamer articles and recording realised figures (Slotwet). It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for the year 2022 (final budget act).
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2022 (Slotwet).

36414.s: The bill raises the statutory maximum prison sentences for human smuggling under the Dutch Criminal Code and the Caribbean Netherlands code, with higher maxima for aggravated forms. It also extends Dutch criminal jurisdiction so that human smuggling committed abroad can be prosecuted in the Netherlands.
36414.j: The memorandum justifies the higher maxima by the harmful nature of human smuggling and the need for sentences proportionate to it, and extends jurisdiction because the current scope does not match the wide reach of the offence.
q: It is proposed to widen the extraterritorial jurisdiction rules so that anyone who commits human smuggling as defined in Article 197a of the Criminal Code can be prosecuted before the Dutch courts.

Voorgesteld wordt de regeling van extraterritoriale rechtsmacht zodanig te verruimen dat eenieder die zich schuldig maakt aan mensensmokkel als strafbaar gesteld in artikel 197a Sr vervolgbaar is voor de Nederlandse rechter.

parties: Supports higher penalties and wider extraterritorial jurisdiction and asks about enforcement capacity, information sharing and Italy's accession to the protocol, without raising checks on the executive.
These members endorse both the need to raise the statutory maximum penalties for migrant smuggling and the extension of extraterritorial jurisdiction.
Deze leden onderschrijven de noodzaak van zowel de verhoging van de wettelijke strafmaxima van mensensmokkel alsook de verruiming van de extraterritoriale rechtsmacht.

Worries that humanitarian aid is increasingly labelled smuggling and that wider jurisdiction could prosecute humanitarian actors abroad; plans an amendment excluding humanitarian aid and questions the penalty increase without evaluation.
Therefore they will submit an amendment to exclude humanitarian aid and they would like a response to this.
Daarom zullen zij een amendement indienen over humanitaire hulpverlening uit te sluiten en zij horen hier graag een reactie op.

Asks whether the penalty increase is justified given no baseline measurement was made for the previous increase, and asks about information sharing between enforcement partners and privacy safeguards.
These members ask the government what the reason was for not carrying out a baseline measurement.
Deze leden vragen de regering wat de reden is geweest om geen nulmeting uit te voeren.
Questions raising penalties despite the impossibility of showing effectiveness of the previous increase and asks for comparative data on penalties in other EU states.
Why, despite this finding, does the government choose to raise the maximum penalty at this time?
Waarom kiest de regering ondanks deze constatering op dit moment ervoor het strafmaximum te verhogen?
Asks how prosecutorial discretion at the OM will be exercised under the wider jurisdiction and whether the bill clarifies liability for humanitarian smuggling.

Do the PvdA and GroenLinks members understand correctly that with the intended extension of jurisdiction any suspect of migrant smuggling, wherever committed, could be prosecuted in the Netherlands, and that the actual decision to prosecute lies with the OM under its opportunity assessment?

Begrijpen de leden van de PvdA- en GroenLinks-fracties het goed dat met de voorgenomen verruiming van de rechtsmacht iedere verdachte van mensensmokkel, waar dan ook begaan, in Nederland vervolgd zou kunnen worden en dat de concrete vraag of er daadwerkelijk tot vervolging zal worden overgegaan in de opportuniteitsafweging bij het OM ligt?

Shares the Raad van State's doubts about extending jurisdiction beyond EU and Schengen destinations, citing the legality principle, and questions the effectiveness and evaluability of the penalty increase.
These members question the government's argument that broad criminalisation will prevent possible relevant gaps in the future.
Deze leden stellen daarbij vraagtekens bij de argumentatie van de regering dat met strafbaarstelling in brede zin mogelijke relevante lacunes in de toekomst worden voorkomen.
Has no questions or remarks at this stage.
The BBB members have no questions or remarks regarding the bill at this stage.
De leden van de BBB-fractie hebben voor nu geen vragen/opmerkingen inzake het wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised (dictum C_Adapt) on a draft bill raising Dutch maximum penalties for migrant smuggling and extending extraterritorial jurisdiction, asking for clearer scope, narrower jurisdiction limited to Dutch and EU interests, better motivation for higher penalties, and an evaluation clause. The government's nader rapport reports that it adopted most of these points, clarifying scope, adding motivation, and adding an evaluation provision, while keeping the broad jurisdictional extension and explaining why.
concerns: The Afdeling advised not to extend jurisdiction beyond what Dutch and EU interests require, since smuggling to non-EU destinations lacks a sufficient link; the government kept the broad extension and gave a motivation instead.

The Afdeling asked for a substantive motivation of the higher maximum penalties, given that the 2015 increase was never evaluated and no inadequacy was shown by the OM or judiciary; the government added motivation.
The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify how the geographic scope of the offence relates to the jurisdiction provision; the government added a passage on this.
The Afdeling asked for better justification of the expected workload on the criminal justice chain given existing capacity shortages; the government clarified expected staffing needs.
The Afdeling recommended an evaluation clause, which the government added to the bill.

36423.s: The bill amends the Dutch tax rules for the fonds voor gemene rekening (fgr) and the vrijgestelde beleggingsinstelling (vbi) regime, narrowing their definitions to Wft-listed investment fund forms and restricting access to vbi status. It adds transitional rules (deemed disposals, share-merger relief, transfer tax exemption, and payment deferral up to ten years) for investors affected by the 1 January 2025 change.
36423.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as preventing unintended use of the fgr and vbi regimes by wealthy individuals and families and aligning definitions with the Wft, while noting revenue expectations and transitional relief.
q: The aim is to bring the use of these schemes more in line with their original purpose and prevent unintended use of the fgr and vbi regime (mainly by wealthy persons and families).

Hiermee wordt beoogd het gebruik van de regelingen meer in overeenstemming te brengen met de oorspronkelijke doelstelling en wordt onbedoeld gebruik van het fgr en het vbi-regime (voornamelijk door vermogende personen en families) voorkomen.
d: Artikel VI, lid 2 and artikel VIII/IX (interpretive references)
share-merger relief conditions and transfer-tax exemption procedure
Minister may grant exception to fgr profit inclusion on joint request under conditions
inspector sets manner of filing transfer-tax declaration
p: The Minister may, under conditions the Minister sets, allow the inspector to disregard fgr profits, with conditions limited to securing tax collection.
The collector may attach conditions to continuing payment deferral and may revoke the deferral if conditions are not met.

parties: Asks the government for a numerical example of the forced final settlement for funds with losses above 1 million euro and whether the loss-offset measure should be disapplied.
Can the government explain with a numerical example how this final settlement will take place for a fgr with offsettable losses of more than 1 million euro?
Kan de regering met een cijfervoorbeeld uiteenzetten hoe deze eindafrekening zal plaatsvinden bij een fonds voor gemene rekening met verrekenbare verliezen van meer dan 1 miljoen euro?
Welcomes the measure against misuse but asks detailed questions on the scope of the definitions, the number of cases affected and whether the fgr remains a desirable anonymising structure.

find it good that an amendment is proposed to counter the unintended use (mainly by wealthy persons and families) of tax schemes.](Note: this sentence is not used verbatim as evidence; see evidence_nl below.)
vinden het goed dat er een wijziging ligt om het onbedoeld gebruik (voornamelijk door vermogende personen en families) van fiscale regelingen tegen te gaan.
Supports any step to prevent improper use of tax advantages by wealthy persons and has no additional questions.
These members encourage every step to prevent improper use of tax advantages by wealthy persons and currently have no additional questions on this.
Deze leden moedigen elke stap ter voorkoming van oneigenlijk gebruik van fiscale voordelen door vermogende personen aan en hebben hierover op dit moment geen aanvullende vragen.
Asks whether the forced sale of shares under the transitional rule amounts to coercion and what negative consequences this could have for shareholders.
Can the government explain to what extent there is coercion in having to sell shares, and what negative consequences this could have for shareholders?
Kan de regering toelichten in hoeverre hier sprake is van dwang bij het moeten verkopen van aandelen, en wat hiervan de negatieve gevolgen voor aandeelhouders zouden kunnen zijn?
Asks for more clarity on the feasibility of the bill, including whether 24.1 fte can realistically be recruited quickly and what competence profile is sought.
To what extent is it realistic that 24.1 fte have been recruited at short notice?
In hoeverre is het realistisch dat 24,1 fte’s op korte termijn zijn geworven?

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering issued an opinion on a bill amending the Corporate Income Tax Act 1969 and other laws concerning the fonds voor gemene rekening and the vrijgestelde beleggingsinstelling, raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport thanks the Afdeling and reports only minor editorial and technical changes to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

36432.s: The bill amends the Dutch environmental tax law to set a schedule of CO2 price amounts for industry and electricity for 2020 through 2030, with an indexation mechanism from 2024, and to abolish tax exemptions for mineralogical, metallurgical and electrolytic processes except hydrogen production by electrolysis. It also removes the definition of dual use of coal and the related coal exemption from 2028, with the changes taking effect from 2024 to 2028.
36432.j: The explanatory memorandum offers no justification for delegation or new powers; it only notes the removal of a definition tied to the abolished coal exemption.
q: With this part the definition of dual use of coal is removed.
Met dit onderdeel vervalt de definitie van duaal gebruik van kolen.

parties: Asks about impact assessments, carbon-leakage risks, electrification policy conflicts and revenue estimates for the exemption removal.
Can the government further explain the cited carbon-leakage risk for these sectors, as also examined in the Trinomics and Bluterra studies?
Kan de regering het genoemde weglekrisico voor deze sectoren, zoals ook onderzocht in de onderzoeken van Trinomics en Bluterra, nader toelichten?
Supports the next step in phasing out fossil subsidies and asks why 2028 was chosen for coal exemptions.
The D66 members support this next step by the government in phasing out fossil subsidies.
De leden van de D66-fractie ondersteunen deze volgende stap van de regering in het afbouwen van de fossiele subsidies.
Supports phasing out fossil advantages but raises concerns about industrial competitiveness and leakage risks not addressed by the government.
These members lack a government response to this risk and ask whether the government sees this risk and, if so, why it considers it acceptable.
Deze leden missen een reactie van de regering op dit risico en vragen of de regering wil toelichten of zij dit risico ook ziet en zo ja, waarom zij dit risico aanvaardbaar acht.
Asks about the 2025 implementation date, the 2028 coal date and the effectiveness of the minimum CO2 price relative to projections.
Why does the minimum CO2 price not align better with this?
Waarom sluit de minimum CO 2 -prijs hier niet beter op aan?
Has no additional questions at this time.
have no additional questions about it at this moment.
hebben hier op dit moment geen aanvullende vragen over.
Welcomes the abolition but worries about heavy impact on electrified firms and possible relocation, and asks about earlier entry into force.
However, the impact on already electrified companies such as Nyrstar Budel is very large.
De impact op al geëlektrificeerde bedrijven zoals Nyrstar Budel is echter erg groot.
Asks about the size of carbon-leakage risk, effects on electrification, EU comparisons and absence of changes after consultation.
What does this mean for the desired electrification of industry?
Wat betekent dit voor de gewenste elektrificatie van de industrie?
Asks whether the government assessed effects on competitiveness and how the Kamer's motion on describing effects of fiscal changes was followed, and questions the budgetary estimates.

How does this 'open end' relate to the motion by member Idsinga (Kamerstuk 36 202, no. 95) requesting the government to describe, for future fiscal policy changes affecting our investment climate, these effects so the Chamber can weigh them?

Hoe verhoudt zich dit «open einde» ten opzichte van de motie van het lid Idsinga (Kamerstuk 36 202, nr. 95 ) die de regering verzoekt om bij toekomstige fiscale beleidswijzigingen die effect kunnen hebben op ons vestigingsklimaat, deze effecten te beschrijven, zodat de Kamer deze in haar beoordeling kan meewegen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, on 11 September 2023, that it had no remarks on the draft bill amending the Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag (fiscal climate measures for industry and electricity) and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris's reply of 18 September 2023 notes only minor technical and textual improvements, including a changed citation title.

36441.s: The bill amends the Gas Act and the Mining Act to end gas extraction from the Groningen field from 1 October 2024, replacing the annual supply-security forecast with a yearly overview and removing the operational strategy, the Technical Committee on Ground Movement and related advisory and reporting duties. It also keeps residual monitoring and care duties for the licence holder under a new article 52g, with details to be set by ministerial regulation.
36441.j: The memorandum justifies removing the operational strategy and advisory bodies by the end of extraction and by reduced regulatory burden, and leaves detailed monitoring rules to ministerial regulation.
q: The removal of this obligation leads to a periodic reduction in burden of about 1.3 million euros per year.
Het vervallen van deze verplichting leidt tot een periodieke lastenvermindering van ongeveer 1,3 miljoen euro per jaar.
d: date and details of the annual supply-security overview
requirements and frequency of measurements and analyses after closure
date and rules for the gas extraction overview
p: The Minister may assign analyses of seismicity and ground movement to a legal person and require the licence holder to hand over data, with no independent oversight role stated.
Artikel II A, C, I, J–O, S, V (abolition of Mijnraad and Technische commissie bodembeweging)

The bill abolishes the Mijnraad and the Technical Committee on Ground Movement and removes their advisory roles over operational strategies and damage advice, shifting technical advice to ministerial control.
Damage-advice requests are routed to the Minister, who receives the advice from a commission he installs, changing the path for citizens claiming mining damage.

parties: Asks whether the government will commit to continuing Groningen damage settlement and reinforcement regardless of shifting political and international circumstances, and worries a future cabinet could put supply security above Groningers' safety.

Does the government share the view of the GroenLinks-PvdA faction that doing justice to Groningen and Groningers should not depend on, and be subject to, changing national and international political circumstances and factors?

Deelt de regering de opvatting van de leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie dat recht doen aan Groningen en Groningers niet moet afhangen van- en onderheven moet zijn aan veranderende nationale alsook internationale politieke verhoudingen en factoren?
Supports closure but asks about unrealised supply-security measures and asks the government to update the preventive action plan following the Council of State's advice.
The VVD faction notes that the Council of State advised updating the 2019 Preventive Action Plan Gas so that the consequences of closing the Groningen field can be incorporated.

De leden van de VVD-fractie lezen dat de Raad van State heeft geadviseerd om het Preventief Actieplan Gas uit 2019 bij te werken zodat de gevolgen van de sluiting van het Groningenveld hierin kunnen worden meegenomen.
Asks how the NAM's responsibility for damage is guaranteed to remain unchanged and how the government will explain the handling of the Council of State's advice.
Can the government guarantee that this amendment will bring no changes regarding the responsibility of the NAM?
Kan de regering garanderen dat er met deze wijziging geen veranderingen optreden met betrekking tot de verantwoordelijkheid van de NAM?
Asks whether a statutory permanent ban is proportionate given supply security risks, and whether an operational strategy setting zero output annually would suffice.
These members ask whether such a permanent statutory ban is wise in light of supply security, whether or not in combination with geopolitical conflicts.</evidence_en>
Deze leden vragen of een dergelijk permanent wettelijk verbod verstandig is in het licht van leveringszekerheid, al dan niet in combinatie met geopolitieke conflicten.
Supports closure but insists the operator retains a residual duty of care and that residents can rely on it having the means to meet it; asks about negotiations with Shell and ExxonMobil.
These members ask the government how it will ensure that residents can rely on the licence holder taking its responsibility and having the (financial) means to do so.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe ervoor wordt gezorgd dat bewoners ervan op aan kunnen dat de vergunninghouder zijn verantwoordelijkheid neemt en daar ook de (financiële) middelen voor heeft.
Asks how the government will enforce residual duties if operators fall into financial difficulty, how limitation periods for mining damage are handled and whether the Civil Code should be amended.
How does the government ensure that mining damage in Groningen and northern Drenthe does not become time-barred?
Hoe zorgt de regering ervoor dat mijnbouwschade in Groningen en Noord-Drenthe niet verjaard?

Welcomes closure but questions whether the shift from a general to a specific duty of care in new article 52g is legally secured, asks for enforcement instruments of the Inspector-General of Mines, and asks what risks monitoring must address.
These members ask whether it is legally sufficiently secured that holders of current licences must comply with this.
Deze leden vragen of juridisch voldoende is geborgd dat houders van huidige vergunningen zich hieraan moeten houden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised in 2021 on a bill ending gas extraction from the Groningen field in two phases, raising concerns about an incomplete balancing of safety and security-of-supply interests, the lack of criteria for entry into force of phase 2, insufficient parliamentary involvement, excessive delegation for phase 1 'opregeling', and an unmotivated infringement of the licence holder's property right. The government's 2023 reply states the bill has been shortened to cover only the post-closure phase with a fixed date of 1 October 2024, adds a fuller interest balancing and property-right justification, and largely meets the concerns while rejecting some points as no longer relevant.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a full, reasoned balancing of safety and security-of-supply interests, including the possible seismic benefit of minimum-flow production and quantified supply risks, which the government addressed only by summarizing the balancing in the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling advised including the criteria for entry into force of phase 2 in the bill itself, a point rendered moot because the bill now sets a fixed date of 1 October 2024.

The Afdeling advised ensuring formal parliamentary involvement in the decision to end extraction, which the government answered by pointing to the fixed statutory date and parliamentary treatment of the bill.

The Afdeling advised against delegating to the minister by ministerial regulation the situations in which phase 1 extraction may be increased, and advised narrowing the statutory basis; the phase 1 provisions were dropped from the bill, so the point was no longer addressed in the bill itself.

The Afdeling required a self-standing justification of the infringement on the licence holder's property right and a fair balance between general and individual interests, which the government added to the explanatory memorandum.
Several technical corrections were made, including restoring an omitted text in the Mijnbouwwet and moving the safety norm definition into the Tijdelijke wet Groningen.

36450.s: The bill establishes a permanent independent advisory college (Adviescollege toetsing regeldruk) that reviews the regulatory burden of draft laws, general administrative orders and ministerial regulations and advises the minister. It sets out its tasks, powers, composition, working procedures and an evaluation obligation.
36450.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation of deadlines and exempt categories to the minister as administrative detail that needs flexibility to adapt to practice.
q: For the further elaboration of a number of provisions, the bill provides for delegation to the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate.
Voor de nadere uitwerking van een aantal bepalingen voorziet het wetsvoorstel in delegatie naar de Minister van EZK.
d: categories of ministerial regulations exempt from advice request
deadlines for submission and advice of the college

parties: The VVD argues the advisory body's mandate is too non-binding, since ministries can set its advice aside, and asks what purpose it serves.
These members believe the mandate is too non-committal.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat het mandaat te vrijblijvend is.
NSC questions why decades of advice have not curbed regulatory burden, asks for a baseline measurement, and wants the body to review clusters of legislation and alternatives, and to report quarterly.
It is disappointing to note that so many years of advice have not led to controlling regulatory burden for citizens, businesses and non-profit organisations.
Het is teleurstellend om te constateren dat zoveel jaren van advisering niet heeft geleid tot het beheersen van de regeldruk voor burgers, bedrijven en non-profit organisaties.
BBB asks how the exclusion of budget bills, criminal and procedural law, and non-discretionary EU implementation affects the body's ability to advise on EU proposals.
To what extent is this an obstacle in the proposal for the new advisory body to advise on EU proposals forwarded by the Minister?
In hoeverre is dit een belemmering in het voorstel om het nieuwe Adviescollege een advies te laten geven op EU-voorstellen die door de Minister zullen worden doorgestuurd?

CDA supports the body but asks whether ministries internalise attention to regulatory burden, whether volunteer organisations should be an explicit target group, and whether the body should review complexity and the quality of mkb-toetsen.

SGP asks whether the body should be able to review the mkb-toets, comment on EU instruments and interpretation differences, be consulted earlier, and why the composition is limited to three to five members.
The SGP members find it striking that the advisory body is not tasked with checking how the mkb-toets was carried out.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vinden het opvallend dat het Adviescollege niet de taak krijgt te controleren hoe de mkb-toets is uitgevoerd.
ChristenUnie supports the bill's aim and asks the minister to reflect on how internalisation of attention to regulatory burden in departments can be furthered.
These members believe that, even with a permanent body, internalisation of attention to regulatory burden in the departments remains important.
Deze leden menen dat, ook bij het instellen van een permanent college, internalisering van de aandacht voor regeldruk bij de departementen alsnog van belang blijft.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against submitting the bill establishing a permanent Regulatory Burden Assessment Committee (ATR) unless revised, raising constitutional grounding under Article 79 Grondwet, its place in legislative quality policy, the open definition of 'experienced regulatory burden', the scope of EU proposal review, the exemption for implementing legislation and procedural law, and the 'other powers'. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted most points by amending the explanatory memorandum and wording, while maintaining the other powers and the procedural law exclusion with added justification.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller justification of establishing a permanent advisory committee under Article 79 Grondwet and the Kaderwet adviescolleges; the government expanded the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
The open notion of 'experienced regulatory burden' was too broad; the government concretised the definition in article 1 and limited the advisory task to regulatory burden effects.

The relationship of the committee's review to the Ministry of Justice legislative test and other review instruments in the legislative process needed clarification; the explanatory memorandum was expanded accordingly.
Review of EU Commission proposals should be limited to those accompanied by a BNC-fiche; the government clarified article 3 but retained forwarding of all proposals under article 8.
The exemption for implementing legislation without national policy discretion needed clarification versus article 1:7 Awb; the government explained the overlap and removed the duplicative provision.
The blanket exclusion of procedural law from review was insufficiently motivated; the government added reasons but kept the exclusion.
The Afdeling advised reconsidering or removing the 'other powers' given limited past use and capacity; the government rejected this and retained them, citing recent studies and budget increase.

36504.s: The bill amends the 2024 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate by adding 200 million euro in commitments to the policy article on innovation and entrepreneurship for sustainable growth. The additional funding is for the 'Maatwerkfinanciering CO2-reductie Verduurzaming Industrie' scheme, with the budget increase running from 2025 to 2028.

36513.s: The bill amends the Childcare Act to make childminding (gastouderopvang) subject to the same 'responsible childcare' standard, adds pedagogical staff who coach childminders, and caps a childminder's affiliation at two childminding agencies per childminding arrangement (temporarily three). Detailed quality conditions and pedagogical staff requirements are delegated to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulation.
36513.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to set detailed quality conditions per childcare form, which it says cannot be fixed in the statute itself.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order, further rules will be set on the temporary extension to three childminding agencies.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden nadere regels gesteld omtrent de tijdelijke uitbreiding naar drie gastouderbureaus.
d: nadere regels on aspects of responsible childcare, including childminding
conditions for responsible childcare, including deployment of pedagogical staff
rules on temporary extension to three childminding agencies
p: Caps the number of childminding agencies per childminder at two, with a temporary extension to three set by general administrative order.

parties: Asks for an overview of AMvBs and ministerial regulations without prior consultation (voorhang), a timeline, and how the Chamber and stakeholders will be involved in implementing the bill's delegated rules.
These members ask whether they understand correctly that no prior submission (voorhang) to parliament is foreseen for any of these points.</reasoning_effort>
Deze leden vragen of zij het goed begrijpen dat er bij elk van deze punten geen voorhang is voorzien.

Finds it hard to assess the bill because almost all measures depend on unspecified lower regulation, and would prefer a regulatory burden test of those regulations before agreeing to the enabling powers.
These members would prefer, before agreeing to the statutory bases, to see a regulatory burden assessment of the implementing rules.
Deze leden zouden liever alvorens akkoord te gaan met grondslagen, een regeldruktoetsing van de nadere regelingen zien.
Worries that the measures will reduce the accessibility and number of childminders and raise costs for parents, and questions the cumulative regulatory burden.
These members have serious concerns about the effects of these measures on the accessibility of childminding.
De leden van de SGP-fractie maken zich serieuze zorgen over de effecten van deze maatregelen op de toegankelijkheid van de gastouderopvang.
Asks how the effectiveness of quality measures will be guaranteed and monitored, which bodies are responsible for supervision, and how regulatory burden and parental costs will be limited.
The VVD members ask how it is guaranteed that the proposed measures actually lead to an improvement of pedagogical quality in childminding.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe wordt gegarandeerd dat de voorgestelde maatregelen daadwerkelijk leiden tot een verbetering van de pedagogische kwaliteit in de gastouderopvang.
Asks how the quality requirements can avoid hampering the flexible, small-scale character of childminding and about the staffing shortages and cost effects.
These members therefore ask the government to explain further how it intends to prevent this.
Deze leden vragen de regering dan ook nader aan te geven hoe de regering dit wil voorkomen.
Asks who defines 'generally accepted values and norms' and why two agencies rather than one are allowed, raising questions about the normative basis of the rules.
Who is going to determine what 'generally accepted values and norms' precisely are?
Wie gaat vaststellen wat «algemeen aanvaarde waarden en normen» precies zijn?
Asks why the cap is set at two agencies rather than one, and how the pedagogical quality gap and the distinction from daycare will be handled.
Can the government further explain why, for that reason, one childminding agency was not chosen.
Kan de regering nader duiden waarom, met die reden, niet gekozen is voor één gastouderbureau.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill tightening quality requirements for childminding (gastouderopvang), raising concerns about effects on availability and affordability, insufficient detail on measures left to lower regulation, and the justification of the cap on childminding agencies. The minister's reply largely accepted the advice by adding explanation, moving the agency cap into the statute, and clarifying affordability measures and transition rules.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum did not assess the effects of the quality measures on availability and affordability of childminding, which the minister partly addressed by adding analysis.
The bill left the content of quality measures to lower regulation without sufficient explanation; the minister added detail on the planned measures in the memorandum.
The cap on the number of childminding agencies should be set in the statute rather than in lower regulation, and the minister moved it into the bill as article 1.56c.
Feasibility of the requirements given labour market shortages of pedagogical staff was questioned; the minister argued sufficient staff would be available, citing research.
Reactions from the internet consultation on affordability and the maximum hourly rate should be taken into account, and the minister included them in the memorandum.

36531.s: The bill implements the EU Digital Services Act in Dutch law by designating the Autoriteit Consument en Markt as digital services coordinator and supervisor, and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens as competent authority for two provisions on personal data. It grants these authorities administrative fines, penalty payments, binding commitments and self-standing orders, with a prior judicial authorisation by a rechter-commissaris for certain orders, and adds information-sharing and cooperation rules.
36531.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary to implement the EU regulation and to create legal certainty and effective supervision of digital services.
q: The Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets is competent to impose an administrative fine up to the amount stated in Article 52(3) of the Digital Services Regulation.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt is bevoegd tot oplegging van een bestuurlijke boete van ten hoogste het bedrag, genoemd in artikel 52, derde lid, van de digitaledienstenverordening.
d: rules on decision-making on researcher data access requests
p: Allows the ACM to impose self-standing orders on intermediary service providers, including preliminary measures, with the orders for the most serious cases requiring prior judicial authorisation.
Denies the supervisor the power in Article 5:19 Awb during supervision, limiting one investigative tool.
Allows AP-designated persons to enter a home without the occupant's consent when reasonably necessary, with a specific power of attorney from the AP required.
Lets the AP make binding commitments by providers replace fines or penalty payments when it considers this more efficient.

parties: Asks how the vague notion of disinformation is interpreted and whether individual opinions could be wrongly classified, and asks the government to explain the term 'opruiing'.
The PVV members note that such indicators are freely interpretable.
De leden van de PVV-fractie merken op dat dergelijke indicaties vrijelijk interpretabel zijn.
Supports the DSA but asks whether supervisors have enough capacity, whether the AP budget is adequate, and whether supervisors can compel platforms to change algorithms.
Can the government indicate whether it thinks the AP and ACM have enough capacity to exercise good and targeted supervision here?
Kan de regering aangeven of zij denkt dat de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) en ACM genoeg capaciteit hebben om hier goed en gericht toezicht op te houden?
Asks how supervisors will be adequately equipped, how conflicts between ACM and AP conclusions will be resolved, and how illegal content removal and enforcement will work.
How is it ensured that these supervisors are sufficiently equipped for this role, also with regard to the other areas these parties supervise.
Hoe wordt ervoor gezorgd dat deze toezichthouders voldoende uitgerust zijn voor deze rol, dit ook met oog op de andere gebieden waar deze partijen toezicht op houden.

Notes the Raad van State warning that ministerial responsibility is limited by departing from the framework act for independent administrative bodies, and asks for concrete situations where this limitation is desirable; also asks what happens if the AP's negative advice is overridden.
The NSC members read that the Raad van State warns that ministerial responsibility in the bill is limited by departing on some points from the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies.

De leden van de NSC-fractie lezen dat de Raad van State waarschuwt dat de ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid in het wetsvoorstel beperkt wordt door op enkele punten af te wijken van de Kaderwet zelfstandig bestuursorganen.
Asks why no maximum deadline is set for ACM handling of complaints, asks about the AP's underfunding, and asks about the right to encryption and limits on active monitoring.
Why is it chosen not to attach a maximum term here, ask the D66 members.
Waarom wordt ervoor gekozen hier geen maximale termijn aan te verbinden, zo vragen de leden van de D66-fractie.
Supports swift passage but criticises the missed fifteen-month deadline that leaves the ACM unable to enforce complaints, and asks about data sharing with police and prosecutors.
As a result, the supervisor, the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM), cannot currently enforce when reports come in.
Hierdoor kan de toezichthouder, de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM), op dit moment niet handhaven wanneer meldingen binnenkomen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Uitvoeringswet of the EU Digital Services Act, designating the ACM and AP as supervisors, and raised concerns on the scope of 'illegal content', the ACM's need to judge individual moderation decisions, limits on sanctions, and ministerial accountability via exclusion of policy rules. The government's nader rapport largely accepted these points, adding clarifications to the memorie van toelichting, narrowing the sanction limitation, and explaining accountability and the digital services board.
concerns: The Afdeling advised clarifying the key concepts 'illegal content' and 'desinformatie' in the explanatory memorandum, which was done by expanding paragraph 2.4.2.

The Afdeling advised that the ACM must in some cases form at least a marginal judgment on whether content is illegal, and the explanatory memorandum was amended accordingly, though the government stresses the regulation does not provide a power to rule on content legality.

The Afdeling advised that sanction powers should not be limited to damage to collective interests, as individual moderation decisions may need supervisory assessment; the government dropped that restriction and clarified the scope in the memorandum.

The Afdeling advised substantively motivating the exclusion of ministerial policy-rule powers and clarifying public accountability of the ACM, the digital services coordinator and the European digital services board; the government added motivation and clarifications but maintains the exclusion is required by EU independence rules.
The Afdeling noted the explanatory memorandum needed updating and the government updated it, adding the designation of the ACM as competent authority and an overlap provision.

36600-V.s: This bill fixes the 2025 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, setting expenditure and commitment amounts in thousands of euros across policy and non-policy articles. The accompanying explanatory memorandum discusses policy priorities such as international law, EU cooperation, non-proliferation and information management, without creating new executive powers.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2025 is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State had no remarks on the draft 2025 budget bill (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply notes the blanco advice and makes technical adjustments to EU contributions and the unallocated HGIS article, reducing expenditure and receipts slightly.

36603.s: This omnibus tax bill amends several Dutch tax laws for fiscal policy in 2025, including corporate tax, wage tax, dividend tax, excise, motor vehicle taxes, customs and pension transfer rules. It also adjusts the customs penalty procedure and codifies rules previously handled by ministerial approval, without granting broad new executive discretion.
36603.j: The memorandum justifies the new customs penalty power as mirroring an existing tax-authority rule and the ministerial CO2 rule as technical clarification for vehicles whose emissions are unknown.
q: For the Tax Authority, Article 67pb AWR since 1996 provides that, departing from Article 10:3(4) of the General Administrative Law Act, the official charged with levying tax may also impose a fine when he finds an offence.

Voor de Belastingdienst is in artikel 67pb AWR in 1996 geregeld, dat in afwijking met artikel 10:3, vierde lid, Awb, de ambtenaar die belast is met de heffing ook een boete kan opleggen als hij een overtreding constateert.
d: how CO2 emissions of delivery vans are proven
p: Customs officials may impose a penalty for an offence while also handling the levy, and the usual separate penalty-decision check no longer applies, though a formal report is still required.

Allows a fine for an offence to be imposed after an earlier fine for negligence for the same act when new objections become known, departing from the general rule against double sanction in the General Administrative Law Act.

parties: Asks for the state of Pillar 2 implementation abroad and the basis for codifying the GAAR, without raising checks on the executive.
The PVV members ask on what basis the GAAR is now being implemented?
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen op basis waarvan de GAAR nu wordt geïmplementeerd?
Argues the general anti-abuse doctrine (fraus legis) should be codified in the AWR so judges can apply it ex officio, and asks for the legal analysis underlying the GAAR codification.
In the view of the GroenLinks-PvdA members, the time is ripe to codify the fraus legis doctrine in the AWR.
Naar de mening van de leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie is de tijd rijp om het fraus legis-leerstuk te codificeren in de AWR.
Asks whether the codified GAAR differs in practice from fraus legis in case law and how the Tax Authority will apply it, touching on legal certainty and review.
How will the Tax Authority in practice handle situations in which it believes abuse is present?
Hoe zal de Belastingdienst in de praktijk omgaan met situaties waarin de Belastingdienst van mening is dat er sprake is van misbruik?
Asks technical questions about the pension premium ceiling and the 60-year yield expectation used by DNB, and about budgetary effects of the van tax measure.
How is a 60-year yield expectation calculated by De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB)?
Op welke manier wordt een rendementsverwachting van 60 jaar berekend door De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB)?
Asks whether the van tax measure could be abused, for example by polluting vans deliberately not supplying emissions data.
Does the government see a risk of abuse, for example because polluting vans deliberately do not supply data?
Ziet de regering kans op misbruik, bijvoorbeeld doordat vervuilende bestelauto's bewust geen gegevens aanleveren?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft bill amending several tax laws (Overige fiscale maatregelen 2025) and raised no remarks, recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply (nader rapport) forwards the advice and notes only minor redactional changes added to the nota van wijziging.

The Raad van State advisory division had no remarks on the draft bill amending several tax laws (Overige fiscale maatregelen 2025) and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply only notes minor editorial changes to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

36612.s: The bill implements Regulation (EU) 2023/2631 on European green bonds in Dutch financial supervision law by giving the AFM and DNB new enforcement powers, including suspending or banning offerings, suspending or banning advertising, publishing infringements and banning issuance for up to one year. It also extends cross-border assistance powers to designated supervisory persons and makes minor amendments to the Wft.
36612.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary to give supervisors the enforcement tools that the EU regulation requires but that the Wft does not yet contain.
q: With this bill, the powers that the regulation prescribes for supervisors, but which are not yet part of the enforcement toolkit in the Wft, are added to it.

Met onderhavig wetsvoorstel worden de bevoegdheden voor de toezichthouders die de verordening voorschrijft, maar die nog geen onderdeel zijn van het handhavingsinstrumentarium in de Wft daar alsnog in opgenomen.
d: supervisory enforcement powers over green bonds
p: Gives the supervisor power to suspend or ban offerings, advertising and issuance of green bonds for limited periods without prior judicial authorisation.
Allows the supervisor to order an offender to publish public statements on its website where the regulation so provides.
Enables designated persons to carry out on-site inspections for foreign supervisors, applying general administrative law safeguards.

parties: Asks whether there is sufficient capacity for the expanded enforcement powers and what the costs are, and what criteria govern open consultation.
The PVV members ask on this point whether there is sufficient capacity for this expansion of enforcement powers and what the associated costs are.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen op dit punt of er voldoende capaciteit is voor deze uitbreiding van handhavingsbevoegdheden en wat de daarmee gemoeide kosten zijn.
Positive about the implementing act; asks how the government will grow green bond issuance and help institutions meet the requirements.
The GroenLinks-PvdA members are positive about the Implementing Act on the EU regulation on European green bonds and have a few further questions.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks-PvdA zijn positief over de Uitvoeringswet verordening Europese groene obligaties en hebben nog een enkele vraag.

Asks whether AFM approval is required for each issuance, the AFM's suspension powers, the division of roles between AFM and DNB, and how the effectiveness and use of proceeds of green investments are verified.
How is it ensured that the proceeds of the investments are actually spent only on green projects?
Hoe wordt ervoor gezorgd dat de opbrengst van de investeringen daadwerkelijk alleen aan groene projecten besteed wordt?

Objects that the bill adds a national sanctions option despite the coalition agreement's ban on new national add-ons to EU policy, with a summary justification; also asks why DNB did no implementation test.
Nevertheless, the draft implementing act makes use of one of the two member state options.
In de concept-uitvoeringswet wordt toch gebruik gemaakt van één van de twee lidstaatopties.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering has no remarks on the draft bill amending the Wft to implement the EU regulation on European green bonds and optional disclosures for sustainability-linked bonds, and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's reply notes a drafting improvement to article 1:77o Wft and an added explanation of how certain Member State options are handled.

36621.s: The bill amends several health, social support and youth laws to create or sharpen legal bases for data sharing between the Ministry of Health's agencies, municipalities, the CAK, care providers, the RIVM and the Wzd/forensic care chain, including sharing of health data that overrides medical confidentiality. It also removes the intent requirement from Wmo recovery of undue benefits, adds recovery powers for personal budgets under the Youth Act, and sets out that further rules will be made by general administrative order or ministerial regulation.
36621.j: The memorandum justifies the data-sharing powers by the need for effective fraud control, adequate monitoring of screening programmes, timely placement of court-ordered clients and reducing unintended refusals of vaccination, and argues the proportionality of overriding confidentiality.
q: This bill proposes amending Article 2.4.1 of the Wmo 2015 so that the double intent requirement lapses.
Met dit wetsvoorstel wordt voorgesteld artikel 2.4.1 Wmo 2015 te wijzigen waardoor het dubbel opzetvereiste vervalt.
d: Artikel IV (Wpg 6b, achtste lid; Wet op het RIVM art. 7a, zesde lid; Wmo art. 5.2.5b, zesde lid)
details of data to be provided and manner of provision for vaccination, screening and medical-care data sharing
Artikel II, onderdeel D (Wmo art. 5.2.5b, zesde lid)
data to be provided and manner of provision for medically necessary care to uninsured persons
which personal data are shared between care, justice and insurance bodies to place persons under court order
Artikel III (Wet op het RIVM art. 7a, zesde lid)
rules on data provided by care providers to screening programme executors
p: Removes the intent requirement for recovery of undue Wmo benefits and gives municipal boards discretion over whom to recover from, including providers and third parties.
Creates a statutory duty to share health data with the RIVM, overriding medical confidentiality, with an opt-out only for individuals who object.
Allows several public and private bodies to exchange health and criminal-law personal data about clients to prepare placement under a court order.
Obliges care providers to report uninsured patients' personal and health data to municipalities, overriding medical confidentiality, with a carve-out for known non-insurable persons.

parties: Asks whether consent and opt-out rights for patients are preserved and whether breaching medical confidentiality meets subsidiarity and proportionality.
Said members doubt whether the infringement of medical confidentiality here meets the requirements of subsidiarity and proportionality.
Genoemde leden twijfelen in dit geval of de inbreuk op het medisch beroepsgeheim hier wel aan de eisen van subsidiariteit en proportionaliteit voldoet.
Asks how clawback decisions left to municipal colleges will avoid unequal treatment of clients and how intent and client circumstances are assessed.
Can it be further explained how it will be ensured that this does not in practice lead to unjustified differences between municipalities to the detriment of clients?
Kan er nader worden toegelicht op welke wijze erop toegezien zal worden dat dit in de praktijk niet tot onterechte verschillen, ten nadele van de cliënten tussen gemeenten zal leiden?
Supports tougher anti-fraud tools for municipalities but asks whether the proposals suffice and when clawback may target providers versus clients.
It is not clear enough to the VVD members in which cases clawback may and may not be applied to the care provider and in which cases to the client.
Het is de leden van de VVD-fractie echter niet duidelijk genoeg in welke gevallen wel en niet mag worden teruggevorderd van de zorgaanbieder en in welke gevallen wel en niet van de cliënt.
Asks why the Raad van State's advice was not followed by writing clawback safeguards into the statute and how clients can appeal clawback.
How can the client appeal against clawback?
Hoe kan de cliënt in beroep gaan tegen terugvordering?
Asks the government to respond to the Raad van State's view that the clawback measure achieves the anti-fraud aim only to a limited extent.
The Council of State however indicates that with the proposed measure this aim can only be achieved to a limited extent.
